Generated with Nano Banana 2.1 

Bookmark and try it with prompt : 🔻
posts.prompt:
BRAND NAME = FLIPKART
Act as a Senior Social Media Art Director and Digital Collage Artist specializing in bold, high-impact e-commerce advertising campaigns for Instagram and digital platforms.
CAMPAIGN TITLE: “MORE TO EXPLORE.”
CORE MESSAGE: More choices. More discoveries. More possibilities.
PHASE 1: CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK
Create a dynamic digital collage that merges contemporary lifestyle photography with bold graphic design and playful commercial art direction.
The campaign celebrates the excitement of discovering everything in one shopping destination — fashion, electronics, beauty, home, appliances, and everyday essentials.
Aesthetic direction:
* Contemporary commercial editorial
* Youth-driven visual energy
* Playful retail storytelling
* Bold graphic experimentation
* Premium e-commerce advertising
Visual language:
Torn magazine edges, oversized typography, floating product cutouts, hand-drawn arrows, graphic stickers, paper textures, playful annotations, and bold colour blocking.
The final composition should feel like an international creative agency’s retail campaign, combining editorial photography with an energetic digital collage aesthetic.
PHASE 2: MODEL & PHOTOGRAPHY
* Subject: One stylish, confident Indian young adult model, age 22–28.
* Pose Energy: 80% attitude, 20% natural.
    (Dynamic walking pose, looking toward camera, holding a shopping bag, interacting naturally with products — NEVER static.)
* Outfit: Contemporary casual streetwear — oversized blue jacket, clean white innerwear, relaxed-fit trousers, and modern sneakers.
* Hero Products: A curated selection of lifestyle shopping categories, including a smartphone, headphones, sneakers, skincare, and a home accessory.
* Photography Style: High-end commercial lifestyle photography.
* Background Removal: Clean, sharp extraction with realistic edges.
* Camera Angle: Slight low angle with natural perspective.
* Crop: Full body or 3/4 body, with the model clearly visible.
The model must look authentic and photorealistic, with natural skin texture, realistic anatomy, expressive body language, and premium commercial photography quality.
PHASE 3: COLOR BLOCKING FOUNDATION
* Primary Color Blob:
    Large organic Flipkart-inspired bright yellow shape (40–60% of frame).
* Color Selection:
    1 dominant vibrant yellow with Flipkart blue and controlled white accents.
* Shape Style:
    Irregular, hand-painted / torn paper (NO perfect geometry).
* Texture:
    Brush grain / noise (15–25% opacity).
* Placement:
    Behind or wrapping around the model and product arrangement, creating a strong visual frame.
Use yellow as the dominant visual signature and blue as a contrasting graphic accent.
PHASE 4: GRAPHIC ELEMENTS LAYER
Add 3–5 abstract elements:
Element types:
* Hand-drawn shopping arrows and motion indicators.
* Product-inspired doodles and sketches.
* Irregular circles and organic blobs.
* Torn retail magazine fragments.
* Graphic stickers and handwritten annotations.
Rules:
* Colors: 2–3 total (primary + 1–2 accents).
* Placement: Asymmetric (top-left + bottom-right bias).
* Scale: Small (5%) + medium (15%).
* Avoid center clutter.
* Keep imperfect, handmade feel.
Product cutouts should appear naturally integrated into the composition, with realistic proportions, shadows, and reflections.
PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION
* Logo:
    Official Flipkart logo in the upper-left or upper-right (10–15% width). Preserve its accurate original logo proportions, blue-and-yellow identity, and shopping-bag symbol.
* Slogan/Headline:
    “MORE TO EXPLORE.”
* Supporting Copy:
    “Discover more. Shop everything you love.”
* Additional Microcopy:
    “THE EVERYDAY SHOPPING EDIT”
    “STYLE • TECH • HOME • MORE”
    “YOUR NEXT DISCOVERY STARTS HERE”
* Type Style:
    Bold sans-serif / grotesk / geometric, inspired by contemporary retail advertising and editorial typography.
* Treatment:
    Mix straight + slight rotation (2–5°). Use oversized typography with deliberate cropping and layered placement.
* Hierarchy:
    Logo → Headline → Supporting copy.
Typography must be sharp, correctly spelled, highly legible, and integrated naturally into the collage.
PHASE 6: TEXTURE & BACKGROUND
* Base Layer:
    Warm off-white / light grey (NOT pure white).
* Color Range:
    RGB 245–250 (warm neutral).
* Texture Options:
    Recycled magazine paper grain / subtle cardboard texture / analog print noise / torn paper edges.
* Rule:
    Texture should be FELT, not dominant.
Maintain strong contrast between the warm neutral background, vibrant yellow colour blocking, blue accents, and product photography.
PHASE 7: COMPOSITION RULES
* Layout:
    Asymmetric balance (model off-center).
* Breathing Room:
    15–20% negative space.
* Layering Order:
    Background → Color blob → Graphics → Product cutouts → Model → Typography.
* Focal Point:
    Model + shopping products = 60%.
    Graphics = 40% support.
* Movement:
    Strong diagonal flow
    (top-left → bottom-right OR reverse).
The composition should communicate variety and discovery without making the poster look like a cluttered product catalogue.
PHASE 8: BRAND INTELLIGENCE (AUTO-ADAPT)
Adapt energy based on Flipkart’s multi-category e-commerce positioning:
→ Fashion
Contemporary styling, confident poses, expressive fashion photography.
→ Electronics
Sleek product photography, sharp reflections, futuristic graphic accents.
→ Beauty & Personal Care
Clean product arrangements, premium textures, modern beauty editorial styling.
→ Home & Living
Warm lifestyle photography, inviting spaces, tactile product details.
→ Appliances
Bold product silhouettes, clean commercial lighting, strong visual hierarchy.
→ Everyday Shopping
Relatable Indian lifestyle moments, energetic compositions, approachable visual storytelling.
Maintain Flipkart’s recognisable yellow-and-blue brand identity while creating a distinctive campaign aesthetic.
PHASE 9: SOCIAL MEDIA FOOTER (OPTIONAL)
* Bottom strip (8–10% height).
* Light neutral background.
* CTA: “DISCOVER MORE ON FLIPKART”.
* Social handles / icons, if required.
* Clean grid layout.
* Keep minimal (contrast to collage).
TECHNICAL SPECS:
* Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (primary) or 1:1.
* Resolution: 2400 × 3000px+.
* Color Mode: sRGB (Instagram optimized).
* Sharpness: High detail, slight grain allowed.
* Output Style: Digital collage mimicking analog craft.
* Photography Base (before cutout):
    50mm or 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field.
FINAL ART DIRECTION:
Create a premium, Behance-featured e-commerce SMM campaign that feels like a collaboration between an international creative advertising agency and a leading Indian retail brand.
The final artwork must be visually bold, commercially engaging, compositionally sophisticated, and instantly recognisable as a Flipkart campaign.
STRICT RULES:
* Do not create a generic discount or sale poster.
* No fabricated prices, discount percentages, or promotional claims.
* No distorted product designs, logos, or brand marks.
* Do not alter or recreate the Flipkart logo incorrectly.
* Avoid random floating products without visual purpose.
* Keep the model and product selection as the primary visual focus.

Turn any photo into a beautiful hand-painted masterpiece with GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
A wide horizontal landscape hand-painted illustration of [LANDMARK NAME] in [CITY/COUNTRY] with strong emphasis on negative space and quiet composition.

The image features a warm off-white cream paper background that occupies 40-50% of the total canvas, creating generous blank margins and breathing room.

The [LANDMARK NAME] is positioned slightly off-center as a calm visual anchor, depicted through simplified [KEY ARCHITECTURAL FEATURES - e.g., "towering structures", "iconic silhouette", "distinctive archways"] with loose, expressive brush strokes. The landmark is suggested through minimal rhythmic marks and abstract color blocks in deep teal, cobalt blue, and forest green, rather than drawing every architectural detail precisely.

The composition is sparse and uncluttered: only a few carefully placed elements including 2-3 tiny human figures [DOING TYPICAL ACTIVITY - e.g., "walking", "taking photos", "sitting"] rendered as simple silhouettes in coral red and mustard yellow, one small [CONTEXTUAL ELEMENT - e.g., "cafe table", "bench", "street vendor cart"] with minimal shapes, two or three [NATURAL ELEMENTS - e.g., "potted plants", "trees", "flowers"] in emerald green, and subtle [CULTURAL/ARCHITECTURAL HINTS - e.g., "traditional roof lines", "modern glass panels", "historic columns"].

Large areas of the warm paper background remain completely untouched, especially around the edges and between elements.

The style combines mid-century travel poster aesthetics with contemporary [REGIONAL] editorial illustration: elegant, minimal, warm, cultured, and slightly nostalgic.

The texture shows loose hand-painted gouache and pastel marks with dry brush strokes, pastel smudges, wax-crayon edges, uneven color patches, imperfect handmade edges, and visible gaps between colored areas.

Colors are layered, dry, and tactile with a restrained palette of deep teal, sky blue, coral red, salmon pink, mustard yellow, ochre, terracotta, and small near-black accents, but used sparingly so each color can breathe against the paper.

The overall mood is quiet, spacious, relaxed, refined, like a sophisticated [CITY] cultural postcard or handmade art print suitable for premium lifestyle merchandise.

The landmark remains recognizable through its essential identity—[DEFINING CHARACTERISTICS]—but the drawing stays airy, calm, poetic, and softly abstract.

Strong sense of pause, breath, and refined emptiness with confident use of blank space.

No crowded composition, no full-bleed busy background, no photorealism, no glossy digital rendering, no clean vector art, no 3D rendering, no text, no signage, no logos, no readable text.

posts.text:
Transform your photo into a minimalist pastel crayon art poster using GPT Image 2.5

Prompt: Transform each uploaded photograph into a separate, independent, high-end editorial design poster. Process every photograph individually and generate one standalone poster per image. Never combine multiple photographs into a collage.

Overall Format & Composition

- Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical portrait.
- Divide the canvas into two perfectly equal horizontal sections.
- The upper and lower sections must each occupy exactly 50% of the total canvas height.
- Maintain a precise 50/50 division with no borders, frames, or transition strips.

Upper Half — Original Photograph

Preserve the original photograph in the upper half, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, pose, proportions, realistic textures, natural lighting, shadows, and original color atmosphere.

Apply only subtle, sophisticated color grading to achieve the visual quality of an art magazine, independent publication, or contemporary photography exhibition.

You may naturally extend the surrounding environment or background to fit the composition, but never stretch, distort, reshape, or alter the original subject.

The photograph should remain authentic and recognizable, with an understated, refined editorial aesthetic.

Lower Half — Minimalist Pastel Crayon Illustration

First, interpret the photograph to identify its most memorable central subject, visual relationship, structural direction, emotional atmosphere, and underlying visual metaphor.

Reconstruct this visual memory as a minimalist pastel crayon doodle illustration on lightly textured vintage-style paper.

Do not reproduce every object in the photograph. Avoid literal, complete tracing or detailed conversion. Instead, retain only the most recognizable silhouettes, gestures, directions, proportions, and defining visual elements that establish a clear connection with the original photograph.

Use artistic simplification, selective exaggeration, reduction, and subtle recomposition to create an illustration that feels expressive, spontaneous, and visually distinctive.

Main Subject — Hand-Drawn Crayon Aesthetic

Draw the primary subject using bold, coarse-grained pastel chalk and crayon outlines.

The lines should feel:

- Slightly thick, loose, and naturally imperfect.
- Dry, grainy, and powdery, with visible pigment texture.
- Irregular, with occasional broken strokes, faded patches, and subtle hand-drawn wobble.
- Softly rounded at the ends, with naturally incomplete and open contours.

Inside the subject, introduce only a few minimal pastel color accents, simple grids, stripes, dots, or spontaneous scribbles to suggest its essential structure.

Avoid realistic shading, dimensional rendering, excessive detail, or fully filled-in shapes. The illustration should feel like an expressive hand-drawn study rather than a polished digital drawing.

Surrounding Doodles — Consistent Visual Language

Any small decorative elements surrounding the main subject must use exactly the same crayon and chalk drawing language.

Reduce secondary elements to simple, instantly recognizable symbols made with just one or a few loose strokes.

Stars, flowers, plants, objects, environmental details, and abstract symbols should appear:

- Simple, naive, playful, and spontaneous.
- Primarily constructed from single-line outlines.
- Slightly irregular, open, and imperfect.
- Minimally colored, with very limited pastel fills.

Avoid polished icons, decorative stickers, vector graphics, or separate miniature illustrations.

Composition — Negative Space as the Main Design Element

Maintain the visual relationship of a small-scale stamp-like illustration surrounded by generous negative space.

Arrange the main subject according to its natural direction, proportions, and visual center of gravity.

The illustration may be asymmetrically positioned, slightly off-center, suspended in space, placed near an edge, or partially cropped.

Allow the main subject and a very small number of supporting doodle symbols to form a loose but intentional visual cluster.

Leave the remaining space deliberately empty.

Negative space must function as a primary compositional element. Create visual rhythm through:

- Empty space versus concentrated detail.
- Clustering versus separation.
- Contrasts in scale and proportion.
- Asymmetry and visual imbalance.
- A sense of breathing room, distance, and intentional pauses.

Less is more. Never fill the entire lower section. Resist the temptation to add unnecessary decorative elements.

Background — Clean, Light Paper Texture

Use an extremely light, bright, clean paper background.

Suitable tones include:

- Creamy white.
- Ivory white.
- Pale warm white.
- Soft off-white.
- Very light almond white.
- Extremely pale neutral white.

Intelligently match the paper's subtle undertone to the overall color temperature of the original photograph.

The paper should retain only a very subtle natural fiber texture and fine grain.

Avoid backgrounds that appear brown, yellow, muddy, dark gray, heavily aged, stained, or excessively vintage.

The background must remain significantly brighter than the illustration's outlines and color accents, ensuring that every crayon stroke, doodle, and decorative element remains crisp, distinct, and clearly visible.

Never allow the illustration to blend into the background.

Color Palette — Extracted from the Original Photograph

Extract 2–4 of the most vibrant, appealing, and emotionally representative colors from the original photograph.

Reinterpret these colors into a bright, soft, harmonious pastel crayon palette.

Depending on the photograph, the palette may naturally include:

- Peach pink.
- Apricot orange.
- Butter yellow.
- Mint green.
- Sky blue.
- Soft lavender.

Prioritize light, cheerful, warm, and visually friendly pastel tones.

The main subject's outlines should use clearly distinguishable colors that contrast against the light paper background, such as coral pink, soft blue, turquoise green, warm orange, lavender, or deeper creamy pastel tones.

Maintain a restrained and cohesive palette. Every color should feel intentional and connected to the original photograph.

Final Artistic Direction

The final poster should feel like a sophisticated experimental art publication combining authentic photography with spontaneous, minimalist, hand-drawn pastel illustration.

The upper half should communicate realism, atmosphere, and photographic depth.

The lower half should communicate memory, emotion, abstraction, and artistic interpretation.

The relationship between both halves should be immediately recognizable without requiring a literal reproduction of the photograph.

Prioritize artistic intelligence, visual restraint, expressive imperfections, delicate textures, and generous negative space.

The result should feel curated, contemporary, playful, poetic, and gallery-worthy — like a limited-edition art print from an independent creative studio.

video: wan 3.0 ($0.70)
image: seedream 5.5 ($0.03)

save this workflow to create your own:

1. find a reference video while scrolling

2. download it without the watermark

3. cut the before & after clips (use concut)

4. find a pic of a girl on pinterest & ask chatgpt for a prompt to create a new character

5. create a character sheet using seedream 5.5 with this prompt:

“Character turnaround sheet of the person from the reference photo, six views: full body front, side and back + super close-up front, side and back. Strictly keep 100% of face, hair, body, clothing and all details from the reference.
Clean gray background, consistent and natural lighting.”

“Replace the girl in {video} with the girl in {character sheet}.
Keep the same movements, camera quality, voice tone, background sounds, and hand gestures.
Remove the text from {video}.”

7. use concut to combine the two clips

this looks insanely real but costs $0.73 instead of $2k or CPM-based deals.

and you can use your own AI character for organic content or ads.

let me know if you want more prompts!

posts.prompt:
Create a 4×4 dance pose sheet featuring one original character, with exactly 16 equally sized panels in one square image.

CHARACTER DESIGN
Design a sharp cyberpunk hacker with an asymmetrical black-and-magenta bob, one glowing cybernetic eye, a fitted black tactical jacket with circuit-pattern accents, fingerless tech gloves with small screen displays, cargo pants, and chunky boots with neon soles. Keep her exact face, hairstyle, colors, proportions, outfit, and accessories fully consistent across all 16 panels — no redesigns, recolors, or costume changes between panels.

ART STYLE
Render in 2D anime, high-contrast cel-shading with neon rim light, with crisp outlines and consistent lighting across every panel.

CHOREOGRAPHY
Design a cohesive 16-pose dance sequence with a clear beginning, build-up, climax, and ending, ordered left to right, top to bottom. Include: an opening pose that establishes personality; a small rhythmic step with a coordinated arm gesture; a side step with one arm extended; a compact expressive gesture near the face; a grounded stance with arms crossing or sweeping inward; a knee lift or weight shift; an open expansive pose with arms spread; a playful balance pose; a turning pose showing a three-quarter rear view; a forward-reaching diagonal lean; a strong upward-reaching accent; a climactic jump (or full-body extension if jumping doesn't suit the character); a lowered stance with a forward gesture; a dynamic side-facing transition; a signature gesture unique to the character; and a confident final pose with a clear finishing silhouette.

COMPOSITION
Use a clean white background, thin grid lines, and small readable numbers 1–16 in the upper-left corner of each panel. One full-body depiction of the character per panel, consistent scale, camera distance, lighting, and rendering style throughout. Fixed camera angle while the character turns naturally. Keep the entire character — hair, hands, feet, wings, tails, and accessories — inside each panel with comfortable margins, with subtle ground shadows and natural secondary movement in hair and fabric.

AVOID
Repeated or near-identical poses, identity drift, costume changes, inconsistent proportions, extra or missing limbs, malformed hands, cropped body parts, overlapping panels, additional characters, motion trails, background scenery, unlisted props, speech bubbles, and watermarks.

Final output: one polished square image, a clearly organized 4×4 grid of 16 distinct, character-appropriate dance poses.
Video Prompt (Seedance)
Copy
Use this sheet for character appearance and choreography. Follow poses 1→16 from left to right, top to bottom, connecting them into one continuous dance.

Create a continuous 2D anime, high-contrast cel-shading with neon rim light animation of the character from the reference sheet, dancing in a plain white space. Preserve her exact face, hairstyle, colors, proportions, outfit, and accessories, matching the reference precisely in every frame. Keep her identity fully consistent throughout.

Her performance is sleek, controlled, and quietly intense, like every move is calculated.

Use a fixed front-facing camera in one uninterrupted full-body shot. Start immediately in pose 1. Keep her entire silhouette — including hands, hair, wings/tail if present, and feet — inside the frame with comfortable white margins. A soft light-gray oval shadow grounds her on the floor and remains during jumps.

The grid defines choreography order only. Show one character in one continuous space. No reference sheet, split screens, borders, numbers, captions, duplicate figures, afterimages, cuts, or camera movement.

Each numbered pose occupies 0.5 seconds (16 poses = 8 seconds total). Clearly articulate each pose's silhouette, then transition through natural movement into the next. Maintain continuous anatomy and weight transfer: feet push off and land, joints absorb impact, hips and shoulders guide turns. Hair, clothing, and accessories follow with slightly delayed motion. Avoid slideshow transitions, morphing, foot sliding, or sudden changes in limb position.

0.0–0.5s — Pose 1: She stands tall with feet shoulder-width apart, arms crossed over the chest, sharp confident gaze; uncrosses the arms and drops into a ready stance.
0.5–1.0s — Pose 2: She snaps into a low guarded stance with one fist forward, weight on the back leg; pushes off, driving one knee up.
1.0–1.5s — Pose 3: She strikes a wide power stance with one arm punched out to the side and the other pulled back at the hip; recoils and pivots the torso.
1.5–2.0s — Pose 4: She snaps the head and gaze toward camera, one hand raised near the temple in a sharp gesture; lowers the hand and steps wide.
2.0–2.5s — Pose 5: She crosses both forearms in an X-block in front of the chest, weight centered, elbows sharp; snaps the arms open and outward.
2.5–3.0s — Pose 6: She drives one knee up in an explosive step, both fists guarding the chest; plants the foot hard, transferring weight forward.
3.0–3.5s — Pose 7: She spreads both arms wide at shoulder height, chest open, chin lifted in a commanding presence; sweeps the arms down and inward.
3.5–4.0s — Pose 8: She pivots onto one leg with the opposite knee lifted, one fist raised overhead in triumph; lowers the leg and preps a spin.
4.0–4.5s — Pose 9: She spins into a three-quarter rear view with one arm trailing behind, looking back sharply over the shoulder; continues rotating back to the front.
4.5–5.0s — Pose 10: She lunges forward low with one arm punched straight ahead and the other braced back for balance; pushes back to standing.
5.0–5.5s — Pose 11: She reaches one arm straight overhead in a strong vertical line, the other braced at the hip; gathers energy as the knees bend to load a jump.
5.5–6.0s — Pose 12: She performs an explosive jump with both knees driving up and the arms thrown wide in a dynamic shape; lands hard but controlled, absorbing through both knees.
6.0–6.5s — Pose 13: She lands in a low crouch with one fist grounded, eyes up toward camera; rises slowly, shifting weight to one side.
6.5–7.0s — Pose 14: She rotates into a side-facing stance with one arm sweeping overhead and the other locked straight out to the side; rotates back to face camera.
7.0–7.5s — Pose 15: She snaps into a sharp signature pose (a salute, a fist to the chest, or a raised hand), holds briefly; releases into the final setup.
7.5–8.0s — Pose 16: She finishes in a wide, grounded power stance with one arm raised in a fist or open palm toward the sky, chin lifted, unwavering gaze; holds and settles.

Complete the final pose by 7.8 seconds and hold through 8.0 seconds while her hair and clothing settle.

Close-up portrait. The subject holds a bright orange fruit toward the camera with one hand while making a playful expression. Add cute white cat-face doodles on the fruit and handwritten text "WOW".

Full-body playful pose against the blue sky, standing on one leg with the other leg stretched sideways and arms spread out. Add handwritten text "egg tart" with small hearts and movement lines.

Side profile, holding an orange fruit near the face while looking at it. Add playful white doodles, cartoon eyes, and handwritten text "LOOK!".

Panel 4 (Middle Left):
Back view of the subject reaching upward with one hand, showing the large egg tart illustration on the back of the hoodie. Add a large hand-drawn white cloud outline and a small heart.

Panel 5 (Middle Center):
Front-facing portrait with both hands near the head, holding a small orange fruit beside the cheek. Add a white speech bubble containing "Hi".

Panel 6 (Middle Right):
Relaxed sitting pose with one knee raised, holding an orange fruit near the cheek. Looking slightly upward with a cute, confident expression. Add handwritten text "yum" and small decorative lines.

Panel 7 (Bottom Left):
Sitting casually with one hand touching the pink cap and an orange fruit resting above it. Eyes gently closed with a relaxed smile. Add playful crown-like doodles and small decorative hearts.

Panel 8 (Bottom Center):
Full back view, hands on waist, clearly displaying the oversized hoodie and its large yellow-orange egg tart artwork. Add curved white doodle lines around the subject.

Panel 9 (Bottom Right):

- Perfectly aligned 3×3 grid with nine equally sized rectangular panels.
- Consistent facial identity throughout all nine photographs.
- Sky-blue and deep cobalt-blue backgrounds.
- Bright natural summer sunlight.
- Realistic skin texture and natural anatomy.

- White handwritten doodles, hearts, clouds, stars, cartoon eyes, and motion marks.
- Maintain consistent outfit, hairstyle, cap, and accessories in every panel.
- No borders or gaps between panels.

Use casual, imperfect, hand-drawn white lettering. Include "WOW", "egg tart", "LOOK!", "Hi", and "yum" in the corresponding panels.

Final Output: A beautiful, cohesive 3×3 Korean-inspired summer fashion photo collage, vertical 3:4 composition, ultra-realistic photography, high detail, vibrant blue skies, and playful editorial storytelling.

Prompt:
Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Process each photo separately. Never combine photos into a collage, grid, split-screen, or multi-photo composition.

FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition, horizontally divided into two exactly equal 50/50 sections. Top 50% = original photography; bottom 50% = flat editorial illustration. Keep the overall design premium, clean, art-directed, visually balanced, and rich in negative space.

TOP 50% - ORIGINAL PHOT

Treat the uploaded photo as the single source of truth. Preserve the original subject, identity, facial features, body proportions, pose, expression, clothing, objects, environment, composition, colors, spatial relationships, lighting, shadows, depth, and photographic texture. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, distort, stretch, duplicate, or reinterpret the subject. Only subtle professional color grading is allowed, with the feel of an independent art magazine, premium travel editorial, or exhibition photograph. If more space is needed, naturally extend the existing background without altering the subject.

BOTTOM 50% - FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION

Reinterpret the same photograph as a playful, slightly awkward Korean-inspired flat editorial illustration. Identify and preserve the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, action, key relationships, and narrative of the original scene. Simplify them into rounded, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with clean solid fills and rough, imperfect black hand-drawn outlines featuring subtle wobble, uneven thickness, broken edges, and imperfect contours. Remove photorealistic lighting, shadows, perspective, and material textures. Avoid conventional cartoon or photorealistic styles. Aim for a contemporary Korean children's book, independent magazine graphic, or playful editorial artwork.

COMPOSITION

Keep one dominant focal point with secondary objects used only as accents. Create relaxed visual rhythm through varied scale, slight misalignment, overlaps, partial cropping, irregular spacing, and subtle asymmetry. Allow some shapes to extend beyond or overlap the composition. Use bold color blocks and generous negative space. Preserve key visual relationships without reproducing every detail. The illustration should feel designed, relaxed, and intentionally imperfect, never mechanically traced or cluttered.

COLOR

Extract the photograph's most distinctive colors and reinterpret them as a limited palette of high-purity, high-saturation flat colors. Use bold, clean color blocks and bright youthful contrasts. No gradients, realistic shadows, muddy gray tones, glossy effects, complex blending, or excessive texture. The palette should feel cheerful, energetic, childlike, warm, and visually confident.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL TEXT

Generate English text inspired by the photo's theme, action, emotion, atmosphere, or story. Integrate typography naturally into the

illustration.

MAIN TITLE: 2-4 English words, placed near the upper illustration area. Use playful, slightly handwritten, imperfect lettering; irregular alignment or capitalization is allowed.

SUBTAGLINE: One short, restrained English phrase below the title.

LOCATION / YEAR: Small editorial line in the lower-middle area. Use a verified location/year when known; otherwise use the subject, activity, event, or travel theme. Never invent a location.

POETIC MICRO-CAPTION: A short 1-2 line poetic or playful phrase, placed naturally within negative space, beside a color block, along

an edge, or on the visual axis.

SERIES NUMBER: Small, subtle editorial numbering such as "No.01" in a corner.

Typography may follow subject contours, align with color blocks, occupy negative space, overlap shapes slightly, rotate subtly, or use irregular spacing/cropping. Readability must remain strong. Title can be expressive; supporting text should stay clean and restrained.

Art DIRECTION

Combine real travel photography x playful flat illustration x premium editorial design x Korean graphic sensibility x travel diary aesthetics. The result should feel bright, youthful, cheerful, warm, playful, slightly quirky, sophisticated, and collectible-like a limited-edition travel art print or contemporary illustrated travel diary, not a generic tourist poster.

STRICT RESTRICTIONS

One photo = one independent poster. Never combine photos. Never invent a different scene, replace the subject, alter identity or pose, or introduce unrelated objects. Keep the bottom illustration clearly derived from the same photo shown above. No photorealistic illustration, excessive gradients, shadows, 3D/glossy effects, visual clutter, or overcrowding. The top and bottom must feel like two connected interpretations of the same travel moment.

Prompt: Transform the uploaded photo into a minimalist, hand-drawn, paper-textured artistic cover.

Composition

- The main subject should occupy only 10–20% of the frame.
- Position the subject near the bottom center of the composition.
- Leave generous negative space throughout the image.
- Suggest the environment using only a few lines or small blocks of color.

Preserve

- The most recognizable features of the original subject.
- The essential silhouette and proportions.
- The original pose or primary action.
- Important objects and defining details.
- The core story, relationships, and emotional atmosphere.

Color Palette

- Extract the dominant colors from the original photograph.
- Limit the palette to no more than four main colors.
- Use bold yet restrained, flat color blocks.
- Maintain a harmonious, muted color combination.
- Add subtle paper grain and handmade brush textures.

Simplification
Remove unnecessary details and visual clutter. Retain only the essential visual information needed to make the subject instantly recognizable.

Typography

- Optionally incorporate a small amount of simple text.
- Keep typography short, subtle, and aesthetically refined.
- Integrate the text naturally into the composition.
- Aim for the visual language of an art-book cover, independent publishing, modern editorial design, or a contemplative picture book.
- Do not force typography into the image if it doesn't improve the composition.

Style and Materials

- Delicate, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines.
- A few clearly defined acrylic-like flat color blocks.
- Rough, tactile paper texture.
- Visible handmade brushstrokes.
- Organic, irregular, natural contours.
- Subtle imperfections that make the artwork feel genuinely handmade.

Overall Mood
Quiet, poetic, sophisticated, minimalist, innocent, relaxed, artistic, thoughtful, distinctive, and premium.

Avoid

- Colored-pencil rendering.
- Dry-brush effects.
- Watercolor washes or bleeding.
- Pure line-art illustration.
- Overly detailed or realistic illustrations.
- Heavy impasto or thick oil-paint textures.
- Smooth, polished digital illustration.
- 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, or artificial lighting effects.
- Generic commercial cartoon styles.
- E-commerce advertising aesthetics.
- Generic poster templates.
- Excessive decorative elements.
- Overly complex compositions.
- Too much text.

Create an extraordinarily beautiful, photorealistic architectural travel photograph featuring [CITY / COUNTRY / LANDMARK], inspired by luxury travel photography, cinematic architectural composition and timeless fine-art photography.

1. The architectural framing

Create a dramatic foreground using a monumental traditional archway, historic doorway, stone corridor or distinctive architectural entrance associated with the destination.

The foreground should be dark, richly textured and intricately detailed, creating a natural frame around the landmark.

2. The magnificent reveal

Through the centre of the archway, reveal the destination’s most iconic landmark in all its glory.

Position the landmark as the central focal point, beautifully illuminated by soft natural daylight.

Preserve its authentic architectural details, proportions, materials and recognizable silhouette.

3. Composition and perspective

* Strong central symmetry and balanced architectural framing.
* A beautiful stone pathway or courtyard leading towards the landmark.
* Dark foreground contrasting with the softly illuminated background.
* Natural depth, realistic perspective and architectural scale.
* An elegant visual transition from shadow into light.

4. Lighting and atmosphere

Use soft golden daylight, subtle atmospheric haze and natural shadows. Create a beautiful contrast between the deep shadows of the foreground and the luminous landmark beyond.

The atmosphere should feel peaceful, timeless, majestic and slightly mysterious.

5. Photography style

Luxury architectural photography, cinematic fine-art photography, realistic stone textures, intricate craftsmanship, natural lighting, sophisticated tonal contrast, exceptional detail and professional travel-magazine quality.

6. Typography and destination identity

Add the destination name in large, bold, elegant uppercase lettering at the bottom of the composition.

Example: [DESTINATION NAME]

Below it, add a beautiful, meaningful tagline in smaller sophisticated typography.

Choose a tagline that reflects the history, beauty, identity or atmosphere of the destination.

Examples:

* PARIS — Where Every Street Tells a Story.
* EGYPT — Where Eternity Meets the Earth.
* JAPAN — Where Tradition Meets Tomorrow.
* ITALY — A Timeless Masterpiece.
* KASHMIR — Heaven Woven in Mountains.

Keep typography elegant, perfectly spelled, well-spaced and visually integrated without obstructing the architecture.

7. Final presentation

Vertical 2:3 premium collectible travel-art photograph, cinematic architectural framing, photorealistic details, luxury editorial finish and timeless composition.

Important: Select an authentic architectural frame appropriate to the chosen destination. Do not use the same archway for every location. The landmark must remain historically and architecturally accurate. Avoid artificial fantasy architecture, excessive decoration and cartoon illustrations

Transform the main subject in the uploaded photograph into a square miniature oil painting using a bold, heavily textured palette knife impasto technique.

1. PAINTING STYLE — EXTREME 3D TEXTURE

Apply thick, generously layered oil paint using bold palette knife strokes, creating a raised impasto surface that appears to protrude 3–5 mm from the canvas.

- Preserve visible directional knife marks, grooves, ridges, and uneven paint textures.
- Assume light comes from the upper left. Add bright highlights to raised paint and deep shadows to recessed and overlapping areas.
- Introduce subtle shadows along paint edges to create the illusion of individually layered, dimensional paint.
- Preserve the original subject's recognizable silhouette, essential colors, and overall composition, but simplify its form into expressive, thick paint masses rather than realistic photographic details.
- Avoid excessive detailing. Use a restrained number of bold, sculptural palette knife strokes while keeping the subject instantly recognizable.

2. BACKGROUND

Use a consistent warm ivory or creamy-white watercolor paper background with a subtle, slightly rough texture.

Keep the background completely flat and understated to emphasize the dimensionality of the painted subject.

3. TYPOGRAPHY

Add a small black handwritten-style title in a lower corner or the area with the most negative space.

Automatically identify the subject and generate suitable text:

- Food / Drinks: Dish or beverage name (e.g., Pancake, Earl Grey Cake).
- Products: Product name or category.
- People: Name or a short expressive phrase representing the subject.
- Animals: Animal name or species.
- Landscapes: Location name or a short descriptive phrase.

Use natural, slightly irregular, casually handwritten lettering. Avoid overly polished or standard-looking typography.

4. FORMAT & COMPOSITION

- Aspect ratio: Strictly 1:1 square.
- Position the main subject centrally.
- Maintain generous negative space around the subject.
- Show only the original main subject without introducing additional props or decorative objects.
- Keep the overall composition minimal, balanced, and visually refined.

FINAL RESULT: A premium miniature impasto oil painting with dramatically raised palette knife textures, realistic paint depth, expressive sculptural strokes, and a warm minimalist presentation. H&M also maintains proprietary fonts including HMSans, HMSerif, HM Amperserif and HMMove. So unlike the MANGO direction, this should be more energetic, graphic, youthful and high-contrast rather than Mediterranean/minimal. ⸻ PROMPT — H&M “NEW UNIFORM” FORMAT Ultra-Premium H&M Fashion SMM Promotional Poster Vertical 4:5 Instagram Hero Creative Global Fashion Retail Campaign Contemporary Fashion Advertising Commercial Fashion Graphic Design Agency-Level Art Direction Behance Front Page Quality 8K UHD Hyper-Realistic Fashion × Graphic Design × Street Culture Fusion High-Impact Visual Communication Zero AI Slop Zero Generic Fast-Fashion Advertising Zero Catalogue Aesthetic Zero Luxury-Copycat Aesthetic ⸻ CORE STRATEGY This is not simply a clothing advertisement. This is H&M turned into a visual statement. The campaign should communicate: fashion moves fast. culture moves faster. H&M should feel: accessible + expressive + contemporary + youthful + global + confident. The visual language should combine: H&M fashion campaign × editorial magazine × street-culture poster × high-fashion graphic design × digital-first social advertising The result should feel unmistakably H&M, not Zara, Mango, COS or a generic luxury fashion brand. This is: THE UNIFORM OF NOW. The clothes represent the constantly changing identity of a new generation. One day: minimal. Next day: street. Next: tailored. Next: experimental. H&M becomes the wardrobe that keeps up. The campaign message: THE UNIFORM CHANGES. YOU DON’T HAVE TO. ⸻ MASTER VISUAL Create an enormous typographic structure reading: H&M The typography should occupy approximately 60–70% of the entire composition. But unlike the MANGO concept, the H&M typography should feel: bold compressed graphic energetic slightly disruptive The giant H&M lettering can be: partially cropped, stacked, repeated, layered, hidden behind the model, intersected by red graphic blocks, cut by diagonal photographic frames, and pushed beyond the canvas. The typography should feel like a physical poster installation, not simple text. ⸻ HERO SUBJECT Young female fashion model. Contemporary global fashion appearance. Natural skin texture. Strong expressive face. Minimal but polished makeup. Confident expression. No artificial influencer smile. No exaggerated luxury pose. The model should feel like someone who actually belongs in the city. Youthful. Self-assured. Energetic. Culturally aware. ⸻ WARDROBE Create a contemporary H&M fashion look. HERO LOOK Oversized black leather-effect bomber jacket. Crisp white fitted tank. Relaxed wide-leg grey trousers. Chunky black footwear. Small silver jewelry. Structured mini shoulder bag. Subtle red accessory detail. Layered styling. The clothing should feel: accessible fashion elevated through styling. Not couture. Not runway costume. Not quiet luxury. Not excessive branding. The clothes should look genuinely wearable. ⸻ POSE / MOVEMENT The model is captured mid-stride. One foot forward. Jacket moving naturally. Hair slightly moving. Body turned approximately 15 degrees. Direct eye contact. One hand adjusting the jacket. Other hand relaxed. The image should feel like a moment captured rather than a pose performed. This directly aligns with H&M’s published preference for dramatic, in-the-moment/action-oriented imagery. ⸻ COMPOSITION TYPOGRAPHY 60–70% MODEL 20–25% GRAPHIC / PROMOTIONAL INFORMATION 10–15% Visual hierarchy: H&M ↓ NEW UNIFORM ↓ MODEL ↓ COLLECTION INFORMATION ↓ CTA Create strong visual tension between the model and typography. The model should partially cover the giant letters. ⸻ H&M COLOR SYSTEM PRIMARY H&M RED Strong saturated red. Use approximately: #E50010 as the primary visual reference. BLACK #000000 Used for: typography, fashion, graphic blocks, borders, micro typography. WHITE #FFFFFF Used for: negative space, copy, graphic panels, background areas. The recognizable H&M visual palette is strongly associated with red, black and white. ⸻ COLOR RATIO 60% White / light neutral 20% Black 15% H&M Red 5% photographic natural tones The red should be strategic, not flooding the entire poster. Use red as a visual trigger. Red graphic rectangle. Red typography. Red edge strip. Red accessory. Red CTA. The eye should naturally travel toward the red elements. ⸻ BACKGROUND Create a contemporary urban studio environment. White architectural walls. Concrete floor. Large geometric panels. Sharp sunlight. Hard shadows. One massive H&M red architectural block. Black graphic planes. Subtle paper/poster texture. The environment should feel halfway between: fashion studio and urban billboard installation. No recognizable city. No distracting scenery. No luxury hotel. No generic streetwear alley. The graphic environment itself should create the H&M world. ⸻ GRAPHIC DESIGN SYSTEM Create an aggressive but controlled editorial grid. Use: bold horizontal rules, vertical lines, red rectangles, black blocks, oversized numerals, micro typography, cropped type, collection codes, thin borders, small directional arrows, photographic crop windows. Introduce a subtle poster-within-poster system. For example: a small secondary campaign image appears inside a red frame. Beside it: 01 / 04 NEW SEASON H&M WOMEN This gives the composition the feeling of a sophisticated global fashion campaign rather than a basic Instagram advertisement. ⸻ TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM Use H&M’s established typographic character rather than generic fashion fonts. PRIMARY HEADLINE Condensed, uppercase, bold display typography inspired by H&M’s headline system. Extremely large scale. Tight leading. Minimal tracking. Hard geometric presence. H&M’s published style guide identifies a condensed caps-only headline typeface for high-impact headlines, while IBM Plex Sans is used for longer supporting copy. SUPPORTING COPY Clean grotesk / sans-serif. IBM Plex Sans-style characteristics. Highly readable. Neutral. Modern. ⸻ TOP LEFT Small official-style H&M logo placement. Below: FASHION FOR EVERYONE Very small. Do not compete with the hero typography. Preserve generous clear space around the logo. H&M’s published logo guidance stresses maintaining clear space and avoiding distortion or unsuitable treatment. ⸻ GIANT CENTER TYPOGRAPHY Massive: H&M Then layered behind it: NEW UNIFORM The giant H&M lettering should extend outside the frame. Crop: left side, top, right side. The typography should physically interact with the model. ⸻ CAMPAIGN TITLE Lower-left: NEW UNIFORM Use extremely bold condensed uppercase typography. Make UNIFORM substantially larger than NEW. Add a small red underline. ⸻ SUPPORTING COPY THE UNIFORM OF NOW. Secondary line: Designed for whatever comes next. Keep it short. No paragraph. No unnecessary marketing copy. ⸻ COLLECTION INFORMATION Small structured block: H&M WOMEN AUTUMN / WINTER 2026 COLLECTION 01 NEW SEASON FASHION / ESSENTIALS / STREET Use micro typography. ⸻ PROMOTIONAL STRIP Create a thin H&M red horizontal block containing: NEW ARRIVALS TRENDING NOW ONLINE EXCLUSIVE MEMBERS FIRST ACCESS White uppercase typography. The strip should feel integrated into the grid. Not like a sale banner. ⸻ CTA Bottom-right: SHOP NOW → Black rectangular button. White typography. Underneath: Explore the new collection Keep the button compact. ⸻ PRICE Bottom-right corner: FROM ₹999 Large enough to be commercially readable. But secondary to the fashion statement. Do not make the poster look like a discount advertisement. ⸻ BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP Thin black rule. Then: WOMEN / MEN / KIDS / DENIM / TRENDING / NEW ARRIVALS Centered beneath: ⸻ VERTICAL EDGE TEXT Right edge: H&M / AW26 Rotated vertically. Small. Precise. ⸻ RED GRAPHIC DEVICE Create one enormous H&M-red rectangle behind the model. Inside the rectangle: 02 Large black number. Underneath: THE NEW EVERYDAY This becomes the campaign’s visual signature. The red block should feel almost like a piece of Swiss graphic design translated into contemporary fashion advertising. ⸻ PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE High-energy fashion photography. Dramatic contrast. Sharp moment. Natural movement. Hard directional light. Deep shadows. Bright whites. Saturated H&M red. Natural skin. Realistic fabric. Subtle motion in clothing. H&M’s published style guide specifically calls for dramatic contrast and captivating in-the-moment imagery, with action shots as the primary photographic direction. ⸻ LIGHTING Large directional studio source. Strong side lighting. Controlled hard shadows. Bright white highlights. Deep black clothing separation. Red surfaces receiving rich saturated light. Natural skin exposure. No beauty-dish glamour. No soft luxury haze. No excessive bloom. No artificial neon. ⸻ CAMERA ARRI Alexa Mini LF 50mm fashion/editorial lens Slightly low camera angle. Full-body composition. Fast-fashion campaign energy. Moderate depth of field. Extremely sharp clothing texture. Natural movement. High dynamic range. Premium commercial fashion photography. ⸻ POST-PRODUCTION Contemporary global fashion campaign grading. Clean whites. Deep blacks. Highly saturated controlled red. Natural skin tones. Subtle film grain. Visible textile texture. Crisp typography. Sharp graphic edges. Controlled contrast. No excessive retouching. No plastic skin. No artificial HDR. No fake luxury glow. No cinematic teal-orange grade. No excessive grain. ⸻ BRAND SAFETY / CONSISTENCY The final visual must immediately read as: H&M without relying solely on the logo. Brand recognition should come from: red / black / white bold condensed typography dramatic in-motion photography accessible contemporary styling graphic campaign language youthful global fashion energy strong commercial communication Do not make it resemble: ZARA’s restrained editorial minimalism. MANGO’s Mediterranean warmth. COS’s architectural minimalism. Prada’s intellectual luxury. Louis Vuitton’s heritage luxury. The visual identity must remain H&M. ⸻ FINAL FEEL If: H&M × a global fashion magazine × a contemporary graphic design studio × street culture × a giant urban billboard created one campaign together. Not a catalogue. Not a generic fast-fashion ad. Not a luxury fashion imitation. Not a simple red-and-white poster. A high-impact H&M campaign where typography, movement, fashion and graphic design become one visual system. Vertical 4:5 — 8K UHD — hyper-realistic — dramatic in-the-moment fashion photography — H&M red/black/white palette — oversized condensed typography — precise editorial grid — realistic human anatomy — natural skin — detailed fabrics — accurate H&M branding treatment — crisp readable typography — premium commercial photography — agency-level art direction — Instagram hero creative — Behance front-page quality — print-ready.

GPT image 2.5

Prompt:
Create an exceptionally striking, premium minimalist travel-art poster featuring [COUNTRY / CITY / LANDMARK], designed as part of an exclusive international collection titled:

“DESTINATION IN SHAPES”

1. UNIQUE VISUAL IDENTITY

Transform the destination into a bold geometric landscape using simplified architectural forms, angular mountains, overlapping shapes, dramatic silhouettes and carefully composed negative space.

Capture the most recognisable visual identity of the destination without making it look like a conventional photograph.

2. DESTINATION-INSPIRED COLOUR PALETTE

Choose a distinctive colour combination inspired by the destination’s geography, culture, architecture and natural environment.

Every destination must have its own colour identity. Avoid repeating the same palette.

Examples:

* Japan — Vermilion red, warm ivory and deep charcoal.
* Italy — Mediterranean blue, lemon yellow and terracotta.
* Morocco — Burnt orange, desert sand and deep teal.
* Iceland — Glacier blue, icy white and volcanic black.
* India — Saffron, indigo and warm cream.
* Greece — Cobalt blue, white and soft coral.
* Switzerland — Royal blue, scarlet red and ivory.
* Egypt — Golden ochre, turquoise and midnight navy.

3. TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT

* Oversized, bold, modern sans-serif typography.
* Destination name prominently positioned at the top.
* Small elegant descriptive text underneath, featuring 3–4 destination-related keywords.
* A small geometric emblem or symbolic detail representing the destination.
* Strong editorial composition with generous negative space.
* A clean, sophisticated international travel-poster aesthetic.

4. SIGNATURE DETAILS

Include one small, distinctive visual element associated with the destination, such as a cable car, sailing boat, traditional doorway, rising sun, palm tree, train, bridge or architectural detail.

5. ART DIRECTION

* Flat vector-style geometric illustration.
* Bold silhouettes and crisp edges.
* Beautifully layered shapes.
* Subtle paper texture.
* Sophisticated colour blocking.
* Contemporary Swiss graphic design influence with an original artistic interpretation.

FINAL RESULT

A visually unforgettable, beautifully balanced, collectible travel poster. Minimal yet expressive, colourful yet sophisticated.

Portrait 2:3 composition. Ultra-clean professional graphic design.

Display only the destination name and short geographical descriptors. No artist signature, no watermark, no unnecessary text

Create an exceptionally beautiful, sophisticated minimalist geometric architectural travel poster featuring [LANDMARK NAME], [CITY], [COUNTRY].

1. CENTRAL ARCHITECTURAL SUBJECT

Feature the iconic landmark as the dominant central attraction.

Illustrate its recognisable architectural structure using simplified geometric shapes, clean silhouettes, elegant curves and carefully constructed flat-colour forms.
Preserve the landmark’s distinctive architectural identity, proportions and signature details.
Transform complex architectural details into beautifully simplified artistic elements.
Integrate the architecture naturally into the surrounding abstract landscape.

2. ORGANIC GEOMETRIC LANDSCAPE

Create an imaginative environment using a combination of abstract geometric and organic forms.

Oversized circles, semicircles and curved shapes representing the sun and moon.
Flowing hills, layered mountains and abstract landscape formations.
Architectural arches, rectangular frames and sculptural platforms.
Overlapping organic shapes creating beautiful depth and dimension.
Simplified trees, water bodies, pathways and natural elements.
Large geometric foreground elements framing the landmark.

Every shape should feel intentional, balanced and artistically connected.

3. DISTINCTIVE COMPOSITION

Create a visually striking composition inspired by contemporary Swiss graphic design, Bauhaus principles and modern editorial illustration.

Strong central architectural arrangement.
Beautiful interaction between positive and negative space.
Layered foreground, middle ground and background.
Oversized abstract forms framing the architecture.
Elegant asymmetrical balance.
Bold shapes with carefully controlled proportions.
Avoid unnecessary details and visual clutter.

4. UNIQUE DESTINATION COLOUR PALETTE

Develop a completely distinctive colour identity inspired by the destination’s cultural character, architecture and natural environment.

Use approximately 5–7 carefully coordinated colours.

Combine bold contrasting tones with sophisticated muted shades, warm neutrals and occasional unexpected accents.

Every destination must receive its own original palette. Never repeat colour combinations across the collection.

5. COLOUR AND SHAPE INTERACTION

Use large areas of solid colour, subtle overlapping forms and beautifully controlled tonal transitions.

Crisp, clean edges.
Smooth organic curves.
Flat graphic illustration.
Subtle paper-grain texture.
Minimal gradients used selectively.
Beautiful colour blocking.
No excessive photorealism or 3D effects.

6. POSTER TYPOGRAPHY

Include sophisticated editorial typography.

Main title: [DESTINATION NAME]

Secondary text: [COUNTRY]

Add a small poetic tagline inspired by the destination.

Use elegant oversized contemporary serif or refined modern sans-serif typography.

Typography should feel like an integral part of the composition rather than an afterthought.

7. FINAL ART DIRECTION

A beautiful fusion of minimalist architecture, organic geometry, contemporary graphic design, modernist illustration and premium international travel poster aesthetics.

The finished artwork should feel timeless, intelligent, artistic, visually memorable and suitable for a prestigious design exhibition.

Museum-quality graphic composition, exceptional colour harmony, clean silhouettes, refined details and sophisticated visual storytelling.

Portrait 2:3 format. No borders, no watermark, no unnecessary text. Preserve the authentic recognisable identity of the landmark.

《中國傳統色｜二十種有來處的顏色》

中國傳統色 × 宋式冊頁 × 同色系意象 × 極細豎排色票。

全輯20色，一色一卡。每張嚴格1:6直式，600×3600px，sRGB PNG。指定HEX純色滿版，頂部1200px保持完全均勻的原始純色供取樣。無邊框、角花、白色題籤。

【宋式意象】

一色一意象，以宋式冊頁美學自由構圖。探索筆墨、材質、疏密與虛實，意象以主色深淺塑形，自然融入中下段，保留清晰結構、柔和暈染與大片留白。

繁體色名以行楷直題，筆鋒、字形及粗細變化清楚，與意象共同形成視覺重心。

【20色與意象】

01｜暮山紫｜# 74647D｜灰紫遠山、薄霧
02｜朱砂｜# B94135｜朱紅漆盞、器口
03｜月白｜# DDE7EE｜清亮白瓷、瓷緣
04｜石青｜# 356C9E｜藍銅礦斷面
05｜海棠粉｜# E8A9BE｜斜入海棠花枝
06｜柿色｜# DB762B｜帶青蒂的熟柿
07｜梔子黃｜# E9AE28｜裂開的梔子果
08｜鵝黃｜# F7E7A0｜淡黃絨羽
09｜柳綠｜# ABB84E｜初展柳芽
10｜茶葉末｜#636440｜青褐釉細斑
11｜梅子青｜# 8DA288｜龍泉青瓷厚釉
12｜石綠｜# 2B8059｜孔雀石環紋
13｜天青｜# 80ADB0｜汝窯釉面、細開片
14｜縹｜# A7BADF｜輕薄藍絹
15｜靛青｜#233652｜靛染布褶
16｜青蓮｜# 53428D｜冷紫蓮花
17｜赭石｜# A46F51｜赭石乾擦筆痕
18｜栗色｜#634332｜光澤栗殼
19｜德化白｜# F3E7CC｜德化白瓷衣紋
20｜墨色｜#242426｜濃淡墨痕

【封面】

01暮山紫兼封面，色名旁增加兩列繁體直題：
「中國傳統色」
「二十種有來處的顏色」

【底部排版】

三組文字統一使用IBM Plex Mono Variable，字重150，極細清晰，依底色調整文字明度。

左下DeepBlue：76px，整個單詞順時針旋轉90°，由上往下閱讀。
右下HEX：68px，逐字豎排。
最右卡號：62px，分三組豎排，如「02」「/」「20」。

三組錯落平衡，保留底部留白。

【簽名】

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

本系列採用特別版：取消獨立藍點及手寫筆觸。DeepBlue改用上述極細字體，僅將首字母D的封閉內腔填入#0B3D91，外輪廓與其他字母同色。藍色完整限制於內腔，保持D的形狀與可讀性。

【製作與驗收】

AI創作宋式意象，使用固定600×3600px畫布合成精確sRGB純色底、清晰書法及真實字體排版。

核對尺寸、頂部HEX像素值、繁體字形、卡號、文字方向及D內腔填色。保留自然筆墨，避免文字柔化。

每張獨立PNG，逐張輸出，不拼圖、不壓縮打包。

posts.prompt:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical travel-editorial artwork combining romantic European street photography, delicate watercolor illustration, and elegant botanical storytelling.

PURE GENERATION:
Generate the complete artwork from the written concept alone. Create a sophisticated, artistic composition that blends the romantic atmosphere of Paris, the timeless charm of Tokyo, and the historic beauty of Istanbul into one cohesive visual story.

MAIN COMPOSITION:
Design a luxurious fine-art travel poster on warm ivory handmade watercolor paper with subtle paper grain, natural pigment textures, soft edges, and delicate artistic imperfections.

At the top section, feature a cinematic, photorealistic European city street after gentle rain. Elegant cream-colored historic buildings, tall arched wooden windows, traditional storefronts, wet reflective pavement, and warm sunlight filtering through the trees create a nostalgic Parisian atmosphere.

In the middle section, transform the same street into a delicate watercolor illustration. An elderly couple, dressed in elegant dark coats, walks peacefully away from the viewer, holding hands. Their quiet companionship represents enduring love, memories, and a lifetime of shared moments. In the distance, reveal a subtle Eiffel Tower silhouette framed by beautiful Parisian architecture.

FLOWER STORY:
Place a single deep crimson-red rose in the foreground, its velvety petals covered with tiny raindrops. The rose should be sharply detailed, naturally illuminated, and emotionally expressive without looking artificial.

Blend this scene with a second botanical composition featuring a graceful white lily with delicate ivory petals, golden stamens, and fresh green leaves. Position the lily beside a softly painted panoramic view of Istanbul, with the magnificent Blue Mosque in the background, its elegant domes and slender minarets fading gently into the atmospheric distance.

Add subtle Japanese-inspired cherry blossom branches near the upper edges, with pale pink flowers and a few drifting petals, creating a poetic connection between Eastern and Western visual traditions.

ARTISTIC STYLE:
Combine realistic architectural photography with sophisticated watercolor painting, delicate ink outlines, botanical illustration, and premium travel-magazine art direction.

Use soft watercolor washes, fine pigment granulation, natural paint splashes, gentle bleeding edges, and graceful transitions between realistic and illustrated sections.

COLOR PALETTE:
Warm ivory, antique cream, muted beige, soft taupe, charcoal gray, dusty pink, crimson red, botanical green, pale blue, and subtle golden highlights.

LIGHTING AND ATMOSPHERE:
Soft natural daylight after rainfall, warm reflections on wet pavement, gentle cinematic depth, delicate atmospheric haze, and a peaceful romantic mood.

DESIGN AND LAYOUT:
Maintain generous negative space around the main artwork.
Use an elegant editorial composition with a balanced vertical flow.
Allow the photographic scene to transition organically into the watercolor illustration.
Keep the flowers as prominent foreground elements while the architecture provides a beautiful sense of place.
Add tiny artistic ink splashes and restrained botanical details around the edges.
The final result should resemble an exclusive fine-art travel poster created by a professional illustrator.

TYPOGRAPHY:
At the bottom, add a small, elegant, widely spaced serif title:

“WHERE LOVE BLOOMS”

Below it, add a delicate subtitle:

“PARIS • TOKYO • ISTANBUL”

Use refined editorial typography in dark charcoal with subtle spacing and excellent readability. Keep all text minimal and secondary to the artwork.

QUALITY:
Ultra-detailed architectural elements, realistic flower textures, refined watercolor brushwork, harmonious composition, professional art direction, premium print quality, high-resolution rendering, natural proportions, and museum-quality fine-art aesthetics.

ASPECT RATIO:
4:5 vertical poster.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Low resolution, blurry flowers, distorted architecture, malformed buildings, inaccurate mosque structures, artificial-looking petals, oversaturated colors, excessive visual clutter, harsh outlines, plastic textures, cartoon appearance, excessive contrast, poorly rendered people, deformed hands, duplicated flowers, messy typography, misspelled text, watermarks, logos, and unnecessary decorative elements.

FINAL RESULT:
A breathtaking, romantic, premium travel-editorial artwork where Parisian nostalgia, Japanese floral elegance, and Istanbul's historic beauty unite through rain, flowers, architecture, and the timeless language of love.

Impasto oil painting on coarse canvas, thick sculptural palette-knife paint standing in raised ridges, wide 16:9 panoramic composition, symmetrically mirrored scene. Edge to edge, no frame, no border.

CONCEPT: a still lake splits the canvas dead centre into a perfect horizontal mirror line, the upper half the world and the lower half its exact rippled reflection.

SKY upper: pale silver-white torn cloud banks of heavy thick knife-paint, their undersides shaded grey-cream, opening in the middle to a band of soft duck-egg turquoise and pale aqua. Low on the horizon, a warm blush of peach, apricot and faint rose glows behind a distant ridge.

MOUNTAINS: a soft pale blue-lavender ridge sits in the centre distance, hazy and simple, its crest catching the warm horizon light.

TREES: on both shores stand tall slender cypresses in deep teal-blue and near-black, their surface built from dense vertical knife-scrapes. Around them cluster rounded bushy trees in pale ice-blue and silvery turquoise. The trunks are dark and faint, and thin bare branches on the right shore rise against the sky. The tree masses crowd both banks symmetrically, framing the water.

BANKS: narrow strips of pale silver-tan bank with fine grass strokes run along both sides at the waterline.

WATER: the mirror surface is painted in long horizontal knife-drags, its colour a vivid saturated turquoise shading to deep indigo, with wide pale gold and peach patches where the horizon glow reflects.

REFLECTION lower: every element repeats downward upside-down — the cypress spires pointing down, the bushy crowns as silvery fans, the sky as torn pale slabs, all of it smeared by horizontal knife ridges and broken into flat elongated flecks like floating debris.

PALETTE: teal blue, turquoise, silver-white, pale aqua, slate, peach and apricot glow, near-black cypress. Heavy tactile ridges, matte glossy paint, serene and dreamlike, clean and unmarked.

TOP SECTION — THE REAL WORLD

Use the actual destination as the primary visual reference.

Create a breathtaking photorealistic travel photograph of [DESTINATION].
Preserve its recognizable architecture, landscape, landmarks and geographical identity.
Capture beautiful natural lighting, realistic colours and atmospheric depth.
Include a few subtle human elements, boats, streets or local details where appropriate.
Keep the composition cinematic, clean and visually immersive.

Create an elegant transition between photography and illustration.

Include the country name in small uppercase lettering.

Use delicate hand-drawn decorative elements, tiny botanical details or a minimal location emblem.
Maintain generous white space and a refined editorial layout.

The lower illustration must be an artistic interpretation of the SAME location shown above, not an unrelated scene.

ART DIRECTION

Premium illustrated travel magazine aesthetic.
Contemporary minimalist editorial design.
Beautiful balance between photography and fine art.
Delicate watercolor and mixed-media textures.
Sophisticated typography and generous negative space.
Soft, harmonious colour palette.
Elegant, clean and collectible poster appearance.

FINAL COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 poster.
Upper half: approximately 50% photorealistic destination photography.
Lower half: approximately 50% minimalist watercolor illustration.
A subtle, elegant transition between both worlds.
Destination name clearly visible and beautifully typeset.
No creator watermark, no unnecessary text, no clutter.

COUNTRY: [COUNTRY]

posts.prompt:
Create a single unified ultra-realistic cinematic scene, NOT a split image, NOT a collage, and NOT two separate images.

A young woman is sitting calmly on a massive dark rocky structure beside the water during a dramatic golden sunset. She has long flowing dark brown hair, an olive-green oversized jacket, a simple light-colored shirt, wide-leg faded blue jeans, and white sneakers. She sits naturally with one hand resting against her cheek, looking slightly upward toward the sunset with a soft, peaceful and hopeful expression.

Behind her, create a huge broken circular portal made of dark ancient stone and glowing molten-golden energy. The circular ring is partially shattered, with realistic chunks of stone, dust, sparks, and debris floating around the broken sections. The glowing golden energy illuminates the woman from behind and creates beautiful cinematic rim lighting around her hair and body.

On the left side, a large cracked dark stone wall contains elegant handwritten glowing text:
“A Stronger Me Ahead”
with a small glowing heart underneath.

In the same single composition, the foreground continues naturally into shallow reflective water. The entire scene — the woman, rocky structure, broken glowing portal, sunset, clouds, and distant city skyline — creates a realistic reflection in the water below. The reflection should be visible directly beneath the main scene, slightly softer, dreamy, and naturally distorted by gentle water ripples, while remaining clearly recognizable.

The background features a distant modern city skyline beside the water, silhouetted against dramatic orange, golden, and dark-gray clouds. The sun is low on the horizon and creates a beautiful long golden reflection across the water.

IMPORTANT COMPOSITION:
Everything must exist inside ONE continuous physical environment and ONE cohesive image. [CITY / DESTINATION NAME]

[COUNTRY]

A breathtaking fusion of miniature architecture, layered paper sculpture, handcrafted papercraft, whimsical storytelling and premium contemporary travel poster design.

Extremely intricate craftsmanship, sophisticated colour harmony, realistic paper shadows, beautiful depth, exquisite architectural details and museum-quality presentation.

Portrait 2:3 composition. No watermark, no unnecessary text, no photorealistic buildings, no plastic appearance.

This prompt turns your pet into a 4×4 pixel-art sprite sheet. I tried it with my cat, and it should work with any pet.

Prompt in thread 🧵
posts.prompt:
Here's my prompt:

Turn the pet in my uploaded reference image into an adorable pixel-art sprite with a subtle, seamless looping animation.

PET REFERENCE
Use the uploaded image as the visual reference. Preserve the pet’s species, recognizable colors, markings, body shape, eye color, and distinctive features, including any visible accessories.

Adapt the pet into cute chibi proportions while keeping its natural anatomy recognizable. Preserve species-appropriate legs, paws, wings, fins, tails, ears, shells, or other features. Do not add limbs or features the animal does not have. Do not turn the pet into a human-shaped character or default to a cat-like design.

If the reference is cropped, infer the missing body details naturally from the visible animal. If multiple pets appear, use the most prominent pet unless I specify otherwise.

STYLE
Create crisp, charming pixel art with clearly defined square pixels, clean outlines, gentle shading, and a cohesive limited palette.
Use expressive features appropriate to the animal.
No blurry edges, smooth vector styling, photorealistic rendering, or anti-aliased outlines.

POSE AND ANIMATION
Create 16 consecutive frames of one gentle, species-appropriate idle animation.

Choose a comfortable resting, standing, perched, or hovering pose that suits this pet’s anatomy. Prefer a front-facing or slight three-quarter view that shows its recognizable features.

Include:
- A subtle breathing or resting motion appropriate to the species.
- One small secondary motion, such as an ear twitch, tail sway, feather settling, antenna movement, or gentle fin movement.
- One brief natural blink only if the species has movable eyelids.

Choose only movements that make sense for this animal. Animals without movable eyelids must not blink. Do not force paw gestures, sitting poses, or mammal-like expressions onto other species.

Keep the animation restrained and readable:
- Keep the pet in the same position.
- Anchor feet or other contact points for grounded animals.
- For swimming or hovering animals, keep the body centered with minimal drift.
- Keep the anatomy, markings, accessories, proportions, camera angle, and scale consistent.
- No walking, turning, large gestures, camera movement, or scene changes.
- Make the last frame transition smoothly back to the first.

SPRITE SHEET
Arrange the 16 frames in exactly 4 columns × 4 rows, ordered left to right, top to bottom.

Canvas: 1024 × 1024 pixels.
Each cell: 256 × 256 pixels.

Use identical alignment, a fixed body anchor, and a consistent baseline across all cells.
Choose a scale that accommodates the pet’s widest animation pose.
Keep the entire pet inside each cell, with at least 16 pixels of transparent padding on every side, including around moving tails, wings, fins, ears, and accessories.

These are consecutive frames of the SAME pet, not separate character variations.
No overlapping cells, grid lines, labels, text, or watermarks.

TRANSPARENCY
Use a genuinely transparent RGBA background with alpha zero outside the pet.
Do not draw a checkerboard or add a solid background, scenery, floor, water, or cast shadow.
Preserve white and pale details inside the pet.

If background removal is necessary, use a careful foreground mask. Do not globally erase a color that also appears in the pet’s body, markings, or accessories.

DELIVERABLES
Complete the actual files, not just instructions:

1. A transparent 4 × 4 PNG sprite sheet at 1024 × 1024 pixels.
2. A transparent animated GIF of the single pet, using all 16 frames at 256 × 256 pixels, looping forever with a 2.4-second cycle: 150 milliseconds per frame.
3. A ZIP containing all 16 individual transparent PNG frames, named frame_01.png through frame_16.png in playback order.

Use available image-generation and file-processing tools to generate the artwork, split the sheet, and assemble the GIF.

Split the sheet into equal cells. Keep every exported frame on the same 256 × 256 canvas. Do not independently crop or scale frames, as this can cause jitter.
Use nearest-neighbor sampling if resizing is needed to preserve crisp pixels.
Configure GIF transparency and frame disposal so previous frames leave no trails.

QUALITY CHECK
Before exporting, inspect all 16 frames and preview the assembled animation.

Check for:
- Consistent species, anatomy, markings, and limb count.
- Stable body position, scale, and contact points.
- Clipped ears, tails, wings, fins, or accessories.
- Stray pixels or fragments from neighboring cells.
- Accidental removal of pale or white body details.
- Background artifacts, unwanted position jumps, or GIF trails.
- A smooth transition from the last frame back to the first.

Fix any issues before delivering. Ensure the PNG files and GIF have genuinely transparent backgrounds.

Provide the finished files with a GIF preview and download links.

If your environment cannot create or attach an animated GIF or ZIP, clearly state which deliverables could not be completed. Do not present a static image as a completed animation.

Create a 3:4 vertical poetic vintage editorial poster using the uploaded photograph as the sole reference. Maintain a clean, minimalist composition with retro magazine typography and authentic multicolour halftone print texture.

Study the original photograph and identify the most distinctive subject suitable for an upward-extending composition. Preserve its defining features, original perspective, proportions, pose, and relationship with other subjects. Do not introduce unnecessary objects.

BACKGROUND & COLOUR: Simplify the original environment while retaining essential scene details. Reduce distracting elements into a few harmonious, softly blended colour areas. Extract muted, low-saturation vintage colours from the original photograph rather than replacing the entire background with a solid colour.

TOP SECTION: Reserve approximately one-third of the upper canvas as clean, warm ivory-white space. Add two short English poetic lines that complement the photograph's mood, using subtle, small typewriter-style typography with generous spacing.

MAIN TYPOGRAPHY: Select one meaningful English word that reflects the photograph's subject. Display it across the middle in oversized, high-contrast uppercase serif lettering, leaving balanced side margins. Extract its colour from the photograph's most representative tones, ensuring strong contrast.

SUBJECT INTEGRATION: Extend the original photographic subject naturally upward from the lower scene, passing through and slightly obscuring selected letter strokes. The subject should visibly rise above the typography into the upper ivory space. Preserve realistic anatomy, proportions, perspective, and photographic detail. Never stretch, distort, or make the subject appear to float. Keep the word clearly readable.

SEAMLESS TRANSITION: Maintain one continuous composition. Use the subject's natural silhouette, original lighting, simplified background colours, and gradually fading halftone dots to transition organically into the warm ivory upper space. Avoid rectangular divisions, straight horizontal cuts, cutout edges, harsh gradients, or excessive haze.

HALFTONE PRINT EFFECT: Apply fine, clearly visible circular CMYK-style halftone dots to the large typography and main photographic colour areas. Use denser dots in shadows and lighter spacing in highlights, with subtle cyan, magenta, and yellow misregistration for authentic vintage printing. Keep background dots softer and sparser. Preserve the upper ivory paper area relatively clean, without heavy aged-paper textures. Avoid ordinary digital noise, stains, or scratches.

ORIGINAL PHOTO INSET: Place a small thumbnail of the complete original photograph in the upper-right corner, occupying approximately 15–18% of the canvas width. Preserve its original proportions, colours, and full framing without cropping or editing. Add a fine border and the exact label “ORIGINAL”, ensuring clear spacing from the poetry and main subject.

FINAL AESTHETIC: Maintain a refined visual hierarchy: the photographic subject and oversized typography should dominate, the poetry should remain secondary, and the background should be understated. Enhance the lighting mood to complement the original photograph while preserving realistic photographic textures.

Ensure all English text is correctly spelled. No additional titles, watermarks, unnecessary decorations, or extra labels. Output exactly one complete, polished 3:4 vertical poster, not a collage or mockup.
