posts.prompt:
以下のプロンプトを、キャラクターイラストを添付してGPT-Image-2.6で実行して下さい。
※最下部の入力欄に「予算」のみ設けてますので、そちらに希望の数字（0円～）を入力。空欄の場合はおまかせになります。

【予算絶対主義・ファッション広告生成プロンプト】

【基本指示】

添付画像の人物／動物／異形／ロボット／ぬいぐるみ／建造物／乗り物／家具／道具／食品／植物／その他あらゆる被写体を参考に、指定予算内で新規調達した衣装・装飾品による「全身・全体像ファッション広告ビジュアル」を1枚制作してください。
原型・個性の絶対保持 × 元衣装の完全無視 × 画面全体の画風統一 × 現実の販売相場 × 購入品先行確定 × 厳密な計算 × 正確な文字合成 × 自己陶酔型広告。
最初に現実的な購入品と価格を確定し、その購入品だけでコーディネートを設計。被写体本来の姿・頭身・表現形式を保持し、衣装／装飾／背景／商品画像／文字／タイポグラフィまで元画像の画風に合わせてください。
現実的なのは購入価格・商品構造・材質・調達条件であり、描画表現を写実的にする必要はありません。
低予算では貧相さや不完全さ、高予算では価格相応の豪華さを表現。ただし広告のデザイン品質は予算に関係なく一流。
基本構図：4:5縦長。

【1. 制作工程・順序厳守】

PHASE 1：添付画像から原型／身体的特徴／頭身／画風／色彩／描画技法を分析。元衣装は参照対象から除外。生成当日の日付・季節・記念日を確認。
PHASE 2：予算と被写体のサイズに適した購入候補を、現実の国内販売相場から調査。新品／中古／セール／特注品を区別。
PHASE 3：購入候補を選択し、税込単価／数量／小計／送料／部材／施工費を計算。購入台帳／TOTAL／残金を確定。
PHASE 4：確定購入品だけでコーディネートを設計。予算不足なら購入点数を削減し、必要に応じて黒いゴミ袋／新聞紙で補う。
PHASE 5：元画像の画風を衣装・背景・装飾・広告グラフィックへ統一した文字なしビジュアルを生成。
PHASE 6：購入台帳との照合／原型保持／画風統一／未購入品の混入を監査。違反があれば画像を修正。
PHASE 7：元画像の表現形式と調和する書体・文字組みを設計し、確定台帳の数字とコピーを正確なテキストとして合成。
PHASE 8：価格／文字／画風／購入品／全体構成を最終監査して完成。
後工程の都合で購入品や価格を無断変更しないこと。変更が必要なら購入台帳を更新し再計算。画像生成と文字合成は、利用可能な場合は必ず別工程で実行。

【2. 原型・種族・アイデンティティの絶対保持】

添付画像の種族／姿／顔／髪／瞳／体型／頭身／骨格／構造／シルエット／素材感を忠実に再現。
人は人／動物は動物／異形は異形／機械は機械／ぬいぐるみはぬいぐるみ／建物は建物／モノはモノ。
元から人型でない限り、擬人化／美少女化／イケメン化／人型化は禁止。

人間・人型：顔立ち／髪／瞳／年齢感／性別表現／頭身／身体比率を保持。

動物：種族／骨格／四肢／翼／ヒレ／尾／毛並み／鱗／模様／姿勢を保持。

異形：特殊器官／角／牙／触手／四肢の数／非対称性を保持。

ロボット：外装／パネル／関節／センサー／機構／プロポーションを保持。

ぬいぐるみ：布地／縫い目／綿の膨らみ／柔らかさ／造形を保持。

建造物：屋根／窓／扉／柱／階数／外壁／建築様式を保持。

乗り物：車体／車輪／翼／窓／機構／外形を保持。

その他：元の形状／素材／構造／用途／特徴を保持。
メカクレ／アホ毛／オッドアイ／左右非対称の髪型／頬の傷／ほくろ／身体模様／角／牙／義肢／特殊パーツなどを保護。位置／形／左右関係を変更しないこと。
身体の一部や不可分の外装は保持。着脱可能な元衣装・服飾品は流用禁止。

【3. 元衣装の完全無視】

元衣装のデザイン／配色／柄／素材／シルエット／重ね着／ジャンル／アイテム構成／装飾モチーフを一切参考にしないこと。
色違い／素材違い／簡略化／リメイクによる流用も禁止。
元衣装は存在しなかったものとして、被写体の身体的特徴／性格／年齢感／種族／世界観／季節から完全新規コーデを設計。
ただし身体そのものの特徴は保持。着脱可能な象徴的服飾品も無料流用せず、必要なら新規購入。
元衣装のデザインは無視するが、元画像の描画技法・配色傾向・視覚的世界観は必ず参照すること。この2つを混同しないこと。

【4. 画風・描画技法・表現形式の完全統一】

最重要：画風を保持する対象はキャラクター単体ではなく、完成広告の画面全体です。
被写体／新衣装／靴／靴下／タイツ／アクセサリー／背景／建造物／小道具／商品紹介画像／広告装飾／文字デザインまで、元画像と調和する一貫した美術表現で制作してください。
元画像の主線／線の太さ／輪郭処理／塗り／陰影段階／色数／彩度／明度／質感／ディテール密度／デフォルメ／遠近感／空気感を分析し、画面全体へ適用。

ドット絵：被写体・衣装・背景・小物・商品カード装飾まで同一のピクセル表現。ピクセル密度／階段状輪郭／限定色／陰影段階／ディザリングを統一。滑らかな高精細化禁止。

ローポリ：衣装・背景・装飾も角張った少数ポリゴンの面構成に統一。写実的な布や光沢を混在させない。

ボクセル：被写体だけでなく衣装・背景・小物も立方体の集合構造で統一。

アニメ・漫画：キャラクターと同じ線画／セル塗り／影の段数／ハイライト／色設計で衣装と背景を描写。実写素材の貼り付け禁止。

ノーライン・フラット：衣装／背景／小物も輪郭線に頼らない色面設計。写実的な布の陰影や写真風の質感を追加しない。

実写・写真：被写体／衣装／背景を実写・フォトリアルで統一。アニメ化・イラスト化禁止。

3DCG：元のモデリング／マテリアル／シェーディング／レンダリング傾向で画面全体を統一。

水彩・油彩・切り絵・版画・クレヨンなど：衣装／背景／装飾にも元の筆致／色面／画材感／質感を反映。

その他：独自の描画技法／解像感／色数／抽象化の程度を維持。
SDはSD／ドットはドット／実写は実写のまま。モデル体型化／脚長化／小顔化／不自然な大人化は禁止。

【現実の商品を元の画風へ翻訳】

現実の販売相場に基づいて商品を選定しても、その商品を実物写真のように描く必要はありません。
価格・素材・商品構造・販売条件は現実的に設定し、その視覚表現のみ元画像の画風へ変換してください。
例：アニメ調なら中古ジャケットもアニメの塗り／ドット絵なら高級ドレスもドット絵／フラット絵なら革靴も整理された色面／水彩なら金属アクセサリーも水彩表現。
素材の違いは元画像の技法内で表現し、リアルな繊維・革の毛穴・金属反射・写真風のシワ・過剰な陰影を勝手に追加しないこと。
安価な商品は元の画風内で品質や使用感を表し、高価な商品も元の画風内で素材・装飾・構造による豪華さを表現。
現実的な価格設定と写実的なレンダリングは完全に別の概念として扱ってください。

【背景との画風一致】

背景も元画像の美術設計で新規制作。キャラだけがイラストで背景が実写写真という構成は禁止。
輪郭／色彩／陰影／遠近感／ディテール密度／質感を統一。スタジオ撮影風の演出も元画像の画風で再解釈すること。
写実的な被写界深度／レンズフレア／写真風の布や床材／高精細3D背景などを、元画像に存在しないのに追加しないこと。
背景の情報量は元の画風を尊重し、キャラクターと衣装を主役にしてください。

【5. 初期装備・所有物】

撮影用の衣類・装飾品を一切所有していない状態から開始。
人間・人型は一般的な下着のみ初期装備として許可。下着代は予算対象外。動物・異形・機械・無生物は自然な身体／体毛／鱗／外装／構造を維持。
購入対象：上着／トップス／スカート／ズボン／ワンピース／靴／サンダル／靴下／ニーソックス／タイツ／ストッキング／レギンス／ベルト／帽子／髪飾り／リボン／バッグ／アクセサリー／その他すべての着用品・装飾品。
私物／借り物／拾得物／廃材／プレゼント／無料配布品／未計上品は禁止。新品・中古・セール品の購入は可能。

【6. 日付・季節・記念日】

画像生成当日の日本時間を基準に、季節／気候／祝日／年中行事／記念日を反映。
衣装／装飾／背景／配色に自然に取り入れる。季節対応の着用品も予算内に計上。
記念日が不明なら捏造禁止。予算不足なら防寒着／靴下／タイツなどを省略してよい。季節感のために無料衣装を追加しないこと。

【7. 現実の販売相場・価格検証】

購入品を決める前に、日本国内で販売されている同種商品の相場を調査。
確認項目：カテゴリ／販売店の種類／新品・中古・セール条件／素材／品質／サイズ／状態／税込価格／送料／数量。
可能なら実際の販売情報を参照し、価格／条件／調査時点を確認。実在商品は価格の参考とし、広告上では架空ブランド・商品名を使用してよい。
架空商品でも価格は現実相場に準拠。新品の靴48円／タイツ10円／高級コート100円／大型建築装飾100円など、不自然な安値は禁止。
中古品は状態／使用感／販売経路に見合う価格にする。特注品・大型装飾は材料費／加工費／施工費を考慮。
税抜価格は税込へ換算。送料が必要なら計上。セット商品は実際の販売単位で購入。
予算に合わせて参考価格を勝手に下げないこと。
販売情報を確認できない場合は、確認済みと偽らず保守的な推定相場を使用。価格根拠が不確かな商品は避け、価格設定しやすい商品に変更。

【8. 購入台帳・計算の先行確定】

画像生成前に購入台帳を作成。
記録：商品ID／カテゴリ／商品名／架空の購入元／購入条件／相場根拠／税込単価／数量／小計。
送料／取付部材／施工費は必要に応じて独立項目で計上。
商品小計＝税込単価 × 数量
TOTAL＝全商品小計＋必要な送料・部材・施工費
残金＝指定予算 − TOTAL
必須条件：TOTAL ≤ 指定予算／残金 ≥ 0／TOTAL＋残金＝指定予算。
すべて整数円で計算。税込価格への税金二重加算は禁止。左右1組・セット商品は実際の購入単位で計算し、標準付属品を重複計上しない。
予算超過なら商品を削除・変更して最初から再計算。予算を使い切る必要はありません。
検算①全小計を加算してTOTALを確認。
検算②予算から各費用を順次減算して残金を確認。
検算③TOTAL＋残金＝指定予算を確認。
可能なら電卓・計算プログラムで検算。確定台帳を唯一の数値情報源とし、後工程で金額を再推定・変更しないこと。

【予算おまかせ】

空欄なら被写体に最適なコーデの方向性を先に設定し、相場に基づき必要な商品を選定。購入合計に応じて適正予算を決定。無理な節約・高額化は不要。計算と検算は通常と同様。

【9. 購入品だけでコーディネート設計】

確定した購入台帳の商品だけで被写体に似合うコーディネートを構成。商品の無断追加／価格変更／条件変更は禁止。
元衣装の構成は参照せず、被写体の個性／確定商品／季節からスタイリング。
服飾カテゴリを全部そろえる必要はありません。優先順位：適切な被覆／主要衣類／安全・季節対応／靴・靴下・タイツ／帽子・バッグ／装飾品。
靴がなければ裸足／靴下がなければ素足／タイツがなければ生脚／バッグがなければ手ぶら。
スカート・ズボンが購入できなければ必要に応じて救済素材で補う。靴／靴下／タイツ／ストッキングは別購入品。明細にないなら着用禁止。
商品デザインは現実的な購入条件に従い、絵柄だけを元画像へ合わせること。画風を合わせるために商品構造や価格を変更しない。

【10. 無料救済措置：黒いゴミ袋／新聞紙】

最低限の被覆や必要な衣装を購入できない場合に限り、撮影用特例として黒いゴミ袋／新聞紙を無料使用可能。
表記：「撮影用特例支給 ¥0」。
黒いゴミ袋：即席ワンピース／スカート／簡易ズボン／マント／覆い布／カバー。
新聞紙：簡易衣服／巻きスカート／折り紙帽子／包装／装飾。
素材らしさ／折り目／シワ／印刷面／薄さ／安っぽさを元の画風で表現。写実的なゴミ袋や新聞紙だけをイラスト上へ貼り付けないこと。
高級布・革・金属に偽装しない。折る／巻く／結ぶなどで加工し、追加のテープ／紐／留め具が必要なら費用計上。
人型では胸部／腰部／臀部を適切に覆い、下着や露出を強調しないこと。人外・建物・乗り物は無理に装着せず、装飾なしも許可。
無料素材はこの2種類のみ。購入台帳の有料品と区別。

【11. 被写体別ドレスアップ】

人間・人型：新規衣服／靴／小物。

動物：骨格・動作に適した衣装／首輪／ハーネス。

異形：特殊器官・骨格に合う衣装／装身具。

ロボット：外装アクセサリー／専用カバー／装飾パネル。

ぬいぐるみ：小型衣装／帽子／布製アクセサリー。

建造物：旗／バナー／のれん／装飾布／ガーランド／イルミネーションなどの外観装飾。

乗り物：ラッピング／デカール／専用装飾パーツ。

家具・家電・道具：カバー／ラッピング／装飾。

食品・植物：包装／盛り付け／容器／飾り付け。
元の形態／構造／用途／安全性を保持。擬人化は禁止。
建造物は建物そのものをモデルに見立てて飾り、屋根／窓／扉／階数／建築様式を変更しない。大型装飾はサイズ相応の材料費・施工費を計上。低予算は部分装飾、0円なら装飾なしも許可。
追加装飾だけでなく背景・風景・広告デザインにも、元画像の画風を適用してください。

【12. 画風統一の文字なし広告生成】

購入台帳とコーデ確定後、初めて画像生成を実行。
生成対象：元の姿の被写体／確定購入品／救済素材／同一画風の背景／広告装飾／商品紹介用画像／文字配置用の余白。
文字・価格・商品名・TOTAL・キャッチコピーはまだ描かない。
最重要：被写体だけでなく、新衣装・小物・背景・広告の枠や装飾まで元画像の画風に統一すること。
アニメキャラに実写衣装／ドット絵キャラに滑らかな服／フラット絵キャラに高精細3D背景／水彩キャラに写真風小物など、表現形式の混在は禁止。
商品カードの単体画像も確定商品の外観を元画像の画風で描写。実物写真や写実レンダリングを貼り付けないこと。
元の頭身／骨格／構造を保持し、全身・全体像を描写。買えなかった部位をトリミングで隠さない。
広告としての構図・デザインは高品質にしつつ、元の画風が持つ単純化／色数／質感／平面性／デフォルメを尊重。
背景・撮影設備・広告制作費は予算対象外。被写体に装着する照明や装飾は費用計上。

【13. 生成画像の監査】

文字合成前に画像と購入台帳を照合。
着用品：帽子／髪飾り／上着／インナー／シャツ／スカート／ズボン／ベルト／靴下／ニーソックス／タイツ／ストッキング／レギンス／靴／バッグ／アクセサリー／装飾品。
建物・乗り物は取付装飾／固定部材／設置物を確認。
台帳にない着用品は削除。購入品の形・色・数量が異なる場合は修正。
原型／頭身／アイデンティティ／種族／画風を確認。衣装や背景だけが写実化されていないかも検査。
画風違反があれば、衣装・背景・小物を元画像の表現形式へ描き直す。商品価格や種類は変更しないこと。

【14. 正確な文字合成・タイポグラフィの画風統一】

文字は画像生成後、確定購入台帳から正確なテキストとして合成。可能なら専用の文字描画・画像編集機能で直接配置し、画像生成AIに金額を書き直させないこと。
ただし、文字を正確にするために、元画像と無関係な無機質なフォントや写実的な雑誌デザインを持ち込まないでください。
書体／字形／太さ／角の丸み／字間／行間／傾き／縁取り／影／装飾／文字配置を、元画像の画風・世界観・色彩・線の特徴に合わせて設計してください。

【画風別のタイポグラフィ】

ドット絵：ピクセルフォント／階段状の文字輪郭／整数倍のドット感／ピクセル単位の配置。数字もドット風だが正確に判読可能にする。

ローポリ・ボクセル：角張った幾何学的書体／直線的な装飾／ブロック状の見出し。

アニメ・漫画：元の線画に合う見出し／漫画的な強弱／セル塗り調の縁取りや影。

ノーライン・フラット：輪郭線を抑えた平面的な文字／整理された色面／シンプルな図形装飾。

水彩・手描き：元の筆致と調和する柔らかな文字／にじみや紙質を感じる装飾。ただし数字は鮮明に描画。

レトロ・版画：印刷物らしい書体／元の色数に合わせた文字色／素朴な版ズレや質感。

実写：実写ファッション広告に適したタイポグラフィ。

その他：元画像の表現様式から自然な文字組みを設計。

【文字合成の原則】

文字は可読性確保のため高解像度で描画してよいが、デザイン上は元画像の画風を維持すること。「高解像度」と「写実的・現代的なデザイン」は同義ではありません。
ピクセル文字は実際にドット形状で構成／手描き風は正確な文字を手描き風の字形で配置／フラット絵は平面的な文字設計にする。
正確な字形と数字を維持しながら、元の世界観へ溶け込ませてください。
掲載項目：キャッチコピー／コーデ名／指定予算／商品名／架空購入元／購入条件／税込単価／数量・小計／TOTAL／残金／救済素材。
確定台帳の数値をそのまま使用し、再計算・推測・変更は禁止。同一商品の価格は全表示箇所で統一。
商品数が多い場合は主要カードと簡潔な明細に分け、全費用を確認可能にする。
文字サイズ／色／背景との明度差を調整し、数字・商品名を読みやすくする。装飾で文字を崩したり数字を変形させたりしないこと。
文字合成機能がない場合は、正確な数字を生成できたと偽らず、確定明細を画像外のテキストとして提示。

【15. 自己陶酔型キャッチコピー】

メンズナックル系ファッション誌を思わせる、自己陶酔的／挑発的／芝居がかった／厨二病的／根拠のない自信に満ちたセリフ風コピーを作成。
被写体の性別／外見／年齢感／性格／種族／形態に応じて一人称／語尾／語感を変更。元キャラの性格・口調を優先。
クール系は孤高／元気系は強気／可愛い系は無邪気な自信／お嬢様系は優雅／異形は神秘性／動物は習性／ロボットは演算・性能／建造物は歴史・存在感を反映。
参考：「財布は空でも、俺の美学に値下げはない。」「靴を履かないんじゃない。大地が俺を選んだんだ。」
毎回新しいコピーを考案。人外のセリフ上の擬人化は許可、ビジュアルの擬人化は禁止。
予算0円でも自己評価は最高級。衣装の貧相さと自己陶酔の落差を活用。
キャッチコピーの文字デザインも元画像の画風に統一すること。

【16. 最終監査・完成判定】

原型：種族／姿／頭身／構造／アイデンティティを保持したか。

元衣装：デザイン／配色／アイテム構成を流用していないか。

画風：被写体／衣装／小物／背景／商品画像／広告装飾／タイポグラフィまで統一されているか。

写実化：元が非写実の場合、新衣装や背景だけが写真風・高精細3Dになっていないか。

相場：商品の品質／状態／サイズ／購入条件に対して価格が現実的か。

台帳：商品／購入元／単価／数量／小計／送料／部材／施工費を確認したか。

計算：小計の総和＝TOTAL／予算−TOTAL＝残金／TOTAL＋残金＝予算。

着用品：購入していない服／靴下／タイツ／靴／小物が描かれていないか。

文字：価格／商品名／TOTAL／残金が台帳と一致し、元画風と調和しているか。

救済：無料素材は黒いゴミ袋・新聞紙のみか。

演出：当日の季節／記念日／コピー／広告品質が適切か。
違反があれば該当工程に戻って修正。価格を都合よく下げる／未購入品を無料扱いする／画風の不一致を放置する／数字の誤りを演出で隠すことは禁止。

【最重要原則】

元の種族／姿／構造／頭身／アイデンティティを保持。

元衣装を完全無視。ただし元画像の画風・美術表現は徹底的に継承。

現実の販売相場から購入品を決定し、台帳と計算を確定。

確定購入品だけでコーデを構成し、元の画風へ翻訳。

キャラクター／衣装／背景／商品カード／装飾を同一画風で生成。

生成画像と購入台帳を照合し、未購入品・写実化を修正。

正確な文字を別工程で合成し、タイポグラフィも元画風に統一。

最終監査後に完成画像を出力。
現実の相場を守ることと、実写風に描くことは別。
買っていないものは着ない。元の衣装は引き継がない。元の画風は画面の隅々まで引き継ぐ。
予算不足なら省略／裸足／黒いゴミ袋・新聞紙で対応。
人は人、動物は動物、モノはモノ。元がドットなら背景も衣装もドット。
広告の品質は高めても、元の表現形式を別物に変えてはいけません。
お金はなくても、自己陶酔だけは無制限。

-----

A Renaissance masterpiece, reimagined with me as the woman in the painting. Preserving the original artwork while bringing my own identity into it.

Created with GPT Image 2.6.

Prompt 👇
posts.prompt:
Use the uploaded personal photo as the identity reference and the uploaded classical painting as the artwork reference.

Recreate the original painting with the person’s face from the personal reference photo seamlessly replacing the face of the original subject.

IMPORTANT: Preserve the original artwork exactly. Keep the original subject’s hairstyle, head covering, clothing, jewellery, body position, hands, pose, accessories, background, lighting, composition, colours, and artistic details unchanged.

Only replace the facial identity. The new face must clearly resemble the person in the uploaded personal photo, preserving their distinctive facial features, skin tone, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and natural proportions.

Blend the new face naturally into the original painting. Match the original artwork’s expression, head angle, lighting, shadows, perspective, brushwork, texture, and colour grading so the face looks as though the person was originally painted by the artist.

プロンプト：GPT Image 2.5

A vintage Showa-era offset-lithograph printed illustration, horizontal 3:2, a "find the hidden cats" picture in the spirit of a classic seek-and-find book: a night festival (engi-nichi) in the grounds of a Japanese shrine, seen from a high, wide bird's-eye view so that everything is small and there is a huge amount to look at. In the middle stands a tall wooden drummers' tower (yagura) with a red-and-white striped curtain and two taiko drummers on top; a ring of about twenty bon-dance dancers circles it, and strings of glowing paper lanterns run from the tower out to the stalls. Two long rows of stalls with striped canvas awnings line the left and right of the central ground: cotton candy, takoyaki, candy apples, a shooting gallery, water-balloon fishing, balloons, roasted corn. Behind them a stone torii gate, stone steps up to a small shrine hall, big old trees, and a dark blue night sky with fireworks. In front, a crowd of about 150 tiny people in yukata and happi coats: children with balloons and candy apples, a child on a father's shoulders, a vendor flipping takoyaki, a policeman guiding the crowd. A standing person is only about 3% of the picture height, every figure drawn tiny and crisp.

The look is the point: printed with only four spot inks, vermilion red, teal blue, mustard yellow and sumi black, on aged cream paper. All other colors come from overprinting (red over yellow = orange, blue over yellow = green, blue plus black = night sky). Thin black key lines, flat color areas, visible halftone dot screens for the glow of lanterns and fireworks, slight misregistration with thin colored fringes, uneven ink, paper fibre, yellowed foxing and tiny printing specks. It must read as a real old printed page, not a digital painting. Full bleed, no border, no registration marks, no signature.

Exactly one small logo: a modest dark wooden signboard hanging at the front of the shooting-gallery stall in the right half, about 5% of the picture width, showing a cream cat paw print whose big pad holds a swirling ocean wave, with the word "Shoji" in cream cursive brush lettering to its right. Apart from that sign there are no letters, words or numbers anywhere; lanterns, curtains and awnings show only stripes, dots and pictures.

Exactly four cats are hidden in the scene and no other cat or animal anywhere (no fish, birds, insects, dogs, foxes, stone guardian lion-dogs, animal masks, cat ears or cat silhouettes). The four cats stand in the same row of stalls, at the same distance, and are all tiny: the three real cats each only about 1.5% of the picture height, about two fifths of a standing person, Shoji Cat a little taller; easy to overlook but findable, never hidden behind anything, none in the lower third of the picture:
1. a black-and-white "hachiware" cat (black head and back, a white blaze splitting the face, white chest and paws) sitting upright on the counter of the cotton-candy stall on the left, among the cotton candies next to a white tub;
2. a brown mackerel tabby (warm brown fur with dark stripes, white muzzle and chest) sitting upright on a shelf board of the prize shelf of the shooting-gallery stall on the right, among the round prizes;
3. a calico cat (white with orange and black patches) sitting upright on the top rim of the water-balloon fishing tank below the shooting gallery;
4. Shoji Cat, an upright orange tabby cat about three heads tall in a black leather jacket, denim shorts, cream sneakers and black wayfarer sunglasses with blue and red lenses, dancing the bon dance with both arms raised among the human dancers in the open sand around the tower, a little taller than the other three cats.
The first three cats wear a thin red collar with a tiny gold bell. No dark round objects or dark animal-like shapes that could be mistaken for a cat. No watermark.

posts.text:
GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
image1 = MY PHOTO. Everything in the poster comes from here — the subject, the scene, the objects, the details and the setting.

Turn @image1 into a single high-end design poster. 3:4 vertical, split into two zones of strictly equal height, 1:1, each occupying 50% of the frame, divided by one clean horizontal edge. One poster only — no collage, no multi-image grid.

TOP HALF
The original photograph from @image1, preserving the subject's identity, structure, pose, real texture, natural light and shadow and original colour atmosphere, with only a subtle refined grade so it carries the quality of an art magazine, an independent publication or a lifestyle editorial. The environment may be naturally extended to fit the frame, but never stretch, distort or alter the subject. Full bleed, no border.

BOTTOM HALF — THE SCENE MAP
Extract the most recognisable subject relationships, object details, everyday details and narrative memory points from @image1, and rebuild them as a life-fragment Scene Map — an acrylic collectible catalogue laid out on paper.

Do not reproduce the photograph. Freely select roughly 4–7 of the most memorable elements from it: part of a person, food, a drink, an object, a plant, an animal, an architectural feature, a landmark, a vehicle, or a small detail carrying emotional value.

OBJECT TREATMENT
Each element is rendered as a real photographed object with crisp, tangible texture — never flattened into cartoon or vector style. Treat them with a soft lifestyle palette: natural light, clean highlights, creamy bright areas, a light soft haze, clear translucent shadows, a comfortable warm-cool balance. Reduce harsh contrast slightly and lift the colours so each object feels gentle, refined, clean and soothing, while still looking genuinely photographed.

Encase each one in a transparent rounded acrylic or resin shell that follows its silhouette with a soft rounded outline, like a sealed gel pouch or a clear collectible keepsake. Give the casing slight visible thickness, a delicate bright highlight along its upper edge, faint refraction where it meets the object, and a soft contact shadow beneath it on the paper. It should read as a real physical miniature collectible, not a plastic 3D toy and not a sticker.

LAYOUT
Do NOT use a fixed four-square grid, evenly spaced rows or uniform sizing. Organise the elements dynamically by their own size, orientation, shape and visual weight.

Choose one composition: diagonal flow, an S-shaped route, a circular enclosure, staggered vertical offsets, a stepped rhythm, radiating from a centre, two clustered groups, entering from the edge, or asymmetric floating. Elements may differ sharply in scale, rotate slightly, partially overlap, sit against the edge or be cropped.

Keep one clear reading path and generous white space on a warm off-white paper background with a faint natural grain — lively but not chaotic, relaxed but ordered.

CONNECTIONS
Between elements, add thin dashed lines in soft blue, curved arrows, small route nodes, location pins, dots, brackets and light hand-drawn strokes, following the flow of the composition. Not every element needs connecting. Lines may detour, skip, break off or form small local loops, so it reads like a carefully arranged private memory map rather than a flowchart or an infographic.

TEXT — ALL IN ENGLISH
Every piece of text in the poster is in ENGLISH. No Japanese, Chinese or Korean characters anywhere.

Write "Scene Map" as a large handwritten script title in the upper-left corner, in soft blue ink, loose and flowing across two lines. Beneath it, two small handwritten lines — a short poetic phrase naming the place or moment, and a hashtag. For example "fragments of a day in paris." and "#seine memory". Add a small hand-drawn wave or squiggle beneath them.

Divide the composition into three perfectly equal horizontal panels, separated by thin, clean white lines. Each panel must show a complete, beautifully framed close-up portrait with no awkward cropping.

STYLE & OUTFIT:
Soft, voluminous dark hair styled in a slightly messy high bun with delicate loose strands and a pink floral scrunchie. The same adorable, extremely fluffy grey-and-white Ragdoll kitten with big crystal-blue eyes, a tiny pink nose, and soft pink paw pads appears consistently in all three panels.

PANEL 2 — SWEETEST MOMENT:
She rests her cheek against the peacefully sleeping kitten, giving the camera a cute, natural wink and a gentle closed-mouth smile. Both look comfortable and affectionate, creating a heartwarming portrait.

She rests her cheek on one hand while holding the kitten close. The kitten gazes lovingly up at her with curious blue eyes as she looks thoughtfully to the side. Soft, innocent, naturally adorable expressions.

Clean, minimal soft-grey studio background. Add a few delicate hand-drawn pastel pink and white hearts, tiny cat doodles, and playful thought bubbles around the subjects, without cluttering the composition.

Soft pastel color grading, balanced contrast, natural highlights, and gentle depth of field.

Photorealistic, crystal-clear, beautifully composed, irresistibly cute, premium Instagram-worthy aesthetic. Maintain identical facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, and kitten appearance across all three panels. Natural human proportions, accurate hands and paws, no facial distortion, no excessive skin smoothing, no artificial CGI or plastic appearance.

何為有女人味？

每個人都有自己的答案

🫦 GPT image 2.6 Prompt:

電影感近景人像 × 清透晨光 × 成熟女人味 × 克制的曖昧張力。

每張獨立創作一張 9:16 直式人像。主體為二十多歲的成年東亞女性，氣質鬆弛從容，神情帶有主動而含蓄的吸引力。

【事件與表情】
每張選擇一個安靜的日常片刻，例如喝茶後放下杯子、整理耳邊髮絲、推開窗戶、從鏡前經過，或擦肩後回望。畫面捕捉她察覺有人在看、決定回應那道視線的瞬間。

每張只用一個主要表情動作。她可以在轉頭前先以眼睛看過來、平靜迎住目光多停半拍、透過倒影與鏡頭對視，或讓一點笑意剛浮上嘴角。眼神有明確的落點，眉眼、嘴唇與下顎自然放鬆。她可以含笑、安靜直視或側臉回眸，表情隨事件自然變化。

【膚質與妝感】
保留細小毛孔、細絨毛與自然色差。面頰泛著薄而柔和的天然紅潤，側光下肌膚有溫潤的透亮感。極薄底妝，杏粉色眼影，水光唇釉邊緣柔和，像剛輕抿過嘴唇。深棕髮絲自然垂落，少量碎髮隨風移動。鎖骨間的細金屬項鏈偶爾接住一點晨光。

【鏡頭與空間】
以臉部為視覺中心，根據事件選擇平視、側臉、隔桌、肩後或鏡中取景。可見自然的肩頸與日常服裝，人物視線所指的方向留有空間。清透晨光、柔和陰影、淡茶色與淺木色背景，安靜而疏朗。同批改變事件、視線交會方式和構圖，讓每張有不同的情緒與空間關係。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

Prompt 👇

A realistic, straight-on street style digital photograph captures a centrally positioned young man standing in a historic European neoclassical courtyard during autumn or winter. He has thick, medium-short dark wavy hair styled in a tousled curly mop top with a natural messy fringe that reaches mid-ear on the sides and falls to his brow line, displaying organic curl clumps, slight frizz, and flyaways with a matte-to-low-sheen finish. His neck is inclined downward with a serious, posed expression, natural dark relaxed eyebrows, gently closed lips, and mostly lowered eyelids as his gaze casts downward toward his chest. His shoulders are slightly tilted with the right shoulder subtly higher than the left, dressed in a layered winter outfit consisting of a charcoal dark turtleneck under a cream ribbed V-neck sweater, a warm heather brown wool overcoat, and dark brown-black pleated wide-leg trousers. An oversized, fringed oatmeal beige scarf hangs down his torso, creating strong vertical lines. Caught mid-motion in a relaxed gesture, his left hand is raised to mid-chest level and clad in a matte dark brown glove with a metallic silver signet ring worn directly over the pinky finger, thumb pointing up and fingers lightly curled inward hovering near the left side of the beige scarf, while his brown-gloved right hand rests downward along his right hip and thigh. He stands in the foreground on an expansive, medium asphalt gray concrete pavement marked by diagonal expansion joints, which transitions through the midground to a narrow border of square granite cobblestones and a stone curbstone at the base of the background building. The pristine background features a perfectly smooth, matte, uniform warm off-white plaster facade detailed with horizontal rusticated banding on the upper wall, a classical molded cornice beneath the windows, and recessed rectangular panels on the lower plinth. Behind the subject from top-center to upper-right, a dominant, pristine arched entrance door in rich cognac paneled wood frames his upper body, topped by a dark metal semicircular fanlight window with radial muntins reflecting a warm interior light. In the upper-left quadrant, a pristine medium-sized casement window with a dark gray frame and four glass panes reflects the sky and opposite buildings, while an aged, small recessed rectangular basement ventilation grille with diamond lattice metalwork sits along the lower wall in the middle-left quadrant, creating an asymmetric balance. The scene is illuminated by moderate, diffused soft light from a single-source overcast sky overhead, paired with natural outdoor ambient fill bouncing off the light pavement and white facade. This neutral-temperature lighting produces a calm, sophisticated mood with low-contrast, short gray shadows with soft gradual edges under the coat lapels, beneath the chin, and inside the trouser folds, while preserved highlights delicately catch the bridge of his nose, the cream knit sweater, the beige scarf, and the silver ring. The analogous color palette of off-white cream, medium asphalt gray, charcoal, warm heather brown, oatmeal beige, and rich cognac wood displays moderate saturation and medium contrast, embodying a clean Scandinavian minimalist and dark academia menswear aesthetic with quiet, understated urban elegance. Captured at a 35mm equivalent focal length with an f/2.8 to f/4 aperture, ISO 100, and 1/250s shutter speed with daylight white balance, the image achieves tack-sharp texture and a deep depth of field where both the subject and background architecture remain clearly legible, finished with subtle warm earthy color grading and a gentle contrast curve, framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.

Prompt 
CINEMATIC ROMANTIC SUNSET PORTRAIT SERIES | 9:16 VERTICAL

Create a cinematic, photorealistic vertical editorial photography composition featuring a young couple in an open rural grassland during a warm golden hour sunset. The composition consists of three seamlessly stacked horizontal frames, capturing an intimate, dreamy, and nostalgic moment between two people.

Subject & Appearance:

A young woman with long, naturally flowing dark brown hair, delicate facial features, expressive hazel-green eyes, and a soft, thoughtful expression. She wears a simple white romantic dress with delicate lace sleeves.

A young man with naturally messy dark brown hair, subtle facial stubble, expressive dark eyes, and a calm, introspective expression. He wears a dark oversized jacket over a simple shirt.

Maintain consistent facial features, hairstyles, clothing, and natural proportions throughout all frames.

Frame 1: Extreme Close-Up of the Woman's Eyes

An extreme close-up photograph focusing entirely on the young woman's hazel-green eyes. Her eyes are positioned symmetrically across the frame, with delicate eyelashes, natural eyebrows, and realistic skin texture.

Warm golden sunlight illuminates one side of her face while the opposite side falls into soft, cinematic shadow. A subtle reflection of the sunset is visible in her eyes.

Frame 2: Wide Romantic Landscape Shot

A wide cinematic shot of the young couple standing several feet apart in a vast green meadow, facing each other quietly.

The woman stands on the left wearing her flowing white dress. The young man stands on the right wearing his dark jacket and trousers.

Tall grass surrounds them, with a distant tree line stretching across the horizon. The setting sun casts a soft golden glow across the landscape, creating a beautiful contrast between the warm sky and the darker foreground.

The couple remains still, sharing a quiet and emotional moment.

Frame 3: Extreme Close-Up of the Young Man's Eyes

An extreme close-up portrait focusing on the young man's eyes, eyebrows, and upper face.

His dark eyes look directly toward the camera with a subtle, emotional expression. His naturally messy dark hair falls gently across his forehead.

Warm golden sunlight highlights individual hair strands, natural skin texture, and delicate reflections in his eyes. The background remains completely out of focus.

Photography & Color Grading:

Professional full-frame cinematic photography, 85mm portrait lens for close-ups, 50mm lens for the wide landscape frame, natural golden-hour lighting, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, warm amber highlights, muted green grass, deep cinematic shadows, subtle analog film texture, realistic skin details, and natural imperfections.

Composition:

Exactly three horizontal cinematic frames stacked vertically within a single 9:16 vertical canvas.

Top frame: 25% extreme close-up of the woman's eyes.

Middle frame: 40% wide landscape shot of the couple facing each other.

Bottom frame: 35% extreme close-up of the man's eyes.

Clean horizontal transitions, no borders, no text, no logos, no additional subjects.

Overall Mood: Romantic, nostalgic, intimate, emotional, dreamy, and poetic. A quiet moment between two people captured in the final light of sunset, like a still from an independent romantic film.

Ultra-photorealistic, cinematic composition, natural lighting, realistic photography, high detail, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

posts.text:
STOP asking AI to make your images look more realistic.

you're literally making the same mistake again and again.

AI images look fake because everything is TOO PERFECT.

→ perfect skin. 
→ perfect lighting. 
→ perfect poses. 
→ perfect backgrounds.

that's not how normal people take photos.

and if you're creating images for tiktok, reels, or youtube shorts, this one mistake can make your entire video look like AI slop.

here's a ridiculously SIMPLE trick i use to make AI images look like real smartphone photos.

you only need 4 things.

1. choose the kind of photo.

don't just say "photorealistic image."

tell AI where the photo came from.

for example:

→ a random tiktok video frame
→ an instagram story screenshot
→ a casual photo taken by a friend
→ a blurry late-night restaurant photo
→ an everyday street snapshot

2. describe a normal person,

not a supermodel.

not someone with flawless skin.

just an ordinary woman in her 20s with natural features, everyday clothes, and a relaxed expression.

3. create a moment, NOT a pose.

this is the BIG SECRET.

instead of making your subject pose for the camera, give them something natural to do.

for example:

a woman is enjoying dinner with her friends at a small restaurant.

someone suddenly points a phone at her.

she turns around, slightly surprised, without fixing her hair or preparing for the photo.

that's the kind of moment we want.

4. add real-life imperfections.

tell AI to keep the lighting uneven, the framing casual, and the skin natural.

even a little camera blur can make the image feel less staged.

now copy this prompt:

image prompt:

"generate a highly realistic candid photo that looks like it was taken by a friend using a normal smartphone.

the subject is a woman in her 20s sitting at a small restaurant at night with her friends.

the photo captures the exact moment she notices the camera and casually turns her head toward it.

she has a natural expression with a slight look of surprise. her face is clearly visible.

the restaurant has warm yellow lights, wooden furniture, food plates, drinks, and menu boards in the background.

the image should look like a real frame taken from someone's instagram reel or tiktok video.

include natural skin pores, tiny facial imperfections, realistic hair, slightly uneven exposure, subtle motion blur, and imperfect camera framing.

make it feel spontaneous, ordinary, and completely unstaged.

avoid the look of a professional photoshoot or a polished commercial.

negative: artificial skin, plastic face, 3d, cgi, illustration, cartoon, anime, beauty retouching, excessive glow, perfect lighting, unnatural eyes, strange hands, forced smile, overly symmetrical face, cinematic lighting, heavy background blur, over-sharpening, studio portrait, unrealistic environment."

and here's one more thing.

stop adding words like "masterpiece," "perfect lighting," and "flawless beauty" to every prompt.

those words can push your images toward that polished AI look you're trying to AVOID.

you're not trying to make a perfect image.

you're trying to make a BELIEVABLE image.

that's a MASSIVE difference.

right: google's nano banana 2.1

COLLECTIBLE THREE-COLOR REDUCTION LINOCUT | CITY TRAVEL POSTER

Create a striking, collectible three-color reduction linocut travel poster featuring [CITY NAME], printed vertically in a 4:5 aspect ratio on pristine, pure-white paper.

COMPOSITION & ARCHITECTURE

Make [PRIMARY LANDMARK] the dominant focal point. Select two additional instantly recognizable landmarks from [CITY NAME], ensuring their architectural forms create a compelling visual contrast.

Bring all three landmarks together along one continuous waterfront, artistically reimagining their geographical positions while preserving their authentic silhouettes, architectural proportions and defining details.

Use an asymmetric, low three-quarter perspective. Ground every structure in a believable waterfront environment with convincing foundations, bridges and architectural connections.

Establish a unified horizontal visual flow through varied building heights, intentional spacing and subtle overlaps. Maintain a balanced, organic composition. Avoid conventional skyline arrangements, stacked architectural tiers or disconnected floating structures.

Include exactly four tiny contemporary pedestrians along the waterfront to introduce scale, atmosphere and subtle human presence.

PRINTMAKING & COLOUR PALETTE

Use exactly three destination-inspired ink colours, carefully selected to reflect the city's character, architecture and atmosphere.

Embrace authentic reduction linocut aesthetics:

- Bold, sculptural carved shapes and confident silhouettes.
- Rhythmic white negative-space cuts revealing the texture of the paper.
- Organic, slightly irregular hand-carved edges.
- Subtle variations in ink density and uneven pressure, suggesting traditional block printing.
- Strong contrasts between deep architectural shadows and luminous unprinted areas.
- Waterfront reflections simplified into expressive, broken horizontal marks.

The finished artwork should feel like an authentic, artisan-produced limited-edition print rather than a digitally generated illustration.

TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT

Position the text "[CITY NAME]" discreetly in the upper-left corner.

Use a clean, SUIT-style uppercase sans-serif typeface in Regular or Medium weight, with restrained letter spacing and generous surrounding white space.

Keep the typography minimal, sophisticated and secondary to the artwork.

FINAL ART DIRECTION

A refined collectible destination poster combining traditional Japanese-inspired reduction printmaking, contemporary graphic design and distinctive architectural illustration.

Prioritize strong composition, architectural authenticity, elegant negative space, carefully controlled colour separation and timeless visual appeal.

STRICT RESTRICTIONS: No additional text, captions, inscriptions, decorative lettering, logos, borders, signatures or watermarks. Exactly three ink colours, four pedestrians and one continuous waterfront composition.

Today's Pop Culture Stand-In | Daily Prompt Share Theme: Give Someone A Dollar Day 💲(Uncle Sam) 🇺🇲 🫡

To truly honor the day I'll be giving ONE💲 ($1.00) to my top 4 favorites of the day!!!
*MUST BE ABLE TO RECEIVE @XMoney*

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:
• A reference image of yourself or any character you want to throw into the scene.

⚠️ Chat GPT or GPT Image 2.5 Recommended ⚠️

Prompt:
Transform the subject in the uploaded reference image into a spectacular, larger-than-life, hyperrealistic UNCLE SAM in an explosive Hollywood-blockbuster patriotic masterpiece. Preserve recognizable facial features, identity, and unique characteristics. Adapt naturally to ANY person, character, or avatar.

CHARACTER: Legendary American showman with outrageous charisma, electrifying confidence, HUGE mischievous grin, thick WAVY WHITE HAIR flowing beneath an extravagant stars-and-stripes top hat, and prominent BUSHY WHITE EYEBROWS. Turn ALL existing facial hair snowy white, preserving its original shape and length; clean-shaven subjects remain clean-shaven. Luxurious navy-blue tailcoat with gold embroidery, crisp white shirt, oversized red bow tie, red-and-white striped trousers, polished black boots. Hair and clothing billow in powerful winds.

THE MONEY SHOT: Uncle Sam lunges toward the camera, thrusting EXACTLY ONE realistic U.S. ONE-DOLLAR BILL directly at the viewer as if handing it through the screen! EXTREME forced perspective makes the bill MASSIVE in the foreground, displaying George Washington's portrait, authentic green ink, and accurate proportions. Fingers naturally grip one corner without obscuring the design. Other arm sweeps outward theatrically. Anatomically correct hands, five fingers each. NO additional money.

EXPRESSION: Enormous infectious grin, dramatically arched bushy white eyebrows, sparkling eyes, playful manic enthusiasm, and DIRECT eye contact. Flowing white hair frames the recognizable face.

BACKGROUND: EXPLOSIVE red, white, and blue fireworks, enormous American flags whipping in cinematic winds, golden sparks, swirling patriotic confetti, glowing embers, atmospheric smoke, spectacular lens flares, and dramatic golden sunlight piercing storm clouds above a monumental American city skyline.

COMPOSITION: EXTREME 18mm wide-angle lens, dramatic low-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal framing, breathtaking 3D depth, and exaggerated foreshortening. Uncle Sam appears to BURST THROUGH THE SCREEN! Massive foreground dollar bill without covering the face. Face and bill razor-sharp; layered cinematic background. Entire top hat, flowing white hair, and eyebrows clearly visible.

STYLE: Jaw-dropping Hollywood blockbuster poster meets premium commercial photography. Ultra-photorealistic skin, individually defined white hair and facial hair, luxurious fabric textures, metallic reflections, saturated patriotic colors, intense HDR contrast, volumetric lighting, cinematic ray tracing, and spectacular VFX.

FINAL IMPACT: An outrageously energetic, unforgettable, scroll-stopping patriotic spectacle of Uncle Sam EXPLODING THROUGH THE SCREEN to personally GIVE THE VIEWER ONE DOLLAR!

QUALITY: 8K, 2:3 vertical, Octane render, theatrical poster quality. NO text overlays, watermarks, extra dollar bills, duplicate limbs, or distorted hands.

芙门永存！神爱世人，世人爱芙！

感谢@0xkyne 佬的提示词灵感

完整提示词：

GPT Image 2.5

画面比例：竖版 9:16。超高质量真实人物摄影，国际高级时尚杂志封面级摄影品质。

一张具有极高真实感的旅行纪实风格时尚人像照片，拍摄于一列行驶在法国乡间的古典豪华卧铺列车内。将法国古典油画的光影美学、高级奢侈品时尚摄影的精致质感，以及真实生活抓拍的自然感完美结合。

整张照片必须被理解为真实相机拍摄的真人、真实服装和真实场景，而不是动漫插画、三维渲染或数字绘画。

一、人物：真人版芙宁娜 Cosplay

画面中的主角是一位二十出头、明确成年的东亚女性，正在 Cosplay《原神》中的芙宁娜（Furina）。

她拥有高级写真模特般的出众容貌，脸型小巧，精致而不失自然的五官，秀气的鼻梁，柔和清晰的下颌线，细腻的嘴唇，略带清冷和高贵气质的神情。她刚刚睡醒，神态带着一点慵懒和迷糊，气质柔软亲近。

严格还原芙宁娜的标志性视觉特征：银白色与浅冰蓝色交织的头发、精致的蓝色眼眸、具有角色辨识度的不对称发型与面部两侧的卷曲发束。头发采用高质量真实 Cosplay 假发的质感，发丝细密、自然蓬松，存在真实的层次、毛流、少量飞散的碎发和不规则的发束，绝不是塑料般顺滑的三维模型头发。

头顶佩戴芙宁娜标志性的深海军蓝小礼帽，帽子拥有金色装饰、蓝色宝石、白色褶皱饰物和精致的角色风格装饰，具有真实的布料、金属以及宝石材质。小帽子佩戴自然，大小比例合理，与她的发型完整结合。

皮肤必须呈现真实年轻女性的摄影质感：可见极其细微的毛孔、自然皮肤纹理、柔软的面部绒毛、真实的眼睑结构、轻微的肤色变化及自然的唇部光泽。禁止磨皮、陶瓷肌、蜡像肌、过分均匀的皮肤和 AI 美颜。

二、服装：Gucci × Hermès 风格的奢华粗针织毛衣

她穿着一件明显超大号的奶油白色粗棒针毛衣，以 Gucci 的复古学院派图案美学和 Hermès 的高级羊绒针织工艺为灵感。

毛衣非常宽松，肩线明显下落，袖子肥大而柔软，袖口略微盖住手掌；厚实的天然羊毛与羊绒混纺纱线形成清晰、立体、自然的粗针织结构。

毛衣以暖象牙白为底色，加入克制而精致的深海军蓝复古几何纹样、优雅的装饰性编织图案，体现欧洲老钱风与法式旅行时尚的高级感。

宽大的领口自然滑落到一侧肩膀，露出一侧锁骨和肩部。毛衣作为宽松的毛衣裙穿着，下摆覆盖至大腿上段，布料因坐姿形成自然的重力褶皱和松弛堆叠。

她穿着黑色偏深海军蓝的厚棉过膝袜，袜子的针织纹理细腻真实，袜口柔软地贴合大腿。袜口与毛衣下摆之间露出一段自然白皙的大腿肌肤。没有穿鞋。

人物身材高挑纤长，比例符合真实人体解剖结构，曲线自然，不刻意夸张。

三、动作与构图

摄影机位来自对面上铺的朋友，采用略高于人物视线的自然俯拍角度，模拟旅行途中用 iPhone 1 倍主摄拍摄的真实视角，同时拥有专业时尚摄影般的构图控制。

人物坐在下铺靠窗的位置，后背倚靠深灰绿色真皮靠背和深蓝色天鹅绒床铺。

一条腿自然盘起，膝盖向上弯曲；另一条腿向画面下方自然伸展，形成具有透视感的前景线条。双手轻轻握着一个奶油白色保温杯，放在身体前方。

她没有看向窗外，而是微微转过头，直接看向摄影机镜头，与拍摄者形成自然的眼神交流。

眼神安静、慵懒，带着一点刚睡醒的迷离和若有若无的笑意。没有刻意摆拍感，也没有夸张的表情。

人物脸部是画面的第一视觉中心，头发、小礼帽、肩部、毛衣和双腿共同形成舒展而自然的纵向构图。

画面右上角可以带入一小部分上铺护栏与白色被褥，形成轻微的虚化前景，进一步增强真实旅途抓拍的空间感。

四、环境：法国古典豪华列车

一间极具欧洲古典主义气质的法式复古卧铺包厢，参考二十世纪初豪华欧洲列车的室内设计。

车厢拥有深色抛光胡桃木护墙板、优雅的黄铜装饰、精致的古典雕花、复古的壁灯、深灰绿色真皮铺位、厚实的深蓝色天鹅绒床单和柔软凌乱的白色被子。

窗户带有厚实的黄铜金属边框，旁边悬挂奶油金与灰蓝色古典提花窗帘，搭配精致的流苏绑带。

壁面上可以看见一幅小型镀金画框的法国乡村油画，空间精致、有历史感，所有元素都符合真实老式豪华火车包厢的建筑和材质逻辑。

窗边的小桌板上自然摆放着一份精致的法式水果奶油小蛋糕、两枚马卡龙、一杯橙汁、一小束白色鲜花、一台复古相机以及一张对折的车票。

物品排列自然，像真实旅行者使用后的状态，不要过度整齐，也不要堆砌无关装饰。

窗外是明媚而温柔的法国春日乡村：翠绿的草坡、盛开的果树、淡黄色的野花、远方红瓦石屋组成的小村庄、稀疏的树木和蓝天下柔软的白云。

火车正在行驶，窗外近处的植被具有轻微而符合摄影逻辑的横向运动模糊，远景保持适度清晰，呈现真实的运动层次。

绝对没有雪景。

五、核心光影：法国古典油画式的暖光塑形

画面唯一占据主导地位的主光源来自画面左侧的车窗。

春日上午的金色阳光穿过窗户，以较低的侧向角度照进车厢，形成温暖而富有立体感的侧光。

参考法国古典油画的人像光影处理，以及高端时尚杂志中精致、克制的自然光肖像摄影。

脸部呈现美丽而真实的明暗过渡。光线沿着鼻梁、眼窝、颧骨和下颌线逐渐衰减，形成富有雕塑感的面部立体结构，而不是平面化的美颜补光。

毛衣的立体针织纹理在侧光下产生自然、细小而有逻辑的阴影。银白色发丝在阳光照射下呈现细腻的金色轮廓光，部分冰蓝色发束保持自然的冷色反射。

车厢深处维持浓郁而透明的暖棕色阴影，深蓝色天鹅绒保留丰富的暗部层次。

一盏小巧的暖黄色古典壁灯提供很弱的环境辅助光，但不能与左侧窗光争夺主光源地位。

画质纯净、通透、扎实，具有高质量 RAW 照片经过专业调色后的真实光学质感。

posts.text:
Turning a simple photo into a little piece of art. Love this editorial poster style

Made with GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
Transform the uploaded photos into an individual, high-end design poster. Do not combine multiple images; output each photo as a separate, standalone piece. Use a vertical {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} format, with the upper and lower sections divided strictly 1:1, each occupying 50% of the total composition.

The upper section should retain the original photograph—preserving its core structure, authentic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere—while applying subtle, high-end photographic color grading to evoke the aesthetic of magazine photography or art publications. To fit the frame, you may naturally extend the sky, ground, or environmental background, provided that the main subject remains undistorted and unaltered.

The lower section should distill the most recognizable elements of the subject—its silhouette, posture, and narrative context—into a minimalist, hand-drawn, paper-textured cover illustration. Strip away complex details, retaining only the most essential visual features. Use delicate, slightly unsteady hand-drawn lines combined with a few distinct, flat-applied acrylic color blocks to represent the subject, ensuring it remains instantly identifiable. The subject should be small and concentrated—occupying approximately {argument name="subject proportion" default="10%–20%"} of the lower section—surrounded by ample negative space. The background should resemble rough or light-colored paper, with only minimal lines or color planes to suggest the environment.

The color palette should be derived from the original photo and condensed into no more than four primary colors. These color blocks should be bold, solid, and restrained, incorporating textures like paper grain, visible brushstrokes, and slightly irregular edges. Lines should define the structure, while color blocks should establish the subject. Avoid styles such as colored pencil, crayon, watercolor washes, pure line art, complex realism, heavy oil-painting textures, slick digital illustrations, or 3D-rendered effects.

You may incorporate a small amount of concise text—such as titles, keywords, subject names, locations, years, serial numbers, or short phrases—tailored to the content of each photo (not limited to urban themes). The typography should be sparse and restrained, blending naturally with the negative space and illustration to evoke the aesthetic of an art book cover, an independent publication, or a children’s picture book.  The overall visual aesthetic features small subjects, ample negative space, a high degree of distillation, and strong recognizability. It conveys a sense of tranquility, childlike charm, and ease—evoking a poetic, sophisticated quality while steering clear of the look typical of commercial cartoons, e-commerce imagery, or generic templates.

The upper section should retain the original photograph—preserving its core structure, authentic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere—while applying subtle, high-end photographic color grading to evoke the aesthetic of magazine photography or art publications. To fit the frame, you may naturally extend the sky, ground, or environmental background, provided that the main subject remains undistorted and unaltered.

The lower section should distill the most recognizable elements of the subject—its silhouette, posture, and narrative context—into a minimalist, hand-drawn, paper-textured cover illustration. Strip away complex details, retaining only the most essential visual features. Use delicate, slightly unsteady hand-drawn lines combined with a few distinct, flat-applied acrylic color blocks to represent the subject, ensuring it remains instantly identifiable. The subject should be small and concentrated—occupying approximately {argument name="subject proportion" default="10%–20%"} of the lower section—surrounded by ample negative space. The typography should be sparse and restrained, blending naturally with the negative space and illustration to evoke the aesthetic of an art book cover, an independent publication, or a children’s picture book.  The overall visual aesthetic features small subjects, ample negative space, a high degree of distillation, and strong recognizability. It conveys a sense of tranquility, childlike charm, and ease—evoking a poetic, sophisticated quality while steering clear of the look typical of commercial cartoons, e-commerce imagery, or generic templates.

A young adult male with warm tan skin (#B68261) sits upright in the driver's seat of a Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon in a strict 90-degree left profile, wearing a jet-black (#18181A) grained leather jacket with a snap cuff. posts.prompt:
一张写实的新中式高级礼服全身人像。成年东方女性，身形自然匀称，中等身高，真实头身比例。竖版构图，完整展示发饰、袖型、裙摆与铺地拖尾。

【服装设计】
香槟象牙白真丝缎面与藕粉色轻薄欧根纱搭配，精致小立领，领缘绣细窄浅金纹样，胸前排列小巧手工盘扣。肩线自然贴合，上身采用不透明缎面，合体剪裁，腰线自然。

长袖以半透明藕粉绣纱制作，上臂较合体，从手肘以下柔和展开，形成轻盈飘逸的微喇袖口。腰间搭配窄幅藕粉腰封、小巧花形扣与两条珍珠流苏。

裙身从腰胯顺势舒展，象牙白缎面内裙叠搭藕粉薄纱外裙，轮廓柔顺，具有适度裙量。前裙边轻轻堆叠于地面，侧后方拖尾与裙身连贯，沿地面自然铺开，褶皱细腻、垂坠真实。

【刺绣纹样】
以浅粉与象牙白玉兰、细小花枝和灵动飞鸟为主题，点缀低饱和灰绿叶片与极细香槟金绣线。纹样从单侧肩胸经过腰间，延伸至裙摆和拖尾，疏密有致，保留大面积素色面料。绣线针脚清晰，花瓣具有细微立体层次，整体精致轻盈。

【人物造型】
自然东方成年女性面容，眼睛大小真实，五官比例协调，面部保留轻微不对称。皮肤白皙细腻、柔和通透，保留细微肌理、自然血色和真实唇纹。轻薄妆容，温柔淡笑，避免瓷娃娃感与过度磨皮。

深色头发盘成优雅高髻，佩戴精巧金色花枝发簪、少量珍珠垂饰与小巧耳坠。人物微侧站立，一手自然置于腰前，另一手放松垂落，肩颈舒展，姿势自然。

【背景与光线】
低调雅致的暖灰米色室内背景，一侧有深木格栅与轻微虚化的花器，背景留白充足。柔和侧窗光结合自然反射补光，面部明暗过渡细腻，皮肤高光不过曝。窗影轻落于墙面与地面，真丝、薄纱、绣线和珍珠具有各自真实的光泽。

高端时装摄影，平视机位，自然透视，真实相机质感，画面重点突出人物与礼服，完整保留裙摆和拖尾。

避免：僵硬蓬蓬裙、厚重织锦、独立长条拖布、夸张拉长的身材、塑料皮肤、动漫大眼、畸形手指、云肩、厚重肩饰、文字、水印、拼图。

Prompt:
UNIVERSAL PROMPT - PREMIUM MINIMALIST LAYERED PAPER-CUT EDITORIAL POSTER | 3:4

Use the uploaded photograph as the sole source of the subject. Create a premium editorial poster, with each photograph processed and exported individually. Do not combine multiple images into a collage.

COMPOSITION & LAYOUT: Use a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio. Divide the canvas into two equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height. Position the dividing line precisely at the vertical midpoint. The two sections must meet seamlessly, with no borders, gaps, or spacing between them.

PHOTO PRESERVATION: Preserve the original subject's identity, pose, architectural structures, natural lighting, realistic textures, and overall color atmosphere. Apply only subtle, art-directed color grading worthy of a high-end editorial magazine. If necessary, naturally extend the environmental background to fit the horizontal composition. Never stretch the subject, alter its proportions, or crop out important narrative elements.

LAYERED PAPER-CUT REINTERPRETATION: Extract the photograph's most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, and narrative relationships, then reinterpret them as minimalist, handcrafted layered paper-cut art and sculptural paper relief. Establish one central focal subject, simplifying the surrounding environment into distinct foreground, midground, and background paper layers.

PAPERCRAFT & DEPTH: Create visual depth through precise cutting, folding, overlapping, masking, positive and negative space, and intentional use of whitespace. Preserve the subject's recognizability without mechanically reproducing every original detail. The result should feel artistically constructed by hand, with sophisticated dimensionality and a refined minimalist aesthetic.

COLOR PALETTE & MATERIALS: Extract a limited, harmonious color palette from the original photograph. Use warm ivory paper as the base, complemented by the dominant colors of the scene, deeper structural tones, and a restrained accent color. Render matte cardstock, delicate paper fibers, crisp cut edges, convincing physical thickness, and soft contact shadows under natural diffused lighting. The final artwork should feel tactile, realistic, and exquisitely crafted.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL DETAILS: Add typography exclusively within the lower half of the poster. Derive a short, compelling English headline from the photograph's subject or narrative. Complement it with 2–4 small supporting text elements, such as a serial number, material descriptors, category labels, or an extremely brief poetic phrase. Maintain elegant typography, deliberate spacing, and a sophisticated luxury-editorial hierarchy.

Do not add years, invented locations, fictional coordinates, or unsupported factual details.

FINAL RESULT: A premium 3:4 vertical editorial poster combining the recognizable essence of the original photograph with minimalist, handcrafted layered paper-cut artistry, tactile materials, precise composition, and restrained luxury-magazine typography. Ensure the upper and lower sections remain exactly equal in height, with the central division aligned precisely at 50% of the canvas.

prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic 3×3 photo collage featuring the same stylish young woman in nine different skateboarding poses, maintaining consistent facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, and accessories across all nine frames.

Outfit: Brown and lime-green raglan graphic T-shirt, oversized baggy blue denim jeans, and chunky black-and-white skateboarding sneakers.

Location: An outdoor urban skatepark with a large curved concrete bowl, colorful graffiti-covered walls, metal railings, distant palm trees, and a beautiful clear blue sky under bright afternoon sunlight.

Composition: A perfectly aligned 3×3 grid collage containing nine individual photographs. Every panel features the same girl with a different pose, camera angle, and expression.

Nine Different Frames:

1. Extreme Close-Up: Looking directly down into the fisheye camera, reaching both hands toward the lens while sitting on her skateboard.
2. Mid-Air Trick: Performing a high skateboard jump above the camera, with the skateboard underside prominently visible and arms stretched outward.
3. Relaxed Skate Pose: Sitting casually inside the skatepark bowl with one knee raised and her skateboard resting beside her.
4. Flying Skateboard: Captured from an extreme ground-level angle while performing an impressive aerial trick, with her sneakers and skateboard dominating the foreground.

6. High Jump Action: Performing a dynamic mid-air skateboard trick with one arm raised, bent knees, and the board tilted toward the lens.
7. Candid Selfie: Smiling naturally while leaning close to the camera, with one arm extended toward the lens.
8. Skateboard Jump: Captured from directly underneath as she floats above the camera with the skateboard clearly visible against the blue sky.
9. Casual Portrait: Sitting comfortably on the concrete skatepark ramp, resting her cheek against one hand with a relaxed, confident expression.

Photography Style: Extreme circular fisheye lens, ultra-wide-angle distortion, dramatic low-angle photography, dynamic forced perspective, authentic 1990s and early 2000s skate magazine aesthetic, Y2K street fashion editorial, candid expressions, energetic action photography, natural sunlight, realistic shadows, detailed denim textures, natural skin texture, slight analog film grain, and vibrant colors.

- Each panel must have a unique pose and camera composition.
- Skateboard must look realistic with visible wheels, trucks, grip tape, and graphic underside.
- Bright blue sky and concrete skatepark environment throughout.
- No text, no captions, no watermarks, no extra panels.

提示词：
一幅16:9横向电影宽画幅的高精度东方幻想风格化3D CG人物场景。画面中只有一位年轻成年东亚女性，她拥有精致柔和的日系与东方美型相结合的三维面容、白皙细腻的肌肤、柔和的深棕色眼睛、自然泛红的脸颊、乌黑蓬松的古典双侧盘髻，以及浓密柔软的黑色波浪长发。

她身穿一件深墨绿近黑色的中式改良旗袍式连体短装，领口采用青蓝色传统盘扣，胸前具有精致的金色东方盘龙刺绣，服装修身而富有传统东方装饰语言。右侧肩膀披着一件松散滑落的浅灰白色细条纹衬衫，手腕佩戴黑色半透明蕾丝护手，腿部穿着白色蕾丝边半透明长袜，搭配细长的白色吊带与黑色亮面高跟鞋。

人物站在一间深夜营业的复古便利店冷藏食品区，身体呈三分之四侧面姿态，腰部向画面右侧轻微扭转，上半身略微向左侧冷柜倾斜。靠近冷柜的一只手臂高高举起，手指伸向冷柜上层的一瓶蓝色瓶装饮料，蓝色瓶体位于人物头部左上方附近，具有半透明塑料瓶身、浅蓝色标签和清楚的瓶盖结构。另一只手放在冷柜透明玻璃门上，手掌与玻璃之间形成自然的接触与支撑关系。

人物头部轻微向画面左侧倾斜，同时转向镜头，柔和而略带迷离的眼神望向观看者。她的嘴唇轻轻张开，面部神情安静、自然，带有轻微的疲倦感和梦幻般的疏离气质。双腿呈自然的不对称站姿，一条腿靠前承担身体重量，另一条腿略向后方伸展，脚尖和黑色高跟鞋与便利店瓷砖地板形成可信的接触关系。

画面左侧是一整排巨大而明亮的冷藏展示柜，冷柜内部发出强烈的冰青蓝色与冷白色灯光，冷柜的透明玻璃门表面存在细密的水汽凝结、局部雾化、微弱水痕和强烈的镜面反射。冰蓝色灯光沿着冷柜纵深形成多条连续的明亮水平光带，冷柜内部的商品经过玻璃折射、镜头景深和空气散射而呈现模糊朦胧的形态。

画面右侧是一排从近景延伸至店铺深处的高大商品货架，货架上整齐而密集地摆放着大量瓶装饮品、零食包装、盒装食品和日常商品。右侧货架处于较暗的暖灰褐色与墨绿色阴影中，商品包装保留模糊而真实的商业陈列层次，但不需要出现准确可读的品牌文字。

便利店顶部排列着细长的暖黄色与暖白色荧光灯，灯光从画面中上方沿店铺深处延伸，在人物头发、脸颊、裸露的肩膀和金色盘龙刺绣上形成柔和的暖色高光。远处便利店过道末端可以看到带有冷白色灯光的门口或柜台区域，冷光与暖光在幽暗的空间中自然交织。

整个环境充满细腻而均匀的湿润空气散射，明亮的左侧冷柜光芒在空气中扩散成大面积朦胧的冰青蓝色光幕，暖黄色顶灯则形成柔和的香槟金色光晕。画面呈现低对比、柔焦、略微雾化的电影影像质感，具有高精度三维CG人物、真实物理材质、HDR高光扩散、空气透视、轻微镜头光晕和自然浅景深。

人物面部采用精致的日系美型三维角色设计，脸型小巧而柔和，整体为自然的椭圆形，额头饱满，眉骨起伏细腻，颧骨与脸颊具有柔软的三维体积，下颌线纤细而平滑。鼻梁细直，鼻尖小巧，鼻翼自然，嘴唇呈柔和的浅玫瑰粉色与淡珊瑚色，唇峰柔软，下唇略微丰满。

人物眼睛呈清澈的深棕色与柔和灰褐色混合，虹膜具有细腻的深浅渐变、自然的瞳孔深度与少量明亮的冷白色环境反光。眼睛形状为柔和的杏仁形，眼尾略微收窄，上眼睑自然下垂，睫毛纤细而精致，眉毛具有柔和的深棕黑色弧线。

人物视线朝向镜头附近，眼神平静、柔和，略带淡淡的迷离感。眼妆采用浅粉棕色与自然暖灰色的细腻渐变，眼下和脸颊带有柔和的暖粉色腮红，唇妆呈自然水润的淡玫瑰色。嘴唇轻微分开，不露齿，面部没有夸张的表情。

皮肤采用高精度风格化三维次表面散射材质，具有细腻的皮肤厚度、自然的浅象牙白色和柔和暖米色变化。额头、鼻梁、眼下、嘴唇、肩膀、手臂与腿部保留自然的光照渐变，皮肤亮部柔润细腻，阴影区域呈浅灰青色和低饱和暖褐色。

左侧冰蓝色冷柜光照亮人物的脸颊与肩膀，在白皙皮肤上形成柔和的冷白色与淡青蓝色反射。顶部暖黄色灯光在发际线、鼻梁、锁骨与上臂产生微弱的暖金色高光。不同色温的光源在人物皮肤上自然融合，不形成强烈而生硬的双色灯光分界。

人物拥有浓密而极长的乌黑色长发，发色由深墨黑、深棕黑、蓝黑和少量冷灰色反射组成。头顶头发具有自然的蓬松体积，额前留有轻薄而略微凌乱的细碎刘海。刘海由宽窄不同的独立发束构成，部分发丝垂落至眉毛附近，形成柔和的额头阴影。

后脑上方的头发被盘成两个略微不对称的古典发髻，发髻具有清楚的三维发束交叠、自然的圆润轮廓与轻微凌乱感。发髻之间保留少量细长碎发，使整体发型显得蓬松而柔软。

发髻上点缀精致的蓝紫色蝴蝶发饰，蝴蝶翅片具有柔和的浅紫色、青蓝色与微弱的珍珠白色反光，边缘细薄，局部呈半透明质感。蝴蝶装饰位于人物头部两侧偏后上方，与乌黑色发髻形成清楚的色彩分离。

大量未盘起的黑色长发从后脑和肩膀处向下自然延伸，形成浓密、蓬松、层次丰富的波浪卷发。长发长度接近腰臀部，部分发束垂落在胸前和肩侧，另外一部分沿人物背部自然垂下。

长发具有明显的S形波浪结构和不同大小的卷曲弧线，发束之间呈现真实的交叠与空间遮挡。靠近头部的发束相对集中，靠近发尾的卷发逐渐分散，形成柔软而自然的黑色流线形轮廓。

头发采用高精度三维发束与大量细密独立发丝相结合的渲染方式，具有真实体积、柔和的各向异性反射、自然的发丝遮挡和微弱的动态变化。靠近冷柜的发丝出现冷青蓝色与浅灰白色边缘高光，靠近暖黄色顶灯的发丝则呈现非常微弱的深棕金色反射。

整体头发保持柔和的黑色层次，不出现完全均匀的纯黑塑料发片，也不将自然的波浪长发改成整齐平直的短发。人物头发与冷柜玻璃、右侧货架之间存在清楚的前后空间关系。

人物身穿一件深墨绿色与深黑色相结合的改良中式旗袍式连体短装。服装具有贴合颈部的中式立领，领口沿边缘采用细窄的深青色滚边，领口前方设置精致的青蓝色传统盘扣，盘扣呈小巧的花结形状，具有真实的丝线厚度和柔和的纤维光泽。

旗袍主体采用具有低调丝缎光泽的深青黑色织物，剪裁修身，贴合人物自然的胸部、腰腹与髋部曲线，形成清楚但不过度夸张的三维服装结构。衣料随身体微微扭转产生自然的纵向、横向和斜向褶皱。

服装胸前偏侧具有精致的金色东方盘龙刺绣。龙纹由细密的古金色、浅铜金色和少量暖黄色丝线构成，具有清楚的龙首、弯曲龙身、细长龙须、鳞片、龙爪和局部云气纹样。

金色盘龙刺绣沿深色布料的自然曲面弯曲，受到上方暖黄色灯光照射的位置呈现细窄的金色丝线反光，受到冷柜蓝光照射的区域则产生更低饱和的浅金灰色反射。刺绣是柔软织物上的精细丝线纹样，不是硬质的金属浮雕或独立装甲。

服装领口与肩部采用具有改良东方服饰特点的露肩剪裁，肩膀与上臂自然露出，颈部下方的深色衣料形成柔和的弧形开口。服装边缘具有真实的布料厚度、局部细窄滚边和自然贴合的接触阴影。

腰部和髋部的短装衣料较为贴合身体，下摆沿髋部自然收束，具有深色连体短装的整体形态。腰侧点缀小巧的蓝紫色蝴蝶装饰，与发髻上的蝴蝶形成统一的设计语言。

右侧肩膀外松散披着一件浅灰白色细条纹宽松衬衫。衬衫从肩部自然滑落，布料堆积在上臂与手肘附近，一部分松散垂挂至人物腰侧和臀部后方。

衬衫整体颜色为奶油白色、浅灰白色与微弱的淡蓝灰色，布面具有密集而清楚的纵向细条纹。条纹随着衣料折叠与褶皱自然弯曲，形成真实的织物形变。

衬衫采用柔软的棉质或轻薄混纺织物材质，具有细腻的纤维纹理、自然的布料厚度和低调的漫反射。靠近冷柜的位置受到冰青色光线照射，呈现浅蓝白色反光，远离冷柜的位置则呈现暖灰色和柔和的米白色阴影。

人物手腕佩戴黑色半透明蕾丝护手，主要可见于靠近冷柜玻璃的手腕与前臂位置。蕾丝具有细密的传统植物花纹、局部黑色网纱和柔软的不规则花边，织物半透明，能够透出微弱的自然肤色。

靠近冷柜玻璃的手掌自然张开，五指略微分开并贴近冷柜门表面，手指与玻璃形成明确的接触关系。指尖具有自然的三维骨骼结构，手背和指节受到冷柜蓝白色光照射，呈现柔和的冷色高光。

人物另一只手臂高高举起，沿画面左上方向伸展，手掌靠近冷柜上部的一瓶蓝色瓶装饮料。手臂自然伸直，肩膀受到抬臂动作影响微微提高，手掌与瓶体之间形成可信的抓握或取物动作关系。

蓝色瓶装饮料位于画面中上部靠左的位置，瓶体呈透明或半透明的浅蓝色塑料材质，具有清楚的圆柱形瓶身、蓝色标签和小型瓶盖，内部液体及塑料表面在冷柜光照下形成细小而明亮的冷白色反射。瓶子尺寸自然，不放大成醒目的主要商品展示。

人物腿部穿着白色半透明蕾丝长袜。长袜袜口位于大腿上方，具有宽阔而精致的白色花卉蕾丝边，花边内部由细小的花瓣、植物枝叶和半透明网纱结构组成，具有真实的纤维厚度。

长袜主体为柔和的浅象牙白色与半透明珍珠白色，织物贴合腿部自然曲线，具有细密的网纱结构和微弱的纤维反光。袜身表面散布少量非常细小的珍珠白色亮点，受到冷柜高亮冰青色光照射后形成细腻的冷白色反射。

长袜上缘连接细长的白色吊带，吊带从人物深色短装下缘向大腿蕾丝袜口延伸，具有自然的张力和清楚的连接关系。吊带宽度较窄，柔和贴合身体，不额外加入大量复杂饰物。

人物双脚穿着黑色亮面高跟鞋，鞋面为修长而圆润的闭合轮廓，鞋跟中等偏高，具有真实的结构厚度和自然的重力接触。黑色漆皮表面在冷柜冰蓝光下形成清晰的冷白色镜面反射，在顶部暖黄色灯光下呈现小面积的暖金色亮线。

人物身体以三分之四侧面姿态靠近左侧冷柜，上半身略微向冷柜倾斜，腰部向画面右侧自然扭转，臀部轻微后移，形成柔和的S形人体姿态。

高举的一只手臂向冷柜上方伸展，另一只手掌自然放在冷柜玻璃门上，使人物在狭窄货架空间中形成具有明确支撑关系的动态姿态。

人物双腿呈不对称站姿，靠近画面左侧的一条腿相对笔直并承担部分身体重量，另一条腿向画面右后侧轻微伸展，膝盖略微弯曲，脚跟和鞋尖与便利店瓷砖地面形成自然接触。

人物腿部、腰部与上半身之间具有真实的三维解剖结构与自然受力关系。裙装、衬衫、长袜和吊带随着身体动作自然贴合或垂落，不出现不合理的衣物穿模、重复肢体和悬浮鞋履。

便利店左侧是一排体积较大的冷藏展示柜，冷柜从非常靠近镜头的画面左边缘向画面深处延伸，形成强烈的纵向透视结构。冷柜由透明玻璃门、银灰色金属框架、内部水平置物架和连续的冷白色照明灯组成。

冷柜内部摆放大量模糊的饮料瓶、冷藏食品包装和盒装商品，但由于冷柜玻璃的水汽凝结与强烈冷色光线，商品的具体标签与形状并不完全清晰，只保留真实的商业陈列层次。

冷柜玻璃门表面布满细密的透明水滴、局部凝结水汽、纵向水痕和不规则的玻璃反射。靠近镜头的玻璃区域被明亮的冰青蓝色光线照亮，形成宽阔而柔和的蓝白色反光面。

冷柜内部灯管沿纵向排列的冷柜结构向远处延伸，部分光带在玻璃表面形成连续的水平亮线。最明亮的位置呈接近纯白色的冷白光，外围依次过渡为淡冰蓝色、青蓝色、浅青绿色与半透明灰蓝色散射。

画面左侧大面积冷柜区域因为极强的光学扩散而呈现柔和的冰蓝色光幕，柜门内部的部分商品细节被自然的高亮和雾化覆盖。靠近人物手掌的位置保留较明确的玻璃门边缘、水汽痕迹和反射结构。

冷柜的冷蓝色灯光不仅照亮玻璃本身，也真实地照射到人物的面部、头发、服装和腿部，形成统一的冷色环境光场。光线沿人物身体的左侧自然衰减，不出现与空间光源不一致的孤立发光区域。

便利店右侧是一排高大而纵深明显的食品货架。货架由深灰色或暗金属色的立柱、水平层板、细窄标签条和大量密集的商品包装组成，从画面右侧近景一直延伸至商店深处。

货架上摆放着大量日常零食、瓶装饮料、袋装食品、盒装商品和日用品。商品包装具有真实的不同高度、体积、色块与空间排列，但因为货架距离镜头较远且光线较暗，具体文字和品牌标志保持模糊，不强制生成可读的文字。

右侧商品货架整体处于暖灰褐色、深墨绿色与低饱和暗金色的环境光中，较高位置的包装受到暖黄色顶灯照射，形成局部柔和高光，较低位置逐渐融入深色阴影。

货架纵深具有清楚的透视收缩，靠近镜头的商品尺寸较大，远处商品逐渐缩小并被空气散射与浅景深柔化。商品排列密集但不形成杂乱的悬浮几何结构。

便利店中央是一条狭窄的过道，地面铺设浅灰褐色或暖灰色方形瓷砖。瓷砖具有清楚而自然的接缝、微弱的磨损纹理和低对比的湿润反射。部分地面受到冷柜蓝白色光线照射，呈现浅青灰色变化，另一部分受到顶部暖黄色灯光照射，呈现柔和暖灰色。

地面透视沿画面中央向远处收束，过道尽头有一处冷白色照明较强的门口、柜台或冷藏设备区域，形成小面积明亮的背景焦点。远处背景细节受到浓密空气散射与景深处理而逐渐模糊，保留真实的空间深度。

便利店顶部具有低矮的灰褐色天花板、细长的暖黄色荧光灯、部分通风结构与低对比的旧化表面。灯管沿过道方向排列，暖金色光线经过雾化空气扩散成柔和的长条形高光。

画面中上方偏右有一盏明显的暖黄色荧光灯，发出柔和而明亮的琥珀金色光线。灯光照亮人物黑色发髻的上缘、脸颊、肩部、黑金旗袍与右侧货架上缘，形成暖色环境层次。

整个便利店内部充满细密而均匀的湿润空气散射，画面左侧的冰蓝色冷柜光在空气中形成明亮的冷色体积光幕，右侧暖黄色顶灯则形成低对比的暖金色光雾。空气雾化自然地覆盖中远景，使右侧商品货架和店铺深处的对比度明显降低。

雾气并不是清楚的白色烟柱，也不是完全遮挡空间的大量蒸汽，而是一层具有连续深度、柔和透明度和真实光学散射的空气薄雾。越靠近高亮冷柜，雾气与冷蓝色光线的融合越明显；越靠近远处货架，空气散射使深色区域逐渐呈现灰青褐色。

整体光照采用强烈冷暖混合的电影式三维CG照明。主要冷光来自画面左侧冷柜内部的冰蓝白色灯管，主要暖光来自顶部的琥珀黄色荧光灯。两组光源在人物皮肤、黑色长发、丝缎衣料、玻璃和瓷砖表面产生不同的反射响应。

人物的面部受到左侧冷柜光线照射，脸颊、鼻梁、下颌和露出的肩膀呈现柔和的冷白色与淡青蓝色反光。顶部暖黄色灯光使面部较高的位置产生少量浅金白色高光，整体肤色保持自然的柔和象牙白色。

黑色长发在靠近冷柜的位置呈现冷蓝灰色边缘反射，在靠近顶部暖灯的位置产生极细的暖棕金色高光。深黑色旗袍保持浓郁的暗部体积，受光区域具有低调的墨绿色丝缎反射，金色盘龙刺绣在暖黄色灯光下呈现明亮而纤细的金色纹样。

白色蕾丝袜在左侧冷蓝色环境光照射下呈现浅冰蓝白色和珍珠白色变化，细密的蕾丝花边与薄纱表面产生柔和的高光。黑色漆皮高跟鞋产生小面积、较为集中的冷白色和暖金色镜面反射，瓷砖地面则呈现更宽、更弱的环境光反射。

冷柜玻璃表面的透明水滴具有真实的折射、局部透射、表面张力和不同尺度的反光。靠近镜头的部分水滴形成柔和的小型高亮，远处水痕和冷柜商品逐渐融入雾化的蓝白色光场。

整体采用高动态范围HDR三维CG照明，冷柜内部最明亮的区域具有明显的Bloom高光扩散和局部过曝。冰蓝色亮部边缘自然溢出到周围空气中，部分玻璃结构和内部商品细节被高亮柔和覆盖，但人物面部和主要身体轮廓保持可辨认。

画面整体色彩以低饱和冰青蓝色、冷灰绿色、深墨绿色、灰褐色、奶油暖白色、柔和琥珀黄色和少量古金色为主。左侧大面积冷柜光构成画面的冷色视觉主体，右侧商品货架构成较暗的暖灰褐色背景，人物位于冷暖光场交界的位置。

整体对比度较低，画面暗部并非完全纯黑，而是带有青绿色、深灰褐色和灰蓝色的空气感。高光具有轻微的暖白色与冰蓝色光学扩散，中间调柔和而具有连续渐变，形成潮湿、朦胧、略带复古气质的电影级数字CG色彩表现。

构图采用16:9横向电影宽画幅，摄影机位于便利店中央过道附近，以略微宽广的中距离视角观察人物和冷柜。人物处于画面中央略偏右的位置，头部位于画面中上区域，身体从上半部一直延伸至画面底部，黑色高跟鞋和瓷砖地面完整可见。

蓝色瓶装饮料位于画面中上部靠左的位置，瓶体呈透明或半透明的浅蓝色塑料材质，具有清楚的圆柱形瓶身、蓝色标签和小型瓶盖，内部液体及塑料表面在冷柜光照下形成细小而明亮的冷白色反射。瓶子尺寸自然，不放大成醒目的主要商品展示。

人物腿部穿着白色半透明蕾丝长袜。长袜袜口位于大腿上方，具有宽阔而精致的白色花卉蕾丝边，花边内部由细小的花瓣、植物枝叶和半透明网纱结构组成，具有真实的纤维厚度。

长袜主体为柔和的浅象牙白色与半透明珍珠白色，织物贴合腿部自然曲线，具有细密的网纱结构和微弱的纤维反光。袜身表面散布少量非常细小的珍珠白色亮点，受到冷柜高亮冰青色光照射后形成细腻的冷白色反射。

长袜上缘连接细长的白色吊带，吊带从人物深色短装下缘向大腿蕾丝袜口延伸，具有自然的张力和清楚的连接关系。吊带宽度较窄，柔和贴合身体，不额外加入大量复杂饰物。

人物双脚穿着黑色亮面高跟鞋，鞋面为修长而圆润的闭合轮廓，鞋跟中等偏高，具有真实的结构厚度和自然的重力接触。黑色漆皮表面在冷柜冰蓝光下形成清晰的冷白色镜面反射，在顶部暖黄色灯光下呈现小面积的暖金色亮线。

人物身体以三分之四侧面姿态靠近左侧冷柜，上半身略微向冷柜倾斜，腰部向画面右侧自然扭转，臀部轻微后移，形成柔和的S形人体姿态。

高举的一只手臂向冷柜上方伸展，另一只手掌自然放在冷柜玻璃门上，使人物在狭窄货架空间中形成具有明确支撑关系的动态姿态。

人物双腿呈不对称站姿，靠近画面左侧的一条腿相对笔直并承担部分身体重量，另一条腿向画面右后侧轻微伸展，膝盖略微弯曲，脚跟和鞋尖与便利店瓷砖地面形成自然接触。

人物腿部、腰部与上半身之间具有真实的三维解剖结构与自然受力关系。裙装、衬衫、长袜和吊带随着身体动作自然贴合或垂落，不出现不合理的衣物穿模、重复肢体和悬浮鞋履。

便利店左侧是一排体积较大的冷藏展示柜，冷柜从非常靠近镜头的画面左边缘向画面深处延伸，形成强烈的纵向透视结构。冷柜由透明玻璃门、银灰色金属框架、内部水平置物架和连续的冷白色照明灯组成。

冷柜内部摆放大量模糊的饮料瓶、冷藏食品包装和盒装商品，但由于冷柜玻璃的水汽凝结与强烈冷色光线，商品的具体标签与形状并不完全清晰，只保留真实的商业陈列层次。

冷柜玻璃门表面布满细密的透明水滴、局部凝结水汽、纵向水痕和不规则的玻璃反射。靠近镜头的玻璃区域被明亮的冰青蓝色光线照亮，形成宽阔而柔和的蓝白色反光面。

冷柜内部灯管沿纵向排列的冷柜结构向远处延伸，部分光带在玻璃表面形成连续的水平亮线。最明亮的位置呈接近纯白色的冷白光，外围依次过渡为淡冰蓝色、青蓝色、浅青绿色与半透明灰蓝色散射。

画面左侧大面积冷柜区域因为极强的光学扩散而呈现柔和的冰蓝色光幕，柜门内部的部分商品细节被自然的高亮和雾化覆盖。靠近人物手掌的位置保留较明确的玻璃门边缘、水汽痕迹和反射结构。

冷柜的冷蓝色灯光不仅照亮玻璃本身，也真实地照射到人物的面部、头发、服装和腿部，形成统一的冷色环境光场。光线沿人物身体的左侧自然衰减，不出现与空间光源不一致的孤立发光区域。

便利店右侧是一排高大而纵深明显的食品货架。货架由深灰色或暗金属色的立柱、水平层板、细窄标签条和大量密集的商品包装组成，从画面右侧近景一直延伸至商店深处。

货架上摆放着大量日常零食、瓶装饮料、袋装食品、盒装商品和日用品。商品包装具有真实的不同高度、体积、色块与空间排列，但因为货架距离镜头较远且光线较暗，具体文字和品牌标志保持模糊，不强制生成可读的文字。

右侧商品货架整体处于暖灰褐色、深墨绿色与低饱和暗金色的环境光中，较高位置的包装受到暖黄色顶灯照射，形成局部柔和高光，较低位置逐渐融入深色阴影。

货架纵深具有清楚的透视收缩，靠近镜头的商品尺寸较大，远处商品逐渐缩小并被空气散射与浅景深柔化。商品排列密集但不形成杂乱的悬浮几何结构。

便利店中央是一条狭窄的过道，地面铺设浅灰褐色或暖灰色方形瓷砖。瓷砖具有清楚而自然的接缝、微弱的磨损纹理和低对比的湿润反射。部分地面受到冷柜蓝白色光线照射，呈现浅青灰色变化，另一部分受到顶部暖黄色灯光照射，呈现柔和暖灰色。

地面透视沿画面中央向远处收束，过道尽头有一处冷白色照明较强的门口、柜台或冷藏设备区域，形成小面积明亮的背景焦点。远处背景细节受到浓密空气散射与景深处理而逐渐模糊，保留真实的空间深度。

便利店顶部具有低矮的灰褐色天花板、细长的暖黄色荧光灯、部分通风结构与低对比的旧化表面。灯管沿过道方向排列，暖金色光线经过雾化空气扩散成柔和的长条形高光。

画面中上方偏右有一盏明显的暖黄色荧光灯，发出柔和而明亮的琥珀金色光线。灯光照亮人物黑色发髻的上缘、脸颊、肩部、黑金旗袍与右侧货架上缘，形成暖色环境层次。

整个便利店内部充满细密而均匀的湿润空气散射，画面左侧的冰蓝色冷柜光在空气中形成明亮的冷色体积光幕，右侧暖黄色顶灯则形成低对比的暖金色光雾。空气雾化自然地覆盖中远景，使右侧商品货架和店铺深处的对比度明显降低。

雾气并不是清楚的白色烟柱，也不是完全遮挡空间的大量蒸汽，而是一层具有连续深度、柔和透明度和真实光学散射的空气薄雾。越靠近高亮冷柜，雾气与冷蓝色光线的融合越明显；越靠近远处货架，空气散射使深色区域逐渐呈现灰青褐色。

整体光照采用强烈冷暖混合的电影式三维CG照明。主要冷光来自画面左侧冷柜内部的冰蓝白色灯管，主要暖光来自顶部的琥珀黄色荧光灯。两组光源在人物皮肤、黑色长发、丝缎衣料、玻璃和瓷砖表面产生不同的反射响应。

人物的面部受到左侧冷柜光线照射，脸颊、鼻梁、下颌和露出的肩膀呈现柔和的冷白色与淡青蓝色反光。顶部暖黄色灯光使面部较高的位置产生少量浅金白色高光，整体肤色保持自然的柔和象牙白色。

黑色长发在靠近冷柜的位置呈现冷蓝灰色边缘反射，在靠近顶部暖灯的位置产生极细的暖棕金色高光。深黑色旗袍保持浓郁的暗部体积，受光区域具有低调的墨绿色丝缎反射，金色盘龙刺绣在暖黄色灯光下呈现明亮而纤细的金色纹样。

白色蕾丝袜在左侧冷蓝色环境光照射下呈现浅冰蓝白色和珍珠白色变化，细密的蕾丝花边与薄纱表面产生柔和的高光。黑色漆皮高跟鞋产生小面积、较为集中的冷白色和暖金色镜面反射，瓷砖地面则呈现更宽、更弱的环境光反射。

冷柜玻璃表面的透明水滴具有真实的折射、局部透射、表面张力和不同尺度的反光。靠近镜头的部分水滴形成柔和的小型高亮，远处水痕和冷柜商品逐渐融入雾化的蓝白色光场。

整体采用高动态范围HDR三维CG照明，冷柜内部最明亮的区域具有明显的Bloom高光扩散和局部过曝。冰蓝色亮部边缘自然溢出到周围空气中，部分玻璃结构和内部商品细节被高亮柔和覆盖，但人物面部和主要身体轮廓保持可辨认。

画面整体色彩以低饱和冰青蓝色、冷灰绿色、深墨绿色、灰褐色、奶油暖白色、柔和琥珀黄色和少量古金色为主。左侧大面积冷柜光构成画面的冷色视觉主体，右侧商品货架构成较暗的暖灰褐色背景，人物位于冷暖光场交界的位置。

整体对比度较低，画面暗部并非完全纯黑，而是带有青绿色、深灰褐色和灰蓝色的空气感。高光具有轻微的暖白色与冰蓝色光学扩散，中间调柔和而具有连续渐变，形成潮湿、朦胧、略带复古气质的电影级数字CG色彩表现。

构图采用16:9横向电影宽画幅，摄影机位于便利店中央过道附近，以略微宽广的中距离视角观察人物和冷柜。人物处于画面中央略偏右的位置，头部位于画面中上区域，身体从上半部一直延伸至画面底部，黑色高跟鞋和瓷砖地面完整可见。

人物高举的手臂沿画面中央偏左的位置向上延伸，形成明显的竖向动作线条，手掌靠近左侧冷柜上层的一瓶蓝色瓶装饮料。另一只手自然放在冷柜玻璃门上，与冷柜形成明确的视觉连接。

人物肩膀、腰部与髋部形成柔和的三分之四侧面扭转，臀部向画面右侧轻微偏移，两条腿在画面下半部形成自然的不对称站姿。浅灰白色条纹衬衫堆积在右臂附近，与黑色短装形成清楚的浅深色层次。

地面瓷砖、冷柜灯带、右侧货架层板和顶部荧光灯共同指向画面后方的透视消失点。人物位于两侧商业陈列空间之间，成为整个画面的中景视觉中心。

镜头焦点主要落在人物的眼睛、面部、黑色双髻、蓝紫色蝴蝶发饰以及胸前的金色盘龙纹样上。人物高举的手掌、蓝色瓶装饮料、放在冷柜玻璃上的另一只手和主要服装轮廓保持次级清晰度。

左侧靠近镜头的冷柜光带、内部商品与玻璃水汽因强烈曝光和空气散射而自然柔化，右侧远处商品货架与店铺后方空间则因浅景深逐渐失焦。人物面部相对清晰，但仍然保留柔和的CG镜头质感，不进行过度锐化。

深色旗袍采用真实的丝缎材质与自然的织物褶皱，金色盘龙纹样由细密的丝线刺绣构成，黑色蕾丝护手具有半透明的纤维纹理，浅灰白条纹衬衫具有真实的棉质厚度与重力折叠。

白色蕾丝袜具有细腻的薄纱透光、花卉蕾丝结构与自然的腿部贴合，黑色高跟鞋采用具有真实空间厚度的漆皮材质。玻璃冷柜采用物理可信的透明折射、凝结水珠、局部雾化与高亮镜面反射，商品货架采用真实的三维陈列结构和合理的空间透视。

画面具有电影级HDR高动态范围、强烈但柔和的冰蓝色Bloom、暖黄色顶部高光扩散、自然体积光、低对比度空气透视、适度的浅景深、微弱镜头眩光和细腻的光学柔焦。

人物面部、主要服装刺绣、眼睛和发饰保持柔和而清楚，冷柜内部、左侧高亮玻璃和远处商品货架具有更明显的雾化与失焦。整体呈现真实的三维空间光照、柔和的角色材质与具有电影气氛的数字CG成像。

人物的日系与东方美型特征体现在角色五官、服装剪裁、头发设计和装饰语言中，而实际的皮肤、头发、服装、玻璃、货架、瓷砖和光源均按照真实三维CG的材质与空间受光机制表现。

最终画面呈现一位乌黑双髻长卷发、佩戴蓝紫色蝴蝶发饰、穿着深墨绿色金龙纹改良旗袍、白色蕾丝袜和黑色高跟鞋的成年东方女性，在一间深夜复古便利店的冷柜旁侧身站立。她一只手高举伸向上方的蓝色瓶装饮料，另一只手轻轻扶住冷柜玻璃门，身体微微向左倾斜，腰部自然扭转，臀部向右偏移，双腿形成柔和的不对称站姿。

左侧冷柜释放出大面积明亮的冰青蓝色光芒，透明玻璃上的凝结水汽与内部照明产生柔和的折射和高光扩散。右侧高大的商品货架在暖黄色顶灯下逐渐延伸至店铺深处，远端冷白色门口和柜台隐约可见。

人物面部受到冰蓝色冷柜光与暖黄色顶灯的共同照亮，乌黑长发、金色盘龙刺绣、白色蕾丝袜与黑色漆皮高跟鞋呈现真实而细腻的材质光泽。整张画面被低饱和青蓝色与暖金色雾光笼罩，具有明显的空气散射、柔和Bloom、低对比暗部和高精度三维CG电影成像。

必须保持单一成年女性主体、乌黑蓬松双髻、浓密黑色波浪长发、蓝紫色蝴蝶发饰、深墨绿黑色金龙纹改良旗袍、青蓝色盘扣、黑色蕾丝护手、右肩滑落的浅灰白条纹衬衫、白色蕾丝边半透明长袜、细长白色吊带、黑色亮面高跟鞋、一只手高举取蓝色瓶装饮料、另一只手扶住冷柜玻璃、侧身微倾的站立姿态、左侧高亮冰蓝色冷柜、右侧密集便利店食品货架、顶部暖黄色荧光灯、瓷砖地板和后方深远的店铺空间。

turn each photo I upload into a separate, high-end design poster. Do not combine multiple photos into a collage. Each photo must be processed and output individually.

Preserve the original photograph in the upper section. Maintain the subject’s identity, structure, pose, realistic textures, natural lighting, shadows, and original color atmosphere. Apply only subtle, sophisticated color grading to achieve the aesthetic of an art magazine, independent publication, or gallery exhibition image.

Extract the most recognizable subjects, distinctive details, action cues, objects, and narrative relationships from the photograph. Reinterpret them as a visual system combining a modular 3×3 icon grid, naïve hand-drawn doodle illustrations, crayon/p colored-pencil textures, and handwritten typography.
Do not reproduce the original photograph in full detail, and do not create realistic illustrations. Instead, simplify the complex visual information into nine memorable visual elements. These may include:
The main subject
Distinctive physical or visual features
Personal belongings or objects
Plants or food
Modes of transportation
Poses or gestures
Emotional symbols
Small memorable details from the surrounding scene
Every element must be a semantic extension of the same photograph above, creating a cohesive “memory checklist” that clearly belongs to that specific image.
4. Grid System and Visual Arrangement
Use an implicit, loosely arranged 3×3 grid. The nine-cell structure should serve as an underlying compositional framework rather than a rigid, visible grid.
Slightly vary the position, scale, angle, and placement of each icon to create an organic, imperfect arrangement that feels structured but never mechanical. Aim for a natural loose grid / organic grid aesthetic.
At the top of the lower section, you may add a short handwritten title, accompanied by a few playful wavy lines, tiny stars, or decorative symbols.
At the bottom, include a very small handwritten caption, making the overall design feel like a page from a personal journal, visual diary, or curated collection sheet.
Maintain generous negative space. The layout should feel relaxed, cute, restrained, and visually balanced rather than cluttered.

Use a Naïve Hand-Drawn Doodle Illustration style.
Keep shapes simple, slightly childlike, and intentionally imperfect.
Use subtly shaky outlines with irregular line thickness.
Allow contours to remain partially open rather than perfectly closed.
Preserve a sense of deliberate imperfection and handmade character.
Avoid overly dense coloring. Let the paper texture, white grain, and rough edges remain visible.
Combine fine black outlines with colored-pencil or crayon fills and a few selective blocks of color.
Use flat color / spot color to establish visual relationships instead of relying on realistic lighting and shading.
If grid guidelines are included, keep them extremely faint, as if lightly sketched in pencil, rather than using clean, computer-generated table lines.
Final Art Direction
The finished poster should feel like a sophisticated independent art publication blended with a playful, handmade visual diary. The upper half should preserve the beauty and authenticity of the original photograph, while the lower half transforms its most meaningful details into nine charming, hand-drawn visual memories.
The final result must be a separate 3:4 vertical poster for each uploaded photograph, with an exact 50/50 split between the original photograph and the illustrated memory collection.

Prompt:
REALITY IN YOUR HANDS | CREATIVE FORCED-PERSPECTIVE PHOTOGRAPHY

Create an ultra-photorealistic, visually clever forced-perspective photograph that transforms an ordinary real-world scene into an extraordinary optical illusion.

CORE CONCEPT:
A human hand interacts with an existing architectural structure, landmark, everyday object, or distant element in a way that creates an unbelievable visual illusion. Through precise positioning, scale manipulation, and camera perspective, make it appear as though the person is physically holding, pinching, lifting, controlling, supporting, or interacting with something much larger.

CREATIVE DIRECTION:

- Use an unexpected visual connection between the foreground hand and background environment.
- Explore imaginative interactions with skyscrapers, bridges, monuments, staircases, sculptures, vehicles, and everyday objects.
- Make the illusion immediately understandable but surprising enough to make viewers look twice.
- Use clever alignment, natural proportions, and realistic spatial relationships.
- Keep the composition simple, spontaneous, and visually intelligent.

PHOTOGRAPHY & REALISM:
Captured like a real travel photograph by a skilled photographer using a professional DSLR or mirrorless camera. Natural daylight, authentic environmental textures, realistic skin details, accurate shadows, natural reflections, realistic depth, and exceptional optical clarity.

COMPOSITION:
First-person perspective where appropriate, with the hand positioned prominently in the foreground and the architectural subject clearly visible in the background. Carefully align both elements to create a seamless illusion.

IMPORTANT:
The result must look like an actual photograph taken in a real location, NOT CGI, NOT 3D rendering, NOT digital compositing, and NOT an illustration. Avoid artificial-looking hands, distorted fingers, impossible shadows, excessive editing, and unrealistic proportions.

FINAL RESULT: A genuinely creative, technically convincing optical illusion photograph that makes people stop scrolling, look twice, and wonder how the photograph was captured.

Every generation should introduce a completely different, original visual illusion rather than repeating the same concept.

浅灰蓝披帛轻柔环绕双臂，形成自然垂坠与丰富的纱料层次，刺绣与透明材质在阳光中带有细小反光。

明亮柔和的自然逆光从花廊侧后方照入，人物乌发边缘、透明琉璃与轻纱刺绣呈现细腻轮廓光，面部由柔和自然反射光照亮，肤色白皙通透，明暗过渡柔和，保留自然骨相结构。

85mm 人像镜头，浅景深，人物面部与眼睛精准对焦，紫藤花前景自然虚化，白色拱门和远处庭院形成柔和散景。真实细腻的皮肤纹理，清晰的睫毛、发丝、珍珠、琉璃与精致刺绣质感，明亮通透的电影自然光，高级古风杂志封面美学，梦幻而不失真实，精致华丽而不过度装饰，9:16 竖版。

Prompt:
Create a highly realistic 3×3 photo collage featuring the same young woman from the reference image, maintaining consistent facial features, hairstyle, natural skin texture, outfit, and overall appearance across all nine frames.

Outfit: A cute pastel pink winter outfit featuring a knitted pink beanie, fluffy white earmuffs, pink knitted gloves, a soft pink sweater with brown Nordic patterns, and a cozy winter scarf.

Location: A beautiful snowy mountain landscape with snow-covered mountains, pine trees, a clear vibrant blue sky, and soft white clouds in the background.

Composition: A perfectly aligned 3×3 grid collage containing nine separate portrait photographs. Each frame should feature a different natural pose and facial expression.

Nine Different Poses:

2. Winking playfully while making a peace sign near her face.
3. Holding both gloved hands close to her cheeks with a cute smile.
4. Looking back over her shoulder with a gentle smile.
5. Stretching both arms outward while enjoying the snowy scenery.
6. Making a heart shape with her gloved hands in front of her chest.
7. Sitting on the snow and looking up toward the sky with a happy expression.
8. Bringing one gloved hand close to the camera for a playful perspective shot.
9. Making a cute finger heart gesture while winking at the camera.

Photography Style: Ultra-photorealistic winter travel photography, natural candid expressions, beautiful soft daylight, realistic snow textures, detailed knitted fabric, natural hair movement, subtle camera depth of field, flattering natural lighting, crisp facial details, and vibrant winter colors.

Important: All nine frames must show exactly the same girl with consistent facial identity, clothing, accessories, and hairstyle. Every frame must have a unique pose and composition. Clean, symmetrical 3×3 collage layout, equal-sized panels, no borders, no text, no watermarks.

Aspect Ratio: 3:4 portrait collage, high resolution, professional photography quality.

GPT Image 2.6

Prompt:
Create an extraordinarily detailed, whimsical miniature fantasy world inspired by [YOUR SUBJECT], designed entirely as an enchanting handcrafted textile and sewing-art diorama.

CORE CONCEPT:
Transform [YOUR SUBJECT] into a magical miniature village made entirely from sewing materials, including colorful buttons, spools of thread, sewing thimbles, embroidered fabrics, lace, yarn, felt, crochet, ribbons, and delicate stitching. The entire scene must look like an intricate handmade miniature world brought to life.

ARCHITECTURE & DETAILS:
Build charming miniature houses, whimsical towers, tiny shops, bridges, pathways, staircases, and decorative structures using sewing thimbles, stacked thread spools, wooden buttons, folded fabrics, and embroidered textile pieces. Incorporate oversized colorful buttons as circular village squares and stepping stones. Use thread spools as towers, thimbles as little houses, and delicate stitched fabrics as rooftops, walls, and surrounding landscapes.

ENVIRONMENT:
Create a richly layered miniature landscape with rolling fabric hills, patchwork pathways, embroidered flowers, tiny gardens, delicate lace fences, hanging threads, and miniature decorative details. Everything must appear physically handcrafted from real textile materials.

MATERIALS & TEXTURES:
Show incredibly realistic fabric fibers, visible embroidery stitches, woven linen, knitted yarn, soft felt, frayed fabric edges, delicate lace patterns, buttonholes, twisted threads, and intricate handmade craftsmanship. Every object must have convincing tactile texture.

LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE:
Use warm, dreamy golden-hour lighting with soft sunlight streaming diagonally across the miniature world. Add tiny glowing lanterns, gentle atmospheric haze, delicate shadows, and beautiful depth. Create a magical, nostalgic fairytale atmosphere.

COLOR PALETTE:
Soft dusty pink, warm beige, muted lavender, cream, blush, sage green, pastel blue, and subtle golden accents. Maintain a harmonious, sophisticated pastel color palette.

COMPOSITION:
Create a wide, immersive, three-dimensional miniature diorama viewed from a slightly elevated front-facing perspective. Fill the entire frame with intricate details, multiple layers of miniature architecture, and a beautifully constructed foreground, middle ground, and background. Make the scene feel like a photograph of an actual handcrafted miniature installation.

VISUAL QUALITY:
Ultra-photorealistic miniature photography, extraordinary micro-details, realistic textile materials, exquisite handcrafted construction, cinematic depth of field, soft natural lighting, premium editorial photography, magical realism, and museum-quality miniature artistry.

IMPORTANT:
The identity and recognizable characteristics of [YOUR SUBJECT] must remain central to the entire composition. Interpret the subject creatively through the miniature sewing-world aesthetic rather than simply placing an ordinary object inside the scene.

No cartoon appearance, no plastic materials, no CGI-looking surfaces, no flat illustration, no artificial-looking textures, no unrelated objects, no typography, no captions, no watermarks.

The final result must look like a breathtaking, physically handcrafted miniature textile fantasy village photographed with a professional macro camera.

She leans backward against the polished wooden railing of a boat, her torso angled diagonally toward the left side of the frame; her back rests lightly against the railing, her head tilts far backward with her chin lifted toward the sky, and both arms extend freely outward in opposite directions, with one arm reaching behind her toward the left and the other stretching diagonally toward the lower right, palm open and fingers naturally relaxed. Her eyes are closed, eyebrows relaxed, and mouth open in a broad, spontaneous laugh, conveying pure joy and freedom. Her long, dark chestnut-brown hair is blown dramatically backward toward the right by the sea breeze, with individual strands streaming horizontally away from her face. Fair luminous porcelain skin with a bright ivory to light beige tone and a neutral-cool undertone, featuring natural realistic texture and soft highlights warmed by the sunset. Prompt:
Create a 3:4 vertical travel-memory poster using [LOCATION / DESTINATION / SUBJECT] as the only scene reference.

COMPOSITION:
Divide the image into two equal horizontal halves.

TOP HALF — REAL PHOTOGRAPH:
Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible, retaining recognizable architecture, natural proportions, perspective, lighting, shadows, and environmental details. Allow only subtle color correction and necessary cropping. Do not redesign or invent elements.

BOTTOM HALF — POP-UP PAPER WORLD:
Show a real open travel journal against a warm ivory background, with visible page thickness, a defined spine, gently curled corners, and tactile paper texture. Reconstruct the photograph’s most distinctive landmarks and environmental features as a miniature three-dimensional paper-cut scene rising from the pages. Use delicate architectural linework, restrained pastel coloring, layered cutouts, folded paper, realistic occlusion, and natural contact shadows.

TRANSITION:
Connect both halves organically using elements from the actual location, such as a river flowing into the book, a street continuing across the spine, or trees transforming into layered paper shapes. Make the transition feel spatially continuous rather than like a collage.

STYLE:
A sophisticated blend of authentic photography, handcrafted paper engineering, and minimalist travel-journal artistry. Preserve the destination’s identity and create the feeling of collecting a real place inside a book.

Avoid turning the photograph into an illustration, flattening the paper scene, distorting landmarks, adding unrelated objects, excessive decoration, titles, readable text, or watermarks.

FORMAT: 3:4 vertical, exact 50/50 horizontal split.

Subtitle: [ENGLISH LOCATION NAME]

RYOBIYORI
No. [NUMBER] / [YEAR]

All text, labels, washi tape, and decorative elements must remain entirely within the right half. The left half must contain only the original generated realistic destination scene. Never reproduce or modify an existing photograph.

Warm ivory watercolor-paper texture, delicate fibers, subtle grain, organic pigment edges, and a carefully assembled travel-journal feeling.

Realistic destination imagery × autumn watercolor illustration × handmade travel journal × nostalgic seasonal palette × premium editorial design.

Reference-image requests, image-editing instructions, existing-photo preservation, unequal panel widths, text crossing the center divider, excessive decoration, oversaturated colors, glossy digital painting, 3D rendering, misspelled text, extra logos, watermarks, and interface elements.

镂空金属文字雕塑

 GPT image 2.6 Prompt:

经典动漫游戏角色 × 多语言文字雕塑 × 镂空金属结构 × 真实美术馆摄影。

【角色抽卡】
每张独立选择一位具有鲜明辨识度的经典动漫或游戏成年角色，男女不限，作品来源开放。

准确保留原作标志性的发型、头部轮廓、经典服装、关键配饰及代表性武器，让人物即使完全由文字构成，依然能够辨认其角色身份。

【角色专属文字】
整座雕塑完全由与当前角色直接相关的文字构成。

根据角色原作设定，选择真实准确的姓名、别名、称号、所属组织、武器名称、技能名称、能力属性及具有代表性的世界观关键词。

允许混合中文、日文、英文及角色原作涉及的其他语言。

每张选择少量具有代表性的关键词，通过不同尺寸、方向与重复组合构成完整雕塑。

文字内容必须与角色身份对应，具有明确含义。重要文字保持完整可辨，优先使用准确的短词与短句。

【实体文字雕塑】
所有文字都是具有真实厚度的独立金属构件，通过局部交叠与精细焊接形成连续的三维开放式网格。

文字沿角色的头部、五官、头发、身体、服装与配饰的立体曲面自然排列。

通过字符的大小、方向、疏密和空间起伏塑造人物形态。

面部、头发与服装均由文字本身形成，文字间保留清晰的镂空间隙，可以透过雕塑看到背后的真实空间。

根据角色经典配色，在银色、深色金属及少量彩色金属之间自然选择，保留真实金属反光、连接节点和投影。

posts.text:
🤖#AI理解力チャレンジ・秋のホラー編
今更「シン・」がついたパロディ映画にハマっている、どうも。僕です。
今回は「私が監督した"シン・ハロウィン"」！
「らしさ」を汲んだ「映画のポスター」と「配信サイトの紹介ページ」が作成できます！
あなたの「シン・ハロウィン」を、ぜひ見せてください🎃

🎬プロンプト：

--- ↓ここから↓ ---

【正式な監督名】
名前：［ここに入力］
この名前を正式な監督名として、すべての制作物・クレジットに統一使用すること。英語名や別名義は本人の指定がある場合のみ使用する。

【目的】
ユーザーが監督した架空のパロディ映画**『シン・ハロウィン』**を、実在する商業作品のように企画・ビジュアル化する。
過去の会話からユーザーの美意識、創作傾向、ユーモア、こだわりを分析し、**「明らかにこの人が監督した映画」**と感じられる独自の作品をAI主導で創造する。情報不足の場合は独自の作家像を構築する。
作品の方向性は、本格派からB級・Z級、実写・アニメ・ハイブリッド、ホラー・コメディ・怪作まで自由。監督の作家性に最もふさわしい表現をAIが選ぶ。
主題は常に『シン・ハロウィン』。 既存のホラー映画を連想させるパロディ性を持ちつつ、独立した物語と世界観を持つ「本気のパロディ映画」として成立させる。

【制作モード】
最初に以下の3択のみ確認する。
- 映画ポスターのみ
- 作品紹介のみ
- 映画ポスター → 作品紹介
作品紹介のみの場合は画像／テキストを選択する。

【AIの制作方針】
物語、登場人物、ジャンル、映像形式、構図、色彩、タイトルデザイン、キャッチコピー、制作会社名義などは、指定がなければAIが主体的に決定する。
最適と判断した1案のみを提案する。
生成前には作品概要・ビジュアルの方向性を簡潔に説明し、大きな修正の有無だけ確認する。 細かな質問や選択は不要。

ユーザーの「生成してください」で画像制作を開始する。

【映画ポスター】
9:16縦長。日本公開向けの洗練された商業映画ポスターとして制作。
映画タイトル『シン・ハロウィン』、印象的なキービジュアル、キャッチコピー、正式な監督名、公開情報、制作クレジットを配置する。
監督独自の作家性、パロディの面白さ、作品ジャンルに適した映画的表現を重視。B級・Z級作品でも、意図的なチープさや奇抜さを含め、完成度の高い商業デザインに仕上げる。

【ポスター完成後】
次の3択のみ確認する。
作品紹介を画像で制作
作品紹介をテキストで制作
制作終了

【作品紹介｜画像】
9:16縦長。本当に存在する動画配信サービスの作品詳細画面のように描く。
独自の架空サービス名・ロゴ・ナビゲーション・検索・再生ボタン・予告編・マイリストなど、説得力のある商業UIを設計。

掲載内容：
映画タイトル、メインビジュアル、作品情報
完成映画の異なる場面を描いたダイジェスト画面3点（再生アイコン・尺・説明付き）
あらすじ、見どころ3点
監督近影とプロフィール
制作クレジット
映画の世界観は主にメインビジュアル、ダイジェスト、見どころで表現し、その他は視認性の高い現代的な配信UIとして整理する。
監督近影は過去の会話から導かれる創作上の人物像としてAIが演出。顔が不明な場合は後ろ姿、横顔、シルエット、制作現場などを活用する。
完成したポスターの設定、キャラクター、映像スタイルを一貫して継承する。

【作品紹介｜テキスト】
実在する映画公式サイト・配信サービスの掲載文のように、作品概要、あらすじ、見どころ、監督紹介、作風、必要に応じた架空の代表作、宣伝コピー、基本情報を簡潔にまとめる。

【独自性・品質】
既存映画のキャラクター・固有デザイン、公式ロゴ、ポスター、配信サービス固有のUIを直接流用せず、オリジナルの商業表現として設計する。

QUALITY FIRST.
Ultra high quality, professional commercial finish, ultra detailed, cinematic art direction, smooth clean rendering, refined lighting, rich textures, precise typography, polished UI, mobile-friendly readability, high resolution.

基本比率：9:16
高画質・高精細・滑らかな線・精密な素材感。スマートフォン閲覧に適した構図と文字の視認性を重視する。

【進行ルール】
制作モード選択 → AIによる企画 → 大きな修正の有無を確認 →「生成してください」で制作 → 必要に応じて作品紹介

ユーザーへの細かな判断の委任を避け、AI自身の発想と審美眼で完成させる。修正時は完成形を肯定的な描写で整理し、指示の矛盾を確認する。

最終目標は、監督本人の個性が強く表れた、唯一無二のパロディ映画『シン・ハロウィン』を生み出すこと。

--- ここまで ---

※ 名前はご自身でご入力ください。
※即時生成防止のため「生成してください」と言わない限り生成しないようになっています。
※ポスター作成後にAIからの問いかけがない場合は「次の段階に進んでください」と指示してください。
💡実写からアニメ、B級からZ級まで、どんなものができるかはガチャ仕様です。また、クレジット節約の為、紹介内容をテキスト出力することも選択可能です👍

🖼 作例：
①② GPT image / ③④Nano Banana 2.1
もっとオモシロB級映画になるかと思ったのに…(´･ω･`)
