posts.text:
GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
Create a premium FULL-FRAME 4:5 vertical vintage watercolor travel-art poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork from the written destination or subject alone. Do not request, upload, use, or depend on any reference image. Automatically identify the destination’s distinctive architecture, iconic landmarks, local streets, vegetation, and cultural atmosphere.

CORE CONCEPT:
Illustrate one charming local street, historic café, distinctive building, or recognizable destination landmark as a collectible vintage travel-art print. Capture the warmth and nostalgia of an old travel memory, combining architectural watercolor illustration with delicate ink details.

COMPOSITION:
Fill the entire 4:5 portrait canvas with the artwork from edge to edge. The illustration must occupy the COMPLETE FRAME, with no mockup, no surrounding wall, no framed-print presentation, and no blank margins outside the artwork.

Feature one prominent architectural subject, such as a historic corner café, pastel-colored townhouse, traditional storefront, or iconic local building. Include authentic windows, balconies, decorative façades, street details, and lush climbing plants or sidewalk trees where appropriate. Add subtle surrounding architecture to create natural depth without distracting from the main subject.

ART STYLE:
Hand-painted architectural watercolor with fine brown ink outlines, delicate pen-and-ink details, transparent watercolor washes, soft gouache accents, visible paper grain, natural pigment variation, and slightly imperfect handmade lines.

COLOR PALETTE:
Dusty rose, warm terracotta, muted sage green, soft olive, pale sky blue, warm cream, and gentle ochre. Automatically adapt the palette to the destination while maintaining a harmonious, nostalgic atmosphere.

LIGHTING & MOOD:
Soft natural daylight, gentle shadows, warm afternoon light, delicate foliage, and a peaceful lived-in atmosphere. Preserve the character of ordinary local life, creating the feeling of discovering a beautiful little street while travelling.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Integrate a small, elegant destination title directly into the artwork, using refined vintage editorial lettering. Add a discreet subtitle only when appropriate. Keep text minimal, legible, and secondary to the illustration.

TEXTURE & FINISH:
Premium archival art-print aesthetic, matte watercolor surfaces, subtle paper fibers, restrained ink details, organic brushwork, and sophisticated independent travel-poster design.

AVOID:
Photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy digital effects, generic architecture, oversaturated colors, excessive detail, cluttered typography, borders, picture frames, interior room mockups, white walls, product photography, logos, and watermarks.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Vintage architectural watercolor × nostalgic travel illustration × charming local streets × delicate botanical details × premium collectible art print.

FORMAT:
FULL 4:5 vertical portrait composition, edge-to-edge artwork, complete canvas coverage, high resolution, no external margins, no mockup, no frame.

GPT image 2.5

Prompt:

Create a high-fidelity, visually stunning app UI mockup for [APP NAME], inspired by the polished user experience of leading entertainment platforms such as Spotify and Netflix.

Design a realistic, professional interface that looks like a finished product created by an expert UI/UX designer. The screen should immediately communicate the app’s purpose, feature its most important content, and make the primary action obvious.

1. App Identity & Layout

App name: [APP NAME]
Platform: [Mobile / Desktop / Tablet]
Screen: Home / Dashboard
Target audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]
Featured content: [SONG / ARTIST / MOVIE / K-DRAMA / SHOW]
Visual direction: Clean, minimal, premium, modern, and cinematic.

2. Main Screen Composition

Create a well-organized interface with:

A recognizable app logo and navigation menu.
A clear header with search, notifications, and profile controls where appropriate.
A prominent featured-content section with beautiful, relevant artwork.
The content title, creator or artist, genre, and a concise description.
A highly visible primary action button, such as Play, Watch Now, or Explore.
A secondary action such as Like, Save, or Add to List, where appropriate.
Horizontally scrolling content cards for recommendations, popular items, or recently played content.
A persistent bottom navigation or playback bar when appropriate for the platform.

3. Visual Design

Use a sophisticated design system with:

Carefully balanced spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy.
Crisp typography with clear distinctions between headings, descriptions, and metadata.
Consistent margins, rounded cards, subtle shadows, and refined iconography.
High-quality cinematic imagery or album artwork relevant to the featured content.
A cohesive color palette inspired by the app’s identity.
Realistic interface details, including progress bars, playback controls, active navigation states, and content thumbnails when relevant.

4. User Experience

Make the screen intuitive, uncluttered, and believable. The user should instantly understand what is featured and how to interact with it. Keep the primary action prominent, secondary controls understated, and supporting content visually organized.

5. Rendering & Presentation

Render the complete interface as a polished, high-resolution product mockup. Show the entire screen clearly, with sharp text, realistic UI components, accurate proportions, and professional lighting or device framing when suitable.

The final result should feel like a premium, launch-ready entertainment app design—not a generic template, wireframe, poster, or collection of unrelated elements.

Important: Preserve the supplied app name, labels, and content exactly. Do not invent prices, account details, ratings, statistics, or unsupported features. Prioritize usability, visual consistency, and a clear content hierarchy.

Prompt:
Create a sophisticated, vintage-inspired editorial poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio, using the uploaded image as the primary visual reference.

UPLOADED IMAGE: Use the uploaded image to determine the subject, theme, and visual inspiration automatically. Identify its main subject and create a beautiful, photorealistic cinematic scene that represents it. Preserve the essential identity and meaning of the subject while artistically adapting the composition to match the poster design.

POSTER DESIGN & LAYOUT:

Create a warm, pale beige, aged-paper background with subtle paper fibers, fine grain, and authentic vintage print imperfections. Place a large rectangular photographic panel across most of the canvas, leaving a narrow beige border. Give the panel softly rounded bottom corners and a faded analog-film appearance.

OVERSIZED TYPOGRAPHY:

Automatically determine a short, elegant title based on the uploaded image's subject. Display that title in enormous, high-contrast serif typography across the upper third of the poster, stretching almost edge to edge. Use tall, refined letterforms, dramatic thick-and-thin strokes, and tight spacing.

Color the headline muted dusty turquoise-blue with subtle photographic texture and weathered ink. Allow the letters to overlap the sky or upper portion of the photograph, blending typography and imagery into a sophisticated editorial composition.

SMALL EDITORIAL DETAILS:

Near the upper-left part of the title, add the small heading “Colors” with “from” arranged vertically underneath.

Near the upper-right side, add a tiny, understated subtitle reading “a collection of color combinations / inspired by [DETECTED SUBJECT].”

Add the vertical annotation “Save for later” beside the right edge of the headline.

Place two tiny four-pointed turquoise star symbols near the top-left and top-right corners of the beige background.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE:

Create a cinematic, photorealistic image inspired by the uploaded subject, with natural lighting, atmospheric depth, authentic textures, muted colors, subtle 35mm film grain, softly faded contrast, and a nostalgic analog-film finish.

Automatically choose the appropriate environment, composition, colors, and atmosphere based on the uploaded image. Keep the main subject visually compelling and the photograph integrated naturally with the oversized typography.

COLOR PALETTE:

Warm cream, dusty turquoise-blue, muted sky blue, and naturally derived earthy tones that complement the uploaded image. Preserve the understated, timeless aesthetic of a premium independent design magazine.

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:

- Use the uploaded image as the subject reference; do not require the user to type a subject name.
- Automatically detect the subject and generate a suitable title.
- Create a new, theme-appropriate cinematic composition rather than simply placing the original image inside a frame.
- Maintain the same vintage poster layout, oversized typography, beige margins, small annotations, and subtle decorative stars.
- Keep the composition balanced, artistic, and uncluttered.
- Avoid watermarks, glossy digital effects, oversaturation, and unnecessary decorative elements.
- Render all typography as accurately as possible.

OUTPUT: A high-resolution, photorealistic editorial poster in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, inspired by the uploaded image and styled consistently with premium vintage magazine art direction.

都是Opus5.5 + GPT-image2.5
开足马力，一路high模型彪到底
来制作提示词

本次提示词：
```
Turn each photo I upload into its own premium design poster: no multi-image collage, one output per photo. Use a 3:4 vertical format folded like a card into a top half and a bottom half of the same height, the fold falling exactly on the horizontal centre line of the frame; the fold itself is not drawn.

The top half keeps the original photo, preserving the subject's identity, structure, pose, real texture, natural light and original colour mood, with only a light refined grade so it reads like an art magazine, independent publication or exhibition image. To fit the frame, the surrounding background may be extended naturally, but the subject must never be stretched, distorted or altered; crop the photo as a full shot, leaving headroom above the subject so its top is never cut off. Add no text of any kind to the top half; all lettering belongs to the bottom half. Shop signs, brand marks and printed lettering already in the photo stay in the original photo above; the bottom half never copies them.

The bottom half extracts only the photo's most recognisable **subject, contour, structure, pose and narrative relationship**, rebuilt as a **Giant Peeking over the Horizon**. Do not copy the whole photo; enlarge the subject to an impossible size, hide it behind the distant horizon so only the top of its head and the upper half of its face show, and leave only a few tiny people in the foreground, so the link to the photo above is read at a glance. **The subject must be large enough to dwarf the far hills, rising from behind the horizon with its upper body or upper face showing and its body cut off by the horizon; scattered across the broad foreground plane are a few rice-grain-small people going about their business, unaware of the gaze behind them, with a broad empty plane between the two.**

The bottom half needs a fresh artistic judgement. Even if the original is badly composed, cluttered or has a tiny subject, rescue it through **enlarging the subject, removing surroundings and simplifying**; however detailed the subject, first gather it into a few rounded recognisable large shapes, its eyes only dark ovals inside white rings. When the photo is itself a scene, take only its single most representative element to enlarge into the giant and leave the rest undrawn.

The form centres on **flat masses with soft, hazy edges**: no form has an outline, colour melting slowly outward at the rims as if seen through a thin mist. People, animals, buildings and objects all gather into rounded large masses, their expression somewhere between curiosity and worry.

The material is **clean, flat soft-edged colour masses**: the melting happens only where forms meet, the inside of each mass even.

The composition uses **a huge subject + a full spread of horizontal colour bands**: a narrow strip of sky at the top, a silhouette of far hills below, and below that a plane filling most of the picture. The visible part of the subject sits upper-centre with a little headroom, and nothing touches the central fold. Better an emptier foreground than more things added to the plane.

Take the most emotional colours from the photo above and mix them into **one hue family filling the whole picture and one face of the opposite temperature**: the family stretches its values from the palest plane to the deepest hills, the subject's face takes one soft colour of the opposite temperature as the only contrast, and the sky takes a brighter colour on the face's side to answer it. Avoid several hues side by side.

Text is only a minimal editorial intervention, in any language, with no fixed preset title. Distil a short title from this photo's subject, action, mood or metaphor, written as **the giant's inner voice at this moment**, only this one line, with no numbering, rules or small labels; the type is small, much smaller than the subject, in **heavy white sans-serif** set over the far hills, justified wide so the words open into gaps of uneven size, its colour the palest light in the picture, its tone quiet with a hint of question; any Chinese is always in simplified characters. The line must add to the picture: say one thing the picture cannot show that belongs only to this photo; the title does not name the things in the picture and writes no clichés or musings.

The whole reads like a poetic poster by an independent illustrator: horizontal colour bands, a soft-edged giant, rice-grain people and a white phrase together make it quiet, soft and quietly unsettling.

Avoid a full scene copy and template-poster feel, avoid a subject the same size as the people or a giant standing whole in the picture, and avoid edges drawn as crisp outlines and a foreground crowded with people and things.
```

Prompt:
Create a premium 2:3 vertical vintage-modern travel poster of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION], combining painterly realism, elegant geometric framing, and sophisticated editorial design.

CORE CONCEPT: Celebrate the unique identity of the destination through one beautifully composed architectural landscape, blending vintage travel-poster charm with contemporary graphic design.

COMPOSITION: Place the main scene inside a large, elegant geometric arch occupying most of the poster. Surround it with overlapping circles, curved shapes, and abstract color blocks that frame the landscape without overwhelming it. Create a balanced composition with generous negative space and a clear visual hierarchy.

LANDMARKS & SCENERY: Automatically identify the destination’s most recognizable landmark, authentic architecture, characteristic skyline, and two or three complementary local details. Preserve distinctive architectural silhouettes and believable proportions. Integrate foreground, middle ground, and background naturally into one cohesive panoramic scene rather than creating a collage of unrelated attractions.

ART STYLE: Painterly realism with the warmth of traditional travel illustrations. Render buildings, landscapes, and landmarks with refined detail, soft brushwork, atmospheric depth, and gently simplified forms. Combine realistic architectural character with clean geometric shapes and a polished modern editorial finish.

COLOR PALETTE: Develop a destination-specific palette using harmonious pastels, warm ivory, muted coral, dusty rose, soft turquoise, sage green, or powder blue wherever appropriate. Let the selected colors reflect the location’s architecture, landscape, and atmosphere rather than forcing every destination into an identical palette.

LIGHTING & TEXTURE: Use warm, diffused sunlight, a luminous pastel sky, delicate atmospheric haze, and subtle natural shadows. Add fine paper grain and a restrained printed-art texture to create the tactile quality of a premium collectible poster.

TYPOGRAPHY: Place [DESTINATION NAME] prominently near the upper center, using elegant, thin uppercase lettering with generous tracking. Keep the title refined and legible. Add a small, understated emblem inspired by the destination’s cultural identity, positioned harmoniously within the geometric layout.

DESIGN BALANCE: Maintain a clear distinction between the illustrated landscape and the surrounding abstract shapes. Use overlapping geometry to guide the eye toward the landmark, while preserving breathing room, balanced proportions, and an uncluttered editorial composition.

FINAL AESTHETIC: Vintage-modern travel art, painterly architectural realism, Japanese-inspired pastel elegance, sophisticated geometric framing, warm sunlight, and premium art-print craftsmanship.

AVOID: Photographic images, generic landmark collages, inaccurate architecture, distorted buildings, excessive decorative elements, harsh colors, heavy digital effects, cluttered typography, illegible lettering, logos, and watermarks.

FORMAT: Full-bleed 2:3 vertical composition, high resolution, crisp architectural details, elegant typography, and a polished collectible travel-poster finish.

posts.text:
GPT Image 2.6

Prompt:
Create a poetic 3:4 vertical print poster using my uploaded photograph.

First, carefully examine the photograph and identify its most distinctive elements that could naturally extend upward, such as flower branches, an animal’s head and neck, tree canopies, or other prominent subjects. Preserve the key elements of the original photograph and the spatial relationships between the main subject and its surroundings.

OVERALL COMPOSITION:

Design the entire poster as one continuous, seamless composition.

Top section (approximately 1/3): Create clean, warm-white negative space featuring two short lines of English poetry that complement the mood and atmosphere of the photograph.

Middle section: Select one short English word that reflects the photograph’s theme. Display it in large, elegant serif typography, stretching across the width of the composition. The oversized word must serve as the visual boundary between the upper negative space and the photograph below.

Allow the main subject extracted from the original photograph to retain its realistic photographic appearance. Naturally extend it upward from the lower photographic scene, crossing the typographic boundary and partially overlapping some of the large letters as it enters the upper negative space. Maintain a believable physical connection between the subject and the original scene, with realistic overlap and depth, while ensuring that the word remains clearly readable.

IMPORTANT: Do not create two separate images stacked on top of each other. The entire poster must feel like one continuous, integrated composition.

PHOTOGRAPHIC TREATMENT AND ATMOSPHERE:

Apply a noticeable artistic atmospheric treatment to the main photograph. Choose lighting and colour grading that complement the original image, such as golden sunset light, soft spring sunlight, tranquil twilight tones, or luminous water reflections.

Enhance the emotional atmosphere while preserving the recognisability and essential details of the original photograph.

COLOUR PRINT HALFTONE EFFECT:

Incorporate fine, clearly visible, colourful circular halftone printing dots within the oversized typography and the stylised photographic areas.

- Use cyan, blue, magenta, and yellow dots.
- Allow subtle misregistration between the coloured dots to create an authentic vintage CMYK printing effect.
- Make the halftone dots denser in darker areas and more widely spaced in brighter areas.
- Preserve the main subject’s realistic photographic texture.
- Keep the upper warm-white negative space relatively clean and uncluttered.

ORIGINAL PHOTO INSET:

Place a small thumbnail of the original, unedited photograph in the upper-right corner, occupying approximately 15–18% of the poster's total width.

- Display the complete original photograph without any artistic filters or stylisation.
- Add a delicate, thin border.
- Include a small, neat "ORIGINAL" label.
- Ensure the thumbnail does not obstruct the main typography or the subject extending across the visual boundary.

FINAL ART DIRECTION:

Maintain a restrained, poetic, sophisticated aesthetic with the appearance of a premium vintage editorial magazine print.

Ensure all text is correctly spelled, accurately rendered, and visually balanced.

No additional titles, watermarks, unnecessary text, or unrelated decorative elements.

Prompt: Hyper-realistic IMAX-level Netflix-style cinematic surrealist rainbow-paint photography, 9:16 vertical. Use the uploaded image as the primary visual reference and preserve the exact facial identity, proportions, and defining features. Create a woman wearing a white cropped T-shirt printed with a pastel rainbow, distressed blue jeans with large frayed knee openings and colourful paint splatters, and grey lace-up sneakers marked with traces of paint. She lies diagonally across the asphalt road, her upper body resting comfortably on the ground and her long hair spread widely around her head. One knee is raised prominently toward the camera, making the sneaker appear large in the foreground, while her other leg extends diagonally toward the lower edge. Her left arm bends above her head with the hand resting behind her hair, while her right hand holds a small paintbrush upright beside her face. Her face turns slightly upward toward the left, her blue eyes gazing dreamily toward the sunset, eyebrows relaxed and lips forming a gentle, playful smile. Her long, voluminous chestnut-brown hair fans out across the road, with loose waves and individual strands scattered naturally over the painted surface. Fair luminous porcelain skin with a bright ivory to light beige tone and a neutral-cool undertone, natural skin texture and soft rosy highlights. A long, straight desert highway stretches toward the distant horizon, where the setting sun sits directly above the vanishing point beneath dramatic dark storm clouds. A thick, glossy rainbow-coloured paint trail curves along the road behind and around her, transitioning through red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet. Paintbrushes of different sizes, colourful splashes, a paint-covered bucket and a smartphone with a vivid rainbow screen are scattered across the foreground. Warm golden sunbeams break through the clouds, illuminating the paint and creating a striking contrast against the dark asphalt and stormy sky. Apply rich cinematic colour grading with fiery amber highlights, deep charcoal shadows, vivid saturated rainbow pigments, subtle teal-blue atmospheric tones and controlled contrast. Emphasize the wet, glossy paint, realistic road texture, dimensional clouds, glowing sunset rays and crisp foreground details, with a polished surreal editorial finish. 
Negative prompt: changed identity, incorrect pose, misplaced props, distorted hands, extra fingers, bad anatomy, plastic skin, flat lighting, dull colours, text, watermark.

posts.prompt:
Ultra-Realistic Facebook Self-Hug Graffiti Mural – 8K Cinematic Portrait

Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic full-body street portrait using the uploaded reference photo as the exact identity reference.

1. Face & Character Identity
Preserve the real person's exact facial identity, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, hairstyle, hairline, beard, skin tone, age appearance, and natural body proportions. Do not beautify, redesign, or alter the face. The real person and the mural character must look like the same recognizable individual.

2. Outfit
Dress the real person in a stylish burgundy-red bomber jacket over a black T-shirt, black cargo shorts, and clean white sneakers with blue accents. Both the real person and the giant mural character must wear exactly the same outfit, with matching colors, patterns, textures, and details.

3. Giant Self-Hug Mural
Create a huge, highly detailed illustrated portrait of the same person painted on an old, weathered grey concrete wall. The mural character appears behind the real person, approximately twice as large, with a warm, confident expression.

One giant illustrated arm wraps naturally across the real person's shoulders and upper chest, while the other arm wraps around the waist, with its hand resting visibly on the abdomen. Create a convincing three-dimensional optical illusion of the giant mural character hugging the real person from behind.

Ensure both illustrated arms connect naturally to the mural character's body. The hands must be anatomically correct, with realistic fingers and natural contact with the real person's clothing.

4. Facebook-Inspired Graffiti
Decorate the concrete wall with vibrant electric-blue and black paint splashes, a large blue Facebook “f” symbol, floating blue thumbs-up icons, red heart reactions, laughing emojis, and notification bubbles. Add bold, artistic graffiti lettering that reads exactly:

“LOVE YOURSELF FIRST”

Use expressive street-art brushstrokes, layered paint textures, subtle paint drips, and colorful social-media-inspired graphics.

5. Lighting & Photography
Photorealistic street photography, natural daylight, realistic concrete texture, cinematic shadows, lifelike skin texture, detailed fabric, accurate anatomy, realistic shoe details, premium editorial photography, sharp focus, balanced contrast, and professional color grading.

6. Composition
Vertical 9:16 composition. Show the person from head to toe, including both shoes. Position the real person in the center foreground and the giant mural directly behind them. Keep the text and Facebook-inspired graphics visible around the subject without covering the face.

7. Quality & Restrictions
Ultra-detailed 8K appearance, realistic proportions, seamless mural interaction, convincing self-hug illusion, professional composition.

Negative Prompt: Different face, altered identity, different hairstyle, mismatched outfits, extra arms, extra fingers, deformed hands, disconnected limbs, floating hands, unnatural hugging pose, distorted anatomy, duplicate real people, blurry face, plastic skin, cartoon rendering, low resolution, cropped feet, misspelled text, unwanted logos, watermark.

posts.text:
GPT2 x 被注视 x 概念 海报  x 美学提示词

大放厥词：
未来会有很多小朋友
发明很多有意思的、很精彩的创意

然后让我们眼前一亮的感觉
这个时代，美学探索的难度真的平了...

我天天吹的Opus5.5+GPT-image2.5
谁用谁知道哦

真是念几下，美学探索就灵光了

本组提示词：

```
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两半像对折的卡片，折痕正好落在画面正中的水平中线上，两半一样高，折痕本身不画出来。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体；照片按全景裁，主体头上留天，不裁到顶部。上半部分不添加任何文字，所有文字只出现在下半部分。照片里原有的招牌、品牌标志和印刷文字只留在上方原照里，下半部分不照搬。

下半部分只提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为**暗室里唯一的一块光（The Only Light in a Dark Room）**。不要完整复制照片，使人一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。**必须让画面几乎全黑，只有一块边缘柔和、自己发光的长方形是光源；主体很小，低低地待在光的前方，朝光的一侧被照得发亮，背光一侧沉进黑里，轮廓微微分出一冷一暖的色边；一张等距排开的极小白色十字网格铺满整个画面。**

下半部分需重新做美术判断。哪怕原图构图差、背景乱、主体小，也要通过**压暗、缩小与删环境**把它救成一张成立的作品；主体保留照片里认得出的轮廓和姿态，只占画面中下部一小块，四周大片黑暗；照片里最亮的那一处光收成这块长方形。照片本身是场景时，只取最有代表性的一个单体留在光前，其余沉进黑里。

造型以**一个人独自面对一块光，却被冷静的网格和一个大词注视着**为核心：光和主体都略带柔焦，像一张没对准焦的快照，只有字和网格清楚锐利；地面上留一层被光扫到的冷色微光。人物、动物、建筑和器物都同样被这块光单侧照亮。

材质为**洁净的深黑、柔焦的光与锐利的白色细符号**。

构图采用**极小视觉岛 + 大面积纯净留白**：光和主体在中部偏一侧，其余全是黑。主体完整，头顶留一点空，任何部分都不碰到中间的折痕。宁可主体再小一点，也不要把画面照亮。

配色从上方照片中提取最冷、最寂静的那种饱和色，调制成**几乎全黑、一块饱和冷光和近白的受光边**：冷光只在那块长方形和它晕开的一圈里，字和网格是白色。避免第二处光源和暖色铺开。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种，不预设固定标题。从这张照片的主体、动作、情绪或隐喻里提炼一个简短标题，写成**主角此刻的一句心声**，只是一个短词，另配顶部一行极小的白色短句和底部一行三段小字（年份每张另起）；提炼一个说出照片隐喻、不念东西名字的最短的词，放大成画面主角，横跨画面中部，两侧留出空白、不碰到边，字距拉得很开，只遮住主体的一部分，不替掉任何一个整字或字母，整个词仍然认得出来；用**白色粗体无衬线字**，字色取画面里最亮的白，语气冷；中文一律用简体。这句话要给画面加分：说出画里看不见、只属于这张照片的一件事，标题不念画里东西的名字，不写套话和感悟。

整体像一张电子音乐或独立电影的概念海报：暗室、一块冷光和十字网格共同构成安静疏离、带着被凝视的不安。

避免完整场景复刻、模板化海报感，避免画面被照亮、主体画大或正对镜头。
```

下半部分只提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为**暗室里唯一的一块光（The Only Light in a Dark Room）**。不要完整复制照片，使人一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。**必须让画面几乎全黑，只有一块边缘柔和、自己发光的长方形是光源；主体很小，低低地待在光的前方，朝光的一侧被照得发亮，背光一侧沉进黑里，轮廓微微分出一冷一暖的色边；一张等距排开的极小白色十字网格铺满整个画面。**

下半部分需重新做美术判断。哪怕原图构图差、背景乱、主体小，也要通过**压暗、缩小与删环境**把它救成一张成立的作品；主体保留照片里认得出的轮廓和姿态，只占画面中下部一小块，四周大片黑暗；照片里最亮的那一处光收成这块长方形。照片本身是场景时，只取最有代表性的一个单体留在光前，其余沉进黑里。

造型以**一个人独自面对一块光，却被冷静的网格和一个大词注视着**为核心：光和主体都略带柔焦，像一张没对准焦的快照，只有字和网格清楚锐利；地面上留一层被光扫到的冷色微光。人物、动物、建筑和器物都同样被这块光单侧照亮。

材质为**洁净的深黑、柔焦的光与锐利的白色细符号**。

构图采用**极小视觉岛 + 大面积纯净留白**：光和主体在中部偏一侧，其余全是黑。主体完整，头顶留一点空，任何部分都不碰到中间的折痕。宁可主体再小一点，也不要把画面照亮。

配色从上方照片中提取最冷、最寂静的那种饱和色，调制成**几乎全黑、一块饱和冷光和近白的受光边**：冷光只在那块长方形和它晕开的一圈里，字和网格是白色。避免第二处光源和暖色铺开。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种，不预设固定标题。从这张照片的主体、动作、情绪或隐喻里提炼一个简短标题，写成**主角此刻的一句心声**，只是一个短词，另配顶部一行极小的白色短句和底部一行三段小字（年份每张另起）；提炼一个说出照片隐喻、不念东西名字的最短的词，放大成画面主角，横跨画面中部，两侧留出空白、不碰到边，字距拉得很开，只遮住主体的一部分，不替掉任何一个整字或字母，整个词仍然认得出来；用**白色粗体无衬线字**，字色取画面里最亮的白，语气冷；中文一律用简体。这句话要给画面加分：说出画里看不见、只属于这张照片的一件事，标题不念画里东西的名字，不写套话和感悟。

整体像一张电子音乐或独立电影的概念海报：暗室、一块冷光和十字网格共同构成安静疏离、带着被凝视的不安。

避免完整场景复刻、模板化海报感，避免画面被照亮、主体画大或正对镜头。

Blend the magical nighttime atmosphere of Tokyo's illuminated streets, delicate white lilies, and a graceful young Japanese woman holding a tulip into a single sophisticated editorial poster. The artwork should combine photorealistic photography with delicate watercolor illustration on warm ivory handmade paper.

TOP SECTION — CINEMATIC PHOTOGRAPHY:
Show a stunning white lily in the foreground, its delicate petals illuminated by warm golden streetlights, with tiny water droplets adding realistic detail. Behind the flower, create a softly blurred Tokyo street at night, filled with glowing shop windows, colorful city lights, and beautiful golden bokeh. Use cinematic depth of field, realistic textures, and a peaceful Japanese urban atmosphere.

CENTER SECTION — JAPANESE BEAUTY:
Feature a graceful young Japanese woman with natural East Asian facial features, delicate skin texture, expressive dark eyes, and long, softly wavy black hair. She wears an elegant cream-white knitted sweater or a refined white blouse with subtle lace details. She gently holds a soft pink tulip close to her face, looking at it with a peaceful, thoughtful expression.

Her pose should feel candid, natural, and emotionally subtle rather than overly posed. Warm golden city lights illuminate her face while the background remains softly blurred. Maintain realistic hands, natural proportions, delicate makeup, and authentic photographic details.

LOWER SECTION — WATERCOLOR TRANSFORMATION:
Gradually transform the photographic scene into a beautiful hand-painted watercolor illustration. Recreate the same woman holding the tulip, surrounded by flowing watercolor washes in soft ivory, dusty blue, blush pink, lavender, and warm golden tones.

Blend delicate floral details, translucent watercolor layers, subtle ink outlines, and scattered pigment splashes into the composition. Add a few elegant white lilies and tiny floral accents around the main illustration without overcrowding the design.

ARTISTIC BACKGROUND:

COLOR PALETTE:
Warm ivory, pearl white, soft blush pink, muted lavender, midnight blue, champagne gold, and gentle amber. Maintain a harmonious balance between the glowing nighttime city and the soft romantic floral atmosphere.

LIGHTING AND MOOD:
Cinematic nighttime lighting, warm golden bokeh, soft facial illumination, delicate highlights on flower petals, realistic shadows, and a peaceful Tokyo evening atmosphere. The overall feeling should be elegant, dreamy, romantic, calm, and sophisticated.

COMPOSITION:
Create a visually balanced vertical poster with a strong central focal point, carefully layered photographic and watercolor elements, generous negative space, refined editorial spacing, and premium art-book aesthetics.

At the bottom, elegantly write:
“TOKYO SOFT TULIP GLOW”

QUALITY:
Ultra-detailed, premium editorial artwork, photorealistic floral photography, sophisticated watercolor illustration, realistic human anatomy, natural facial features, delicate botanical details, cinematic depth of field, professional art direction, museum-quality paper texture, and exceptional visual harmony.

ASPECT RATIO:
4:5 vertical composition.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Low resolution, blurry main subject, distorted face, unnatural eyes, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate flowers, malformed petals, plastic skin, oversaturated colors, harsh lighting, cluttered composition, excessive decorative elements, illegible typography, misspelled title, artificial-looking watercolor effects, cartoonish facial features, and poor-quality textures.

A luxurious Tokyo-inspired editorial poster that seamlessly combines a glowing white lily, a graceful Japanese woman holding a tulip, magical nighttime city lights, and delicate watercolor artistry into one unified masterpiece.

Prompt:
UNIVERSAL PROMPT - POETIC EDITORIAL PRINT POSTER | 3:4

Transform the uploaded photograph into a poetic 3:4 vertical editorial print poster.

First, analyse the photograph and identify its most distinctive element that can naturally extend upwards, such as a flower branch, an animal’s head and neck, a tree canopy, or another prominent subject. Preserve the original scene, key details, and spatial relationships.

COMPOSITION & TYPOGRAPHY:

Create one continuous composition. Reserve approximately the upper third of the poster as clean, warm-white negative space, featuring two short lines of English poetry that complement the photograph’s mood.

Choose one short English word that reflects the photograph’s theme. Display it in oversized serif typography, spanning the width of the composition. This large word should visually separate the upper negative space from the photograph below.

Keep the extracted subject photorealistic, extending naturally from the original scene, crossing the typography boundary and partially overlapping the letters as it enters the upper white space. Ensure realistic depth, natural continuity, balanced letter visibility, and believable occlusion. Do not create two separate images stacked together.

IMAGE TREATMENT & PRINT TEXTURE:

Apply a noticeable atmospheric treatment suited to the original photograph, using appropriate lighting and colour grading, such as golden sunset tones, soft spring light, serene twilight, or luminous aquatic hues. Enhance the emotional atmosphere while preserving the photograph’s recognisable details.

Integrate fine, clearly visible coloured halftone printing dots into the oversized typography and stylised photograph. Use slightly misaligned cyan, blue, magenta, and yellow dots, with denser patterns in darker areas and sparser patterns in highlights. Keep the main subject photographic in appearance and the upper warm-white space relatively clean.

ORIGINAL PHOTO INSET:

Place a small thumbnail of the untouched original photograph in the upper-right corner, occupying approximately 15–18% of the poster width. Display it completely unaltered, with a thin border and a small “ORIGINAL” label. Ensure it does not obstruct the main typography or the subject extending across the boundary.

FINAL AESTHETIC:

Maintain a restrained, poetic, vintage editorial magazine-print aesthetic. Ensure all text is accurate, legible, and thoughtfully positioned. No additional headlines, watermarks, or irrelevant decorative elements.

COMPOSITION & TYPOGRAPHY:

Create one continuous composition. Reserve approximately the upper third of the poster as clean, warm-white negative space, featuring two short lines of English poetry that complement the photograph’s mood.

Choose one short English word that reflects the photograph’s theme. Display it in oversized serif typography, spanning the width of the composition. This large word should visually separate the upper negative space from the photograph below.

Keep the extracted subject photorealistic, extending naturally from the original scene, crossing the typography boundary and partially overlapping the letters as it enters the upper white space. Ensure realistic depth, natural continuity, balanced letter visibility, and believable occlusion. Do not create two separate images stacked together.

IMAGE TREATMENT & PRINT TEXTURE:

Apply a noticeable atmospheric treatment suited to the original photograph, using appropriate lighting and colour grading, such as golden sunset tones, soft spring light, serene twilight, or luminous aquatic hues. Enhance the emotional atmosphere while preserving the photograph’s recognisable details.

Integrate fine, clearly visible coloured halftone printing dots into the oversized typography and stylised photograph. Use slightly misaligned cyan, blue, magenta, and yellow dots, with denser patterns in darker areas and sparser patterns in highlights. Keep the main subject photographic in appearance and the upper warm-white space relatively clean.

ORIGINAL PHOTO INSET:

Place a small thumbnail of the untouched original photograph in the upper-right corner, occupying approximately 15–18% of the poster width. Display it completely unaltered, with a thin border and a small “ORIGINAL” label. Ensure it does not obstruct the main typography or the subject extending across the boundary.

FINAL AESTHETIC:

Maintain a restrained, poetic, vintage editorial magazine-print aesthetic. Ensure all text is accurate, legible, and thoughtfully positioned. No additional headlines, watermarks, or irrelevant decorative elements.

GPT Image 2.5 on ChatGPT

Prompt:

Create a charming, heartwarming two-panel vertical collage inspired by nostalgic childhood photography and handmade children’s crayon drawings.

TOP PANEL — PHOTOREALISTIC PHOTO: Capture a candid, ultra-realistic photograph of a happy young child enjoying a simple outdoor adventure in a beautiful countryside meadow. The child wears colorful, playful everyday clothing and a cute hat or headscarf, with a natural, spontaneous pose interacting with fluffy sheep grazing nearby. Alternatively, capture the child joyfully jumping in the air against a vivid blue sky. Use bright natural sunlight, authentic skin texture, realistic fabric details, soft shadows, natural colors, and an unposed documentary photography aesthetic. The scene should feel like a genuine childhood memory captured by a professional family photographer.

BOTTOM PANEL — MATCHING CRAYON DRAWING: Directly beneath the photograph, create a handmade children’s illustration of the exact same child, outfit, pose, and main subjects from the photograph. Use visible wax crayon strokes, colored-pencil scribbles, uneven hand-drawn outlines, imperfect proportions, and a warm ivory paper texture. Add small flowers, grass, clouds, a smiling sun, and playful decorative doodles. Include a few short handwritten words in colorful childlike lettering, such as “Little Moments, Big Joy” or “Jump for a Brighter Day.”

COMPOSITION: Stack both panels vertically with a clean horizontal division. The top photograph occupies approximately 60% of the image; the illustrated panel occupies the remaining 40%. Keep the child’s appearance, clothing colors, pose, and surroundings recognizable across both panels. Soft nostalgic colors, cheerful storytelling, wholesome family-album aesthetic, authentic handmade charm, high-quality photorealism in the upper panel, richly textured crayon artwork in the lower panel, portrait 4:5 composition.

IMPORTANT: The two panels must depict the same moment and subject. The upper half must look like a real photograph, while the lower half must look genuinely hand-drawn by a child. Do not blend the illustration into the photograph. Avoid 3D cartoon rendering, digital vector art, overly polished illustrations, artificial skin, and excessive decorative elements.

結合了東方十二生肖和西方十二星座

🐉♊️通用 GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

《生辰之影》SHADOW OF BIRTH

專屬信息
姓名：【填寫姓名】
生日：【YYYY .MM. DD】
生肖：【填寫生肖】
星座：【填寫星座】

東方生肖 × 西方星座 × 影子雕塑 × 生日紀念卡

根據填寫的信息，創作一張專屬生日藝術收藏卡。

生肖決定雕塑的實體形態，保留清晰可辨的輪廓與關鍵特徵。雕塑由不同深度的金屬曲面、彎曲薄片和鏤空構件組成，具有真實的連接與支撐結構。

星座決定雕塑的隱藏投影。一盞定向聚光燈照射雕塑，構件沿光線方向重疊，在後方牆面形成該星座的代表形象。雕塑與投影來自同一套三維結構，光照方向、遮擋關係與投影尺度自然可信。

根據生肖與星座自由設計雕塑材質、色彩、姿態和展廳環境，讓實體與投影都清晰可辨。

採用當代美術館典藏卡的設計語言，融合真實展覽攝影、克制配色、精緻字體與細膩紙張質感。

卡片上方排列標題：

「生辰之影」
SHADOW OF BIRTH

中央完整呈現一件生肖雕塑及其星座投影，兩者同等重要，留白自然。

卡片下方清晰、準確地排列所填寫的姓名、生日、生肖與星座。

結合生肖寓意與星座特質，自動創作一句簡短、溫暖的生日祝福，排列在個人信息下方。每張獨立創作，讓兩種意象自然呼應。

一張卡片，一件雕塑，一組投影，一個完整畫面。

9:16 竪版。

n=3，代表系列計劃數量，每次生成一張完整獨立單圖，不拼圖。

左下簽名：深藍色實心圓點在前，白色手寫體 DeepBlue 在後

Little moments, Tokyo streets, and a whole lot of nostalgia

With GPT Image 2.5 on ChatGPT 

Prompt:
Create a 2×2 collage of four candid, ultra-realistic street photography shots featuring the same stylish young woman exploring Tokyo, Japan, with a nostalgic 1990s disposable film camera aesthetic.

Subject: A beautiful young woman with platinum blonde hair tied in a high ponytail, soft face-framing strands, silver over-ear headphones, and natural makeup. She wears an oversized gray-brown checkered blazer over a white T-shirt, relaxed blue jeans, and carries a black shoulder bag. Maintain consistent facial features, hairstyle, outfit, and accessories across all four photographs.

Top-left panel: The woman stands on Takeshita Street in Harajuku, smiling brightly while holding and eating a Japanese crepe wrapped in paper. A colorful “Takeshita Street” entrance sign, crowded pedestrian street, Japanese storefronts, and busy urban surroundings fill the background.

Top-right panel: A casual arm's-length selfie of the same woman standing at a busy Tokyo pedestrian crossing. She looks directly into the camera with a relaxed expression. Large Japanese commercial buildings, street signs, traffic lights, and white zebra-crossing stripes create an authentic city atmosphere.

Bottom-left panel: The woman smiles playfully beside a Japanese vending machine filled with colorful drinks. She leans slightly toward the camera, with a narrow shopping street, small storefronts, and Japanese signs extending into the background.

Bottom-right panel: The woman sits on a wooden bench along a quiet traditional Japanese shopping street, reading a folded paper map or travel guide. Weathered wooden buildings, small shop entrances, potted greenery, and delicate cherry blossom branches create a peaceful springtime atmosphere.

Photography style: Authentic candid snapshots, slightly imperfect framing, natural body language, soft overcast daylight, subtle motion blur, realistic skin texture, muted colors, warm film grain, faded highlights, gentle shadows, low contrast, and a nostalgic analog camera finish. Add subtle orange date stamps near the bottom edges of the photographs, resembling old 35mm film prints.

Composition: Four equally sized rectangular photographs arranged in a clean 2×2 grid, separated by thin vertical and horizontal borders. Consistent subject identity throughout, documentary-style travel photography, realistic Japanese urban details, natural proportions, and a spontaneous personal travel diary feeling.

Aspect ratio: 3:5 vertical collage.

Avoid: Cartoon styling, illustration, excessive retouching, plastic skin, inconsistent faces, duplicated people, distorted hands, incorrect clothing, artificial lighting, and overly saturated colors.

一位25岁左右的成年东方幻想女性，容貌明艳华美，细长清亮的眼睛，柔和鹅蛋脸，鼻梁秀挺，唇色自然饱满，肌肤白皙细腻且富有生命感，神态端庄、高贵、略带威仪。身形纤细，姿态优雅稳定。

Prompt:
SOUTH AMERICAN PIXEL-ART TRAVEL POSTER

Create a visually stunning, highly detailed retro pixel-art travel poster in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, inspired by classic 16-bit and 32-bit video game aesthetics.

DESTINATION: [Insert City or Location]

DESIGN & COMPOSITION:
Create a beautiful, immersive pixel-art illustration showcasing the destination's most iconic landmarks, recognizable architecture, breathtaking landscapes, local culture, and distinctive atmosphere. Include authentic regional elements such as native plants, flowers, local people, traditional clothing, wildlife, streets, beaches, mountains, or other recognizable features relevant to the destination.

TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT:

- At the top, display the word "VISIT" in small, elegant, retro pixel typography.
- Below it, prominently feature the destination's name in large, bold, decorative pixel-art lettering.
- Include the destination's authentic national flag directly beneath the name.
- Make all typography clean, correctly spelled, legible, and beautifully integrated into the composition.

ART STYLE:
Use authentic high-quality pixel art with crisp square pixels, intricate pixel shading, rich saturated colors, beautiful lighting, atmospheric depth, and carefully crafted details. Aim for the visual quality of a premium retro video game environment.

COLOR & ATMOSPHERE:
Use vibrant blues, lush greens, warm sunlight, colorful architectural details, and striking natural contrasts. Create an inviting, adventurous, nostalgic travel-poster atmosphere.

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS:

- Accurately represent the selected destination and its recognizable landmarks.
- Use the correct national flag.
- Make every poster visually unique according to its destination.
- Maintain consistent typography, composition, and artistic style across different destinations.
- One destination per poster. Never combine multiple locations.
- No watermarks, signatures, borders, or unnecessary text.

FINAL RESULT: A premium, eye-catching retro pixel-art tourism poster that looks like an authentic collectible travel advertisement from a beautifully imagined 16-bit adventure game.

Create a premium 4:5 vertical architectural travel artwork for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / LANDMARK].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire scene creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / LANDMARK] alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT

Transform the destination into a charming handcrafted miniature world made entirely from knitted yarn, soft felt, embroidery, and plush textile materials. Reimagine its architecture, streets, nature, transportation, and local atmosphere as a sophisticated collectible textile diorama.

LANDMARK & COMPOSITION

Automatically select ONE unmistakable landmark representing [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / LANDMARK] and make it the central hero.

Build a complete miniature environment around it using authentic local architecture, streets, gardens, trees, shops, landscape, and a few tiny generic yarn characters. Keep the landmark’s recognizable silhouette and defining architectural features while translating everything into rounded handmade textile forms.

MATERIAL LANGUAGE

Every element should visibly feel handmade:
- chunky knitted yarn
- soft felt
- embroidered details
- woven fabric
- stitched edges
- wool fibers
- plush textile surfaces
- tiny handcrafted imperfections

Architecture should look carefully constructed from layered fabric and yarn rather than plastic, clay, or CGI.

ATMOSPHERE

Create a warm, playful, cozy travel atmosphere with soft natural lighting, gentle shadows, tactile fibers, rounded forms, and subtle depth. Add small destination-specific details such as local food, transportation, plants, signs, or cultural objects where they naturally enhance the scene.

Keep the background simple and softly colored so the miniature world remains the focus.

STYLE

Architectural travel poster × knitted miniature diorama × handmade textile art × plush yarn world × sophisticated editorial illustration.

The result should feel like an elaborate handcrafted collectible discovered in a miniature museum — whimsical but visually refined and architecturally recognizable.

COLOR

Avoid photorealism, plastic materials, smooth CGI, generic architecture, unrelated landmarks, hard geometric edges, excessive clutter, realistic humans, logos, watermarks, and flat vector illustration.

FORMAT

4:5 vertical, one cohesive miniature world, central landmark, rich textile detail, soft depth of field, premium handcrafted finish, highly detailed yarn and felt textures.

GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
Transform the attached photograph into a single, authentic cyanotype sun print, photographed as a physical artwork. Vertical 4:5 composition.

THE SHEET

A handmade cyanotype on thick cotton rag paper, lying on a plain, pale surface in soft natural daylight. The image fills most of the sheet, leaving visible white margins on all four sides. Keep the entire sheet inside the frame, with at least three edges clearly visible and one edge preferably showing a fibrous tear. The paper has subtle cockling from washing and drying, with realistic surface texture and a soft shadow along one side.

HAND-BRUSHED COATING

The photosensitive coating is applied by hand. Blue boundaries are naturally irregular, with visible brushstroke endings, small uncoated patches, uneven edges, and a few stray blue flecks on the white margins. Avoid perfectly straight, mechanical borders on all four sides.

CYANOTYPE TONES

Use only authentic cyanotype colours:

- Shadows: Deep Prussian blue.
- Midtones: Pale to medium cyan.
- Highlights: Completely bare, raw white paper with no blue pigment.

Maintain strong contrast and abrupt transitions between blue and white where appropriate, as in a traditional contact print. Fine paper fibres should remain visible through the blue. No grey, black, sepia, or additional colours. The result must look like a chemically produced cyanotype, not a blue filter over a photograph.

PRESERVE THE ORIGINAL IMAGE

Use the attached photograph as the sole source. Preserve the exact number, identity, position, proportions, silhouettes, poses, and arrangement of all subjects. Do not add, remove, duplicate, or rearrange people, animals, vehicles, or environmental details.

Translate the original photograph into cyanotype tones only: bright areas become bare paper white, midtones become cyan, and dark areas become deep Prussian blue. Preserve the original composition and recognisable facial and body shapes.

PHYSICAL PRESENTATION

Photograph the finished print as a real object resting on a plain, pale surface. Use soft directional daylight, realistic paper fibres, subtle shadows, and natural surface imperfections. Keep the entire sheet visible within the vertical 4:5 frame.

STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

- No text, letters, numbers, signatures, logos, stamps, or watermarks.
- No additional or missing subjects.
- No grids, graph lines, measuring scales, or blueprint-style graphics.
- No blue tint in the brightest highlights; they must be raw paper white.
- No extra colours, decorative effects, or artificial distressing.
- No hands, clips, frames, tools, props, or additional sheets.
- No cropping of the sheet or digitally flat presentation.

PRIORITIES

If every detail cannot be achieved simultaneously, prioritise preserving the exact original subjects and making the brightest highlights completely paper white. Next, maintain realistic physical paper texture and visible sheet edges. If necessary, simplify the brushed margins to one irregular edge and leave the other three edges cleanly cut.

Final result: A realistic, handmade cyanotype sun print with deep Prussian-blue shadows, cyan midtones, pure white paper highlights, organic brushed edges, and authentic cotton-rag texture, photographed as a physical object in soft daylight. Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

A handmade cyanotype on thick cotton rag paper, lying on a plain, pale surface in soft natural daylight. The image fills most of the sheet, leaving visible white margins on all four sides. Keep the entire sheet inside the frame, with at least three edges clearly visible and one edge preferably showing a fibrous tear. The paper has subtle cockling from washing and drying, with realistic surface texture and a soft shadow along one side.

HAND-BRUSHED COATING

The photosensitive coating is applied by hand. Blue boundaries are naturally irregular, with visible brushstroke endings, small uncoated patches, uneven edges, and a few stray blue flecks on the white margins. Avoid perfectly straight, mechanical borders on all four sides.

CYANOTYPE TONES

Use only authentic cyanotype colours:

- Shadows: Deep Prussian blue.
- Midtones: Pale to medium cyan.
- Highlights: Completely bare, raw white paper with no blue pigment.

Maintain strong contrast and abrupt transitions between blue and white where appropriate, as in a traditional contact print. Fine paper fibres should remain visible through the blue. No grey, black, sepia, or additional colours. The result must look like a chemically produced cyanotype, not a blue filter over a photograph.

PRESERVE THE ORIGINAL IMAGE

Use the attached photograph as the sole source. Preserve the exact number, identity, position, proportions, silhouettes, poses, and arrangement of all subjects. Do not add, remove, duplicate, or rearrange people, animals, vehicles, or environmental details.

Translate the original photograph into cyanotype tones only: bright areas become bare paper white, midtones become cyan, and dark areas become deep Prussian blue. Preserve the original composition and recognisable facial and body shapes.

PHYSICAL PRESENTATION

Photograph the finished print as a real object resting on a plain, pale surface. Use soft directional daylight, realistic paper fibres, subtle shadows, and natural surface imperfections. Keep the entire sheet visible within the vertical 4:5 frame.

STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

- No text, letters, numbers, signatures, logos, stamps, or watermarks.
- No additional or missing subjects.
- No grids, graph lines, measuring scales, or blueprint-style graphics.
- No blue tint in the brightest highlights; they must be raw paper white.
- No extra colours, decorative effects, or artificial distressing.
- No hands, clips, frames, tools, props, or additional sheets.
- No cropping of the sheet or digitally flat presentation.

PRIORITIES

If every detail cannot be achieved simultaneously, prioritise preserving the exact original subjects and making the brightest highlights completely paper white. Next, maintain realistic physical paper texture and visible sheet edges. If necessary, simplify the brushed margins to one irregular edge and leave the other three edges cleanly cut.

Final result: A realistic, handmade cyanotype sun print with deep Prussian-blue shadows, cyan midtones, pure white paper highlights, organic brushed edges, and authentic cotton-rag texture, photographed as a physical object in soft daylight. Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

- subject-driven symbolic elements

identity for $ SUBJECT where the wordmark itself

Distinctly original.

posts.text:
GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
UNIVERSAL HALLOWEEN TRAVEL ART POSTER

DESTINATION: [DESTINATION]

Create a bold, hand-drawn Halloween travel poster featuring [DESTINATION], blending its authentic landmarks, architecture, landscapes, and local character with a mysterious, festive Halloween atmosphere.

FORMAT

Vertical 3:4 composition, high-resolution poster artwork with clean outer margins.

CORE CONCEPT

Reimagine [DESTINATION] as a stylish Halloween-night illustration while preserving its recognizable landmarks, real architecture, geography, and regional identity. The result should feel adventurous, atmospheric, sophisticated, and collectible—not like a generic haunted town.

TYPOGRAPHY

Place "[DESTINATION]" in large, bold, custom hand-drawn lettering across the upper-left area. Keep the title highly readable and visually integrated into the composition.

Include only the destination name. No slogans, captions, extra text, logos, or watermarks.

COMPOSITION

Create a rich, vertically layered scene featuring the destination's most recognizable landmarks, streets, architecture, natural landscapes, local vegetation, and regional details. Include small pedestrians, vehicles, or everyday activities where appropriate.

Interweave these elements into one continuous illustration using expressive scale, simplified perspective, overlapping shapes, and strong foreground-to-background depth. Preserve authentic architectural details and avoid inventing or replacing real landmarks.

HALLOWEEN ATMOSPHERE

Create a dramatic Halloween evening using a glowing full moon, deep twilight skies, theatrical shadows, subtle mist, silhouetted bats, warm lantern light, and a few naturally integrated pumpkins or jack-o'-lanterns.

Adapt the details to the destination's environment and character. Keep Halloween decorations subtle so the destination remains the main subject.

COLOR PALETTE

Use a controlled palette of 4–6 colors:

- Vivid pumpkin orange
- Deep midnight navy
- Dark violet or aubergine
- Warm golden yellow
- Forest green
- Bright white highlights and negative space

Adjust the balance to suit the destination while maintaining a distinctive Halloween identity.

VISUAL STYLE

Contemporary hand-drawn travel poster with screen-print and risograph aesthetics. Use linocut-inspired shapes, rough expressive outlines, irregular handmade forms, visible ink grain, dry-brush textures, slightly misregistered color layers, and energetic scribbled shading.

Keep the architecture recognizable but artistically simplified. Emphasize tactile printing imperfections and a sophisticated independent art-book illustration style.

BACKGROUND AND MOOD

Balance generous negative space with dramatic areas of deep navy or violet night sky. Use contrasting moonlight and warm golden illumination to create depth and atmosphere. Maintain a narrow, clean margin around the poster.

The final artwork should feel like a limited-edition Halloween travel print: bold, mysterious, adventurous, festive, and visually refined.

AVOID

Photorealism, 3D rendering, smooth vector graphics, gradients, glossy surfaces, generic haunted houses, excessive skulls or pumpkins, zombies, gore, cartoon ghosts, fantasy architecture replacing real landmarks, culturally inappropriate details, muted beige backgrounds, fake vintage aging, corporate tourism branding, and additional text.

FINAL GOAL: Create an unmistakable [DESTINATION] travel poster reimagined through sophisticated Halloween illustration, authentic local details, bold colors, and expressive handmade print textures.

posts.text:
GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic 3D typography poster featuring the exact word "[YOUR TEXT]", sculpted entirely from thick, fluffy wool yarn.

MAIN TYPOGRAPHY
Form the letters into chunky, bold, tightly packed shapes crafted from soft, off-white cotton fibers. Give each letter a dense, plush, tactile appearance with intricate individual strands, realistic fiber variation, and subtle natural irregularities. Mount the typography on a vibrant red knitted rectangular patch featuring clearly visible stitches, fuzzy edges, raised yarn patterns, and an authentic woven texture.

Ensure the text is spelled exactly as provided, with every letter clearly distinguishable, correctly formed, and fully readable. The typography must remain the dominant visual element.

BACKGROUND & LIGHTING
Use a pure black background with generous negative space around the central composition. Apply dramatic studio lighting to emphasize the contrast between the creamy white yarn, vivid red knitted patch, and deep black surroundings. Create realistic contact shadows, subtle ambient occlusion, dimensional highlights, and convincing depth.

EDITORIAL DETAILS
Add small, minimalist, monospaced white typography in the top-right corner, arranged neatly like a refined editorial design annotation. In the bottom-left corner, include a tiny, charming illustrated mascot accompanied by a short, understated descriptive caption. Keep both elements secondary, precisely aligned, and visually unobtrusive.

MATERIAL REALISM
Render every material with exceptional tactile accuracy, including individual wool fibers, soft fuzz, tightly looped stitches, subtle textile imperfections, and realistic light interaction. The result should feel like a meticulously handcrafted textile artwork photographed in a professional macro studio.

COMPOSITION & OUTPUT
Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Centered composition, balanced visual hierarchy, generous negative space, crisp focus on the main typography, high contrast, sophisticated editorial art direction, premium experimental graphic design, photorealistic 3D rendering, and exceptionally detailed materials.

FINAL REQUIREMENT: Prioritize exact spelling, immediate readability, realistic knitted construction, and a striking visual contrast. Avoid extra words, distorted letters, clutter, excessive decorative elements, or anything that competes with the main text.

动漫或游戏成年女性角色 × 奥斯曼花押式书法 × 角色形态转译 × 纸本钴蓝与金

每张随机选择一位不同的动漫或游戏成年女性角色，提取其清晰可辨的发型、服装、配饰与代表性意象，将发丝、衣袖、裙摆或飘带自然融入花押笔画，形成一枚完整的角色主题徽印。

保留花押骨架：底部交织的书法笔画、三根平行高竖、左侧两层嵌套大椭圆环，以及向右伸展的修长横笔。角色形态与笔画相互连接，整体轮廓清楚，人物保持清晰可辨。

米白色纸本，墨、不透明水彩与金的平面质感。徽印完整可见，周围大面积留白，平整正视。

posts.text:
Another prompt for landing page design, done with GPT Image 2.5. I just feed these to Opus or Sol and ask it to turn them into an interactive website. 

Prompt: 16:9, 2x2 grid, do this for an unusual but real classic motorcycles INPUT = [ TOPIC / HERO_OBJECT / BRAND_TEMPERAMENT / VIEWPORT / GRAVITY_LAW ] 

Run HERO_PRODUCT_GRAVITY:

TOPIC_DNA      := infer the category from TOPIC alone — what's sold, who buys it,
                  what its shelf looks like
HERO_DNA       := ONE photographic hero object, cut out, oversized, 30–40% of frame;
                  real material response — specular on foil, matte on paper,
                  subsurface scatter on skin or fruit
BRAND_DNA      := derive the palette FROM the object — 1 dominant, 1 accent pulled
                  from a hue the object actually contains, 1 near-neutral ground
LIGHT_ANCHOR   := decide key light position ONCE (upper-left or upper-right); every
                  shadow — object, cards, pills, floating confetti — falls the same
                  direction at the same angle and softness
GRAVITY_LAW    := the hero is either GROUNDED (contact shadow touching a visible
                  surface plane) or SUSPENDED (ambient occlusion beneath, blur growing
                  with height) — never both, never floating with a hard cast shadow
                  and no plane to cast it onto
DEPTH_ORDER    := ground wash < decorative rays/confetti < hero object < UI chrome.
                  Nav, cart and buttons are ALWAYS in front, never occluded
TYPE_LOGIC     := one display face for the headline (heavy — pick condensed OR wide,
                  not both), one neutral for everything else; headline ≤ 6 words,
                  body renders as legible micro-type, never enlarged gibberish
IMPERFECTION   := exactly one element breaks its bounding box — a badge rotated 4–7°,
                  a sticker overlapping the product silhouette, a stray mark in the gutter
FRAME          := desktop 16:10, 64–80px outer gutter; the bottom edge reveals the top
                  15% of the next section so the page reads as scrollable
MOOD           := appetite, immediacy, one unmistakable action

Render: one screen where the product's own light governs every pixel of interface around it.

Forbidden — objects: stock-photo humans, lorem blocks at display size, a second competing hero
Forbidden — look: conflicting shadow directions, cut-out halo or chewed edges, cast shadows
on flat 2D illustration, palette colors absent from the object, three type families,
nav bar sitting behind the product

Chest-up portrait, near-frontal with a subtle three-quarter angle body. The subject occupies approximately 70-80% of the frame area. Head slightly tilted upward, chin gently raised. Gaze directed upward and slightly to the right (not at camera), conveying curiosity and quiet introspection.
Expression:
Natural and soft. Eyes wide but realistic, lips slightly parted with a hint of upper teeth. No forced emotion — calm, observational, and candid.
Eyes (Primary Focus):
Highly detailed irises with natural gradients and soft catchlights from overhead lighting. Defined eyelids, fine irregular eyelashes (non-uniform, non-stylized).

Softly shaded nose, natural lips with volume and subtle inner depth. Smooth graphite blending across skin with delicate tonal transitions. Slight depth under chin and along jawline.

Lighting:
Soft top-down (butterfly lighting), evenly diffused. Gentle highlights on forehead, nose bridge, and eyes. No harsh contrast.
Style & Medium:
Photorealistic graphite pencil drawing on clean white paper. Fine line work, subtle hatching, smooth blending, full tonal range.
Background:
Plain white with minimal negative space, no distractions.
Technical:
Ultra-detailed, sharp facial focus, visible pencil texture, 4:5 aspect ratio.

漢服師妹系列～

🪭 GPT image 2.6 Prompt:

古代生活場景 × 成熟東方美人 × 同行者第一人稱視角 × 自然互動 × 手機生活抓拍。

每張獨立選擇一位二十多歲的成年東方女性。她容貌自然精緻，氣質可以慵懶、嫵媚、俏皮、清冷或從容。

人物身材高挑修長，腰線纖細，上身豐滿，胸腰曲線鮮明，整體比例自然協調。

【古代場景與服裝】

每張自由選擇一處有生活氣息的古代場景，可以是馬車、畫舫、庭院、客棧、街市、山間或其他地方。

根據人物身份與場景，設計具有東方韻味的衣裙、髮式與配飾。衣裙可輕盈柔軟、修身收腰，以自然的領口、腰線與布料層次展現女性魅力。布料隨姿態、動作與身體接觸自然貼合、垂墜和起皺。

環境保留能辨認場景的關鍵結構。人物、衣著、器物與空間風格彼此協調，細節隨取景自然出現。

【同行者視角與互動】

以同行者近距離手持手機抓拍的第一人稱視角，記錄人物身邊正在發生的一件小事。適度運用廣角，讓人物與周圍環境處於自然的空間關係中。

攝影者的手、手臂或古代衣袖可自然進入畫面邊緣，位置與持機方式合理，並根據當下事件參與互動。

人物可以正在休息、行走、整理衣物、轉身、回頭，或專注於自己的事情。她可能與同行者交談、玩鬧、分享物品、互相幫忙，也可能因對方的舉動露出微妙反應。動作、表情與視線由事件自然帶出。

同批作品自由變化人物、場景、事件、姿態、視線、景別、機位與構圖，探索不同的距離感和畫面結構。

【影像質感】

像真實存在的古代生活瞬間，被同行的人隨手拍下。自然日光或符合場景的燈火照亮人物，保留真實皮膚紋理、衣料質感與環境細節。廣角透視自然，人物身體、前景與背景的比例和光影保持協調。

竪版 9:16，獨立單圖。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

KodaChrome是摄影历史上的巅峰传奇胶片
也是曾经第一款取得商业成功的彩色胶片
它作为一个反转片胶卷，有着无可撼动的地位，因为非常厚的显影层，所以它的色彩还原非常的厚实、艳丽，有一种扎实的感觉。
但因为极高的拍摄难度和昂贵的冲洗工艺，09 年终于是彻底停产了。
成为了绝版的色彩传奇。
也是数码时代大家一直想追求、但是达不到的独特色彩。
但是，今天利用最新的图片生成模型，我们还是能复刻一丢丢它的韵味。
GPT Image 2.6 prompt：
9：16  一个非常美丽的中国女孩。身材热辣，高挑纤细大长腿。身穿一件波西米亚风格的一字肩多层叠白纱衣，泡泡大袖，搭配牛仔绑带束腰，下半身是超短多重叠白色纱裙。脚穿过膝、棕色磨砂皮质的超长筒高跟鞋，长筒宽松，几乎到大腿根部。一头深栗色的蓬松大卷发，稍显凌乱.女孩牵着一匹纯黑色，毛色非常光亮、鬃毛很柔顺飘逸的马。高级时尚大片质感，奢侈品服装大片风。整个图片成像质感为kodaChrome反转片胶卷的高饱和色调。色彩热烈浓艳但厚重。
#VibeFashion #VibeShooting

写实新中式人像摄影，竖版2:3，正面半身构图，画面从头顶延伸至大腿，人物面部清晰。

一位25岁左右的成年东亚女性，清秀温柔，修长柔和的鹅蛋脸，下颌自然收窄，下巴小巧圆润，眉形自然，杏眼柔和，鼻子秀气。嘴型小巧、横向较窄，上下唇偏薄，淡淡的自然粉色，闭嘴浅笑。妆容清淡细腻，皮肤保留轻微纹理与自然明暗，肤色通透。

人物正面朝向镜头，头部端正，双眼自然看向镜头，肩膀放松。一只手轻扶画面右侧的深色木门框，另一只手自然放在腰前，手腕与手指舒展，神态亲近。

深色头发松松挽成低盘发，额前和脸侧留少量细碎发丝，佩戴小巧珍珠耳坠。

身穿浅紫蓝色真丝提花中式上衣，小立领、同色盘扣、七分微喇袖，剪裁合身舒展。面料织造细密，表面平滑，带低对比度的细叶提花，光泽柔和克制，衣褶随身体自然形成。胸前一侧点缀少量精细的米白玉兰花与浅金枝叶刺绣，袖口有小面积呼应纹样。

搭配高腰米白色真丝长裙，腰头整洁，腰线清晰，裙身自然垂坠，有细腻暗纹与柔和褶裥。腰侧搭配一枚小巧花形装饰和短珍珠流苏，整体精致轻巧。

场景为传统中式茶院门口：深色木柱、雕花木门、灰砖墙、竹叶、古朴吊灯和远处木质茶桌形成层次。人物靠近门框站立，背景适度虚化，仍能辨认木雕、竹影和茶院环境。

柔和自然日光从侧前方照亮人物，面部光线均匀，鼻侧、下颌和颈部保留真实阴影。浅紫蓝与米白服装呼应竹叶和深色木建筑。自然相机色彩，细腻的发丝、真丝提花和刺绣针脚，清秀温婉的新中式旅行写真，85mm人像镜头视角。

避免：棉麻、粗织纹、竹节纱、麻布质感、廉价化纤反光、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张大眼、厚唇、宽嘴、尖下巴、歪头、僵硬手势、畸形手指、密集堆砌花纹、建筑变形、文字、水印、边框、拼图。

Prompt:
SECOND WORLD PHOTOGRAPHY | REALITY MEETS IMAGINATION

Transform an ordinary real-world photograph into a creative visual storytelling artwork where reality seamlessly transitions into a whimsical, hand-drawn second world.

COMPOSITION & STRUCTURE

Create a vertically composed artwork divided into two connected sections:

- Upper section: A highly realistic, photorealistic photograph of an everyday scene, such as a city street, modern building, library, park, bridge, landscape, or architectural location. Preserve authentic photography, natural lighting, realistic textures, accurate proportions, and rich environmental details.
- Lower section: Extend the scene into a warm ivory, lightly textured sketchbook-paper surface. Reimagine selected elements of the original photograph as delicate, minimalist black-ink illustrations, creating an imaginative continuation of the real-world environment.

THE SECOND WORLD CONCEPT

Introduce a small, charming hand-drawn human character interacting creatively with the photographed environment. The illustration should create a clever visual illusion, as though the person is painting, building, extending, repairing, or transforming something from the original photograph.

Examples include painting clouds onto a glass building, extending a real street with hand-drawn roads, transforming library stairs into enormous books, or allowing trees, architecture, and other elements to escape their photographic boundaries.

ARTISTIC STYLE

Combine professional architectural photography with delicate minimalist pen-and-ink doodles. Use thin black sketch lines, loose handwritten details, subtle imperfections, and warm cream paper textures. Maintain a sophisticated, editorial art direction with a playful surrealist touch.

STORYTELLING DETAILS

Add one short, poetic handwritten English sentence near the illustration, expressing the imaginative idea behind the scene. Keep the handwriting subtle, natural, and elegant.

IMPORTANT

The transition between photography and illustration must feel visually connected and conceptually meaningful. Avoid random doodles, excessive decorations, cartoon styling, or clutter. The result should feel like a photograph revealing a hidden imaginary world beneath reality.

Ultra-detailed, artistic, visually intelligent, photorealistic, minimalist, surreal storytelling photography, premium creative editorial aesthetic.

一幅16:9横向电影宽画幅的高精度东方幻想风格化3D CG人物场景。画面中只有一位年轻成年东亚女性角色，她拥有精致柔和的日系与东方美型相结合的三维面容、细腻白皙的肌肤、柔和的深棕色眼睛、乌黑蓬松的古典双侧盘髻，以及极其浓密而飘逸的黑色波浪长发。

她身穿一件深墨绿近黑色的中式改良旗袍短装，领口具有精巧的青蓝色传统盘扣，胸前绣有细密而华丽的金色东方盘龙纹样，身体侧面采用修身的深色织物结构。腰部附近点缀精致的蓝紫色蝴蝶装饰，手臂佩戴黑色半透明蕾丝长护手，腿部穿着白色蕾丝边半透明长袜，搭配白色细吊带与黑色亮面高跟鞋。一件浅灰白色细条纹宽松衬衫从她的右肩自然滑落，松散垂挂于手臂与身体后方。

人物位于一辆空荡而年代感浓厚的老式公交车内部，车厢两侧排列着深灰绿色老旧布面座椅，中央过道向车尾深处延伸，顶部有明亮的暖白色荧光灯和悬挂的三角形扶手吊环。车窗布满细小的雨滴、纵向流淌的水痕和潮湿水汽，窗外的城市灯光被雨水和运动模糊拉伸成柔和的青绿色、冰蓝色与暖金色光带。

人物一只手臂高高举起，手掌握住头顶的公交车吊环，身体自然向右侧扭转并略微后仰，腰臀轻靠右侧座椅边缘。靠近画面左下方的一条腿向前抬起并明显弯曲，膝盖形成宽阔的前景轮廓，小腿向下延伸，另一条腿位于身体后侧，部分被座椅和衣物遮挡。她微微低垂头部，面容转向镜头，眼神安静而柔和，嘴唇轻轻闭合，浓密的黑色长卷发受到气流影响，向画面右侧大幅飘扬。

整个场景笼罩在低对比度的青绿色湿润空气中，顶部暖白色荧光灯照亮她的脸颊、发髻、肩膀、金色盘龙刺绣和白色蕾丝袜，窗外冰蓝色灯光则照亮她的长发外缘和深色旗袍轮廓。暖金色街灯透过左侧潮湿车窗形成宽阔而柔和的横向光晕，右侧雨窗则呈现大面积青蓝色光幕。

整体画面具有高精度三维角色建模、真实皮肤次表面散射、自然的三维发束、物理可信的丝缎与蕾丝材质、雨滴折射、低对比度的体积空气散射、柔和Bloom高光扩散、电影级浅景深与微弱运动拖影，呈现精致、朦胧、略带复古梦幻气息的游戏剧情过场CG质感。

人物面部采用高精度风格化三维角色设计。脸型小巧而自然，整体为柔和的椭圆形，额头饱满，眉骨起伏细腻，颧骨自然，脸颊具有柔润的体积，下颌线纤细而平滑。鼻梁细直，鼻尖小巧，嘴唇呈低饱和的淡玫瑰粉色，唇峰柔和，下唇略微饱满。

她的眼睛呈自然细长的杏仁形，虹膜具有深棕色、灰褐色与淡琥珀色交织的细腻渐变，眼睛表面存在微弱的暖白色反光。上眼睑柔和而略微下垂，眼尾自然收窄，睫毛纤细而清楚。双眉呈柔和的深棕黑色，部分隐藏在细碎的刘海之下。

人物微微低垂头部，脸部朝向画面左前方，同时将目光转向镜头附近。眼神具有淡淡的忧郁感与柔和的疏离感，嘴角自然放松，没有夸张的微笑或张嘴表情。面部表情安静、内敛，带有雨夜独自乘车时的沉思气质。

妆容以浅粉棕色眼影、自然纤细的睫毛、淡玫瑰色唇妆和柔和的粉色腮红为主。双颊具有轻微的暖粉色晕染，鼻梁与眼下呈现细腻的暖色变化。人物五官具有日系美型角色特有的精致比例，但保持真实的三维解剖与自然的面部光照，不使用二维动漫式的大面积平面阴影。

肌肤呈柔和的冷象牙白色，具有自然的皮肤厚度与细腻的次表面散射。额头、鼻梁、颧骨、肩膀、手臂与腿部在暖白色顶灯照射下形成柔软的奶油白色和浅蜜桃色高光，背光区域保留低饱和的灰青色与淡暖灰色阴影。

人物皮肤的高光柔和而细腻，不采用粗糙的真人摄影毛孔，也不呈现塑料人偶般均匀坚硬的镜面反射。受光区域明亮但不刺眼，面部保留清楚的鼻梁、眼窝和下颌立体结构。

人物拥有浓密的乌黑长发，发色由深墨黑、蓝黑、深灰棕和少量暖棕色反射构成。头顶头发蓬松而丰厚，额前留有自然细碎的黑色刘海，刘海由宽窄不同的轻薄发束构成，部分发梢接近眉毛和眼睛上方。

后脑上方的头发被盘绕成左右略微不对称的两个古典发髻，发髻位置较高，具有柔软、蓬松和自然交错的发束结构。发髻边缘保留少量松散碎发，形成轻盈而不完全整齐的轮廓。

头顶发髻上佩戴数枚精致的蓝紫色蝴蝶发饰。蝴蝶翅膀由柔和的浅紫色、蓝紫色、青蓝色和微弱的珍珠白色反光构成，翅片形状精巧，边缘细薄，具有局部半透明的质感和细小的装饰纹理。蝴蝶发饰体积较小，嵌入黑色发髻之间，不形成夸张的巨大蝴蝶头冠。

大部分黑色长发从后脑和肩膀处自然向下延伸，形成极其浓密、蓬松而具有复杂层次的波浪卷发。长发的整体长度接近腰臀以下，发束数量丰富，具有连续而自然的S形卷曲结构。

人物受到车厢运动与气流影响，浓密的波浪长发向画面右侧大幅飘散。靠近头部的发束相对集中，越接近画面右侧，长发逐渐向外展开，形成宽阔而复杂的黑色流线形轮廓。部分长发向右上方弯曲，部分自然垂落至右侧肩膀和座椅附近。

长发在潮湿车窗前形成清楚的深色剪影，与窗外冰蓝色和青绿色光斑产生丰富的前后空间层次。部分发尾接近画面右侧边缘，具有轻微的方向性运动模糊。主要发束仍然保留清晰的曲线、自然的卷曲体积与柔和的高光层次。

头发采用真实三维发束与大量细密独立发丝相结合的高精度渲染方式。发丝具有自然厚度、真实的空间遮挡和方向明确的各向异性反射。受到顶部暖黄光照射的位置呈现微弱的深棕金色反光，靠近窗外冷青色灯光的位置则呈现冷灰蓝色和浅青色边缘高光。

人物身穿深墨绿近黑色的中式改良旗袍式短装。服装具有窄而挺括的中式小立领，领口采用深青绿色布面，并由精细的青蓝色传统盘扣连接。盘扣呈小巧的花结形状，具有真实的绳结结构、织物厚度和柔和的纤维光泽。

旗袍主体采用贴合身体的深青黑色丝缎织物，表面具有低调的缎面光泽与细密的传统暗纹。衣料沿胸部、腰腹和髋部形成自然贴合的剪裁，部分区域随着身体扭转产生柔和的横向与斜向褶皱。

服装胸前偏侧绣有一条精致的金色东方盘龙纹样，龙首、卷曲的龙身、细长龙须、鳞片和局部云气纹样具有清晰而细密的传统装饰结构。金色刺绣由古金色、浅铜金色和少量暖黄色丝线构成，随着身体曲线自然弯曲。

盘龙刺绣表面具有细密的丝线方向与柔和的金属色反射，但本质上是精致的丝线织绣，不呈现坚硬厚重的金属浮雕。暖黄色顶灯在刺绣表面形成细窄的金色高光，使其在深墨绿色布料上显得明亮而精致。

旗袍上半身采用具有传统中式领口特征的修身结构，肩部与上臂露出自然肌肤。胸前的深色衣料沿身体形成柔和而清楚的开口轮廓，衣服边缘具有真实的织物厚度和细窄的滚边。

腰部与身体侧面可以看到黑色细密网纱或蕾丝拼接，局部呈半透明的规则网状结构。腰腹附近的衣料受到身体扭转影响，形成自然的纵向和斜向拉伸纹理，深色织物与半透明网纱之间保持清楚的材质分区。

衣摆较短，沿髋部自然收束，具有修身的改良旗袍短装轮廓。腰臀侧面点缀一只小巧的蓝紫色蝴蝶装饰，蝶翼具有细密的彩色纹理和局部珠光高光，与头发上的蝴蝶发饰形成自然呼应。

人物右侧肩膀上松散披着一件浅灰白色细条纹宽松衬衫。衬衫并未完整穿好，而是从肩膀自然滑落，布料聚集在上臂外侧，部分衣袖和衣摆向身体后方垂落，最终搭在右侧座椅附近。

浅色衬衫具有清楚的纵向细条纹，颜色为奶油白色、浅灰白色与柔和淡蓝灰色。条纹随着织物折叠与自然重力产生柔和变形，袖子与衣摆形成宽阔的布料褶皱。

衬衫采用柔软的棉质或轻薄混纺织物材质，表面具有低反光的纤维纹理和真实的布料厚度。受窗外青绿色灯光照射的位置呈现淡冷灰色反射，受顶灯照射的位置呈现柔和的暖白色高光。

黑色长护手覆盖人物高举手臂的一部分，材质为半透明黑色蕾丝与细密植物花纹织物。蕾丝具有自然的网纱结构、局部深黑色花卉纹样和柔软的边缘。高举手臂时，护手随手腕和前臂曲线自然贴合，手掌部分露出柔和的肤色。

人物一只手高举握住车顶的三角形吊环，手臂从肩膀沿斜向上方延伸，肘部自然弯曲。手腕和手掌具有正确的空间关系，五指自然弯曲，牢牢握住吊环上方或吊环边缘的深色连接结构，指尖受到暖白色顶灯照射，形成细小的高光。

吊环具有三角形或圆角三角形轮廓，颜色为暗黄铜色、深灰金色与局部黑色。吊环通过短连接带固定在车顶横杆下方，具有真实的连接件、金属厚度和自然的吊挂重力。人物手掌与吊环之间存在明确的接触和受力关系。

另一只手臂自然垂落在身体右侧，部分被长发、松散的条纹衬衫和座椅遮挡。手腕附近具有黑色半透明蕾丝饰物，手指略微弯曲并靠近身体腰臀附近，不额外生成醒目的手势或不合理的肢体动作。

人物腿部穿着柔和象牙白色的半透明蕾丝长袜。长袜在大腿上方具有较宽的白色花卉蕾丝袜口，袜口边缘由细密的花瓣、叶片和网纱纹理组成，具有自然的织物厚度和微弱的珍珠白色反射。

袜身主体为极浅的暖白色和微微透明的浅象牙色，通过细密纤维与薄纱表现自然贴合的包覆质感。白色蕾丝花边在膝盖上方形成明显的装饰带，局部与细窄的白色吊带相连接。吊带从衣摆附近向大腿袜口延伸，保持细长、连续、自然的结构关系。

腿部表面具有柔和的皮肤色彩变化，半透明袜面能够透出微弱的自然肤色，布料在暖黄灯光下呈现细腻的奶油白色反射，靠近冷青色车窗的位置则呈现浅灰蓝色高光。

长袜表面散布非常细小的珍珠白色亮点，形成微弱的织物光泽，不使用夸张的魔法亮片。袜口花边、网纱纹理和细吊带在人物腿部弯曲位置具有自然的张力变化。

人物脚部穿着黑色亮面高跟鞋，鞋面为圆润而修长的闭合轮廓，局部具有横向鞋带或玛丽珍式的固定结构，鞋跟较高且具有清楚的实体厚度。鞋面反射暖白色车厢灯光与冷青绿色窗光，形成小面积明亮而受控的镜面高光。

人物位于车厢中央偏右的位置，整体呈现介于站立、倚靠座椅与动态抬腿之间的姿态。上半身微微向后侧倾斜，腰部向画面右侧扭转，一侧肩膀向前，一只手高举抓住吊环，以维持身体平衡。

人物臀腰靠近右侧座椅边缘，身体与座椅之间具有自然的接触、遮挡和重力关系。双腿形成明显的不对称姿态，一条腿从髋部向画面左下方伸出，大腿在前景中形成斜向线条，膝盖自然弯曲，小腿进一步向下延伸，黑色高跟鞋接近画幅底部。

另一条腿位于身体后侧，部分被前方抬起的腿、衣摆和右侧座椅遮挡，膝盖位置较低或略微弯曲，脚部与车厢地面形成自然的空间关系。两条腿之间具有正确的关节角度和前后透视，不生成额外重复腿部。

人物抬起的腿部在画面下半部形成非常重要的视觉结构，斜向大腿与竖向高举手臂共同塑造动态身体轮廓。人物的肩膀、腰腹、髋部与腿部存在自然的扭转和受力变化，身体不是完全笔直的站立姿势，也不是完全坐在椅面上的普通坐姿。
