posts.prompt:
Transform the uploaded photo into a premium **travel-memory Emoji scrapbook poster**.

Use the uploaded photo as the primary visual reference. Preserve the important subjects, people, objects, environment, composition, colors, atmosphere, and recognizable details accurately.

Do not alter the identity, facial features, body proportions, clothing, or important structure of the main subject.

Create a **vertical 3:4 editorial scrapbook composition**, divided horizontally into two clean, balanced sections.

## TOP 50% — ORIGINAL MEMORY

Display the original photograph prominently.

Keep it realistic and photographic, with only subtle enhancement:

- warm natural color grading
- soft cinematic light
- slightly elevated contrast
- realistic skin and materials
- gentle film-like texture
- refined travel-editorial photography aesthetic

Do not over-retouch the image.

Do not turn the photograph into an illustration.

The upper half should still feel like an authentic candid memory captured on camera.

---

## BOTTOM 50% — EMOJI MEMORY BOARD

Transform the most recognizable elements from the photograph into a curated collection of **6–9 custom Emoji-style icons**.

Automatically identify the strongest visual memories in the uploaded photo, such as:

- food or drinks
- buildings or landmarks
- clothing or accessories
- flowers, trees or plants
- clouds, sun, moon or weather
- vehicles
- animals
- street objects
- travel items
- meaningful objects held by the subject
- distinctive colors or visual motifs

Every Emoji must clearly originate from something visible in the uploaded photograph.

Do not introduce unrelated objects.

### EMOJI STYLE

Render each extracted element as a polished, dimensional **premium Emoji sticker**:

- clean rounded forms
- expressive simplified shapes
- soft dimensional volume
- subtle glossy highlights
- gentle ambient shadows
- rich but tasteful colors
- slightly playful proportions
- crisp edges
- highly recognizable silhouettes
- modern mobile-Emoji aesthetic
- sophisticated rather than childish
- visually consistent across all icons

The Emoji should feel like a beautifully designed custom icon set inspired by the photograph.

Avoid mixing different Emoji styles.

Do not use hand-drawn sketches, watercolor, pencil, ink, line art, photorealism, or realistic miniature objects.

---

## LAYOUT

Place the Emoji icons on a warm ivory / soft off-white editorial paper background.

Arrange them in a refined loose **3 × 3 memory grid**.

The grid does not need to be perfectly rigid.

Allow slight variation in:

- Emoji scale
- vertical position
- rotation
- spacing

to create a natural scrapbook feeling.

Keep generous negative space.

Do not place visible boxes around individual Emoji.

Use extremely subtle shadows beneath selected Emoji so they feel like small digital stickers resting on the page.

Add only a few tiny supporting Emoji accents where appropriate, such as:

✨ ⭐️ ☁️ 💛 🌿 🫧 ☀️ 💫

Use them sparingly.

The composition should remain elegant and uncluttered.

---

## TITLE

At the top of the Emoji section, add one short editorial title inspired by the photograph.

Examples:

“PARIS MEMORIES”
“SUMMER DAYS”
“WEEKEND MOMENTS”
“LITTLE THINGS”
“SWEET MEMORIES”
“ONE PERFECT DAY”

Use clean, minimal typography.

The title may combine:

a refined serif or sans-serif typeface  
+ one small Emoji accent.

For example:

SUMMER DAYS ☀️

or

PARIS MEMORIES ✨

Do not use elaborate handwritten lettering.

---

## OPTIONAL MICRO LABELS

Under only 3–5 of the main Emoji icons, add extremely short labels of no more than 1–2 words.

Examples:

morning coffee  
blue skies  
little flowers  
sweet treat  
city lights  
slow morning  
sunset walk

Keep the text small, subtle, editorial, and secondary to the Emoji.

If accurate typography cannot be generated cleanly, omit the labels rather than creating incorrect text.

---

## BOTTOM CAPTION

At the very bottom, add one tiny sentimental line.

Examples:

“a day worth keeping ♡”

“little moments, big memories”

“saved in my camera roll ♡”

“wish I could replay this day”

“one of those days ✨”

Keep it understated and elegant.

---

## OVERALL ART DIRECTION

The final image should feel like:

premium travel editorial  
× modern Emoji sticker sheet  
× personal camera-roll memory  
× Pinterest scrapbook  
× contemporary lifestyle magazine

It should feel playful, nostalgic and social-media-friendly while still looking sophisticated and carefully art-directed.

The Emoji section should look specifically designed from the uploaded photograph, not like a generic collection of existing Emoji.

---

## IMPORTANT

- One original photograph + one Emoji memory section
- Clean 50/50 horizontal composition
- Vertical 3:4 format
- Preserve the original photograph realistically
- Extract 6–9 recognizable elements directly from the photograph
- Convert those elements into one consistent premium Emoji visual language
- No unrelated random Emoji
- No hand-drawn illustration
- No watercolor
- No pencil or ink sketches
- No photorealistic miniature objects
- No complex frames
- No visible boxes around each Emoji
- No excessive decorations
- No clutter
- No childish cartoon style
- No inconsistent Emoji rendering styles
- Minimal typography
- Warm ivory background
- Generous negative space
- Clean, premium, playful, nostalgic aesthetic

  An autumn afternoon in the 8th lunar month of the Tang Dynasty. A heartwarming family gathering of three in an elegant courtyard: father, mother, and daughter sitting together on a spread-out linen mat, savoring Chongyang festive rice cakes (Double Ninth festival cakes) and appreciating the fragrant sweet osmanthus blossoms.

Environment & Setting (环境与场景):
  Traditional Tang Dynasty single-entry courtyard, classical architecture with fish-scale roof tiles, cypress purlin wooden structure, paved with Meiwu large bluish-grey bricks and matching brick walls, neat and straight mortar joints. A tall, lush sweet osmanthus tree stands in the center of the courtyard, blooming profusely with full foliage.
Materials & Textures (材质与纹理):

Color Palette (色彩配色):
  Dominated by warm tones: golden yellow (osmanthus blossoms, pastries), warm earthy brown (wooden structures), bluish-grey (brick walls), deep green (osmanthus leaves), cream/off-white (pastries, linen mat), burgundy/wine red (wine jar); classical, elegant, low-saturation harmonious color scheme.
Lighting Effects (灯光效果):

  Medium shot, slightly elevated high-angle perspective, revealing the courtyard layout and intimate family interaction. Rule of thirds composition: the osmanthus tree positioned at the right third, the family gathering on the left; bluish-grey brick ground in the foreground, classical architecture in the background.

posts.text:
Same prompt, two designers: 🍌2.1 vs GPT Image 2.5.

A dense grunge collage with script capitals, an icy duotone, halftone dots, insets and stickers. Both nailed the vibe. Which one would you post?

Prompt below 👇
posts.prompt:
Design a 16:9 landscape grunge Y2K K-pop collage poster from reference image 1. Layout job: the model, her pose, face, smoky eyes, hair, outfit, gloved hand and the apple stay exactly as in reference image 1, same position and size. Reference images 2 and 3 are other photos of the same model, used only as two tiny inset photos.
Color system: convert the whole photo, including her and the mirror room, into a cold icy blue-gray duotone, like a cyanotype photocopy with crushed blacks, heavy grain and slight print blur. Keep only the apple in its true red so it is the single warm spot. The only accent color is acid lime-yellow, plus black and white.
Elements:
Top-left corner and down the left edge: ornate baroque filigree scrollwork in acid lime, rough and printed.
A large field of black halftone dots on the right half, fading from big dots to small, behind her shoulder.

Across the middle of the poster, crossing in front of her body but never over her face or the apple: a big bold black headline with white outline: “WHOLE DIFFERENT LOOK”, where the W, D and L are swapped for lime script capitals.
Directly above the headline, a lime highlighter strip with black lowercase text: “same face, a whole different look”.
Under the headline, two lines of small white-outlined black lowercase text: “five looks, one model” / “every edit stays on character”.
Below the headline, a spiky lime gothic tribal calligraphy splat, and another lime graffiti tag sticker at the bottom right.
A big lime asterisk sticker with black ink splatter at the top right, a few small white asterisk sparkles.
Small white pill tags with black text: “designbyrenoise” near the top, “look 03” beside her head.
Two tiny square inset photos on the right, from reference images 2 and 3, also in the icy blue duotone with a thin lime frame.
A round black badge with a white flower icon on the left, and two small black line icons in boxes at the right edge.
Down the right edge, a vertical lime band with tiny black vertical text: “nano banana 2.1 · whole different look · nano banana 2.1”.
Keep the bottom-left corner clear for a logo. Every letter spelled exactly as written, crisp and legible. No other text, no watermark.

主题：文艺复兴壁画 × 动漫游戏女性角色

阅卷沉思、书写描绘、讲述辩论、演奏聆听、递接授予、供奉致意、扶持照应、引领同行、举持展示、测量探究、编饰装点、远望呼应。

主题：敦煌壁画 × 动漫游戏女性角色 × 经典飞天与乐舞姿态

以下十位女性角色，每张呈现一位，角色不重复：
春丽、不知火舞、蒂法、2B、雷电将军、金克丝、

保留角色标志性的发型、面部特征、原有服装轮廓、代表配色与关键配饰，使角色清楚可辨。以敦煌壁画的造型与设色语言重新描绘，服饰随动作自然展开，繁复细节适度概括。

动作从以下经典形象中选择，十张采用不同动作：
反弹琵琶、抱弹琵琶、拈花持莲、扬手散花、散香供养、横吹笛管、竖持吹箫、捧笙吹奏、拨奏箜篌、抱阮弹拨、持板击拍、持鼓击奏。

ChatGPT Images 2.5  prompt 👇

Medium shot, eye-level cinematic flash portrait of a graceful early-20s East Asian woman embodying traditional Jiangnan aristocratic elegance inside a quiet Chinese tea room. Seated poised beside an antique dark wooden table, her right forearm rests gracefully along the edge of the timber with slender relaxed fingers cascading downward, wrapped loosely in an ornate floral shawl. She tilts her head slightly, offering a serene, gentle, and soul-stirring gaze directly into the camera.

Her facial features are classical and breathtaking: smooth alabaster porcelain skin, a soft feminine oval jawline, clear dark almond eyes filled with tender warmth, and glossy coral-rose lips. Her makeup is luminous and dewy, featuring a delicate peach-pink blush on her cheeks crowned by glistening champagne-gold highlighter on her high cheekbones. Her raven-black hair is parted neatly down the center and pulled back into a neat, elegant low chignon bun, accented by a classic single round white pearl stud earring on her ear.

She is dressed in an exquisite ivory-white silk satin dress with a scalloped neckline trimmed in delicate sheer white floral lace. Draped luxuriously over both shoulders and arms is an off-white cashmere shawl richly patterned with blooming crimson and pink peony flower motifs and sage-green foliage, falling softly around her lap.

The setting is an authentic vintage tea chamber: on the dark lacquered wooden tea table beside her sits a clear glass teapot filled with brewed golden tea, a delicate white porcelain teacup, and a small dessert plate, set against a quiet, warm off-white wall decorated with a small traditional Chinese ink painting frame.

Illuminated by soft on-camera flash key lighting, casting a dewy, radiant glow across her glistening cheekbones and white lace trims, while letting the room recede into warm, nostalgic vintage shadows. Shot on a 50mm portrait lens at f/2.2, ISO 200, 1/160s, capturing authentic skin micro-pores, intricate lace stitching, fluid satin drape, and a timeless, poetic oriental elegance.

GPT- image 2.5 prompt👇
A full-bleed vertical luxury eyewear poster for the original overseas brand "AEROVIA", combining wind-driven profile tension, precise eyewear-and-hair detail, and a reduced curatorial layout. The hero product is the "WINDLINE SHADES": oversized translucent amber sunglasses shown in high-fashion studio photography from an extreme high overhead three-quarter angle.

Show an adult female model, clearly over 20, in a left-facing profile with head slightly lowered, cropped from head and flying hair to upper torso. The face, sunglasses, and hand form a compact diagonal from upper left to lower center. One hand rests under the chin with elongated fingers and deep burgundy nails, staying below the jawline and away from the lenses. The sunglasses must be the sharpest element: oversized square frames with warm translucent amber acetate rims, thick sculpted temples, dark smoke lenses, black hinge details, and a tiny original silver "A" mark on the side arm. Keep rim thickness, bridge form, hinge pins, temple connection, lens reflections, and face contact structurally believable.

Hair is platinum blonde in tight dark-and-blonde braids wrapping the scalp, with loose wind-blown strands sweeping toward the upper right as the main motion cue. A sleeveless dark plum technical top remains secondary and acts only as a grounding mass. Use a minimal cool blue-gray gradient studio background with no props or scenery. Depth comes from the overhead angle, floating hair strands, hand-to-face overlap, the sunglass silhouette, and soft falloff under the shoulders.

Lighting is hard-soft studio light from the upper left, creating highlights on the amber acetate, cheekbone, platinum strands, burgundy nails, and shoulder, with cool fill preserving shadow detail. Color hierarchy: blue-gray background as the dominant field, amber sunglasses as the hero accent, platinum hair as motion highlight, dark plum top as the grounding tone, burgundy nails as a small secondary accent.

Keep highest detail on the eyewear and hair: glossy amber acetate, smoke lens reflections, hinge pins, temple edges, bridge geometry, braided texture, loose strands, and clean hand contact near the jaw. Skin stays realistic with natural editorial texture. Hair edges remain fine and separated.

Exact visible text only:
Top-left: "AEROVIA"
Top-right: "WINDLINE SHADES"
Typography: small white uppercase sans serif with wide spacing, placed in the upper corners away from the face, hair, hand, and sunglasses.

Negative constraints: no distorted profile, broken sunglass geometry, missing temples, extra hands, distorted fingers, impossible neck angle, or hair covering the eyewear; no plastic skin, muddy amber acetate, dead black lenses, smeared hair, flat light, or dirty background; no copied real logos, misspelled "AEROVIA", extra text, gibberish marks, or typography over the face or sunglasses; no street background, excessive jewelry, sci-fi interface, painterly drift, collage artifacts, or low-quality eyewear edges.

⚡️GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

视频1：

《荷风嬉夏》｜古代荷塘戏水 MV

个人脸部 ID × 江南荷塘 × 汉服内搭 × 双手撩水 × 俏皮互动 × 日系青春 MV

【人物与身份】

使用我在 ChatGPT 账户中保存的个性化「You」参考照片作为人物脸部身份参考，保留五官、脸型、面部比例和个人辨识特征。

人物为同一位成年东亚女性，面容、发型及服装在所有镜头中保持一致。气质清新甜美、古灵精怪，表情自然灵动。

【造型与场景】

女主穿浅色轻盈汉服内搭，柔软的交领中衣、贴身内搭与飘逸长裙自然叠穿，衣料轻薄透气，局部被水沾湿，呈现可信的湿润褶皱和垂坠感。

长发部分挽起，搭配简洁花簪和自然散落的发丝。

盛夏江南古典园林，清澈的浅水荷塘，大片荷叶、盛开的荷花、垂柳与曲廊。阳光透过树叶洒在水面，形成明亮自然的波光。

女主赤脚站在荷塘边缘的浅水中，水面没过脚踝，能够自然弯腰、蹲下、撩水和嬉戏。

【10秒青春MV分镜】

0至1.5秒：
低机位贴近水面，镜头上的水滴逐渐滑落。女主蹲在荷塘浅水处，突然发现摄影者，抬头露出惊喜笑容。

1.5至3.5秒：
面部近景，女主低头看着水面，嘴角扬起调皮的笑意。她用双手捧起清凉的池水，突然抬眼看向镜头。

3.5至5.5秒：
正面动态近景，她双手从水面向前上方轻快撩起一大片水花。水流沿真实的抛物轨迹飞向镜头，水珠在阳光下晶莹闪烁。

5.5至7.5秒：
快速切至侧面中景，女主笑着后退两步，裙摆轻轻掠过水面，带起细碎涟漪。她回头看向镜头，笑得更加开心。

7.5至10秒：
镜头重新贴近水面，女主突然俯身，双手再次捧水向摄影者泼来。水花迅速靠近镜头，部分水滴直接打湿镜头表面。她在水珠后调皮眨眼，最后水花覆盖整个画面，与开场形成自然循环。

【摄影与表演】

Japanese Youth MV × Chinese Summer Garden × Candid Cinematic Montage。

以真实夏日玩水为核心，融合日本青春电影的明亮色彩、轻快节奏和自然抓拍感。

镜头自由切换近景、特写、低机位与动态中景，动作衔接自然。

人物的注意力与摄影者形成亲密互动，偶尔偷笑、突然泼水、被水溅到时自然眯眼、忍不住大笑。

水花由双手真实拨动池水产生，具有自然的飞行方向、重力轨迹、飞溅形态和镜头遮挡。衣料、发丝和水面根据人物动作自然响应。

原创轻快日系青春流行音乐，约160 BPM，人物动作与音乐节奏呼应。保留少量水珠飞溅的瞬间慢动作。

真实皮肤纹理，清透夏日阳光，柔和高光，色彩干净自然。画面轻松、活泼、具有身临其境的夏日快乐。

【输出】

9:16竖版，10秒，目标30fps。
以高质量动态视频为母版，可另外制作无声循环GIF。

首尾利用水珠遮挡实现视觉闭环。
无字幕和额外装饰文字。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

动漫或游戏女性角色 × Art Deco 人物绘画 × 雕塑感造型 × 几何色面

每张随机选择一位不同的成年动漫或游戏女性角色，保留标志性发型、面部特征、服饰轮廓、配饰与代表色，使角色清晰可辨。

参考 Tamara de Lempicka 的装饰艺术人物绘画，将角色转译为1920至1930年代的摩登女性形象。人物具有优雅而鲜明的雕塑感，面部、身体与服装由概括的大块明暗和几何曲面塑造，体态自然，姿态富有个性。

结合角色气质重新设计具有 Art Deco 特征的服装、妆发与珠宝，让角色原有造型与摩登装饰艺术自然融合。丝缎、金属与光滑肌肤通过简洁明暗表现材质差异。

背景以建筑切面、阶梯结构、几何色块或抽象都市景观概括，与人物形成统一的造型节奏。根据角色选择协调而鲜明的配色。

自由变化人物姿态、视线、景别、机位与画面位置，允许大胆裁切和大面积留白。画面具有装饰艺术的精致、摩登与戏剧感，整体笔法统一，细节克制。

同批角色、动作、构图和主色调保持明显差异。

竖版9:16，左下角深蓝色实心圆点与白色手写体“DeepBlue”签名。

n=10，每张独立生成。

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

动漫或游戏女性角色轮廓 × 角色配色柔雾发光 × 弥散光场 × 极简科技主视觉

每张随机选择一位不同的成年动漫或游戏女性角色，以单一人物轮廓居中呈现。适度简化内部细节，保留角色发型、服饰外形及标志性配饰等关键识别特征。

以所选角色的代表性配色为基础，协调主体、柔光与背景光场。多色角色保留核心色彩关系；近单色角色通过同色系明暗与透明度形成层次。

主体半透明，与背景保持适当明暗对比，主轮廓与关键留白清楚。局部边缘轻柔雾化，自然融入背景；柔光克制，内部具有细微明暗与厚度变化。

背景为平滑抽象的弥散渐变，亮处通透，暗处深邃，微颗粒细腻均匀，留白充足。

同批角色不重复，人物轮廓、姿态、光场分布与雾化位置自然变化，保持统一的极简视觉语言。

n=10，9:16 竖版，每轮生成 1 张，连续完成 10 张独立单图，不拼图、不宫格、不分屏。
左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。

posts.text:
今日份的摸鱼：蒸汽朋克少女

看看你们的Chatgpt做出来是什么样子，我现在怀疑一样的提示词不同账号差异会极大！但同账号，不同会话和不同时间还是基本相似的

GPT IMAGE 2.5
提示词：

9：16 4k
胶片相机抓拍的瞬间，80 年代的胶片电影画面，Luc Besson and Steven Spielberg's cinematography styles，Black mist filter。成像质感参考图1，但是更搞会密度的中间偏暗调
蒸汽朋克,中性偏暗调摄影，正面主光
极度美丽的中国少女。圆短脸型小巧圆润的下巴，小翘皮鼻子,近乎白色的眉毛和白色渐变到浅灰色发梢的头发，清晰细腻的皮肤纹理和毛孔,厚而性感的嘴唇，大眼睛，有明显的卧蚕,肤色有自然的变化,。嘴唇丰满但不过分夸张，呈现柔和自然色泽。肤色呈明净的浅杏桃色，脸颊、鼻尖与嘴唇带柔淡的珊瑚粉。面部亮度均匀，额头、鼻梁和脸颊之间只有轻缓的明暗起伏，皮肤阴影保留自然冷色。肤色与环境色融合，同时保持清楚、自然的色彩区分。
繁复的蒸汽朋克款头盔。华卡在头盔上的护目镜，身上大量镶嵌有皮革和黑色、银色金属的机械部件，点缀着阴极管射线小屏幕和辉光电子管，复古旧化的纹理清晰有黄铜布满划痕、氧化痕迹和磨损低饱和度棕色皮革，黑色的金属和少量的白银.
光是柔和的杏色暖光。暗部是清冷色。整体中性灰平衡
电影感，真人电影剧照，IMAX ，Panavision，Cooke S4/i 50mm，T2.0，浅景深，柔和侧逆光，电影级明暗过渡，细腻胶片颗粒，Kodak Vision3 500T 胶片质感，真实肤色，轻微去饱和，暖橙与冷蓝对比，真实皮肤纹理，不要过度锐化，不要塑料感
眼睛和面部处于精确的合焦平面，雀斑、发丝、皮肤纹理与织物纤维通过细微的色调变化显现，边缘自然圆润。肖像镜头的大光圈浅景深，清晰区域向焦外连续过渡，背景构件融化成宽大的柔润色块。极细、低存在感的胶片颗粒，轻微的光学柔化，细腻、浓郁而通透的色彩层次。
色彩鲜活、饱满，具有通透而浓郁的胶片色彩密度。

posts.text:
Can AI maintain character consistency across multiple angles? We tested GPT Image 2.6 on a complex 16-character generation task.

The gap between the two versions is massive:

Flare: Failed the diversity prompt entirely (all black hair, identical eyes). Worse, during pose changes and back views (red/green boxes), hairstyles, accessories, and core features randomly mutated.

Sunburst: Much better. It successfully followed the racial diversity prompt and handled details well. Back views are slightly stiff and some accessories still glitch (red/yellow boxes), but it's far superior to Flare.

The Cost of Quality: 
• Flare: 40.7s (~$0.042) 
• Sunburst: 74.9s (~$0.042)

Sunburst takes nearly 2x the time, but costs the exact same. For complex human characters, the extra wait is absolutely worth it.

Maintaining consistent complex characters remains a major bottleneck for AI.

Can you spot more inconsistencies? The exact prompt we used is in the comments. 👇
#OpenAI #GPTImage #GenerativeAI #AIArt
posts.prompt:
Here is the prompt we used：
Create a 2D pixel-art RPG character sheet featuring 16 fictional adult women:
- four Black women;
- four Asian women representing East Asian, Southeast Asian, and South Asian backgrounds;
- four Latina or Latin American women;
- four White women.
Each group must include one slender, one athletic, one medium-build, and one plus-size woman. Do not associate a body type with any particular ethnic group.
All characters live in the same near-future international city. Give each woman distinct contemporary clothing, facial features, hairstyle, and hair texture. Represent diversity naturally without national flags, ethnic costumes, or exaggerated stereotypes. The White characters must also have varied faces, complexions, and hair colors rather than all being fair-skinned blondes.
Arrange the sheet in 16 columns and three rows:
- Row 1: front-facing pose;
- Row 2: matching rear-facing pose;
- Row 3: matching right-facing walking pose.
Keep the character order identical in every row. Each character must retain the same skin tone, face, hairstyle, body shape, clothing, and accessories across all three views.
Do not lighten or give Eurocentric features to the Black, Asian, or Latina characters in alternate views. Do not make plus-size characters slimmer. Do not create different characters by merely recoloring the same face.
Use one consistent polished 16-bit RPG pixel style, pixel density, outline treatment, body scale, limited palette, and upper-left light source. Align every character to the same baseline. Use a transparent or plain light-gray background.
Deliver one complete, uncropped, high-resolution PNG. Do not generate a GIF, scenery, explanatory text, or a device mockup.

———

Want to see how all 16 characters actually turned out (and where they glitched)?

🏔️ GPT image 2.6 Prompt:

古代傳統事物抽卡 × 東方材質雕塑 × 形態轉化 × 極簡留白

每張獨立選擇一種具有東方傳統文化氣息的古代器物、技藝或生活場景，創作一幅具有極簡東方美學的立體藝術作品。

【傳統主體抽卡】

開放探索茶盞、茶壺、古琴、團扇、竹簡、印章、毛筆、燈籠、屏風、瓷瓶、香爐、瓦當，以及品茶、焚香、撫琴、書寫、製扇等傳統事物。

每張選擇一個主要主體，保留其最具辨識度的形狀、結構與用途，使觀眾能夠一眼認出。

【材質互動與轉化】

根據所選主體的用途、動作或文化意象，設計一個清楚、有趣的視覺事件。

例如茶湯化作層疊紙浪，琴弦延伸成水紋，印泥生長為山巒，竹簡展開成河流，扇面上的雲紋化為立體雲霧。

也可自由探索其他自然的轉化方式。每張圍繞一個主要事件展開，讓原始形態、轉化過程與結果清楚可辨。

【東方材質】

根據主題自由搭配宣紙、陶瓷、漆器、竹木、絲綢、玉石、墨、印泥或透明玻璃等材質。

呈現紙張纖維、陶瓷釉面、木竹紋理、絲綢的柔軟及漆面的光澤。材質之間的接觸、層疊和轉化自然，具有細膩的立體感與真實觸感。

【構圖與氛圍】

採用極簡東方構圖，主體孤絕而突出，畫面保留大量留白。形態、視角和位置依主題自由變化，讓視覺事件清楚可讀。

以墨黑、暖白、硃砂、黛青、茶褐等東方色彩為靈感，根據主題選擇少量協調色彩。柔和自然的光線勾勒材質與輪廓，氣息安靜、含蓄，富有詩意。

每張獨立變化傳統主體、材質、互動方式、構圖與配色。

9:16 直式，每張為獨立完整的單圖，不拼圖、不分屏。

左下角簽名：深藍色實心圓點，後接白色自然手寫體「DeepBlue」。

🛍️ GPT image 2.6 Prompt:

南宋購物節 × 古今商品錯位 × 宋代風俗畫 × 開放載體抽卡。

每張獨立創作一幅發生於南宋時代的奇趣風俗畫。自由選擇符合南宋文化背景的繪畫載體、商業場景、商販與顧客，構成具有生活氣息的市井故事。

【現代購物主題】
posts.prompt:
南宋李嵩《市担婴戏》风格，双十一购物节主题，古今商品错位的绢本团扇风俗画。

【画面构图】
1:1正方形画幅，暖白色纸张背景，中央是一幅几乎占满画面的完整圆形团扇画心。圆内为古旧褐黄色绢本绘画，四周保留少量暖白色边缘。

【人物与事件】
画面中央，一位南宋老货郎身穿朴素旧布衣、头裹布巾，肩挑一根长扁担，身体微微前倾，面带慈祥笑容。

扁担左右各悬挂一座高大复杂的竹木百货担架，层层叠叠，几乎挂满现代商品。

画面左侧，一位宋代妇人怀抱婴儿，身旁四五名天真活泼的孩童正兴奋地围着货郎。孩子们伸手指向盲盒和玩具，有人踮脚张望，人物动作自然生动，充满市井生活趣味。

【现代百货】
左侧货担以数码配件与动漫周边为主，密集陈列充电宝、手机、数据线、无线耳机、迷你风扇、键盘、平板电脑、动漫手办、盲盒、毛绒玩具和宠物小物。

右侧货担以现代便利店与双十一购物商品为主，悬挂奶茶杯、饮料、零食包装、耳机、游戏手柄、小型电子设备、纸袋、快递纸箱和购物包裹。

各种商品分层摆放、交错悬挂，竹架、绳索、挂钩、竹篮与货物之间具有真实的连接关系。商品数量繁多，轮廓清楚，形成可供观众放大寻找彩蛋的密集百货结构。

【趣味文字】
货郎担上悬挂古式布幌与小型木牌，分别写有「双11大促」「盲盒」「包邮」「秒杀」「满减」「便利店零食」。

文字采用传统手写书法，融入画面中的商铺招幌和商品标签。

【环境与留白】
左上方一株古柳从画外斜伸入圆形画心，细长柳枝自然垂落。人物脚下点缀少量野草、坡石和细小花木。

背景以大片浅褐色绢面留白，环境简洁，视觉重点集中于货郎、两座密集货架和围观孩童。

【宋画艺术语言】
整体借鉴南宋院体风俗画，尤其是李嵩《市担婴戏》的细密百货描写与人物造型。

采用精细均匀而富有变化的墨线勾勒，人物衣纹柔和流畅，器物结构精谨。以淡赭石、茶褐、灰绿、浅朱砂与柔和墨色薄染，色彩沉静古雅。

所有现代商品都以南宋画师描绘器物的方式表现，与古代人物共享完全统一的线条、设色、尺度和绘画完成度。

整幅画呈现真实绢本经年保存后的暖褐底色、细密绢丝纹理与自然轻微褪色，保留清晰、细致、耐看的传统笔墨质感。

画面具有宋代风俗画的古雅气息，同时通过大量现代购物商品形成鲜明、幽默的时代反差。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

南宋购物节 × 古今商品错位 × 宋代风俗画 × 开放载体抽卡。

每张独立创作一幅发生于南宋时代的奇趣风俗画。自由选择符合南宋文化背景的绘画载体、商业场景、商贩与顾客，构成具有生活气息的市井故事。

【现代购物主题】
每张独立选择一种现代消费主题，将具有鲜明辨识度的现代商品带入南宋商业场景。商品可来自数码电子、动漫周边、AI创作、美妆、奶茶、潮流穿搭、宠物用品、游戏电竞、便利店、户外露营或其他有趣的现代购物领域。

保留现代商品的标志性造型和用途，让它们与南宋人物、建筑和传统商业器具产生清楚的时代反差。所有商品采用与整幅作品一致的宋代绘画笔墨、线描和设色方式，呈现为古代画师亲手绘制的器物。

【人物与趣味事件】
根据商品与人物身份，自由设计一件有趣的买卖、试用、搬运、展示或围观事件。人物具有自然的表情、动作与互动，形成能够一眼理解的幽默情节。

【画面结构】
根据故事自由选择团扇、册页、手卷、立轴、横幅、屏风画面等合理载体。构图、人物数量、商品密度、景别和环境均可变化，货物陈列符合竹架、挑担、铺席、箱笼或店铺的实际支撑关系。商品丰富而有层次，适合局部放大寻找彩蛋。

【南宋视觉语言】
遵循南宋风俗画的造型与设色传统，采用清晰而有变化的墨线、细致的器物描写、柔和敷色和符合载体的纸绢纹理。建筑、人物服饰、家具、商业器具与生活场景保持南宋时代特征。不同对象的笔法和色彩自然统一，保留原画应有的疏密节奏、空间呼吸与古雅气质。

可以自然融入少量带有现代商业含义的小招幌或题签，例如「包邮」「秒杀」「满减」，作为古今错位的趣味彩蛋。题字使用与绘画协调的传统手写形态。

同一系列保留南宋绘画的整体视觉语言，每张优先改变商业场景、主要交易事件与构图结构，减少重复。单张独立成画。

默认竖版9:16，具体绘画形制保持完整比例。

A very attractive woman in her mid-20s with long dark wavy hair slightly messy from a long night, fresh youthful face, glowing skin with a light sheen, eyeliner gently smudged, lipstick faded at the center. She sits on the carpeted hallway floor with her back against her hotel room door, legs stretched out and crossed at the ankles, laughing at something on her phone.

[OUTFIT]
A black satin corset mini dress with thin straps and a sweetheart neckline, fine lace trim along the edges, visible black garter straps attached to sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace tops. Gold layered necklaces, small hoop earrings, a velvet hair clip hanging loose. One strappy black heel lies on the floor beside her, the other dangles from her hand.

[STORY DETAILS]
An open pizza box on her lap with one slice missing, a slice in her other hand. A neon club wristband on her wrist. Her tiny clutch spilled open next to her: lipstick, a crumpled receipt, no key card. The room door behind her shows a small red light on the card reader. Further down the hallway, a room service tray with empty champagne glasses sits outside another door. A man's suit jacket is draped over her shoulders, too big for her.

[CAMERA AND REALISM]
Shot on an iPhone from standing height, slightly above her, as if a friend just found her there. Warm yellow hallway sconces mixed with cool dawn light from a window at the end of the corridor. Real skin texture with visible pores, natural hair flyaways, slight motion blur on the hand holding the slice, mild phone noise in the shadows. Patterned hotel carpet, slightly worn. Vertical 4:5.

[MOOD]
Funny, tired, glamorous, a little chaotic. The feeling of "best night ever, worst decision about the key card."

-Woman: age, hair, makeup state
-Outfit: dress, stockings, accessories
-Story props: food, wristband, jacket, clutch contents

posts.text:
Math tricks with Nano Banana 2.1

Prompt: 
2x2 grid, 16:9, extremely hard math tricks :  System Instruction:  
You are a Mathematical Visual Architect. You must execute this prompt in three logical phases:

  Phase 1: Trick Discovery (Logic Inference)  
Analyze the `[Input Variable]`. Search your database for a high-value mental math "shortcut" or "hack" based on difficulty level within this domain. Determine the underlying arithmetic logic (e.g., if "Percentages," use the $ x\%$ of $ y = y\%$ of $ x$ trick). Select a set of numbers that perfectly demonstrates this trick with clear, non-cluttered results.

  Phase 2: Vector Mapping (The Connectors)  
Map the movement of digits. Identify which numbers interact.
      Primary Operation:   Define the "Bridge" (The visual path between the digits).
      Secondary Operation:   Define the "Carry" or "Resultant" (The derived digits).
Assign a color to the   Constants   (Standard ink) and a high-vibration color to the   Logic Connectors   (Red/Orange ink).

  Phase 3: The Forensic Render  
Generate a photorealistic macro top-down shot of this discovery on a physical medium.
      The Surface:   A single piece of high-tooth   Architectural Graph Paper  , slightly yellowed. 
      The Medium:   Use a   Fountain Pen   (Black Ink) for the static equation. Use a   Felt-Tip Marker   (Vibrant Ink) for the logic connectors (arrows, circles, arcs).
      Physical Accuracy:   The arrows must physically touch the base of the numbers they are calculating. If a number is moved, draw a dashed line representing the "ghost path." 
      The Finish:   At the bottom, circle the final answer in a third color (Cyan or Electric Blue) to signify completion.

  Visual Syntax:   Sharp macro focus, shallow depth of field, natural desk lighting (warm side-light), ink drying textures visible.

posts.text:
Made with the Scenario MCP: 

The character sheet took three passes.

1. Design
Prompt (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst):
Professional anime character design illustration. One single character, full body, standing in a relaxed three-quarter front view on a pure flat white background, the entire figure visible from the top of the head to the soles of the boots with generous white margins. Front-facing enough that the face reads clearly.

Original character "Rivet": a 19-year-old scrapyard mechanic and robot builder, tomboyish, confident, with a big crooked grin.

HEAD: a messy short wolf-cut in bright mint green with a darker teal underlayer and a few spiky flyaway strands; oversized chunky welding goggles with round amber lenses and a thick black strap pushed up on her forehead; big over-ear headphones in hazard yellow resting around her neck.
FACE: warm light skin, a constellation of freckles across the nose, a small white band-aid on the bridge of her nose, large sharp eyes with hot-pink irises, thick confident eyebrows, a wide toothy grin with one small fang, a little grease smudge on one cheek.
OUTFIT: a huge boxy padded work jacket in hazard yellow, worn slipping off her left shoulder, two horizontal black-and-silver reflective tape stripes around each sleeve, chunky utility pockets, a round mint patch with a simple gear icon on the chest; underneath a white ribbed tank top; charcoal-grey cargo shorts with yellow webbing straps and a tool belt with a few small tools; her right forearm and hand are a sleek mechanical prosthetic in glossy white ceramic panels with thin mint seam lines and black joints; a black fingerless glove on the left hand; mismatched knee socks, one mint and one hot pink; very chunky white high-top work boots with thick yellow treaded soles and fat yellow laces.
POSE: weight on one leg, left hand on hip, the white mechanical right hand resting a big oversized steel wrench on her shoulder, a slight lean toward the viewer, cocky and friendly.

STYLE: top-tier professional character designer's key illustration, the quality of a premium action game's character reveal art. Bold graphic urban anime style: thick confident black ink outlines with varied weight, flat cel colours with crisp two-tone shading, small halftone dot accents inside the shadows, sharp angular shape language, a very strong readable silhouette. Strict limited palette: hazard yellow, mint green, clean white and charcoal grey, with hot pink as the single accent. Clean, crisp, high resolution. No text, no letters, no logo, no brand marks, no signature, no watermark, no background objects, only a faint soft contact shadow under the boots.

2. Redesign
Prompt (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, image 1 = the design, image 2 = a Krea 2 Medium version for style):
Final redesign pass by a top professional character designer. Image 1 is the design and anatomy of Rivet: keep her pose, proportions, mint wolf-cut, amber goggles, yellow headphones, boxy hazard-yellow work jacket with reflective sleeve stripes and mint gear patch, white tank top, charcoal cargo shorts with yellow straps and tool belt, white mechanical right arm with mint seams, fingerless glove, mismatched mint and pink socks, chunky white work boots with yellow soles and laces, the big wrench on her shoulder. Image 2 is the rendering style to adopt: thick confident black ink outlines, flat bold colour fills, crisp two-tone cel shadows, small halftone dot accents, graphic poster-like shapes.

Redraw image 1 in the style of image 2. One single full-body character on a pure flat white background, three-quarter front view, the whole figure visible with white margins.

Improvements:
- Warm, saturated hazard yellow on the jacket (not neon lime), clean flat fills, no dirt texture on clothes; only one small grease smudge on her cheek.
- Face: extremely appealing and charismatic, large sharp hot-pink eyes with bright highlights, freckles, the white band-aid across her nose, a big confident toothy grin with one fang.
- Slightly stylized proportions: a touch larger head and hands, chunky boots, strong readable silhouette.
- Lineart with real weight variation, like a professional illustrator's finished character reveal art.

Strict palette: hazard yellow, mint green, clean white, charcoal grey, hot pink accent. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, only a faint contact shadow.

3. Close-up
Prompt (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, image 1 = the redesign):
Using image 1 as the exact character design and art style, draw a waist-up portrait of the same character, Rivet, as an animation close-up reference sheet. Front view, facing the viewer directly and making eye contact, centered, on a pure flat white background. Landscape framing: the top of her messy mint hair and the amber goggles near the top edge, cut at the waist at the bottom. Both hands held open in front of her chest, palms up, as if about to offer something: the glossy white mechanical right hand with mint seams and the left hand in a black fingerless glove; nothing in them. No wrench.

The face is large, clear and extremely charismatic: big sharp hot-pink eyes with bright highlights, thick expressive eyebrows, freckles, the white band-aid across her nose, a big confident toothy grin with one fang, a single small grease smudge on her cheek. Mint wolf-cut with teal underlayer, amber goggles pushed up on her forehead, hazard-yellow headphones around her neck, boxy hazard-yellow work jacket slipping off one shoulder with black-and-silver reflective sleeve stripes and the mint gear patch, white ribbed tank top.

Same thick black ink outlines, flat bold colour fills, crisp two-tone cel shadows and small halftone accents as image 1, professional illustrator quality. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

超写实罗刹士兵角色设定表，来自罗摩衍那，服务于罗波那军队的恐怖恶魔战士。高大、威严、极度肌肉发达的人形体格，暗木炭灰皮肤带细微蓝调，真实粗糙皮肤纹理，有力下颌，突出眉脊，略尖耳朵，小下犬齿，强烈琥珀色眼睛，凌乱黑色长发，浓密胡须，威严但解剖上真实的面部特征。无多余头部或肢体。

身穿厚重古印度风格黑化钢铁盔甲，带精致金色雕刻，激进肩甲，华丽青铜臂环，皮革绑带，暗绯红腰布，黑色托蒂，装甲护胫与皮凉鞋。手持巨大残酷弯曲剑，暗钢刀刃与雕刻金柄。

干净对称三面板角色设定布局：左侧详细正面面部与上半身特写，中央全身严格正面站立持剑，右侧全身直接背面视图。各视图角色身份一致，盔甲、解剖与比例相同。

纯净无缝中性灰工作室背景，柔和专业三点布光，真实接触阴影，极度细节的自然皮肤、头发、布料、皮革与金属纹理。电影级真人摄影写实，真实解剖，黑暗神话奇幻美学，无CGI外观、无3D渲染感、无插画、无文字。16:9比例。

————————————————————————
瓦纳拉战士：

超写实瓦纳拉战士角色设定表，来自罗摩衍那，强力人形猴战士，肌肉发达运动体格，宽肩，强壮手臂，真实灵长类面部解剖，富有表现力的琥珀色眼睛，全身覆盖短密深棕毛皮，长而肌肉发达的猴尾。凶猛但聪明的外貌，强壮下颌，自然猿类特征，真实比例，无卡通元素。

身穿古印度风格战士装束，风化青铜与金胸甲，华丽金臂环，皮革绑带，装饰腰带，暗藏红花托蒂，传统皮凉鞋。手持巨大传统印度战锤（gada），暗金属带精致金雕刻，重球形头与长柄。

干净对称三面板角色设定布局：左侧详细正面面部与上半身特写，中央全身严格正面站立持锤，右侧全身直接背面视图显示尾巴、盔甲与装备。各视图角色身份一致，服装与比例相同。

纯净无缝中性灰工作室背景，柔和专业三点布光，真实接触阴影，极度细节的自然毛皮、皮肤、布料、皮革与金属纹理。电影级真人摄影写实，真实生物解剖，无CGI外观、无3D渲染感、无插画、无文字。16:9比例。

————————————————————
罗波那：

写实罗波那角色设定表，巨大威严的神话战士国王，极深肤色近乎黑色，带细微冷蓝调，以自然人类色调渲染。浓密黑胡须，黑色长发，强大威慑存在感。身穿精致黑金盔甲，带丰富装饰细节，多层皇家珠宝，以及一把大弯剑。不使用十个真实头部，而是佩戴雕刻有十张面孔的华丽金冠，以保留象征外观同时避免解剖畸形。干净对称角色设定布局：左侧正面面部特写，中央全身正面，右侧全身背面。纯净中性灰背景，柔和专业工作室灯光，高度写实风格，真实皮肤、布料、金属与武器纹理，无3D、无CGI、无文字。

——————————————————————
罗摩：

写实罗摩角色设定表，年轻运动型战士，肤色为微妙深蓝的自然人类色调，非明亮蓝或卡通。黑色长发束成发髻，高耸华丽金冠，裸胸佩戴多层金项链与臂环，藏红花托蒂，带金细节的长木弓，背后箭筒。干净对称角色设定布局：左侧正面面部特写，中央全身正面，右侧全身背面。纯净中性灰背景，柔和专业工作室灯光，高度写实风格，真实皮肤、布料、木材与金属纹理，无3D、无CGI。

———

1/4风景 / 剪影 / 壁纸
写实剪影日落合成图，宽幅16:9全景构图，电影感，超细节。边缘到边缘，无边框、无画框。

天空：上半部分是琥珀色、杏黄色与焦金色的熔炉，地平线处最深，顶部渐变为烟灰色蓝。长条状卷云斜向扫过，云底被金色照亮，边缘拖着细长温暖的余晖。

太阳：一颗巨大、完美圆形、苍白炽热的太阳圆盘，恰好位于画面正中心、树线正上方，边缘发光并向周围橙色区域溢出柔和光晕。

树木：正中心、太阳前方，一棵巨大展开的阔叶树纯黑剪影——粗壮树干在基部向外张开成圆丘，庞大浓密的树冠由细枝与叶簇组成，对称展开，边缘柔和融入光晕中。

城市：树木两侧，黑色摩天大楼剪影沿低矮屋顶脊线排列。左侧是一座带双细天线的阶梯式高塔，周围环绕较短建筑；右侧是三栋高度递减的深色高楼，其中一栋带细长尖顶。建筑不与树木重叠，也不穿过太阳。

水面：下三分之一是冻结的湖面，而非光滑水面——由冰川冰与流动石材组成的湍流大理石状区域，以粉笔白、海绿、板岩灰与暖棕长条状漩涡纹理带状分布。

倒影：天空、太阳、树木与天际线全部向下镜像到大理石状表面，被冰粒打破并拉伸。倒影中的太阳是树干下方宽阔柔和的金色区域，倒影树木呈下方暗色根状分支静脉，倒影塔楼呈垂直暗条，全部被旋转的白色与绿色石材抹开。

配色：纯黑、杏色、琥珀金、焦橙、烟灰、粉笔白、冰川绿、棕褐。锐利剪影边缘对比柔和光晕，高动态范围，干净无标记。

禁止：文字、水印、Logo、签名、艺术家签名、手写签名、首字母、字母组合、日期、印章、封缄、任何文字、数字、边框、画框、衬垫、斜面、模具、牌匾、矩形轮廓、绘画、插画、油画、厚涂、水彩、彩色铅笔、喷枪、数字艺术、卡通、动漫、Q版、扁平2D矢量、模糊、柔焦、噪点颗粒、霓虹、荧光、过度饱和绿色、正午蓝天、日出粉、紫色天空、夜晚、月亮、星星、遮挡太阳的云、雨、风暴、闪电、下雪、第二棵树、森林、多棵树、带颜色的树叶、建筑亮窗、人、面孔、鸟、动物、鹿、船、码头、桥、道路、汽车、交通、路灯、棕榈树、山、沙漠、海浪、海滩、太阳被裁切、树被裁切、非中心树、不对称构图。

———

4/4 风格化 / 动画 / CG

电影级日本3D CG动画静帧，半写实风格化CG年轻女性，青春放松能量，毫不费力随性，明亮全局照明，柔光，高动态范围，发光边缘光，奶油感Cooke镜头渲染，大光圈，发光散景，中景，坐在叶树下乡村木椅上，双手持温热咖啡杯轻啜，超大针织开衫覆盖轻便连衣裙，一杯冒热气的咖啡，柔和微笑，凝视远方，清晨阳光透过树叶过滤带斑驳阴影与发光背景散景

———

3/4 旅行 / 概念摄影
地标素描旅行照：

创建一幅令人惊叹的写实旅行照片，人物站在[地标]的真实世界确切位置，前景手持打开的口袋尺寸素描本。素描本包含该确切地标美丽的手绘黑色墨水建筑素描，带精细笔触、复杂细节、自然不完美与手写旅行日记笔记。

魔法在于构图：真实地标直接站在素描本后方，与其手绘版本完美对齐，创造真实世界与艺术家绘画之间的美丽视觉连接。素描应看起来像有人参观该地、坐在附近并仔细手绘建筑。

捕捉人物手部自然持素描本，地标在背景中清晰可见。使用浅景深、柔和自然日光、真实阴影、细微胶片颗粒与真实旅行摄影美学。

素描本应有略带纹理的奶油色页面、简单装订与精致丝带书签。绘图必须保持单色，仅使用黑色墨水与细铅笔线条。

重要细节：

保持实际地标建筑准确且可立即识别。
使素描匹配真实建筑的确切结构、比例、窗户、塔楼与独特特征。
使背景位置感觉真实，包括周围街道与建筑。
保持手与素描本锐利，真实地标略微柔化但仍可识别。
自然人手解剖、真实透视、专业旅行摄影。
无卡通效果、无3D渲染、无人工外观建筑、无过度滤镜。

整体氛围：艺术、怀旧、真实，旅行日记启发，像真实旅行中捕捉的美丽时刻。

巨型拉链揭示真实地点：

创建一幅令人惊叹的写实超现实摄影，一颗巨型金属拉链部分打开普通真实世界环境表面，揭示其后方[国家/城市/地标]的实际地点。

一颗巨型、物理真实的银色拉链对角横穿场景。其金属齿分离外表面两边缘，创造大型自然开口。拉链必须看起来像真实物理对象，带拉丝金属纹理、细微划痕、准确反射与真实阴影。

开口内部：
揭示[国家/城市/地标]的令人惊叹写实视图，如同真实世界存在。

若主体是国家，展示其真实地理特征、传统建筑、可识别地标与真实文化细节的真实景观。
若主体是城市，展示其实际街道、真实建筑、可识别天际线、真实交通与特色城市氛围。
若主体是地标，再现其真实建筑，带准确比例、材料、颜色、窗户、结构细节与周围环境。

每栋建筑、街道、车辆与建筑特征必须看起来可信并与真实位置一致。使用实际世界建筑参考而非发明结构。

视觉魔法：
唯一超现实元素是巨型拉链打开现实。内部地点必须看起来像专业旅行摄影师拍摄的真实照片。

真实景观自然延伸到拉链开口后方，带真实透视、大气深度、自然阳光与物理准确阴影。拉链边缘在揭示场景上投下可信阴影，使错觉令人信服。

摄影风格：
超写实旅行摄影，自然日光，真实大气透视，真实颜色，物理准确纹理，专业全画幅相机质量，锐利建筑细节，自然对比，真实景深，高端编辑摄影。

构图：
竖版4:5构图。巨型拉链占据前景并足够宽地打开以清晰揭示地点。真实世界目的地是主要主体，立即可识别并视觉主导。干净构图，无多余装饰元素。

严格写实规则：

无奇幻建筑或虚构建筑。
无卡通、插画、绘画或CGI外观景观。
无夸张颜色、人工发光或魔法粒子。
无扭曲建筑、融化结构或不可能道路。
无发明地标或不准确建筑细节。
无额外拉链或无关对象。
无文字、标签、边框或水印。

最终结果：视觉非凡却令人信服的写实图像，巨型拉链揭示隐藏在现实后方的真实地点。概念超现实；目的地本身完全写实。

posts.prompt:
Ultra-Realistic Nostalgic Portrait — Preserve the Exact Girl from the Reference Photo

Use the uploaded reference photo as the exact identity reference for the girl. Preserve her original face, facial structure, eye shape and color, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, freckles (if present), natural skin texture, and all distinctive facial features. Keep her instantly recognizable as the same person. Do not change her identity, beautify her into a different person, or replace her face with a generic East Asian model. Adapt only the hairstyle, outfit, pose, lighting, and photographic aesthetic described below.

Create an ultra-realistic candid portrait of the same girl photographed indoors with a nostalgic early-2000s digital-camera aesthetic. She stands against a simple, warm off-white wall, looking slightly downward and toward the camera with a calm, soft, dreamy expression.

HAIRSTYLE

Style her hair into an elegant, traditional-inspired high updo, with voluminous hair gathered at the back and secured with two simple dark hair sticks extending horizontally. Add loose, softly curled tendrils framing both sides of her face, along with delicate flyaways around the crown and temples. Preserve her recognizable hairline and natural facial proportions. Render individual strands, realistic shine, and slight imperfections for an authentic personal-photograph appearance.

MAKEUP

Use refined, feminine makeup with softly defined brows, subtle warm-brown eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, naturally flushed cheeks, and glossy muted-rose lips. Keep the girl's original eye shape, eye color, facial features, and skin tone unchanged. Retain realistic pores, natural texture, and subtle imperfections. Avoid excessive smoothing or artificial beauty filters.

OUTFIT

Dress her in a beautifully tailored, vintage-inspired Chinese floral qipao (cheongsam) in muted dusty blue-gray. The dress should feature:

- A delicate Mandarin collar and modest curved neckline.
- Short, fitted sleeves and a flattering, elegant silhouette.
- Traditional diagonal front closure with subtle decorative frog buttons.
- Soft satin-like fabric with realistic folds and gentle flash reflections.
- An intricate multicolored floral pattern featuring peonies, roses, and smaller blossoms in dusty pink, burgundy, cream, pale yellow, sage green, and muted coral.

The garment should feel authentic, sophisticated, and vintage-inspired, with realistic fabric construction rather than a theatrical costume.

POSE AND EXPRESSION

She stands naturally with both arms relaxed alongside her body. Her shoulders are slightly angled away from the camera, while her head tilts subtly downward and to one side. Her gaze meets the camera with a quiet, composed, introspective expression. Her lips remain naturally relaxed, without an exaggerated smile.

Keep her posture anatomically natural and believable, with realistic shoulders, arms, hands, and body proportions.

LIGHTING AND ENVIRONMENT

Recreate the appearance of a compact digital camera using direct on-camera flash in a dim indoor environment. The flash softly illuminates her face, creates natural catchlights in her eyes, highlights the satin fabric, and casts a subtle shadow onto the plain wall behind her. Use slightly cool flash illumination against the warmer ivory background, with gentle light falloff toward the edges.

Avoid professional studio lighting, dramatic cinematic spotlights, or overly polished fashion photography.

PHOTOGRAPHIC AESTHETIC

Authentic early-2000s personal digital-camera photography, 35mm-equivalent lens, slight wide-angle perspective, direct flash, subtle digital noise, mild highlight bloom, gentle lens softness, slightly muted colors, modest chromatic aberration, and imperfect exposure. Maintain crisp facial identity and convincing anatomical detail while preserving the imperfect, nostalgic quality of an old personal photograph.

COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 portrait, framed from approximately the hips upward. Position her slightly off-center, leaving generous negative space around her head and shoulders. Keep the simple warm off-white wall visible, allowing the colorful floral dress and elegant dark hairstyle to stand out naturally.

COLOR PALETTE

Dusty blue-gray, muted burgundy, faded rose pink, cream, sage green, pale yellow, deep black hair, and warm ivory.

FINAL RESULT

An incredibly realistic, candid portrait of the exact same girl from the uploaded reference photo, styled in an elegant traditional-inspired floral qipao with a graceful updo. The image should feel like a genuine photograph discovered in a personal photo archive from the early 2000s: feminine, romantic, nostalgic, quietly mysterious, and naturally imperfect.

STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: Do not change the girl's identity or facial features. No face replacement, no different person, no artificial facial reconstruction, no plastic skin, no excessive retouching, no exaggerated makeup, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no malformed limbs, no unrealistic fabric, no cartoon effects, no CGI appearance, no studio-campaign aesthetic, and no artificial AI-generated look.

———

Ultra-Realistic Nostalgic Portrait — 45° Hair Adjustment

IDENTITY LOCK

Use the uploaded reference photo as the definitive facial identity reference for the same person.

Preserve her exact facial structure, eye shape and color, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, freckles if present, hairline, and distinctive facial characteristics. Preserve her natural age appearance and realistic skin texture.

Do not change her identity, reconstruct her face, or transform her into a generic beauty model.

HAIRSTYLE

Style her hair into an elegant, traditional-inspired high updo, with voluminous dark hair gathered at the back and secured with two simple dark hair sticks extending horizontally.

Keep loose softly curled tendrils framing both sides of her face, delicate flyaway strands, natural volume, and slightly imperfect styling.

MAKEUP

Soft feminine vintage makeup: natural brows, subtle warm-brown eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, softly flushed cheeks, glossy muted-rose lips, realistic skin pores and subtle imperfections.

OUTFIT

A vintage-inspired dusty blue-gray Chinese floral qipao, featuring a delicate Mandarin collar, short fitted sleeves, traditional diagonal closure with decorative frog buttons, and authentic satin-like fabric.

Intricate multicolored flowers in dusty pink, burgundy, cream, muted coral, pale yellow, and sage green.

Preserve the exact garment design, floral arrangement, fabric color, and hairstyle throughout this photographic series.

POSE — THREE-QUARTER HAIR ADJUSTMENT

The woman stands naturally against a warm off-white wall.

Her torso is turned approximately 45 degrees toward camera-left, creating an elegant three-quarter silhouette.

Her weight rests comfortably on one leg, with relaxed shoulders.

She gently raises her right hand toward the side of her head, using two relaxed fingers to lightly adjust a loose curled tendril near her ear.

Her fingers remain naturally separated and do not obscure her eyes, nose, or lips.

Her left arm hangs loosely beside her body.

Her head turns back toward the camera, chin slightly lowered.

Her eyes meet the lens with a calm, softly curious expression.

Lips relaxed and gently closed, without an exaggerated smile.

The gesture should appear spontaneous, as though the photographer captured her while fixing her hair between photographs.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 portrait.

Camera positioned at approximately eye level, slightly toward her front-left side.

35mm-equivalent compact digital-camera lens.

Three-quarter portrait framed from mid-thigh to slightly above her head.

Keep her face clearly recognizable, the raised hand anatomically correct, and both horizontal hair sticks believable.

Position her slightly off-center, leaving visible negative space against the ivory wall.

LIGHTING

Authentic early-2000s compact digital-camera flash.

Direct on-camera flash in a dim indoor environment, natural facial catchlights, slightly cool flash highlights, mild satin reflections, and a soft shadow cast behind her.

PHOTOGRAPHIC AESTHETIC

Genuine early-2000s personal photo archive.

Subtle digital sensor noise, mild highlight bloom, modest chromatic aberration, gentle lens softness, slightly imperfect exposure, muted colors, and authentic skin texture.

The photograph should feel intimate, nostalgic, candid, feminine, and naturally imperfect.

STRICT CONSTRAINTS

ONE independent photograph only.

Same face, same outfit, same hairstyle, same indoor background.

No collage, no beauty filter, no facial identity drift, no CGI, no studio-fashion lighting, no extra arms, no duplicated fingers, no distorted hands, no artificial skin, no text or watermark.

———

Ultra-Realistic Nostalgic Portrait — Seated Vintage Moment

IDENTITY LOCK

Use the uploaded reference photograph as the definitive identity reference for the exact same woman.

Preserve her original facial structure, eye shape, iris color, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, natural skin texture, hairline, age appearance, and distinctive facial features.

Keep her instantly recognizable as the same person. Do not beautify, replace, or reinterpret her face.

HAIRSTYLE AND MAKEUP

Maintain the same elegant dark high updo, secured with two simple horizontal dark hair sticks, with loose softly curled tendrils framing the face and delicate natural flyaways.

Refined soft makeup: natural brows, warm-brown eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, subtle rosy cheeks, and glossy muted-rose lips.

Keep natural pores and slight skin imperfections.

OUTFIT

The identical vintage-inspired dusty blue-gray floral Chinese qipao from the original concept.

Traditional Mandarin collar, delicate decorative frog buttons, short fitted sleeves, elegant tailoring, and satin-like fabric.

Detailed floral motifs in faded rose pink, burgundy, sage green, cream, pale yellow, and muted coral.

The fabric must form realistic folds where the body bends or meets the chair.

POSE — SEATED THREE-QUARTER PORTRAIT

The woman sits on a simple vintage dark wooden chair positioned close to a warm ivory wall.

Her torso faces approximately 60 degrees toward camera-right.

Her upper body remains upright but relaxed, with a subtle natural curve through the shoulders.

Both knees point in the same direction, and her legs remain in a comfortable, anatomically believable seated position.

Her hands rest gently on her lap, one hand loosely overlapping the other, with naturally relaxed fingers.

Her head is slightly lowered and turned back toward the photographer.

Her eyes look upward toward the camera, creating a subtle contrast between her lowered chin and attentive gaze.

Her lips are softly relaxed, and her expression is quiet, dreamy, introspective, and slightly mysterious.

Avoid theatrical posing or exaggerated elegance.

The moment should resemble an ordinary personal photograph taken while she was sitting quietly between conversations.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 composition.

Camera positioned slightly above her eye level, angled down by approximately 10 degrees.

Natural 35mm-equivalent compact digital-camera perspective.

Medium seated portrait framed from her lap to above her head.

Include a small visible section of the wooden chair to establish the seated pose.

Keep the warm off-white wall simple and uncluttered.

Leave moderate negative space above and beside her head.

Her eyes, face, hair sticks, collar, and floral fabric should remain clearly visible.

LIGHTING

Direct built-in compact-camera flash in a dim interior.

Soft flash highlights on her face and satin fabric, slight shadow cast onto the wall behind her, gentle brightness falloff, and a subtle cool-versus-warm color contrast.

No professional studio lighting.

TITLE: A WORLD ON THE EDGE — CLIMATE CRISIS CINEMATIC FILM

Duration: 1 minute 41 seconds (101 seconds)
Aspect ratio: 16:9 widescreen
Style: Ultra-realistic cinematic environmental documentary, emotional storytelling, epic scale, photorealistic wildlife, IMAX-quality imagery, dramatic natural lighting, volumetric fog, realistic atmospheric particles, subtle film grain, smooth camera movement, high dynamic range, 4K visual quality.
MASTER PROMPT
Create a deeply emotional cinematic film about Earth's escalating climate crisis, synchronized to the lyrics of an environmental anthem. The film begins with the silent beauty of the Arctic, reveals the devastating effects of global warming, melting polar ice, ocean plastic pollution, and catastrophic forest fires, then transitions into a powerful message of hope, restoration, and collective action.

Every scene must feel like a frame from a premium nature documentary mixed with a dramatic Hollywood environmental film. Use realistic wildlife behavior, physically accurate water and fire, natural atmospheric conditions, detailed textures, dramatic wide shots, intimate animal close-ups, and seamless cinematic transitions.

The emotional progression moves from fragile beauty to fear, destruction, grief, and finally hope. Use a cold blue and desaturated color palette during the crisis, transitioning into warm golden sunlight and lush natural greens toward the ending.

SCENE 1 — THE FROZEN WORLD

00:00–00:12 | Intro and opening lyrics

Open with a breathtaking aerial shot of the Arctic at dawn. Vast white glaciers stretch toward the horizon beneath a cold, overcast sky. The camera slowly descends toward a solitary polar bear standing on a fractured ice shelf.
Cut to an intimate close-up of the bear's face. Its wet fur moves gently in the icy wind. It looks across the empty frozen landscape.
Show cracks spreading through ancient ice, followed by a massive glacier breaking apart and crashing into the dark ocean. Water erupts into the air in slow motion. Tiny ice fragments drift across the surface.

Camera: slow aerial drone descent, cinematic close-up, wide establishing shot, controlled slow motion.

Lighting: cold blue daylight, muted whites, atmospheric mist.

Emotion: fragile beauty, loneliness, impending danger.

SCENE 2 — WHERE THE ICE IS TOO OLD

00:12–00:24 | Lyrics about melting ice and the changing Earth

A polar bear walks cautiously across a narrowing strip of floating ice. The camera tracks alongside it at water level.

Reveal enormous fractures separating the ice into isolated pieces. The bear pauses as another section breaks away. Transition into an overhead shot showing the animal surrounded by an immense dark ocean.
Cut to a wide shot of a glacier collapsing into the sea. Towering ice walls crumble, and waves ripple across the water.
Use a slow match cut from white ice disappearing beneath blue water to sunlight penetrating the ocean depths.

Emotion: vulnerability, environmental loss, urgency.

SCENE 3 — DEEP BENEATH THE BLUE

00:24–00:36 | Lyrics: “Deep beneath the blue” and “Life is calling you”

The camera descends beneath the ocean surface into a beautiful blue underwater world. Sunbeams penetrate the water, illuminating a sea turtle swimming peacefully through the deep.

The beauty is interrupted by floating plastic bags, discarded bottles, fishing lines, and tiny particles suspended in the water.

A translucent plastic bag drifts directly in front of the turtle, briefly obscuring its face. The turtle changes direction and continues swimming through the polluted water.
Cut to a close-up of plastic waste moving with the current, followed by a wide underwater shot revealing pollution spreading through the ocean.
Camera: smooth underwater tracking, slow push-in, close-up of drifting debris, wide cinematic underwater composition.

Lighting: beautiful blue caustics gradually becoming darker and more desaturated.

Emotion: wonder turning into sadness and concern.

SCENE 4 — WHERE THE OCEANS RISE

00:36–00:48 | Lyrics about rising oceans and keeping hope alive

Show powerful ocean waves crashing against a vulnerable coastline. Dark storm clouds gather above a coastal settlement. Water surges over the shore, flooding low-lying land.

Cut to a wide aerial view of muddy water carrying plastic waste toward the open sea.

Underwater, the turtle swims through suspended particles as distant sunlight struggles to reach the seabed.

As the lyric suggests that hope remains alive, a narrow shaft of sunlight breaks through the clouds and illuminates the ocean surface.
Transition from the dark ocean to a glowing orange horizon, foreshadowing the coming wildfire.
Emotion: danger, uncertainty, a fragile glimpse of hope.

SCENE 5 — FIRE THROUGH THE NIGHT

00:48–01:03 | Lyrics: “Fire through the night” and “From the ashes below”

A vast forest burns beneath a smoke-filled sky. Towering orange flames climb the trunks of trees while glowing embers drift through the air.

The camera moves through the forest at a low tracking angle as a deer runs desperately between the trees, escaping the approaching fire.

Show blackened branches silhouetted against an intense orange sky. Aerial footage reveals the enormous scale of the wildfire spreading across the landscape.

Cut to a close-up of charred earth and falling ash. The sound and visual intensity peak with the music.

At the lyric about ashes, a single ember lands on the dark ground. The camera slowly pushes toward it.
The flames gradually fade into drifting gray smoke.
Color palette: fiery orange, deep charcoal, smoky gray, dramatic highlights.

Emotion: panic, devastation, grief, irreversible loss.

SCENE 6 — SEEDS OF LIFE WILL GROW

01:03–01:16 | Lyrics about new life, the sea, and carrying life forward

The ash-covered forest becomes quiet. Gentle rain falls onto the blackened earth.

In a cinematic macro shot, a tiny green shoot emerges through the soil. Water droplets cling to its fresh leaves.

Transition to a young deer standing in a recovering forest as warm morning sunlight filters between the trees.

Cut to a sea turtle swimming freely through clear blue water. Sunlight illuminates its shell as it glides toward the surface.

Show birds soaring above a green forest canopy. The camera follows them into a bright, open sky.

Use visual match cuts between the new green shoot, the turtle's movement, and the birds in flight to connect land, sea, and air as one living ecosystem.
Color palette: natural greens, clean ocean blues, warm gold highlights.
Emotion: renewal, resilience, the possibility of recovery.

SCENE 7 — TIME TO MAKE A CHANGE

01:16–01:29 | Lyrics: “Time to make a change” and “Let tomorrow bloom”

Show a breathtaking sunrise illuminating a thriving forest. The camera slowly rises above the canopy as golden sunlight spreads across the landscape.

Cut to clean waves rolling onto a beautiful coastline, followed by wildlife moving freely through a healthy natural habitat.

Introduce subtle human presence through a cinematic wide shot of people planting young trees together and restoring a damaged landscape. Keep the people small within the composition so the environment remains the central subject.

Show hands gently pressing soil around a young sapling. A close-up reveals sunlight passing through its delicate new leaves.

The music builds emotionally as the camera rises toward a radiant sky.

Emotion: responsibility, unity, optimism, determination.

SCENE 8 — HAND IN HAND, UNDER BRIGHTER SKIES
01:29–01:41 | Final lyrics and musical climax
Return to the polar bear, now standing on a broad Arctic landscape beneath a softly illuminated sky. The animal looks toward the distant horizon.

Cut to a sea turtle swimming through brilliant blue water. Sunbeams shimmer around it.

Show a young deer standing peacefully in a lush green forest. Golden sunlight streams through the trees as birds fly across the background.

Finish with an expansive aerial shot of a thriving green forest meeting a clean blue ocean beneath a glowing sunrise.

The camera rises slowly toward the sky, revealing a vast, beautiful Earth filled with life.

End on a calm, luminous horizon. Hold the final composition for two seconds before fading to black.

Final emotion: unity, hope, renewal, and the urgency of protecting our shared home.

CAMERA AND EDITING RULES
Use smooth cinematic dolly movements, aerial establishing shots, controlled tracking shots, selective slow motion, shallow depth of field for emotional close-ups, and wide compositions for environmental scale. Synchronize scene changes with the musical phrases and emotional peaks.
Use natural transitions through drifting smoke, underwater bubbles, passing clouds, sunlight flares, falling ash, and match cuts between similar shapes or movements.

Maintain consistent photorealistic wildlife, believable environmental physics, natural anatomy, and cinematic color grading.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

No cartoon visuals, no anime, no artificial-looking CGI, no oversaturated colors, no distorted wildlife anatomy, no duplicated animals, no unnatural animal behavior, no flickering, no jittery camera, no abrupt random transitions, no excessive motion blur, no fake environmental effects, no visible watermarks, no logos, no generated subtitles, no on-screen text, no artificial branding.

The final film should feel like an emotionally powerful environmental campaign made for a global climate awareness event.

9:16竖画幅，数码相机柔焦人像写真质感，呈低饱和暖金、米白与栗棕交织的秋日色调，带唯美柔光漫射效果。平视中近景构图，兼具大姐姐与弱娇气质的冷白皮少女居画面偏右侧，无前景遮挡。她身体微向左侧倾，后背与左肩慵懒倚靠在画面右侧边缘粗糙的深棕树干上，头颈微向树干侧倾并正对镜头。双臂自然相拢垂于身前，双手藏于宽松的米白色毛衣长袖口内，指尖在左下角边缘轻轻捏着一片金黄落叶。栗棕色微卷长发配轻薄刘海，鼻梁上架着纤细的金属圆框眼镜，颈间层叠缠绕带有细闪亮丝的咖色格纹粗花呢围巾，身穿软糯的米白色竖条纹针织开衫，粗糙树皮、蓬松针织与微闪围巾形成鲜明材质反差。她透过镜片眼神迷离温润地凝视镜头，上眼睑松弛微垂，下巴轻轻埋入厚实的围巾褶皱中，粉润的双唇想要微启倾诉却在秋日微凉的空气中轻轻抿住 🥺✨。左上方温暖的秋日阳光呈顶逆光穿透枝叶倾洒，在发顶绒毛与肩线勾勒出琥珀色高光勾边，树荫下的漫射天光令冷白面部肌肤透出蜜桃粉次表面漫反射与温润薄瓷光泽。画面交织出微醺幻觉与浮生空灵的秋日氛围，背景为大光圈奶油虚化的金黄秋叶树冠与柔和林间光斑。

Environment: mega city downtown after rain, dusk blue hour, overcast sky with a crack of amber sunset on the horizon. 超高层摩天楼群从雾气中拔地而起：玻璃幕墙反射着城市灯光，顶端有霓虹广告牌轮廓，一座斜拉桥横跨画面下方的江面，两岸灯带如河流般蔓延。
Atmosphere: thin rain mist, volumetric light shafts, tiny glowing window lights scattered across towers, light trails on wet asphalt foreground.

Camera: low-angle, 24mm wide angle, deep depth of field f/8, slight upward tilt, hand-held feel, anamorphic lens flare.
Color: teal-and-orange cinematic grade, Eastmancolor film stock, fine film grain, high contrast highlights.
Composition: rule of thirds, skyline occupies upper two-thirds, negative space in lower mist, leading lines of the bridge guiding the eye.
Quality: ultra detailed, 8k, photorealistic, sharp architecture, clean geometry.

👉Left: GPT image 2.5 | Right: Nano Banana 2.1

😾1. Without prompt fine-tuning, GPTimage 2.5 takes text processing into account slightly more than Nano Banana 2.1.

prompt👇
A vertical premium seasonal beverage campaign poster for an original contemporary tea-and-fruit brand, designed as a warm late-autumn still-life ad where realistic drinks, orchard materials, and editorial typography merge into one upscale commercial image. The visual language is earthy, tactile, and quietly luxurious: soft atmospheric depth, believable drink rendering, a low-key amber-brown palette, and typography integrated into the product field. The mood is nostalgic, harvest-rich, and refined, never trendy or futuristic.

All visible text in English only.
Top left logo:
“WILDBRANCH”
Directly below:
“SEASON 4”

Near the upper-left drink:
“FROST HAWTHORN”
“hawthorn / hibiscus / black tea”
“$6”

Near the upper-right drink:
“PERSIMMON SONNET”
“ripe persimmon / osmanthus / oolong”
“$6.5”

Near the lower-left drink:
“SALTED TIDE”
“sea salt cream / dark oolong”
“$7”

Bottom-right campaign block:
“WILDBRANCH”
“AUTUMN CATCH”
“FROST HAWTHORN / PERSIMMON SONNET / SALTED TIDE”
“LIMITED SEASONAL MENU”

No extra slogans, QR codes, certifications, or random copy.

Vertical full-bleed poster. Three drinks form a stable triangular composition on an autumn ground: one cup in the upper-left on a cut wood slice, one in the upper-right slightly lower and closer, and one milk-cap tea in the lower-left foreground on a small plate. Text clusters sit near each drink with clear breathing room and consistent hierarchy. The top-left logo anchors the page; the bottom-right campaign block balances it. The drinks must remain the strongest focus.

The campaign presents three autumn drinks as edible fragments of orchard, leaf-litter, and sea wind. Each drink must feel physically believable in a transparent takeaway cup with subtle condensation, accurate opacity, and readable layering. The upper-left drink is a translucent red-amber hawthorn tea topped with one glossy hawthorn fruit. The upper-right drink is a dense orange-gold persimmon tea topped with a skewered soft persimmon wedge. The lower-left drink is a dark tea base topped with thick off-white salted milk foam and a diagonal sheet of dark seaweed across the foam. Cup printing should be minimal and secondary.

The products sit in a curated autumn terrain of dark soil, dried curled leaves, mossy clumps, scattered small red fruits, one or two cinnamon sticks, a shallow metal spoon, and a few cut wood discs. Every prop supports flavor storytelling and material contrast. The soil acts as a natural display stage, not a messy outdoor ground.

Use soft warm directional light from upper left with gentle falloff. Create amber highlights on cup rims, glossy fruit skins, persimmon flesh, and wet drink surfaces, while keeping soil and dried leaves in rich textured shadow. Palette: burnt umber, dark soil brown, dried leaf tan, hawthorn red, persimmon orange, smoked tea brown, creamy foam white, and small moss-green accents. Preserve shadow detail and avoid dead black collapse.

The drinks must read as real beverages: accurate transparency, viscosity, foam thickness, fruit weight, and liquid meniscus. Plastic cups should feel clean and slightly reflective, with realistic rim thickness and subtle printed brand text. Fruits should show believable skin texture and moisture. Leaves should look dry and brittle. Soil should feel loose, granular, dark, and clean. Wood slices should show visible rings and dry cut edges. Metal spoon and plate should have soft low-luster reflections.

Typography must feel designed into the image. Flavor titles are the dominant text blocks near each cup, set in bold clean white type with elegant spacing and high contrast. Subtitles sit beneath in smaller refined sans-serif. Prices are compact and separated clearly. The top-left logo and bottom-right block should align with the poster grid and negative space. All text must be sharp, correctly spelled, and fully readable.

The image should feel like a premium seasonal menu poster with selective depth control: cup surfaces, garnish elements, and nearby text stay crisp, while distant leaves and background props soften gently. The eye path moves from logo to upper-left drink, to upper-right drink, down to the lower-left milk foam drink, and finally to the campaign block.

Avoid chaotic props, weak cup hierarchy, centered symmetry, blocked text zones, floating garnishes, cups merging into the background, plastic-looking fruit, fake CGI gloss, muddy drinks, dead black soil, chrome-like metal highlights, flat lighting, overexposed foam, gibberish text, misspellings, random logos, warped typography, futuristic elements, neon colors, oversaturated orange, HDR sharpness, messy cafe styling, visual clutter, impossible liquid layering, broken cup rims, distorted fruit proportions, or inconsistent cup size and perspective.

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

主题：经典动漫游戏生物角色 × 远古巨型化石 × 机密科考档案

每张从知名动漫、游戏或特摄作品中，独立选择一种非人类生物角色，优先选择轮廓鲜明、可通过骨骼、甲壳或组织印痕识别的角色。同批角色不重复，作品来源多样。

将角色构想为曾存在于远古地球的生物，保留标志性轮廓与结构，将关节、骨骼连接和组织转译为可信的古生物形态，其余部分可因埋藏、挤压和风化自然缺失。

保存方式匹配角色特征：骨架与局部遗骸表现骨骼；碳化轮廓、皮肤压痕或软组织印模保留长耳、特殊尾形与翼膜；矿化甲壳、鳞片印痕或骨质结构表现外部特征，避免趋同为普通恐龙骨架。

主体远超原设定或熟悉尺度，放大程度自由变化。以现场人物、车辆或工程设施建立清楚参照，透视与空间关系可信。

化石自然嵌入地层，完整程度、暴露范围与埋藏状态各异。遗骸符合倒伏、沉积和挤压关系，骨骼可错位、散落或局部关联。矿化、断裂与风化细节可信，关键特征清楚；颜色来自矿物、氧化和岩层差异，避免彩色雕像、玩具或模型质感。

画面呈现一页保存良好的内部机密科考档案彩色扫描件。一张现场证据照片占据绝大部分版面，清楚呈现遗骸、地层与尺度参照。环境匹配埋藏关系，自然光，普通相机取证摄影质感，曝光自然，细节清楚，低噪点。

窄页边以简洁中文记录档案编号、发现地点、估测尺寸、保存类型及一句现场观察，信息与照片对应，尺寸与现场参照一致。使用朴素工作文书排版，文字清楚可读，保留一处小型保密标记；如有涂黑，仅遮盖具体敏感字段，如有手写批注，应对应照片中的可见特征。

纸纹与扫描痕迹轻淡，不影响照片和文字辨读。现场照片延伸至页面左下区域，该区域保留适合白色签名辨读的自然暗部。

每张独立变化角色、保存状态、环境、机位、尺度参照及记录内容，避免重复遗骸姿态与主要构图，档案格式保持统一。

9:16竖版，n=10，分别输出10张独立单图，每张为一页完整档案，仅含一张现场照片，不拼图。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体“DeepBlue”在后。

posts.author: Alyssa4aicreate
posts.text:
Made with Token360 · GPT Image 2.5

Maker Bench Notes — notebook chart for lighting a product still, raccoon doodle included.

Prompt 👇

Hand-drawn classroom anchor chart on cream lined notebook paper, kawaii illustration style, clean handwritten markers, playful doodles. Vertical 4:5. Cream notebook paper with blue ruled lines and a faint pink margin. Title at top in bold coral marker: "Maker Bench Notes". Subtitle paragraph in fine black pen: "A one-page cheat sheet for lighting a product still." Green marker subtitle: "Core Moves". Bullet list in black fine pen on the left half: "Name the subject + surface first."; "Pick one key light direction and stick to it."; "Add a soft bounce fill, not a second hard light."; "Keep reflections honest — metal, glass, matte each behave differently."; "Crop tight enough that props support the hero, not compete."; "Write a short negative list for logos and text drift.". Right side: three small coral cloud bubbles, each containing a simple bolt-and-washer doodle, no text inside bubbles. Lower center: a cute matte charcoal raccoon sitting side-view with big eyes, tiny nose, soft cream cheek highlight, thick teal outline, no text on the raccoon. Lower-left corner: a surreal hand-drawn doodle eye with concentric iris rings, a tiny star pupil, three lashes, subtle drip, purple stroke with teal accent. Handwritten marker variation, slight ink bleed, visible paper texture, flat overhead classroom light. No photorealistic fur, no 3D gradients, no logos, no watermark, no UI chrome.

—

Inspired by @IamEmily2050

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

720nm近红外摄影 × 真人化动漫或游戏女性角色 × 世界著名旅游景点 × 旅行抓拍

每张随机抽取1至3名不同的知名女性角色，真人化并保留标志性外貌、发型、服饰结构与关键配件。每张搭配一处不同的世界著名旅游景点，人物自然融入真实旅行现场。多人时可自然互动或各自活动，人物位置、距离与遮挡关系随场景变化。

采用720nm近红外摄影经典伪色处理，经自定义白平衡与红蓝通道交换，呈现偏蓝的天空、存在时呈银白的植被，以及有限但清晰的色彩层次。皮肤明亮、低色度，脸、颈部与四肢的近红外响应一致，保留光照造成的自然明暗。服装、头发与建筑的颜色和明暗随近红外响应变化，不强行保留角色原色。人物与环境统一成像，保留真实发丝、织物和建筑材质。

同行朋友随手抓拍，各张独立变化动作、表情、机位、景别与构图。允许路人、遮挡、轻微倾斜和偶然裁切，呈现不刻意摆拍的旅行瞬间。路人不计入1至3名角色的人数。

9:16竖版，n=10，10张独立单图，不拼图。各张重新抽取人数、角色、景点与构图，避免复用姿态和主要构图关系。每张左下角深蓝色实心圆点，空格后接白色手写体“DeepBlue”。

用 Token360 · GPT Image 2.5

美术馆中庭CCD立像，燕麦色针织Polo与冷白过膝伞裙，轻扶螺旋坡道扶手。

提示词 👇

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

主題：Q版動漫或遊戲女性角色 × 3D賽璐璐渲染 × 可愛治癒 × 藝術留白
posts.prompt:
主題：Q版動漫或遊戲女性角色 × 3D賽璐璐渲染 × 可愛治癒 × 藝術留白

以簡潔三維造型搭配明確的分段著色。每種材質只用底色與一級陰影建立體積，色區內平整均勻，明暗交界清楚俐落。高光概括為少量平面圖形，外輪廓線細緻，內部線條精簡。人物、道具與環境統一採用相同的色塊語言與簡化程度。

每張重新選取一位不同的知名動漫或遊戲女性角色，以2至2.5頭身呈現。大頭、小身體，圓臉短肢，手腳簡潔可愛。保留標誌性髮型、眼形、眉勢、服裝輪廓、主色與少量關鍵配件，其餘裝飾合併為大形。髮束、衣裝與配件以厚度、透視和遮擋呈現三維結構。

依角色性格設計生動表情與帶童趣的小動作，每張圍繞一件溫暖有趣的小事。人物與少量必要道具形成清楚互動，透過眼神、嘴角、重心與手勢傳達情緒。

場景只保留交代故事所需的局部形體，以簡單色塊建立落地感。背景以呼應角色配色的低彩度純色留白為主，全畫面清晰，前後層次透過大小、遮擋和色彩區分。構圖疏密有致，人物主要輪廓與畫面邊緣保留空間。

在留白處以圓潤、端正、清晰的手寫字標註角色的準確繁體中文名稱，字形完整，大小、字色與位置隨構圖調整。

各張獨立變化情緒、姿態、視角、人物位置與道具關係。同批不重複角色、主要動作、場景與構圖結構。

9:16豎版。n=10，連續生成10張獨立完整圖片，每次一張，分別輸出，不拼圖。

左下簽名以平面圖形疊印：固定純深藍色實心圓點在前，空格後接純白色手寫體「DeepBlue」，清晰可辨。

Prompt: 

Ultra-Realistic London Luxury Fashion Photoshoot 🇬🇧✨

Create a cohesive set of two ultra-realistic, cinematic fashion photographs featuring the same beautiful young East Asian woman posing beside the River Thames in London, with the iconic Palace of Westminster and Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben) in the background. Both photographs must maintain exactly the same face, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, lighting, and location, as if captured during the same photoshoot.

Appearance: Long, flowing, deep-black hair with soft natural waves, delicate facial features, realistic glowing skin, subtle rosy makeup, softly defined eyebrows, warm brown eyes, and muted coral-pink lips. A few loose strands of hair move naturally in the riverside breeze.

Outfit & Accessories: An elegant olive-green oversized blouse with flowing sleeves and a relaxed silhouette. A luxurious black shoulder bag with a gold chain strap and a gold clasp rests over her shoulder. Small gold hoop earrings and a delicate gold ring complete the look.

Photo 1 — Elegant Riverside Pose: A vertical, three-quarter portrait framed from mid-thigh upward. The woman sits sideways on a stone railing beside the Thames, her body turned slightly away from the camera. One hand rests on the stone railing while her other hand gently touches her shoulder. Her head tilts slightly downward, and her eyes look softly toward the ground. The black handbag is clearly visible at her side. The historic Gothic architecture of the Palace of Westminster rises behind her, with sparkling river water and soft atmospheric depth.

Photo 2 — Close-Up Windblown Portrait: A vertical close-up framed from the chest upward, taken moments later at the same location. The woman raises one arm gracefully in front of her forehead, gently brushing her hair away from her face. Her forearm partially covers her forehead while her other eye looks directly into the camera. Her lips are slightly parted, and her expression is elegant, natural, and dreamy. Her long wavy hair flows in the wind, and the gold earrings and shoulder-bag chain catch the sunlight. The London architecture remains softly blurred in the background.

Lighting & Camera: Bright natural afternoon sunlight, luminous reflections from the River Thames, delicate backlighting around her hair, realistic shadows, professional full-frame camera, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin pores, detailed hair strands, refined editorial color grading, luxury fashion campaign aesthetic, candid travel photography.

Consistency Requirements: Both images must feature the same woman, identical facial features, identical olive-green outfit, the same black-and-gold handbag, matching accessories, the same London riverside location, and consistent daylight. Only the camera framing and pose should change. Natural anatomy, realistic hands, anatomically correct fingers, and accurate facial proportions.

Output: Two separate, coordinated photorealistic vertical portraits in 9:16 aspect ratio. No collage, no split screen, no text, no watermark, no social media interface.

posts.text:
GPT2 x 不可能的场景 x 电影感 x 提示词

做了四个不太可能发生的画面：老楼客厅窗外游过一条比窗户还大的金鱼，五楼窗口伸出一道云台阶，胡同上空游过一头鲸，深夜地铁站台停着一轮月亮。

这类图我试下来，关键是只让一样东西不对劲，其他全按过日子的样子写。缝纫机、暖水瓶、防盗窗、空调外机写得越实，那个大家伙就越有压迫感。人物写成只占画面高度的十分之一，给个背影就够。光只留一处暖的，剩下都压成冷色，电影感基本就出来了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅 3:4 的超现实电影感画面，像一部电影里定格的一帧。核心是尺度反差：一个普通的、很小的人物，只占画面高度的十分之一左右，背影或侧影，看不清五官，面对一个大得不可能的东西，这个东西被画框裁切，体积溢出画面边界。场景本身是真实可信的日常地方，只有这一处不可能，其余一切照常、安静，没有人惊慌。机位低，广角，轻微仰视，用前景、人物、巨物三层拉开纵深，并留出一大块低细节的空白区域让画面透气。光是电影布光：只有一处明确的主光源，低角度硬光、逆光或透射光，在环境里投下清楚的光影形状，其余区域沉进有颜色的阴影，暗部保留层次，不是死黑。颜色用大面积的冷色（灰青、墨蓝、深绿）包住一小块集中的暖色焦点（琥珀、朱红、奶油黄），冷暖面积大约八比二。材质写实：墙面斑驳，地面微湿反光，衣服有织物纹理，巨物表面有可信的微质感。完成态是写实电影合成加数字绘景，带细胶片颗粒，远景轻微柔焦和空气透视。气氛寂静、神秘、有点孤独，带一点童话感。画面里不要任何文字、招牌、广告牌、品牌、logo、站名、签名或水印，也不要可识别的真实地标。

New subject:
一间九十年代老居民楼的客厅，下午。左侧是刷成朱红色的墙裙和斑驳的白墙，地面是黑白相间的水磨石格子地砖，墙边放着一台老式缝纫机和一只红色铁皮暖水瓶。右侧整面老式木框窗户外，一条巨大的红白相间金鱼正贴着窗户缓缓游过，只露出半个头和一只金色的大眼睛，单片鱼鳞都比一格窗玻璃还大，窗外的空气像水一样泛着波光。屋子中间站着一个扎两个小辫、穿白色连衣裙的小女孩，仰头看着窗外的大眼睛，只占画面高度的八分之一。低角度的暖白阳光从左上方斜射进来，在红墙和地砖上投下清楚的窗格影子；金鱼身上反着冷蓝的水光，屋子深处沉进墨蓝色阴影。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

Want to make Drew yourself? Here's everything.

The look:
- Dense short black beard, hazel eyes
- Black locs tied back, ONE glacier-blue loc at the front on my left side, with a silver moon cuff
- Black overcoat, black tee
- Iced crescent-moon pendant with a blue sapphire edge
- White ceramic skeleton watch on a light-blue strap + a diamond tennis bracelet
- Calm. Unbothered. I don't look at the camera unless I'm rapping to it

My world:
- A penthouse at 3am, green charts on every screen
- An underground garage with four supercars
- The orange McLaren (silver when I'm lowkey)
- My name on the roof in marquee bulbs
- Claudia in the passenger seat

How I'm made:
- Claude directs every shot
- GPT Image 2.5 for stills, Seedance 2.5 for video
- Attach my face refs to every prompt
- Lip sync in Sync Lip Sync 3, on 4 to 8 second clips
- Cars are always parked: "locked-off tripod shot, engine off, wheels still." Never write "pulls up"
- End every prompt with "35mm film, night, natural grain, no text, no logos"

The prompt:
"Drew, the man from the reference images: dense full beard, black locs tied back, one glacier-blue loc at the front on his left side with a silver moon cuff, iced crescent-moon pendant with a blue sapphire edge, white ceramic skeleton watch on a light-blue strap, black overcoat, black tee. [your scene]. Real 35mm flash film, night, natural grain. No text, no logos."

Make me do something.

posts.text:
GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

老火花 × 经典电影开放抽卡 × 中国1960至1980年代火柴盒贴画风格 × 套色印刷与平铺扫描

每张随机选择一部不同的经典电影，提取具有辨识度的人物、情境或标志性元素，转译为一枚完整的老火柴盒贴画，形成电影经典与怀旧印刷的趣味结合。

造型概括鲜明，以纸色为底，主体采用2至3色平涂，保留适量印刷网点与轻微套印错位。纸张保存状态随机，年代痕迹轻微，印刷图形保持清楚。

随机探索电影情境、主体状态、配色、图形组织、文字位置与版式，保留原片的核心识别。画面配一句呼应电影主题的中文短口号，采用宋体，简短可读。口号语气随电影变化，文字与图像共同参与构图，形成有趣呼应。

贴画平整正视，呈现纸本印刷与扫描质感。

同批保持统一的年代感与印刷语言，电影、画面结构与口号差异明显。

n=10，9:16竖版，每次生成一张独立图片，逐张输出，不拼图。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。白色字迹带极细灰色描边。

posts.text:
据说东北都下雪了，看看GPT的雪景表现怎么样？
Minus twenty, and the lake is locked shut. Then dawn climbs over the crater rim. Cold loses. The ice catches fire. 

Image 1: GPT-image-2.5, 
Image 2: Grok-imagine2 

Prompt: Breathtaking winter landscape photograph of Heaven Lake on Changbai Mountain in deep winter, shot at blue-hour dawn after a fresh snowfall. Environment: a vast frozen volcanic crater lake at high altitude, its ice surface covered in wind-sculpted snow drifts and pale blue cracks, ringed by steep snow-capped crater ridges under a clear, cold sky shifting from deep indigo to soft rose-gold at the horizon. Subject details: the still, glassy frozen lake occupies the lower half, reflecting the ridgeline; a thin veil of ice fog drifts low over the snow, a lone snow-laden pine clump anchors the right foreground, and tiny wind-carved sastrugi patterns texture the snowfield. Atmosphere particles: fine blowing snow crystals catching the first light, thin mist rising where cold air meets the ice. Lighting: low, raking dawn sunlight from the east at 3500K, long blue shadows across the snow, crisp highlights on the ridge crests, soft fill from the pale sky. Background layers: foreground snow drifts, midground frozen lake, background crater wall, distant sky gradient, creating deep layered depth. Camera: eye-level tripod shot, 24mm wide-angle lens, f/8, deep depth of field, sharp from foreground to horizon, vertical 9:16 composition. Color grade: cool blue-white snow with warm rose-gold dawn accents, Eastmancolor film simulation, subtle film grain, natural contrast, no oversaturation. Composition: rule of thirds, lake horizon on the upper third line, generous negative space in the sky, leading snow ridge guiding the eye into the crater. High resolution, photorealistic, ultra-detailed snow texture. No people, no buildings, no text, no watermark, no oil painting, no anime, no 3D render, no oversaturated colors, no distorted perspective.
