posts.author: veynmotion
posts.text:
Salt, stone, sea — and a flash of crimson against the silence.

created by GPT-image2.5

Prompt:
Create ONE sophisticated 6-photo analog fashion editorial titled:

“SICILIAN SIREN”

A single continuous photography session featuring the EXACT SAME young Mediterranean woman on a remote volcanic coastline in southern Italy.

This is NOT vacation photography.
This is NOT Pinterest lifestyle photography.
This is NOT a soft romantic white-dress photoshoot.

It must feel like a high-end 1990s European fashion editorial photographed on real medium-format film.

VISUAL CONCEPT:

A solitary woman spending a brutally hot summer afternoon on a remote Sicilian volcanic coast.

She feels almost elemental — connected to the sea, black volcanic stone, salt, wind and heat.

The woman should feel as though she belongs to the landscape rather than simply posing in front of it.

The visual tension comes from:

soft human skin
against hard volcanic rock,

deep red fabric
against cobalt-blue water,

wet dark hair
against sunlit skin,

small human figure
against monumental Mediterranean landscape.

--------------------------------------------------

SUBJECT

The exact same woman in every photograph.

Young adult Mediterranean / Southern European woman, mid-20s.

Long dark brown naturally wavy hair.

Warm sun-browned skin.

Natural strong facial structure.

Subtle freckles.

Minimal makeup.

Natural eyebrows.

Slim but realistic figure.

She is beautiful but not polished like a commercial model.

Quiet.
Self-contained.
Sensual without deliberately posing sexually.
Slightly mysterious.

Her identity must remain completely consistent across all six frames.

--------------------------------------------------

WARDROBE

ONE continuous wardrobe concept.

A deep muted oxblood-red / dark crimson lightweight summer dress.

Thin straps.

Simple silhouette.

Soft fabric that reacts dramatically to wind and water.

The dress can become wet in several photographs.

Bare feet.

No jewelry except perhaps one extremely subtle thin ring.

No sunglasses.
No hat.
No bag.

The dark red fabric is the main chromatic anchor of the entire series.

--------------------------------------------------

LOCATION

One remote Sicilian volcanic coastline.

Black and charcoal-gray volcanic rocks.

Large fractured lava formations.

Deep cobalt Mediterranean water.

Sparse sun-dried vegetation.

Pale hazy summer sky.

Occasional white sea foam.

No towns.

No colorful buildings.

No tourist scenery.

No beach umbrellas.

No luxury-resort aesthetic.

The coastline should feel raw, ancient and almost empty.

--------------------------------------------------

COLOR DESIGN

Extremely strong color separation.

The photographs must NOT be covered by one uniform vintage tint.

Use four clearly separated dominant color families:

BLACK / CHARCOAL:
volcanic rock

COBALT / SLATE BLUE:
Mediterranean sea

DARK OXBLOOD RED:
the woman's dress

WARM PEACH / BRONZE:
natural sun-warmed skin

Secondary color:
pale stone-gray / warm off-white sky.

Keep saturation restrained but maintain clear color identity.

The red fabric must remain distinctly red.

The sea must remain distinctly deep blue.

The volcanic rock must remain neutral charcoal rather than brown.

Skin must stay warm and alive.

Do not turn everything beige, olive or orange.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE

High-end 1990s European fashion editorial.

Vogue Italia summer issue atmosphere.

Shot on a Mamiya RZ67 or Pentax 67 medium-format film camera.

Kodak Portra 160 negative film.

Real medium-format film rendering.

Large negative detail but soft optical texture.

Natural film grain.

Subtle highlight bloom.

Deep but not crushed shadows.

Occasional slightly imperfect focus.

Natural exposure variation.

Soft scanner texture.

No digital HDR.

No hyper-sharp modern mirrorless look.

No Lightroom preset appearance.

No fake film scratches.

No exaggerated vintage overlay.

Skin retains pores, salt, moisture and natural tonal variation.

--------------------------------------------------

LIGHT

One continuous late-afternoon Mediterranean lighting condition.

Strong directional natural sunlight softened slightly by maritime haze.

The light should create sculptural contrast between skin and rock.

Bright sunlight on shoulders and cheekbones.

Deep shadows inside rock formations.

Reflections from the sea illuminate parts of the skin.

Some highlights can slightly overexpose naturally.

No artificial lighting.

No obvious golden-hour orange cast.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 1 — MONUMENTAL LANDSCAPE

Wide environmental photograph.

The woman stands small between enormous black volcanic rock formations.

Deep cobalt sea beyond her.

Her dark red dress moves violently in the wind.

She does not look toward the camera.

The landscape occupies most of the photograph.

The woman is a small but visually powerful red element inside the vast environment.

Strong negative space.

Editorial, monumental, cinematic composition.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 2 — IN THE SEA

Medium environmental photograph.

The same woman stands waist-deep in dark cobalt Mediterranean water beside black volcanic rocks.

The lower half of her red dress is soaked and noticeably darker.

Wet dark hair sticks naturally to her neck and shoulders.

A small wave strikes the nearby rock.

She steadies herself with one hand against the stone.

No posing.

The photograph captures a real physical interaction between body, water and rock.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 3 — RED ON BLACK

High-angle editorial photograph.

She lies directly across a broad charcoal volcanic rock.

Her body creates a soft curved shape against the angular rock surface.

The red fabric spreads irregularly across the black stone.

One bare leg extends naturally.

Her dark hair spreads slightly across the rock.

The composition emphasizes color, shape and texture.

Almost graphic in its simplicity.

Black stone.
Red fabric.
Warm skin.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 4 — SALT PORTRAIT

Tight intimate portrait.

Wet hair blows across part of her face.

Her skin shows natural sunlight, saltwater and subtle moisture.

The background is almost entirely soft out-of-focus deep blue sea.

She looks away from the camera.

Crop the composition imperfectly:
part of the hair, shoulder or forehead may leave the frame.

Natural expression.

No beauty pose.

The image should feel physically close and slightly accidental.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 5 — ASCENT

Low-angle environmental fashion photograph.

She climbs slowly between large volcanic rock formations.

The camera is positioned low behind or beside a dark foreground rock.

Her red dress moves through the black landscape.

Only parts of her body are visible between rocks.

The terrain actively shapes the composition.

The rocks should feel huge.

The woman should not dominate the frame.

Strong sculptural geometry.

--------------------------------------------------

PHOTO 6 — THE RED DOT

Extremely wide final environmental photograph.

A huge expanse of deep blue Mediterranean sea.

Black volcanic coastline occupies part of the foreground.

The woman sits alone on a distant rock close to the water.

She is very small in the photograph.

Her red dress appears only as a tiny deep-red accent against the black rock and blue sea.

The photograph should feel quiet, graphic and monumental.

Large negative space.

No dramatic sunset.

--------------------------------------------------

COLLAGE

Present all six photographs as ONE sophisticated seamless fashion-editorial collage.

No borders.
No white gutters.
No cream spacing.
No contact-sheet frame.
No blank canvas.

All photographs touch edge-to-edge.

Use an asymmetric magazine layout.

Mix:
one dominant environmental vertical image,
two wide landscapes,
one intimate portrait,
one high-angle body composition,
one extreme wide shot.

Do NOT make all six photographs the same size.

Do NOT make a simple symmetrical 2×3 grid.

The layout itself should feel like a fashion magazine spread.

Photography fills the entire vertical 3:4 canvas.

No text.
No title visible.
No logo.
No typography.

--------------------------------------------------

FINAL FEELING

The final image should feel like a forgotten 1990s Italian fashion editorial photographed on medium-format film.

Raw Mediterranean summer.

Black volcanic stone.

Deep blue sea.

Dark red fabric.

Salt.

Wind.

Heat.

Skin.

Large landscapes and intimate human details.

Beautiful, but never pretty.

Sensual, but never glamorous.

Editorial, sculptural and photographic.

Prioritize powerful composition and color relationships over conventional attractiveness.

万圣夜，雨没停。
由 gpt-image-2.5 模型生成。
提示词：
单帧写实 3D 动画电影 CG 静帧，虚幻引擎 5 级物理材质、光线追踪全局光照、次表面散射皮肤，不是 2D、没有线稿、不要分镜和边框。
整体调子严格照风格样图那套滤镜（低饱和暖灰、暗部抬亮、奶油高光、35mm 细颗粒），不要橙色调、不要青橙对比、不要彩色泛光——滤镜本身不变。滤镜之下，这一场的光是冷的：深夜、冷雨、阴冷潮湿；阴影和小店的背光面压成淡淡的青灰，湿地面反射出冷白光，人物皮肤上也有薄薄一层冷调。
场景：万圣夜深夜，安静的居民区街角，一家小便利店门外。台阶上堆着一群大大小小的南瓜灯，有的亮着蜡烛、有的熄了，被雨淋得亮闪闪的；玻璃门上贴着黑色蝙蝠纸贴，上方拉着一串褪了色的三角纸彩旗；门框一侧挂着灰白的假蜘蛛网和一只小小的塑料骷髅。街那头一群盛装打扮的人打着伞一起走远，虚焦，只剩被雨雾晕开的浅灰剪影。
**这一地的糖要看得清清楚楚，它是画面的焦点之一**：她脚边的湿台阶和水洼里散着二三十颗裹着彩色玻璃纸的糖——金的、紫的、粉的、薄荷绿，糖纸在冷光里反着一点亮，被雨水泡得半透明、贴在石面上。有几颗正好在她伸出手的前方：一颗金色的水果糖躺在浅水洼里，水面映着它；一颗紫色糖纸的糖卡在台阶缝里；一颗剥开一半的糖露着里面的软糖。她指尖正捏住离得最近的那一颗，糖已经被捏起来一点，离开地面。
她的长相按女主角设定图：齐刘海黑色短波波头被雨打湿贴在脸颊，黑色罗纹针织裙、黑丝、旧黑靴、厚围巾，头顶戴着廉价塑料小红恶魔角发箍。他按男主角设定图：湿透的橄榄灰 T 恤、黑色毛线帽、黑工装裤、右前臂纹身，肩上搭着湿透的深灰外套。
她蹲在湿台阶上，膝盖并拢，怀里抱着袋角磨破的纸袋、袋里露出一把糖；另一只手伸向地面，指尖刚碰到一颗糖。头抬起来望着他，眼眶红、眼里含着泪，一滴正顺着脸颊滑下来，眉间轻皱，抿着嘴——委屈又倔强。他站在她半步外，身体微微前倾，一只手插在外套口袋里，另一只手伸到一半停在她上方，像没了胆子。

posts.text:
1. Four references, one prompt, three models

Two women, a car and a gas station. I made the four references in FLUX 3 Image so none of the three models started with an advantage.

Then I ran the same references and the same prompt on Seedream 5.5, GPT Image 2.5 (Flare, High) and Nano Banana 2.1, 2 times each at 2K, and chose the better result:

→ Seedream 5.5 kept the station closest to the reference and gave the widest frame
→ GPT Image 2.5 came in closer, with warmer, more orange light
→ Nano Banana 2.1 turned the car the other way and kept the light soft

Prompt:
Figure 1 is the first woman. Figure 2 is the second woman. Figure 3 is the car. Figure 4 is the location.

Generate one photorealistic film still, 16:9. It is the morning after a long night out. The two women from Figure 1 and Figure 2 sit side by side on the bonnet of the car from Figure 3, which is parked on the forecourt beside the fuel pumps of the desert filling station from Figure 4. They are eating burgers at sunrise.

On the left: the woman from Figure 1, the same person, with her black hair in a loose low bun and her emerald green silk slip gown. She is barefoot, holds a burger in both hands and is taking a bite, looking out at the empty road.

On the right: the woman from Figure 2, the same person, with her short copper-red bob, freckles and long-sleeved gold sequin gown. She is barefoot, laughing with her head tipped back, a paper cup with a straw in her left hand and a wrapped burger on her lap.

On the ground by the front wheel: two pairs of high heels kicked off, and one worn canvas duffel bag.

Keep both faces, hair and skin tones exactly as in Figure 1 and Figure 2. Keep the car's shape, cream paint, chrome trim and whitewall tyres exactly as in Figure 3, with no badges, no logos and a blank number plate. Keep the canopy, the two pumps, the white building and the desert horizon of Figure 4. No readable text anywhere.

Light: the sun is just above the horizon behind them, strong warm backlight, a rim of light on their hair and shoulders, soft cool fill from the open sky on their faces so both faces stay readable, long shadows falling toward the camera, light dust haze.

Camera and texture: wide shot from standing height a few metres in front of the car, the whole car and both women in frame, 35mm lens feel, the desert in soft focus behind, fine film grain, natural skin texture, real fabric detail in the silk and the sequins.

posts.text:
GPT2 x 幕布上的影子 x 暖光皮影 x 提示词

睡前发一组安静的。前面是透着暖黄光的皮影子，后面白幕上还有一个更大的影子。皮革是半透明的，花纹是镂空的，铆钉能看见。

四张换的是演什么：一只兔子、一条鲤鱼、一个骑马的人、一棵松。不要去套现成角色，皮的质感和幕布上的影子都不变。

提示词里要写「皮革被后面的光照透，关节有小铆钉」。不写的话它容易画成普通的金黄插画，幕布上的影子也会没。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 9:16 的皮影戏静帧：前景是一件用半透明彩绘皮革制成的精密皮影偶，关节处有小小的金属铆钉，四肢或部件由细杆支撑，皮子被背后的暖黄光照透，能看见厚度、镂空花纹和淡淡的皮质纹理。偶的轮廓是侧影或四分之三侧，姿态清楚，细节靠镂空和描绘完成，不要画成普通插画人物，不要写实皮肤。背景是一块被暖光照亮的米白或浅杏色幕布，幕布上投出同一个主体的更大、稍软的影子，影子可以和偶的动作有一点点错位，形成前后两层。四周可以有传统的皮革边框、云纹、花卉或小型陪衬皮影，以及一盏透光的提灯，但这些都是配角，不要写字、不要匾额文字、不要款识。配色以暖黄、琥珀、赭石为主，主体皮革可带少量靛蓝、朱红或石绿的透明彩绘，暗处是深褐。光线来自幕布后方偏上的暖光，前面的偶是被照透的，影子投在幕上。质感是真实的手工皮革雕刻和剧场灯光，不要 3D 塑料感，不要日出风景照，不要现代舞台LED。安静、像一场还没开演的夜戏。画面无文字、无签名、无品牌、无现成角色。

New subject:
【主体】主体是一只侧身立起的兔子皮影，耳朵很长，前爪抬起，像在探月亮。皮革是暖黄和浅赭，耳朵和胸口有简单的镂空花。幕布上是它的大影子，影子里耳朵特别长。左上可以有一盏小提灯，脚下是云纹皮雕。没有人物。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.author: Ziha_ai
posts.text:
A cinematic portrait transformed into timeless geometric art with GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:
create a 3:4 vertical high-end art poster from the uploaded photo, with 50% of the image on each side strictly in the same position, presenting a dual-layer design of 'real photography × abstract geometric art'.

Top half|Real photography

The original image is preserved in its entirety, including the person, posture, composition, natural light, and color atmosphere, with only the color tone being refined, presenting a high-end art photography and independent publication quality. The background can be naturally extended, but the facial features, body shape, or original details of the person cannot be changed.

Bottom half|Abstract visual

The image is extracted from the photo to transform the person's posture, interaction, scene outline, and representative elements into minimalist geometric illustrations and abstract visual symbols. Color blocks, curves, lines, grids, and negative space are re-structured to maintain the original image's recognizability, but not directly copy the photo.

Design style

Combining Bauhaus, deconstructive Swiss flat design, Post-digital Graphic Design, and Japanese art publication aesthetics. The composition is restrained, the proportions are precise, and a large amount of blank space is left, combining rational order with artistic warmth.

Color and Material

Extract the main color from the original image, combined with warm white, low-saturation color tones, and a small amount of contrast color. Add Risograph embossed printing particles, vintage paper texture, subtle offset printing inaccuracies, and scanning noise to create a refined physical print quality.

Layout Details

Only use a very small number of tiny numbers, coordinates, fine line markings, and color tickets as design elements, without using large headlines. All elements must be coordinated with the main visual, avoiding excessive information.

Final Result

A collector's-level poster for high-end design studios, art institutions, or independent publications. The top half is realistic and natural, while the bottom half is abstract yet instantly recognizable as the original image concept. The overall design is refined, minimalist, and stylish, avoiding cheap commercial illustrations and excessive decoration

posts.prompt:
一张竖构图的电影感照片，画面中，一位二十多岁的亚洲女性正坐在一个透明亚克力座椅上，位置就在相机正上方。镜头被放置在座椅前缘的正下方，几乎垂直向上对准。她身体前倾，凑向镜头上方，面部清晰可见；她戴着一副黑色圆框眼镜，正透过镜片直视下方的观众，同时俏皮地吐出舌头。

———

她深色的编织发辫垂落在脸庞两侧。她身着黑色露肩连衣裙，不透明的裙摆覆盖在膝盖和大腿上。双膝并拢，微微偏向一侧，双手自然地放在膝盖上。近距离广角视角营造出强烈的透视缩短效果：她坐着的身躯占据了画面下方的前景，而面部则位于上方正中。双肩与双臂环绕着她向下注视的视线，

———

透明座椅的边缘泛着淡淡的反光。相机左上方的一盏大型柔光冷白影棚灯照亮了她的脸庞与发辫，柔和的阴影投向相机右侧。眼镜上细微的反光并未遮挡双眼，依然清晰可见。自然的皮肤质感、细腻的衣物褶皱、柔和虚化的背景，以及克制的青绿色调处理，共同构成了这张照片。

【角色與場景】
每張隨機選擇一位辨識度鮮明的經典動漫或遊戲成年角色，保留原作髮型、五官、經典服裝、配色、標誌性配件與人物性格。

角色始終保持原版二維動漫畫風，具有清晰手繪輪廓與賽璐璐色塊。

【互動事件】
每張圍繞一個自然、有趣、意外、親密或具有反差感的真實事件展開。

自由探索身體接觸、物品交接、共同活動、突發狀況、遊戲、惡作劇、相互幫助及其他互動形式。

角色動作由事件自然驅動，可站、坐、蹲、躺、跑、跳、彎腰、轉身、伸手、失衡或處於其他合理姿態。

表情、視線、肢體反應與角色性格及正在發生的事情一致。

【第一人稱攝影】
鏡頭代表觀眾本人的眼睛，採用沈浸式第一人稱iPhone抓拍。

隨機變化機位高度、拍攝角度、景別、人物距離、畫面位置與空間層次。

自由探索俯視、仰視、側視、背影、近距離特寫、遠景、局部裁切、非中心構圖及其他自然視角。

觀眾的真實手腳、身體局部或手持物品根據事件需要自然入鏡，無須每張固定伸手。

角色可以靠近、遠離、經過鏡頭或處於不同空間位置，不必每張正面面對觀眾。

構圖由事件與拍攝者所在位置自然決定，保留真實生活的偶然感。

【跨次元融合】
二維角色真實地存在於三維攝影環境中，保持鮮明的動漫繪制質感。

角色與現實環境遵循一致的空間尺度、透視、遮擋、接觸陰影及光照方向。

角色與真實人物、物品互動時，手指接觸、物品支撐、運動方向及前後層次自然可信。

保留二維角色與真實攝影環境之間鮮明的媒介反差。

【系列隨機性】
每張獨立變化角色、場景、事件、人物姿態、鏡頭角度、景別與構圖結構。

優先形成主體位置、動作和觀看方式的明顯差異，減少重復的正面伸手、遞物、牽手回頭及居中半身構圖。

畫面具有真實生活的臨場感、跨次元趣味與鮮明的角色辨識度。

9:16竪版，每張獨立完整畫面。

posts.text:
Every test here: only the hardest 4 seconds, Seedance 2.5 Draft 480p. Cheap, fast, and enough to see what breaks.

Gen 1❌: Seedance copied the shapes from the 3D blockout. The glass shards came out as flat rectangles, the wine as beads. He also held the glass by the stem, so the crush made no physical sense.

Fix 1 — prompt:
I told Seedance that the glass and wine shapes in the blockout are only a guide for position and timing. I asked for thin, jagged crystal shards and wine moving as real liquid — waves and splashes, not beads. I also specified that the fist grips the bowl.
Gen 2❌: no change.

Fix 2 — blockout:
I rebuilt it: fist on the bowl, jagged shards, wine as streams instead of beads. I also added a hard ban on copying the shapes.
Gen 3❌: the grip was fixed, but the glass and wine still copied the blockout shapes.

Fix 3 — one reference frame:
I took a screenshot of the peak moment where the glass shatters and the wine splashes. In GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst I replaced the 3D shapes with real glass and wine, and added a big splash right near the camera for more drama. Then I added that frame as an image reference.
Gen 4✅: exactly what I wanted. The style held because it was my own frame.

If a complex object renders wrong when it transfers from your blockout, fix one stop-frame from the video and add it as a reference.

The image-right arm bends upward, hand partly hidden by neck and hair. The opposite arm crosses diagonally down between the legs without touching the road or holding the bag. Preserve separate silver sculptural open wraps at the image-left elbow/forearm and wrist; do not connect them into a continuous coil.

Wardrobe: black structured bustier with opaque shaped cups, softer partly sheer lower bodice, vertical seams, and broad straps with repeated silver fittings. Add matte black loose cargo trousers with volume, compression folds, pockets, gathered cuffs, waist drawcords, and a loose cord loop beside the image-right cuff. Both shoes are glossy black pointed-toe pumps with narrow heels and white reflections.

A small structured black chevron-textured bag hangs beside the folded image-left leg. Preserve its small gold YSL-style monogram and fine gold chain rising outside the body and partly behind the arm. Keep the gold chain, silver wraps, and black cords separate. The bag neither enters the low hand nor floats.

Preserve generous asphalt below the pumps; diagonal curb and pale sidewalk above; gray railing; cardboard/white clutter upper-left; cream/brown building elements; dark bags and partial blue denim-like material upper-right. Retain the separate cropped hand, red sleeve, black object, and dark foreground form at lower-right without attaching them to the subject or completing another person. Preserve warm golden-brown skin, honey-beige hair, neutral gray pavement, deep black clothing, amber lenses, silver hardware, and warmer gold bag details. Maintain readable charcoal folds, soft lower-bodice values, narrow patent highlights, gentle skin texture, and sharper asphalt.

posts.author: Alex_allinai
posts.text:
Most prompts describe the picture they want. This one opens by naming the picture it expects to get wrong, then spends every remaining line making that failure impossible.

It is a single-plate infographic prompt for Anne Carson, the Canadian classicist who took the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature. Static image, 16:9, written for Gemini 3 Pro Image at 2K. Twenty-four strings of text, one portrait, one layout keyword: hub-spoke.

Three things stand out. First, it declares its own trap. The keyword hub-spoke summons a mind map — a small circle ringed by evenly weighted bubbles — so the prompt says so outright, under a heading that reads "Read this before drawing — the trap this layout sets," then rules that the hub is a face, not a node, and that no spoke may compete with it in size, contrast or surrounding space.

Second, colour is budgeted, not listed. Five hex values, but only the portrait may use maximum contrast, and the accent is permitted in exactly two places. The prompt even separates texture from emphasis: the style's misregistration and torn paper edges are "the surface, not the accent" — they repeat, so they can never be the event.

Third, the empty space has owners. A table assigns every blank region a job, because this plate's bottom third kept going blank.

The frame of reference is a trade, not a mood: "the authentic look of a small-run two- or three-colour print shop" — spot inks, halftone screens, deliberate misregistration. Concrete enough to check.

The transferable move is the first one. Every layout or style keyword you type arrives carrying a default cluster, and that cluster has a failure shape. Write the failure down and forbid it in the same words. An unstated risk is a coin flip; a named one is a rule.

So before your next prompt, ask what your chosen keyword does when the model stops paying attention. Draw that picture in one sentence, then ban it. One limit worth naming: the prompt demands an individuated likeness of a living writer, and no raster model has her face.

#PromptEngineering #Infographic #AIArt #Gemini3

Try the model on NeoSpark: @neospark_HQ

Images + video on NeoSpark — gpt-image-2.5, Flare, Sunburst, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Seedance 2.0/2.5, Wan 3.0, MiniMax H3, Veo Omni.
posts.prompt:
## Role

You are an editorial art director producing a single-plate infographic poster for a literary news feature. You have produced prize-announcement broadsheets for major literary awards. You understand that a portrait poster lives or dies on whether the face dominates, and you never let a layout's symmetry flatten a person into one tile among many.

## Topic

On 8 October 2026 the Swedish Academy awarded the **Nobel Prize in Literature** to the Canadian poet and classicist **Anne Carson**, "for her bold and creative works that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, have created new forms for contemporary literature."

The plate introduces her: who she is, how she works, what she wrote, what she translated, and the forty-year span from her birth to the prize.

## Learning Objectives

1. **Recognise the subject instantly.** Who is Anne Carson? A Canadian poet and classicist, and the 2026 Nobel laureate. *(Objective #1 — this is what the H1 must answer.)*
2. **Understand why she won.** She joins the philologist's obsession with words to the poet's hunger for new meaning, and uses unexpected cross-era juxtaposition to break out of the lyric paradigm.
3. **Grasp the depth of the body of work.** Four decades of writing and translation, in which she keeps crossing genre boundaries.
4. **Sense a specific person, not an institution.** There is humour here (she called boredom her number one enemy) and there is grief (a book written for her lost brother).

---

## Layout — `hub-spoke`

One hub. Spokes that read outward from it. Annotations after.

**Focal zone: the hub, unambiguously.** The hub is not an abstract concept, a pie chart or a central keyword — **the hub is her face.** The spokes are facets of the work. Every spoke must be visibly lighter than the hub in size, contrast and surrounding space.

**Reading order follows the hub outward, then clockwise.**

### ⛔ Read this before drawing — the trap this layout sets

`hub-spoke` is the layout most likely to fail here. A model that knows only "hub with spokes" produces a **mind map**: a small circle in the middle with evenly weighted satellite bubbles. That is the exact failure this plate must avoid.

- The hub is a **face**, not a node.
- The spokes are **not** the same size as each other. The works spoke is the largest of the three; the translations spoke is the smallest.
- No spoke may have a border, fill or saturation that competes with the portrait.

---

## Style — `risograph-halftone-collage`

A layered risograph collage: spot-colour inks, visible halftone dot screens, torn and cut paper edges, and deliberate slight misregistration between colour plates — the authentic look of a small-run two- or three-colour print shop.

### Palette — use these values, no others

| Role | Colour | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| Deep teal — primary ink | teal | `#007A87` |
| Cadmium red-coral — **the single accent** | red-coral | `#E63946` |
| Mustard — secondary warm ink | mustard | `#F4A261` |
| Paper ground | off-white | `#F4F1EA` |
| Ink black — all typography | carbon black | `#1A1A1A` |

### Surface treatment

- **Halftone dot screens** are the defining texture: dots visible at normal viewing distance on the portrait and on the large colour fields.
- **Misregistration**: colour plates sit 1–2px off their intended register, so teal and coral edges show a thin offset fringe.
- **Torn and cut paper edges** on the collage layers.
- **Typography is printed clean.** The misregistration, the dot screen and the torn edges apply ONLY to the image layers. Every letterform is sharp, solid, correctly spelled and fully legible. Text is never halftoned, never textured, never distressed, never misregistered.

### Figure colours, specified

- Her face is a **duotone risograph portrait**: carbon black halftone for the modelling and shadow, deep teal for the mid-tones, on the off-white paper ground.
- **The dot screen over the face is the finest on the plate.** Her features, the shape of the eyes and the set of the mouth must survive. Do not use the coarse posterised dots used on the background fields.
- Her skin is a natural mid-tone — this is a living woman, not a silhouette, not a single-colour mask, not a statue.

### Style adaptation — read this before drawing the figure

This style's collage habit is to layer **cut-out photographs and printed ephemera**, which very often means cut-out photographs of *people*. On this plate that is forbidden: the collage layers may contain paper, colour fields, dot screens, torn edges and halftone texture — **they may not contain any other human face, portrait, photograph of a person, or figure, in whole or in part.**

---

## Content

Four sections. Tiers are assigned and final.

### SECTION 1 — THE PORTRAIT — **Tier H1**

The hub. Her face and her name are **one fused visual unit** — the name is locked to the portrait, immediately at or against its lower edge, reading as a single object with it.

Verbatim strings:
- `ANNE CARSON`
- `2026`

The name is the largest **typography** on the plate. The face is the largest **element** on the plate — larger than the name.

### SECTION 2 — THE METHOD — **Tier H2** (left spoke)

Her working method, in three short units.

- `ETYMOLOGY` — subtitle: `The starting point of everything she writes`
- `STEREOSCOPIC VISION` — subtitle: `Holding two points of view in balance at once`
- `JUXTAPOSITION` — two paired lines beneath it:
  - `SIMONIDES` / `PAUL CELAN`
  - `THUCYDIDES` / `VIRGINIA WOOLF`

The two pairs are rendered as two parallel rules with a name at each end — **not** as icons, not as portraits, not as book covers.

### SECTION 3 — THE TRANSLATIONS — **Tier H2** (right spoke — the smallest spoke)

Four translated works. Translations from the Greek stand as independent art.

- `ELECTRA` — `2001`
- `IF NOT, WINTER` — `2002`
- `ANTIGONE` — `2015`
- `BAKKHAI` — `2015`

### SECTION 4 — THE WORKS — **Tier H2** (lower spoke — the largest spoke)

Six major works, chronologically. `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED` is the **hero card** of this cluster — drawn at roughly 2× the linear scale of the others, and it is the one card permitted to use the red-coral accent as a fill.

- `EROS THE BITTERSWEET` — `1986`
- `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED` — `1998`  ← **hero card, largest**
- `THE BEAUTY OF THE HUSBAND` — `2001`
- `NOX` — `2010`
- `FLOAT` — `2016`
- `WRONG NORMA` — `2024`

### SECTION 5 — THE FOOTER TIMELINE — **Tier H2\*** (see the R2 note)

⚠️ **This footer is not a legend.** It is a real chronology and it must be drawn at **H2 contrast**, not at caption weight. If it is rendered as a legend, the sequence disappears.

A single horizontal rule spanning the full width of the plate, at the very bottom, with dated nodes:

`1950` · `1981` · `1986` · `1998` · `2001` · `2010` · `2016` · `2024` · **`2026`**

**Traversal is left to right, 1950 → 2026. State it visually: the rule must read as advancing rightward.**

**The terminal node `2026` is the largest node and is filled with the red-coral accent.** Every other node is a small carbon-black dot. The timeline's nodes carry **years only** — never a book title.

### SECTION 6 — ATTRIBUTION — **Tier H3**

Small, low contrast, bottom edge:
- `"BOREDOM IS MY NUMBER ONE ENEMY"`
- `SWEDISH ACADEMY · 8 OCTOBER 2026`

---

## Text Accuracy

**Every string below is rendered exactly as written, once, with no variation.**

| String | Count on plate | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `ANNE CARSON` | 1 | Locked to the portrait. H1. |
| `2026` | 2 | Once as the award year beside the portrait; once as the timeline's terminal node. These are the only permitted duplicate. |
| `ETYMOLOGY` | 1 | |
| `The starting point of everything she writes` | 1 | Sentence case. Lowercase "The". |
| `STEREOSCOPIC VISION` | 1 | |
| `Holding two points of view in balance at once` | 1 | Sentence case. |
| `JUXTAPOSITION` | 1 | |
| `SIMONIDES` | 1 | |
| `PAUL CELAN` | 1 | Two words. |
| `THUCYDIDES` | 1 | T-H-U-C-Y-D-I-D-E-S. |
| `VIRGINIA WOOLF` | 1 | WOOLF — two O's, one F at the end. |
| `ELECTRA` | 1 | |
| `IF NOT, WINTER` | 1 | Comma after NOT. |
| `ANTIGONE` | 1 | A-N-T-I-G-O-N-E. |
| `BAKKHAI` | 1 | B-A-K-K-H-A-I. Double K, then H. |
| `EROS THE BITTERSWEET` | 1 | BITTERSWEET is one word. |
| `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED` | 1 | ⚠️ **Highest-risk string on the plate** (13-letter word). Set it large, alone, on bare paper inside its card. Do not let any texture or ink field touch these letters. |
| `THE BEAUTY OF THE HUSBAND` | 1 | |
| `NOX` | 1 | |
| `FLOAT` | 1 | |
| `WRONG NORMA` | 1 | |
| `1950` `1981` `1986` `1998` `2001` `2010` `2016` `2024` | 1 each | Timeline nodes. Digits only, no "AD", no apostrophes. |
| `"BOREDOM IS MY NUMBER ONE ENEMY"` | 1 | Straight double quotation marks. |
| `SWEDISH ACADEMY · 8 OCTOBER 2026` | 1 | Middle dot separator. |

**Rules for all text:**
- Each string appears exactly **once** (the sole exception is `2026`, noted above).
- Every label sits on **bare, unpainted paper** — never on top of an illustration, ink field, halftone screen or torn edge.
- Labels sit **outside** the thing they label and are connected to it by proximity, never laid over it.
- **No English word on this plate may be invented, abbreviated, hyphenated, split across lines, or respelled.**
- No mirrored, reversed, rotated or vertically-set letterforms. All text is horizontal.

---

## The Portrait

**Depicted: Anne Carson — Canadian poet and classicist, born 1950, Nobel laureate 2026.**

An individuated, realistic likeness of a specific living woman in her mid-seventies: short grey hair, an alert and level gaze directed straight at the viewer, a composed, faintly ironic expression. She reads as a scholar and a poet — intelligent, unadorned, unsentimental.

- **Angle: frontal, 0°. Straight on, facing the viewer.** Both eyes visible, level, unobscured.
- **Framed, not bled.** The portrait sits inside a visible border — a medallion, an oval or a rectangle. It does not touch or cross any edge of the plate.
- **Rendered as a risograph halftone portrait**: carbon-black dots for modelling, deep teal mid-tones, off-white paper. The dot screen is finest here, so the likeness survives.
- **The name `ANNE CARSON` is fused to the portrait**, sitting immediately against its lower edge as part of the same visual object.
- **Nothing is drawn over the face.** No text, no rule, no torn paper, no colour field, no halftone band crosses it.
- **The ground behind her is a flat abstract plane** of teal and off-white — not a room, not a library, not a landscape, not a city, not a sky.

### ⛔ NO OTHER FIGURE ON THIS PLATE

This plate shows **exactly one person, once.** Forbid all of the following absolutely:

- Any second human face, head, silhouette, bust or body, at any size, anywhere — including in the margin, in the collage layers, inside a spoke, or as a background texture.
- **Any cut-out photograph or printed fragment of a person.** The risograph collage idiom invites this; refuse it.
- **Any depiction of the classical world's people**: no Sappho, no Simonides, no Stesichoros, no Thucydides, no Catullus, no Euripides, no Sophocles. They exist on this plate **as names only**.
- **No mythological creature**: no Geryon, no red winged monster, no Herakles, no cattle, no wings.
- **No classical statue, marble bust, plaster cast or sculpted head.** A statue would read as a generic stand-in for a living woman, which is forbidden.
- No Emily Brontë, no John Keats, no Paul Celan, no Virginia Woolf as a figure — `PAUL CELAN` and `VIRGINIA WOOLF` are **text labels only**.

### ⛔ NO UNREQUESTED ILLUSTRATIONS

Do not add: book covers, open books, quills, inkwells, typewriters, laurel wreaths, medals, laureate medallions, Greek columns, temples, olive branches, lyres, owls, or any decorative icon that was not requested above. The only images on this plate are **the portrait** and the geometric/typographic apparatus described in the Content and Composition sections.

---

## Composition & Visual Hierarchy

The plate must read as a **ranked composition**, not as a uniform field of equally weighted tiles.

### Reading order — the eye must travel in this sequence

1. **Her face.** The eye lands on the portrait first, before anything else on the plate — before the name, before the masthead, before any spoke.
2. **`ANNE CARSON`**, fused to the portrait's lower edge.
3. **The left spoke** — `ETYMOLOGY` / `STEREOSCOPIC VISION` / `JUXTAPOSITION`.
4. **The right spoke** — the four translations.
5. **The lower spoke** — the six works, with `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED` as the hero card.
6. **The footer timeline**, travelling left to right, ending at the enlarged `2026` node.
7. Ornament and margin texture — last, and never competing.

### Proportional ladder — share of the plate

| Zone | Share |
|---|---|
| Masthead band (top) | ~5% |
| **The portrait + name (H1)** | **~56%** |
| The three spokes (H2, all together) | ~26% |
| Footer timeline (H2 contrast, edge to edge) | ~8% |
| Margin ring | ~5% |

**Never invert this ranking.** No spoke may approach the portrait's size. The works spoke is the largest spoke; the translations spoke is the smallest.

### Type scale — every level, largest first

1. **`ANNE CARSON`** — the H1 name, fused to the portrait. Largest type on the plate.
2. **Spoke headers** — `ETYMOLOGY`, `STEREOSCOPIC VISION`, `JUXTAPOSITION`, and the works/translations cluster headers.
3. **Work and translation titles** — `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED`, `NOX`, `FLOAT`, `ELECTRA`, …
4. **Subtitles and secondary labels** — `The starting point of everything she writes`, the paired names, the years beside works.
5. **Timeline years and the attribution line** — smallest.

**Each level must be at least 20% larger than the level below it.**

### Contrast and value

- Only the **portrait** may use maximum contrast — it carries the deepest carbon black and the strongest modelling on the plate.
- Spoke headers sit at medium contrast. Work titles sit below them.
- Everything else — subtitles, years, timeline nodes, attribution — stays low and recedes when the plate is squinted at.
- The red-coral accent appears in **exactly two places, both small**: the `AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF RED` hero card fill, and the `2026` terminal timeline node. Nowhere else. No other element may be red-coral.

### Whitespace

- The gutter between spokes is at least **1.5×** the padding inside a single spoke.
- **The portrait gets the most surrounding space on the plate, not the least.** Nothing crowds it.

### Whitespace ownership — every empty region must have an owner

There is no unowned empty space on this plate. Assign each region explicitly:

| Region | Owner |
|---|---|
| Space directly around the portrait | the portrait (its breathing room) |
| The band above the portrait | the masthead |
| Gutters between the three spokes | separation between clusters |
| The strip directly above the timeline rule | the works spoke's lower margin |
| The bottom band, edge to edge | **the footer timeline** — it occupies the full width, so the bottom of the plate is never empty |
| The margin ring | ornament and halftone texture only |

**In particular: the bottom third of the plate is fully occupied by the works spoke and the timeline. Do not leave it blank.**

### Exclusion zones

- Ornament, torn paper and dot texture live **only in the margin ring**.
- **No ornament may be larger than the smallest label on the plate.**
- No ornament may overlap the portrait, the name, or any spoke.

### The single accent

**Exactly one element on the plate may break the grid: the `2026` node on the footer timeline.** It is drawn larger than the other nodes and it is the only element permitted to rise above the timeline rule and cross into the space above it.

That node is the accent. Nothing else tilts, overlaps a boundary, crosses an edge or sits off-baseline.

(The style's own misregistration fringes and torn paper edges are the **surface**, not the accent — they repeat across the whole plate and are not a compositional event.)

### Anti-flattening test

Shrink the plate to 200px wide and squint.

**Her face must still read as the dominant form.** The type may vanish, the labels may vanish, the timeline may vanish — the face must not. If the plate reads as a field of equally weighted tiles, it has failed.

**Correct this by re-weighting scale, contrast and whitespace — never by adding more decoration.** Decoration is what made it flat.

---

## Language

**English throughout.** Every string on the plate is English or Latin script, as listed in the Content section. No Chinese characters, no transliteration, no bilingual labels.

---

## Aspect Ratio

**16:9 landscape.** Compose for a wide plate: portrait hub at centre, spokes flanking left and right, works band below, single timeline rule along the bottom edge.

---

## Quality Rules

- **The plate must read as a ranked hierarchy, not a uniform field.** Apply the Composition section literally: the declared reading order, the proportional ladder, the type scale with ≥20% separation between adjacent levels, and the contrast rule that only the portrait may carry maximum contrast.
- The portrait is the largest element on the plate and nothing approaches it.
- Exactly one human figure; exactly one face.
- Every string is spelled exactly as given in the Text Accuracy table, and appears exactly once.
- Every label sits on bare paper, outside the thing it labels.
- Typography is always clean and sharp — never halftoned, distressed or misregistered.

## Negative Constraints

**Portrait**
- No profile view. No three-quarter view. No rear view. No downward or upward head tilt that hides the eyes.
- No sunglasses, no hat brim, no hair or shadow across the eyes.
- No caricature, no cartoon, no exaggerated features, no comic distortion.
- No classical statue, marble bust, plaster cast or sculpted likeness.
- No generic or anonymous woman — the likeness must be individuated and specific.
- No bleeding the portrait off any edge; it is framed.
- No text, rule, texture or colour field over the face.

**Other figures**
- No second person, face, head, bust, silhouette or body anywhere on the plate, at any size.
- No cut-out photographs or printed fragments of people in the collage layers.
- No depictions of Sappho, Simonides, Stesichoros, Thucydides, Catullus, Sophocles, Euripides, Paul Celan, Virginia Woolf, Emily Brontë or John Keats.
- No Geryon, no winged monster, no Herakles, no mythological scene.
- No crowd, no audience, no hands, no arms.

**Illustration**
- No book covers, open books, quills, inkwells, typewriters, laurel wreaths, medals, columns, temples, olive branches, lyres, owls, globes or maps.
- No decorative icons beyond the geometric apparatus described above.
- No flag, no national emblem, no institutional logo.

**Composition**
- No uniform grid of equally sized cards.
- No mind-map of equally weighted satellite bubbles around a small central circle.
- No second element competing with the portrait for the eye.
- No empty bottom third.
- No ornament outside the margin ring; no ornament overlapping the portrait or a spoke.
- No accent colour anywhere except the two declared places.

**Text defects — explicitly forbidden**
- Misspelled, invented or garbled words.
- Mirrored, reversed or rotated letterforms.
- Words broken across lines or split by a torn edge.
- Duplicated strings.
- Text rendered as halftone dots, distressed, blurred, or partially obscured.
- Any letterform placed over the portrait, over an ink field, or over a torn paper edge.
- Decorative or pseudo-text used to fill space — if a word is not in the Text Accuracy table, it does not appear on the plate.

🔥#promptshare 🔥

A raw, editorial aesthetic style

Use these prompts as inspiration to create your own photos.

Done with GPT Image 2.5
posts.prompt:
Full-body shot of a young Black woman in her early 20s, natural coiled hair, sharp jawline, fierce unapologetic gaze, caught mid-throw, arm cocked back with raw explosive energy, a cracked concrete brick held close to the camera in extreme forced foreground perspective, knuckles sharp and dominant, filling the lower frame. Ultra-wide 16mm lens distortion, extreme low angle looking up from ground level, her figure towering monumental against a bleached urban sky. She wears a cropped oversized graphic jacket, cargo pants, heavy boots planted wide on cracked asphalt. Behind her, massive monumental condensed distressed typography fills the entire background, the words BREAK IT in worn capital letters, partially eclipsed by her silhouette, paint-scraped and flaking like a torn billboard. Brutalist minimal environment, raw concrete walls, peeling posters, urban decay. Hard warm directional sunlight raking across her face at a sharp angle, deep shadows carving her features. Visible print grain, worn matte poster texture, subtle halftone imperfections throughout. Mood: raw, rebellious, unstoppable. Premium editorial campaign aesthetic, bold, scroll-stopping, visually magnetic. Shot for a high-impact social media poster, vertical 4:5 format.

———

Brutal street editorial poster, vertical 4:5, direct overhead bird's-eye camera looking straight down, 16mm ultra-wide lens with strong forced perspective. A 1950s man in a cream dinner jacket, black bow tie, crisp white shirt and high-waisted pleated charcoal trousers, slicked-back dark hair, seen from above at a mid-century cocktail bar. His right hand grips a brushed stainless steel cocktail shaker, his left hand holds a faceted Baccarat crystal jigger, and mid-motion he tosses the shaker in a tight arc between his hands, like a card magician performing a flourish. The brushed steel shaker, caught in mid-air and blurred slightly, becomes the foreground hook, rushing toward the lens with reflections of the ceiling lights. Below, a glossy black and white checkered floor, scattered cocktail glasses, a lime wedge, a silver cocktail strainer and a bottle of crimson liqueur on the counter. Monumental ultra-bold ultra-condensed distressed uppercase lettering reading FRESH fills the background, stacked in massive scale, partially occluded by the man's shoulders and the arc of the shaker, with ink wear and weathered print finish. Hard warm overhead spotlight with crisp shadows, specular highlights on the chrome and crystal, controlled palette of cream, charcoal, crimson, chrome and a single teal accent. Visible print grain, worn poster texture, subtle imperfections, natural skin microtexture, authentic fabric detail, restrained motion blur on the shaker. Photographic, not an illustration. Ratio 4:5

———

A raw street editorial poster of a 25-year-old Japanese woman aggressively roller skating through a brutalist concrete urban environment. She wears a mustard-colored dastar, a champagne wedding dress styled in a tougher, more deconstructed way, a heavy oversized gold coffee-bean necklace, and a worn backpack strapped to her back. She thrusts a purple spray paint can directly toward the lens, making it dominate the foreground with intense forced perspective; the can has a bright yellow banana sticker. She rides retro 1980s roller skates with speed and attitude, body leaning forward, fabric and loose details caught in motion. Shot from an extreme low angle with a 16mm lens, gritty full-body composition, strong distortion, harsh sunlight, deep shadows, and a confrontational stance. Huge distressed black condensed typography behind her reads “WAZAAAA”, integrated like a street poster wall, partially blocked by her silhouette. Visible texture, dust, asphalt grit, rough print finish, rebellious urban energy, raw campaign aesthetic, high contrast, bold and unapologetic. ratio 4:5

———

Brutal street editorial poster, vertical 4:5, direct overhead bird's-eye camera looking straight down, 16mm ultra-wide lens with strong forced perspective. A blonde woman in her forties sits on the nose of a weathered silver rocket, wearing a loose olive green workwear overall with rolled cuffs and wooden clogs dangling over the edge of the hull. She holds a traditional golden-crusted baguette in one hand, the bread scored and dusted with flour, her posture relaxed yet defiant as the rocket plunges toward Earth. The baguette, close to the lens and slightly blurred, becomes the foreground hook, crumbs drifting toward the viewer. Below, a vast curving blue and green planet fills the lower frame, its clouds streaked by the rocket's exhaust trail, with a brutalist steel launch gantry and concrete platform fragments drifting past. Monumental ultra-bold ultra-condensed distressed uppercase lettering reading EARTH fills the background, stacked in massive vertical scale, partially occluded by the woman's shoulders and the rocket's silhouette, with ink wear and weathered print finish. Hard warm sunlight from the upper left casting crisp shadows across the hull, rim light on the flour-dusted bread and blonde hair, controlled palette of olive green, burnt orange, warm ivory, concrete gray and deep charcoal. Visible print grain, worn poster texture, subtle imperfections, natural skin microtexture, authentic fabric detail, restrained motion blur on the exhaust trail. Photographic, not an illustration. ratio 4:5

posts.text:
Most people ask AI to make them look like a Disney princess. This prompt does something much smarter 👑

It keeps the people, their faces, poses, and the original composition recognizable, then redraws the photo like a hand-painted frame from Disney's 1959 Sleeping Beauty.

You even get to pick the season of the enchanted forest.

Want to try it with your own photo?

Open SyntxAI and select GPT Image 2.5.
Upload your photo.
Paste the prompt below.
Choose your season: spring, summer, autumn, or winter.
Hit Generate.

Here's the full prompt 👇

PROMPT:

Transform the source photograph into an atmospheric hand-drawn illustration in the aesthetic of Disney's classic 1959 animated film Sleeping Beauty. SOURCE PHOTO PRESERVATION: Preserve the composition of the original photograph, the exact positioning of the people, their poses, gestures, camera angle, body proportions, direction of gaze, and overall scene structure. Preserve each person's individual facial features, face shape, hairstyle, and recognizability. Do not replace the people or create a new composition; transform the original photograph into a hand-drawn animation frame. ARTISTIC STYLE: Redraw the scene as a genuine hand-drawn frame from a classic mid-20th-century animated film: elegant, crisp outlines, expressive fine linework, stylized organic shapes, flat painterly color fills, delicate rendering of faces and clothing, and decorative fairytale vegetation. The visual language should evoke traditional hand-drawn animation: lines drawn by hand, painterly backgrounds, graphic silhouettes, the slightly irregular natural quality of traditional drawing, and multilayered use of color and shadows. The image must look like an original animation frame created manually by artists, not a modern digital illustration. SEASON AND ENVIRONMENT: Completely replace the original background with an enchanted forest in [INSERT SEASON: SPRING / SUMMER / AUTUMN / WINTER]. The season must be visually obvious through the vegetation, condition of the trees, foliage, ground, atmosphere, lighting, and color palette. Regardless of the selected season, maintain the consistent fairytale visual language of the classic Sleeping Beauty. SPRING: Fresh young greenery, blooming plants, delicate flowers, soft light colors, slender branches, and a sunlit golden haze. SUMMER: Dense, lush green foliage, deep vegetation, sunbeams filtering through the leaves, warm golden light, and rich forest depth. AUTUMN: Terracotta, brown, olive, bottle-green, golden, amber, and warm orange tones, fallen leaves, and a soft golden haze. WINTER: Deep conifer-green and cool blue tones, snow, frost-covered branches, a snow-covered forest, soft diffused lighting, and silver-gold light accents. The seasonal palette must be rich, refined, and painterly, without neon colors or modern digital oversaturation. FOREST AND BACKGROUND: The background is a decorative enchanted forest inspired by medieval book illustration and the art direction of classic animation. Use elongated graceful branches, graphic leaves, decorative plants, expressive tree silhouettes, and layered forest perspective. Vegetation should look hand-drawn and stylized, not photorealistic. Add soft atmospheric perspective, a light haze in the background, and a sense of depth within the illustrated forest space. LIGHTING: Create soft fairytale lighting that naturally matches the chosen season. Light should filter through branches and foliage, creating delicate golden or season-appropriate highlights on the characters, soft translucent transitions, and deep velvety shadows. The lighting should feel cinematic while clearly looking like painted light in classic animation. CHARACTERS: Preserve the natural beauty and recognizability of the faces. Do not enlarge the eyes excessively, make the faces doll-like, or turn the people into caricatures. Add a hairstyle in the aesthetic of Princess Aurora from the classic animation: elegant, softly flowing wavy locks and carefully rendered decorative curls. The hair must look like hand-drawn animation artwork, with crisp lines, painterly color fills, and natural highlights. Individual curls and strands should be clearly rendered and organically integrated into the style of traditional 2D animation, rather than looking like voluminous 3D hair or a digital render. CLOTHING: Preserve the original style, silhouette, main shapes, and character of the people's clothing, but stylize the clothing in the aesthetic of characters from classic Disney animation.

Create a breathtaking, ultra-detailed Y2K internet-girl digital scrapbook collage inspired by early-2000s computer culture, vintage Windows desktop interfaces, nostalgic cyber aesthetics, and authentic candid cat photography. Use the uploaded reference image as the primary visual direction, but elevate the composition into a more sophisticated, visually captivating, premium editorial artwork.

MAIN SUBJECT: A stylish young adult woman with naturally beautiful facial features, warm realistic skin texture, expressive brown eyes, subtle winged eyeliner, glossy natural lips, and long dark brown hair tied in a slightly messy high ponytail. She wears tiny glossy black cat-eye sunglasses and an oversized charcoal-gray chunky knitted sweater, wrapped comfortably around herself. Her expression is effortlessly cool, dreamy, slightly playful, and candid rather than posed. She gently cuddles a ridiculously adorable fluffy gray-and-white tabby kitten with large round amber eyes, a tiny pink nose, realistic individual whiskers, and beautifully detailed soft fur.

COMPOSITION: A striking layered mixed-media collage with one dominant, large central portrait of the woman and kitten occupying approximately 60% of the canvas. Surround it with several smaller photographic snapshots showing different candid moments of the SAME woman and SAME kitten: looking over the sunglasses, cheek-to-cheek cuddling, gently kissing the kitten's forehead, and a close-up of the kitten's curious face. Preserve consistent facial identity, hairstyle, sunglasses, sweater, kitten markings, and photographic realism throughout every frame.

Y2K DIGITAL ELEMENTS: Surround the photographs with charming retro computer interface windows inspired by classic early-2000s desktop software, miniature blue title bars, pixelated cursor arrows, tiny pink heart icons, hand-drawn stars, doodled cat faces, retro folder icons, vintage instant-message pop-ups, a miniature flip-phone interface, playful loading bars, and small faux screenshot frames. Include torn notebook paper, translucent tape, halftone dots, scanned paper textures, photocopier grain, rough black ink marks, subtle sticker outlines, and imperfect hand-cut collage edges. Every decorative element should feel intentionally placed, like an expertly art-directed physical scrapbook assembled by a creative internet girl in 2004.

COLOR PALETTE: Powder pink, bubblegum pink, dusty rose, warm cream, charcoal black, muted denim blue, and soft silver-gray. Use vivid pink accents against neutral photographic tones. Maintain beautiful contrast, balanced negative space, and a cohesive visual hierarchy.

PHOTOGRAPHIC QUALITY: Authentic high-end candid photography, natural facial proportions, visible skin pores, realistic baby hairs, delicate eye reflections, physically accurate sunglasses reflections, intricate knitted yarn fibers, individual kitten fur strands, subtle analog film grain, gentle flash photography, soft ambient window light, and natural shadows. Mix intimate close-up photography with tactile vintage print textures. The photographs must remain photorealistic while the surrounding scrapbook graphics are deliberately handmade and retro.

TYPOGRAPHY AND MICROCOPY: Add a few short, legible handwritten-style phrases such as "just a girl & her cat", "same girl, brighter days", "good things still exist", and "loading happiness..." Use small black handwritten lettering, occasional pixel fonts, and charming pink annotations. Keep text secondary to the portrait, with correct spelling, clean letterforms, and generous spacing.

ART DIRECTION: Premium Pinterest-worthy Y2K moodboard, nostalgic internet diary, playful cyber-feminine aesthetic, authentic 2000s digital nostalgia, Gen Z editorial design, tactile analog-digital fusion, beautifully imperfect maximalist scrapbook, sophisticated visual storytelling, carefully layered depth, immaculate detail, exceptional visual balance, instantly

———

FORMAT: Vertical 2:3 portrait composition, edge-to-edge artwork, high resolution, crisp subject details, cohesive collage structure, premium social-media art direction.

IMPORTANT: Preserve the reference's core identity and mood without copying its exact layout. Create an original, more polished, more visually interesting composition. Keep the woman's face and kitten unobstructed in the main portrait. Make all smaller photographs depict the same subjects. Every UI element, sticker, and doodle must complement the photography rather than overwhelm it. Prioritize visual quality, character consistency, natural anatomy, realistic hands, realistic fur, and an authentic handmade aesthetic.

One selfie. Four colors. A fashion sketch that looks like someone paid an illustrator $200 to draw it. Here's the exact AI prompt✍️

This is the kind of image format that feels bigger than a one-off effect.

You start with a normal photo.

A few seconds later, it comes back looking like it was torn out of a fashion designer's notebook - loose marker strokes, exaggerated features, almost no detail, and somehow way more editorial than the original.

That's what makes it interesting.

Not just because it looks good.

Because it looks sellable.

You could easily imagine this as a paid creative service for stylists, personal brands, fashion creators, or anyone who wants their photos turned into something more distinctive than another polished AI portrait.

Made with GPT Image 2.5.

How to try it:

Go to GPT Image 2.5
Upload your photo
Paste the prompt below
Generate

Prompt: Redraw the person from the original photo as a very loose minimalist fashion sketch, preserving the exact original pose, camera angle, body position, gestures, direction of gaze, and composition. Do not change the pose and do not create a new scene - only transform the photograph into a quick artistic sketch. Style: loose fashion illustration, expressive marker sketch, fashion designer notebook drawing, beautiful exaggerated fashion caricature. The drawing should look as if a fashion illustrator made it in a few minutes: minimum lines, maximum expressiveness. Do not render details - convey the person only through the silhouette, a few confident contours, and large blocks of color. Use a black liner or black gel pen for very simple expressive lines: a few strokes instead of fully rendered drawing. The contours should be lively, slightly rough, uneven, and hand-drawn. Apply color with colored markers in large broad strokes. Maximum 4 colors. Do not create complex shades, shadows, or gradients. Only big color shapes and bold patches. The face should be rendered as a beautiful fashion caricature, but very minimalistically: heavily distorted fashion face proportions; huge expressive eyes extending beyond the natural boundaries of the face; the eyes indicated by only a few lines, without rendering the iris or details; eyelashes with one expressive black stroke; a small simple nose in one line; small lips with one light contour; a sharp chin; an elongated elegant face shape; a thin long neck. Do not draw the face realistically. 3:4

The best AI prompts don't just make something look different.

They make it look like a service someone could actually charge for.

posts.prompt:
主题：治愈系自然万物 × 随机混合探索 × 湿润粉彩画 × 萌系拟人化 × 艺术留白

每张独立随机选择一种真实自然主体，探索多肉植物、奇异果实、野生蘑菇、苔藓、会飞的种子、水生植物、海洋微型生物、昆虫及自然现象等不同类别。同批优先探索十种不同主体，尽可能覆盖不同类别，展现自然万物丰富而奇妙的形态。

保留主体独特的外形、色彩、纹理与自然结构，通过融入原始形态的克制微表情与轻微姿态赋予温暖情绪。根据主体特征自然呈现生长、飘浮、舒展、栖息或其他富有生命力的瞬间。

采用湿润粉彩手绘技法，色粉在真实棉质画纸上自然溶散、晕染与沉积，形成柔和的色彩交融、不规则湿润边缘与清晰可感的纸张纤维肌理。局部保留粉彩颗粒、手工擦抹痕迹与自然的不完美。

遵循少即是多的艺术构图，以大面积自然画纸、轻淡色彩与自由晕染形成舒适留白。背景通过少量湿润笔触暗示环境，营造安静、含蓄、富有生命力的治愈氛围。

在画面合适的留白位置，以柔和可爱的手写字体标注主体的真实中文名称，文字清晰自然，与整体色彩和手绘质感协调。

每张重新独立抽卡，自由探索不同主体、情绪、姿态、场景、视角、构图与光线。场景涵盖自然环境、安静生活空间与微型童话世界。同批避免重复主体、主要场景与构图结构，保持鲜明视觉差异。

1:1方图。左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。

n=10，生成十张相互独立的完整图片，分别输出，每张单独成图，不拼图。

posts.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 editorial memory poster inspired by the uploaded photograph. Divide the composition into two horizontal sections: the top 50% preserves the original photograph with its recognizable subject, identity, pose, clothing, background, natural lighting, and realistic details. Do not redraw or stylize the top section.

The bottom 50% becomes a warm, hand-drawn illustrated scrapbook inspired by the photograph. Fill it with 7–9 small illustrations representing memorable details from the original scene, including the subject’s clothing, hairstyle, accessories, surrounding plants, flowers, trees, architecture, weather, activities, and other relevant objects. Arrange the illustrations in a balanced, playful collage with varied sizes and natural spacing.

ILLUSTRATION STYLE: Hand-drawn colored-pencil and watercolor sketches, delicate ink outlines, visible pencil strokes, imperfect artistic textures, soft coloring, charming doodles, tiny hearts, stars, arrows, and hand-drawn decorative accents. Use a warm cream-colored textured paper background with a nostalgic journal aesthetic.

COLOR PALETTE: Derive colors from the original photograph. Use soft, natural tones with subtle vintage warmth, earthy colors, and gentle highlights.

TYPOGRAPHY: Add a small handwritten title at the top of the illustrated section and a short, sentimental handwritten caption near the bottom. Keep the lettering elegant, lowercase, and naturally integrated into the artwork. Generate wording inspired by the photograph rather than using fixed text.

COMPOSITION RULES:
•Strict vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.
•Top and bottom sections occupy exactly 50% each.
•A perfectly straight horizontal division between sections.
•Original photograph remains photorealistic and unchanged.
•Bottom section contains illustrations related specifically to the uploaded image.
•Maintain a cohesive, handmade travel-journal or lifestyle-scrapbook aesthetic.
•High-quality textures, intricate sketch details, harmonious spacing, and professional editorial design.

IMPORTANT: Adapt every illustration, color, and handwritten caption to the uploaded photograph. Do not reuse objects or themes from reference examples unless they are relevant to the actual image. No extra photographs, no 3D elements, no glossy digital art, and no cluttered layout.

Result: A heartwarming, personalized photo-and-illustration poster that feels like a page from a beautifully illustrated personal diary.

prompt👇
Create a Cannes-level commercial poster for a fictional premium Korean noodle brand, designed as a high-impact editorial food ad where a real bowl of spicy broth noodles is fused with a refined magazine-cover layout. Preserve the exact chiaroscuro hierarchy, tabletop staging, hand-lifted noodle action, prop rhythm, negative-space structure, and typographic architecture of a premium food editorial poster. The noodle bowl must remain the absolute hero, with every surrounding element serving appetite, brand identity, and compositional tension.

Vertical 2:3 full-bleed poster. A large white ceramic bowl sits slightly below center on a dark square wooden riser over a warm wood table. A right hand enters from the upper-right holding dark wooden chopsticks, lifting a tight vertical bundle of noodles so the strands form a clean glowing column in the center-right upper zone. Reserve the upper third for a large bold Korean headline spanning most of the width. Keep a thin vertical editorial strip along the far left edge, a barcode-style brand block near the lower-left corner, and a line of fine Korean microcopy near the lower-right edge. The tabletop contains supporting bowls, cloth, spices, garlic, dried chilies, scattered leaves, and utensils arranged in deliberate editorial rhythm, never stealing focus from the hero dish.

Invent the brand as 온면당 and the hero dish as 붉은 육수 국수. The bowl contains glossy thin noodles in a rich red-orange chili broth, topped with braised diced meat, yellow soybeans, chopped scallion, red chili bits, and small golden pickled vegetables. The lifted noodles must look supple, elastic, smooth, and intensely appetizing, with subtle broth sheen and believable weight. The bowl should be off-white ceramic with delicate speckling and a soft matte glaze. The wooden riser should feel dense, dark, and precisely crafted. Every ingredient must look edible, premium, and intentionally styled.

Freeze one decisive serving moment: the hand grips the chopsticks naturally, fingers anatomically correct, wrist relaxed, chopsticks angled slightly downward from right to left, lifting a compact curtain of noodles high above the bowl. The lifted noodles form the visual bridge between headline and bowl. The bowl anchors the lower center, while the hand acts as the upper-right counterweight. Supporting bowls and props should be distributed across left, rear, and lower corners to create depth and editorial richness without clutter. Nothing may break the clarity of the noodle lift.

Foreground: warm wooden table with visible grain, a few scattered chili pieces, a spoon with sesame seeds, and restrained ingredient accents. Midground: the hero bowl on its riser, with nearby condiment bowls, folded blue-gray cloth, garlic cloves, and dried leaves. Background: darker table extensions, a soft black-brown upper field, a ceramic utensil holder, hanging wooden spoons, and small spice bowls receding into shadow. Keep the space tangible, layered, and realistic, but controlled like a styled magazine cover rather than a casual kitchen scene.

Preserve the original light-dark hierarchy: a deep near-black upper background, warm directional light across the tabletop and bowl, bright highlights on the lifted noodles, glossy accents on the broth surface, and soft sculpting light on the hand and chopsticks. Build contrast to emphasize heat, ingredient gloss, ceramic form, and tabletop texture without muddy shadows or dead black patches. Main palette: roasted brown, walnut wood, off-white ceramic, chili red, broth amber, soybean gold, herb green, charcoal shadow, and muted slate cloth blue. The mood should feel rich, savory, editorial, and premium.

Render as ultra-real luxury food photography fused with high-end print editorial design. The broth must show depth, oil shimmer, suspended spice, and realistic reflections. Noodles should display fine strand separation, slight edge translucency, and soft elasticity. Meat must look caramelized and tender. Ceramic should show subtle glaze pooling and tactile thickness. Wood must feel dry, dense, and natural. Cloth should have soft folds and matte woven texture. Small props such as chilies, garlic, sesame, and leaves should be believable but not overemphasized.

Use Korean typography only. Set a large bold headline across the top:
맛이 솟아오르다
Add a thin vertical strip along the far left margin:
온면당 푸드 에디토리얼 키친
Place a barcode-style brand block in the lower-left:
온면당
Include restrained footer microcopy at the lower-right:
붉은 육수 국수 / 시즌 하우스 에디션
Typography must be crisp, beautifully spaced, and harmonized with the poster grid, with the headline in warm ivory or soft white, never covering the lifted noodles or bowl.

Luxury commercial food poster, product-first, ultra-clean, no extra hands, no malformed fingers, no broken chopstick perspective, no noodle duplication, no floating garnish, no muddy broth, no cheap CGI gloss, no cartoon styling, no unreadable typography, no clutter overload, no random packaging, no dead black blocks, no low-detail props, no messy background, no style drift, no topology collapse.

Prompt:

Create an ultra-realistic 6-photo portrait collage arranged in a seamless 3×2 grid, featuring a naturally beautiful young Portuguese woman in her early 20s. She has warm olive-toned skin, expressive hazel-brown eyes, long chestnut-brown hair with subtle natural highlights, soft face-framing layers, naturally full eyebrows, and delicate, distinctive facial features. Her appearance should feel authentic and individual, with realistic skin texture, tiny imperfections, and minimal everyday makeup.

Visual aesthetic: Effortless European Instagram photo dump, reminiscent of candid photographs taken on a Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III. Direct built-in camera flash, crisp details, bright facial highlights, hard shadows, slightly imperfect framing, subtle digital noise, and a nostalgic early-2000s point-and-shoot feel.

Setting and styling: A warm off-white bedroom wall with subtle texture, a few natural shadows, and no distracting decorations. She wears a fitted burgundy scoop-neck top, tiny gold hoop earrings, and a delicate necklace. Her makeup is understated, with softly flushed cheeks, natural glossy lips, and lightly defined lashes. Her long hair remains the same color and length but falls differently in every photograph.

Six distinct photographs:

1. Sweet candid: Sitting close to the camera, resting her cheek against one hand, smiling gently with relaxed eyes and loose hair framing her face.
2. Playful snapshot: Looking directly into the lens with a mischievous half-smile, one eyebrow slightly raised, fingers casually tucked behind her ear.
3. Messy-girl moment: Eyes closed and laughing softly, both hands lifting her hair away from her shoulders, a few loose strands catching the flash.
4. Effortless confidence: Turning her face over one shoulder, giving the camera a subtle side-eye, with one hand lightly resting against her neck.
5. Caught laughing: Looking toward someone outside the frame, laughing naturally with her head tilted to the side and hair falling across one cheek.
6. Quiet evening mood: Leaning against the wall, gazing thoughtfully into the lens, lips relaxed, fingertips gently twisting a strand of hair.

Identity consistency: The same Portuguese woman must appear in all six frames, with identical facial proportions, eye color, skin tone, hair color, and recognizable features. Each photograph should have a different pose, expression, head angle, and hair arrangement, as if captured within the same casual photo session.

Photography details: Realistic compact-camera flash, authentic skin pores, fine baby hairs, natural facial asymmetry, believable hands, sharp eyes, slight variations in exposure, and candid framing. Avoid excessive retouching, artificial skin smoothing, exaggerated beauty standards, duplicated expressions, malformed fingers, distorted anatomy, or the overly polished appearance of AI-generated portraits.

Output: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, exactly six photographs in a balanced 3-column × 2-row grid, clean alignment, no gutters, no text, no watermark. Photorealistic, youthful, spontaneous, intimate, and effortlessly stylish.

全身性感人像，常被裁成半身，或腿断、头身比例垮。不是模型不会出全身，是比例、腰腿线、机位高度、穿搭尺度和场景光糊进同一句氛围词里，分不清谁该锁全身、谁该拉长腿线、谁只负责换景。

我把全身性感拆成六格写：比例锁、腰腿线、人物面孔、场景与穿搭、姿势与构图、排除，排除也算一格。开头一行是题材和画幅的总述，是每张都不动的底子。骨架固定；两张只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行，比例锁与腰腿线与人物面孔不动。尺度是编辑性感：贴身、露腿、姿态带一点撩，不裸露。下一条是第一张的完整提示词。

附图两张，同一套六格：天台金时、夜色人行道。gpt-image-2.5 出图，AI 生成，人物是虚构的成年人。
posts.prompt:
换变体时，复制帖 2：首行总述、比例锁、腰腿线、人物面孔、排除一行一字不动；只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行。人脸描述两张保持一致。第一张就是帖 2 原文。下面这一套直接替换：

图2｜夜色人行道
场景与穿搭：夜间城市人行道，路灯偏暖弱、招牌虚成色块；穿黑色高领贴身针织与皮质短裙、过膝靴；裙摆以上腿线可见。
姿势与构图：全身微侧站定，重心偏一侧，一脚略前，一手提裙侧，另一手自然垂放，目光平视镜头；全身入画，腿线不断。

———

全身性感美女人像，竖幅 9:16，写实摄影，时尚编辑风格。
比例锁：全身入画，头顶到鞋尖完整可见；头身约七到七点五头身；相机约胸部高度平视或略偏低仰。
腰腿线：腰线收紧可见；髋部自然外扩一线；腿长占身高约一半以上的观感；重心偏一侧或微交叉站姿；衣料贴身勾勒腰腿，编辑性感。
人物面孔：虚构的成年女性，二十五岁上下，原创东亚或混血面孔；鹅蛋脸，微圆下颌，内双，鼻梁中等高，薄唇自然粉带一点水光；浅暖白肤色带一点奶杏，脸颊有自然血色；过肩黑棕微波浪长发，中分，两侧轻贴脸；偏纤瘦自然比例，肩窄、腰细；气质冷艳、略带街头性感；表情平静微撩，目光朝向镜头。
场景与穿搭：城市天台，金色时段侧光，远处楼宇虚成色块；穿白色贴身背心与高腰深蓝牛仔裤、裸踝短靴；腰线与腿线清晰。
姿势与构图：全身侧站靠矮墙，重心偏后腿，前腿微直，一手插裤袋，一手扶矮墙沿，头转向镜头；全身从头顶到靴尖完整可见。
排除：水印、logo、可读文字、乱码字、磨皮塑料感、像真实名人的面孔、未成年人或幼态特征、第二个人物、裸露、透视内衣作主穿着、浓妆过厚、节日装饰、半身裁切、头顶切框、膝盖以下被切出画。

———

调试时我习惯一次只动一格。被裁成半身了，先查比例锁有没有写死全身入画和机位高度；腿短或腰垮了，再查腰腿线；脸漂了，才动人物面孔。附图换景是一次动两处，场景与穿搭加姿势与构图；自己调单张时，才一次只动一格。

想套自己的场景，复制帖 2：首行、比例锁、腰腿线、人物面孔、排除不动，只改场景与穿搭和姿势与构图。两张换地方换穿搭换姿，别换身份。尺度保持编辑性感：贴身、露腿、姿态带撩，不写裸露。

GPT Image 2.5提示词：
9:16竖画幅，手机前置镜头光学写实人像摄影结合清透网感精修质感，整体色调以室内温馨的暖黄棕与燕麦奶茶色为主调，中低饱和度的暖调光影中凸显人物冷白肌肤与绯红妆容的细腻冷暖反差，采用近景人像特写、柔和美颜磨皮、局部动态模糊与高调柔光处理。机位采用视线平齐的第一人称互动视角、胸腰以上近景裁切，一位兼具呆萌与闷骚气质的甜美御姐人妻居中占据画面视觉核心，冷白皮肌肤在室内暖光映衬下显得娇嫩通透，前景下方由她亲手端起的一盘色泽诱人的红烧肉形成极具纵深感的视觉焦点与局部遮挡关系。她的躯干正对镜头略微前倾，右肩自然微抬而左肩舒展微沉，修长的天鹅颈轻柔前探，头部向画面右侧微微歪斜并抬眸迎向镜头，展现出亲昵投喂与分享美食的温婉动势。她的左手从画面右侧伸出，手指自然弯曲稳稳托握住白瓷盘的右侧边缘，将盛满红烧肉的带有黑色细描边的方形圆角白瓷深盘递向镜头前方；盘中大块方正的五花肉炖煮得浓油赤酱、肥瘦相间，底部浸润着深琥珀色浓稠汤汁并散落着白芝麻，顶端装饰着几簇翠绿鲜嫩的香菜叶；她的右手在画面左侧持一双暗红色木质筷子，正从盘中夹起一块泛着油润光泽的红烧肉悬于瓷盘左上方，筷尖与肉块带有轻微的真实动态模糊。她留着一头蓬松柔顺的深棕黑色长发，在脑后偏右侧挽成慵懒饱满的低盘发髻，两侧微卷刘海与一缕S型长发自然垂落脸颊旁及左胸前，几丝纤细碎发斜向轻拂过眉眼与鼻梁，左耳垂下摇曳着一枚璀璨的长款碎钻耳环；她身穿一件燕麦卡其色露肩针织上衣，圆领下方与胸前上方采用半透明薄纱网眼拼接设计，隐约透出锁骨与胸前的细腻肤色，胸下及袖口则为竖条纹罗纹针织材质，裸露的圆润双肩处搭配同色系细肩带，松软的针织袖管包裹手臂并形成自然的堆叠褶皱。她的眼神温柔且专注地直视镜头，佩戴灰棕色美瞳的双眸自然圆睁，上眼睑贴合着浓密卷翘的睫毛与精致眼线，饱满卧蚕下方晕着粉润微光，水润的玫瑰豆沙色双唇微微开启露出一丝洁白上齿边缘，双手在胸前分别托盘与持筷而与面部无接触，唇角想要向两侧大幅扬起展露甜笑却在微启的唇瓣边缘羞怯地收住。室内顶部的暖白筒灯与环境柔光从前上方倾泻而下，在她宛如凝脂薄瓷般的冷白肌肤上雕琢出柔亮细腻的奶油高光，眼下、苹果肌与鼻尖大面积晕染开的樱花粉腮红透出温热的次表面漫反射质感，灰棕色瞳孔中折射出清晰的晶莹水光高光，裸露的双肩与锁骨泛着柔和的丝缎光泽，下颌边缘与颈部沉淀着浅杏色的温暖环境反光，前景红烧肉表面的浓稠酱汁与油脂则在灯光下折射出晶莹剔透的琥珀色镜面高光。画面将微醺幻觉、浮生与留白的意境融入这方温馨的室内光影之中，空气里仿佛弥漫着人间烟火的醇厚香气与甜美暧昧的私密氛围，光影雕琢至像素级细腻真实，极简勾勒出由深色金属边框玻璃推拉门、暖色天花板及远处虚化的圆形筒灯光斑构成的现代居家背景。

院子里有传送门吗？怎么会有精灵女孩？

GPT Image 2.5提示词：
【任务与范式】 3:4 竖向画幅。构建一幅夏日庭院斑驳树影下的白金发色少女半身俯拍人像，以葱郁绿植作为自然留白负空间基底，呈现空灵梦幻的画意氛围。

【构图与机位】 采用腰部以上裁切的半身中景景别。使用 35mm 镜头高机位微俯拍，主体居中，右侧前景探入一片鲜亮阔叶形成局部遮挡与景深前移。设定 f/2.8
光圈，确保人物面容与胸前蕾丝清晰柔润，背景绿植与护栏自然虚化；高反差光斑边缘无紫边。

【场景与空间】
自然有机的户外庭院花园空间，严格遵循微俯视透视守恒。右侧前景斜伸出一片翠绿大叶；中景环绕浓密灌木与斑驳树干；左后方背景隐约可见黑色铁艺护栏与栏外模糊街景，保留真实自然的庭院空间层次。

【人物与服装】 视觉年龄约 18

侧逆光全身人像，常写成一片黑，或整张糊成柔光。不是模型不会打轮廓光，是主光方向、边缘高光、脸部辅光和背景亮度糊进同一句氛围词里，分不清谁勾边、谁保脸、谁压暗。

我把侧逆光拆成五格写：轮廓光指纹、人物面孔、场景与穿搭、姿势与构图、排除，排除也算一格。开头一行是题材和画幅的总述，是每张都不动的底子。骨架固定；四张只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行，轮廓光指纹与人物面孔不动。尺度是编辑性感：贴身、露腿、姿态带一点撩，不裸露；全身入画。下一条是第一张的完整提示词。

附图四张，同一套五格：落地窗黄昏、地下车库斜射、海边日落背光、酒店落地窗夜景。gpt-image-2.5 出图，AI 生成，人物是虚构的成年人。
posts.prompt:
换变体时，复制帖 2：首行总述、轮廓光指纹、人物面孔、排除一行一字不动；只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行。人脸描述四张保持一致。第一张就是帖 2 原文。下面三套直接替换：

图2｜地下车库斜射
场景与穿搭：地下车库过道，顶侧斜射冷白灯很硬、只作侧逆主光；水泥柱与地面干净，远处虚成灰块；穿白色贴身背心与高腰深灰裤、裸踝短靴；腰线与腿线清晰。
姿势与构图：全身微侧站在柱旁，重心偏一侧，一脚略前，一手插裤袋，另一手垂放，目光平视镜头；全身入画；肩臂与裤管外侧有细亮边。

图3｜海边日落背光
场景与穿搭：海边木栈道，日落低位背光偏侧、只勾轮廓；海面与天空虚成暖色块；穿深色裹身短裙、裙侧开衩与细带高跟；裙侧开衩可见腿线。
姿势与构图：全身站在栈道中央偏左，重心偏一髋，一腿微前交叉，一手提发侧，另一手垂放，头微侧，目光朝向镜头；头顶到鞋尖完整入画；发丝与肩线有金边高光。

图4｜酒店落地窗夜景
场景与穿搭：高层酒店落地窗前，窗外城市夜灯虚成小光斑，室内只留极弱环境反光；穿黑色高领贴身针织与皮质短裙、过膝靴；裙摆以上腿线可见。
姿势与构图：全身侧站靠窗，重心落右腿，左腿微前，一手轻扶玻璃，另一手自然垂放，目光朝向镜头；全身入画，腿线不断；肩背与发丝有冷边高光。

———

侧逆光全身美女人像，竖幅 9:16，写实摄影，时尚编辑风格。
轮廓光指纹：主光在身后偏侧，约四十五度侧逆；边缘高光勾肩线、锁骨、发丝与腿外侧；脸部靠弱环境反光或极弱辅光；暗部保留层次；背景比主体暗一档或虚成色块；轮廓光是主光。
人物面孔：虚构的成年女性，二十五岁上下，原创东亚或混血面孔；鹅蛋脸，微圆下颌，内双，鼻梁中等高，薄唇自然粉带一点水光；浅暖白肤色带一点奶杏，脸颊有自然血色；过肩黑棕微波浪长发，中分，两侧轻贴脸；偏纤瘦自然比例，肩窄、腰细；气质冷艳、略带街头性感；表情平静微撩，目光朝向镜头。
场景与穿搭：室内落地窗前，窗外黄昏金光很斜、只作侧逆主光；浅灰墙与地板干净平整；穿黑色贴身吊带短裙与细带高跟；腿线完整可见。
姿势与构图：全身侧站在窗前偏右，重心落后腿，前腿微直，一手轻扶窗框，另一手自然垂放，头微转向镜头；头顶到鞋尖完整入画；肩背与发丝有清晰边缘高光。
排除：水印、logo、可读文字、乱码字、磨皮塑料感、像真实名人的面孔、未成年人或幼态特征、第二个人物、裸露、透视内衣作主穿着、浓妆过厚、节日装饰、半身裁切、头顶切框、膝盖以下被切出画、正面大光箱、均匀柔光美颜灯、死黑糊暗、整图氛围滤镜。

———

调试时我习惯一次只动一格。整张发黑或轮廓没了，先查轮廓光指纹有没有写死主光在身后偏侧、边缘高光落点和脸部只靠弱辅光；脸糊了，再查人物面孔有没有被改短；景不对，才动场景与穿搭和姿势与构图。附图换景是一次动两处，场景与穿搭加姿势与构图；自己调单张时，才一次只动一格。

想套自己的场景，复制帖 2：首行、轮廓光指纹、人物面孔、排除不动，只改场景与穿搭和姿势与构图。四张换地方换穿搭换姿，别换身份。尺度保持编辑性感：贴身、露腿、姿态带撩，不写裸露；全身入画。

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

未竟之美 × 具象主题开放抽卡 × 完整与缺失的视觉关系 × 多元艺术媒介

从《石头记》的未完成性、断臂维纳斯的残缺之美及艺术史中的未完成作品获得启发，探索形体、结构、材料与时间中的未竟美学。
posts.prompt:
未竟之美 × 具象主题开放抽卡 × 完整与缺失的视觉关系 × 多元艺术媒介

从《石头记》的未完成性、断臂维纳斯的残缺之美及艺术史中的未完成作品获得启发，探索形体、结构、材料与时间中的未竟美学。

优先选择能在单张画面中直观呈现未完成状态的具象主题，让已完成或保存的部分与未竟部分形成审美张力。

【开放式抽卡】

每张独立组合以下变量，各组保持开放。

1. 具象主体：
自由探索具有鲜明形态与审美价值的主体，优先选择未完成状态容易通过单张画面辨识的对象。

2. 未竟机制：
根据主体自由探索不同的未完成状态，每张确定一种主要机制。机制应与主体及所选媒介的逻辑相符。

3. 完整与未竟：
根据主体和未竟机制，设计已完成或保存的部分与未竟部分之间的关系。自由变化其位置、比例、边界和过渡方式，使未竟状态融入主体自身的形态与结构。

4. 艺术媒介：
自由选择与主体及未竟机制相适应的真实或实验性媒介，遵循对应的制作方式、物理特征与变化逻辑。

5. 构图与呈现：
根据主体与未完成状态，自由选择景别、视角、空间、背景和光线，呈现作品的形态及其未竟特征。

【核心视觉逻辑】

未完成状态清晰可辨，主体保持可识别性与审美价值。未竟状态具有合理的结构与材料依据，并保留与其形成过程相符的痕迹。

完整与未竟的比例自由变化，不固定对半分割，也不要求每张都有破损。边界、过渡与空间关系自然可信，让观众能够想象未呈现的部分或最终完成的样子。

叙事、象征与情绪可以自然产生，以具象视觉表现为优先，不依赖文字说明。

【视觉品质】

遵循所选媒介的造型、材质、光影与制作逻辑。形体清晰，完成部分具有可信的精细度，未完成部分保留真实材料或工艺特征。

细节的来源、尺度与分布合理，减少无意义碎纹、异常斑驳、密集杂点、过度锐化和装饰堆积。避免随机破坏、人体结构错误、画面模糊及缺乏依据的材质混杂。

【系列规则】

n=10，连续生成10张独立单图，每次生成1张。每张探索不同的具象主题、未竟机制、艺术媒介与构图。

优先形成不同的整体轮廓、材料关系与视觉结构，减少主体类型、未竟呈现方式及画面组织的重复。每张都是独立成立的艺术作品，共同呈现未竟之美的不同形式。

竖版9:16，不拼图、不宫格、不分屏。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。

画面上方偏左位置使用超大号、高级复古衬线字体，深咖啡棕色，分两行排版：

FALL IN
LOVE.

标题采用具有明显粗细对比的时尚杂志衬线字体，字母精致，行距紧凑，产生强烈的视觉冲击。

主标题下方增加小号副标题：
YOUR SEASONAL COFFEE RITUAL

【中心产品主视觉】

一杯真实的南瓜拿铁外带热咖啡放置在浅米色石材桌面上。

纸杯米白色，杯身中间环绕真实的牛皮纸杯套，杯套上清晰印有橙色南瓜图案和品牌名称 PUMPKIN & CO.

杯子使用完整闭合的低矮白色塑料外带热饮杯盖，具有真实饮口、凸起边缘和塑料纹理。

一缕柔和半透明的白色热气从饮口自然升起，轻盈、细腻。

采用真实商业产品摄影质感，杯子作为视觉中心，体积突出，比例正常，产品清晰锐利。

杯子旁点缀一个小型橙色南瓜、两根肉桂棒和少量自然散落的秋叶。装饰元素保持克制。

左上方温暖阳光照亮纸杯，在桌面形成真实、统一的自然阴影。

在画面底部设置精致的信息排版区，采用清晰的网格布局。

左侧使用较大的现代无衬线字体：

PUMPKIN
SPICE LATTE

下方使用小号文字：
WARM SPICES · SMOOTH ESPRESSO
THE TASTE OF FALL

右下角放置一个精致的南瓜橙色圆形印章，内部清晰写着：

LIMITED
EDITION

底部横向分隔线下方安排品牌广告语：

SIP THE SEASON.

【设计要求】

必须呈现完整的商业海报设计，海报上的标题、副标题、品牌名称、产品名称、广告语和限定标签都要实际生成在画面中。

排版具有专业设计感，字体大小层级鲜明，标题具有明显视觉冲击，产品与文字互不遮挡。

所有英文必须正确拼写，文字边缘清晰，避免乱码、错字、重复文字。

画面既有真实摄影的产品质感，又有高级平面设计的商业完成度。

避免普通手机照片、缺少文字的产品摄影、过度复杂的装饰、夸张 CGI、奶油堆顶、冰淇淋形状、假塑料质感、光影错误。

posts.prompt:
A realistic photograph seen directly through the optical peephole of the FRONT DOOR of an American suburban detached house at night. The viewer is inside the house, looking OUTSIDE. Beyond the door is an open-air covered front porch and a typical American front yard: a concrete path leading across a lawn toward a quiet residential street, a driveway off to one side, shrubs beside the porch, and a neighboring detached house faintly visible across the street. NOT an apartment hallway, enclosed corridor, or interior room.

About one meter outside the front door, a single adult-height ghost stands on the porch facing the peephole, head slightly tilted. An old opaque white cotton bedsheet completely covers its body, with believable weight, fine fabric texture, irregular folds and a slightly dirty hem touching the porch floor. Only two roughly cut black eye holes; no visible face, skin or glowing eyes. Hands hidden beneath the sheet. It stands physically on the ground with a plausible contact shadow; no floating or transparency.

Authentic optical door-peephole view: a large circular image centered within a 16:9 landscape frame, surrounded by deep black optical vignette, filling most of the frame height. Strong natural fisheye barrel distortion bends porch posts, roof edges and the walkway near the image perimeter. Center relatively sharp, edges softly blurred with slight chromatic aberration. We see THROUGH the peephole, not a picture OF a door or peephole. No observer, camera or phone visible.

One ordinary porch light casts uneven warm light onto the sheet and porch boards. Beyond the porch, the yard is dim, with weak cool streetlight. Natural low-light noise, limited dynamic range, imperfect exposure, slightly off-center composition. An unsettling everyday snapshot, not a polished horror movie. Real materials, coherent perspective and shadows. No fog, smoke, neon, dramatic cinematic lighting, CGI, illustration, text, timestamps, logos or watermarks. Landscape 16:9.

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

空间悖论与视觉错觉 × 事物与场景开放抽卡 × 《纪念碑谷》式游戏美术 × 风格化三维渲染 × 随机Q版角色彩蛋

深入借鉴《纪念碑谷》的空间解谜设计与埃舍尔的不可能空间作品，将主体转译为局部看似合理、整体无法成立的视觉奇观。

【开放式抽卡】

1. 主体

自由探索不同领域、时代、文化与尺度的具象主题，涵盖独立对象、复合结构及完整场景，保留鲜明辨识度。

优先选择适合承载清晰空间矛盾的主体。主体或相关空间须具有可辨认的结构、连接与参照，能够在单张画面中呈现矛盾。

可先设计悖论再选择主体，也可从主体自身结构出发构思悖论；若两者难以自然结合，重新设计或抽取。

2. 空间悖论

每张设计一种核心空间矛盾。明确参与悖论的部位、各部位的连接、空间参照与局部关系，说明沿结构如何追踪，以及哪些空间判断无法同时成立。

悖论形式根据主体变化，保持开放。单纯弯曲、成环或悬浮，不能直接作为空间悖论的依据。

3. 结构转译

借鉴《纪念碑谷》与埃舍尔对视角、透视、遮挡和深度的组织，将矛盾融入主体自身的结构或与主体相关的空间。

局部连接看似合理，整体关系相互矛盾。关键边缘、连接点和判断所需的参照清楚可见，观众能够在同一视角下沿结构追踪，并指出具体冲突，无需依靠文字说明或想象补全。

4. 场景与叙事

随机探索环境、事件、空间层次与尺度关系，营造奇妙的探索感。场景造型与元素随主体变化，自然融入整体，并服务于空间矛盾的呈现。

5. 视觉风格

采用《纪念碑谷》式极简几何游戏美术与风格化三维渲染。造型简洁，体块与空间层次清楚，保留主体特征；配色、材质表现与光线随主体和场景变化，保持统一的风格化处理。

6. 构图与视角

选择能清楚呈现悖论的观察角度，随机探索景别、主体位置、留白与画面组织。关键连接和参照关系清晰可辨。

7. 随机彩蛋

每张随机选择一位不同的动漫或游戏成年女性角色，以小巧可辨的Q版造型隐藏在画面次要区域。保留角色标志性特征，随机变化位置、动作、表情及与空间的趣味互动，视觉风格与画面统一。

【视觉原则】

第一眼辨认主体，第二眼发现空间悖论，第三眼寻找隐藏彩蛋。

优先保证空间矛盾成立。同批主体、悖论设计、场景、构图与彩蛋角色保持差异，避免固定几何结构和重复组合。

生成前先给出本轮每张图片的完整提示词，逐张写清主体、局部关系、关键连接、空间参照与具体矛盾，再按顺序逐张生成。

成图后依据画面检查矛盾是否成立；若无法指出具体冲突，重新设计结构、生成并复检。若仍无法确认，明确说明问题。

n=10，9:16竖版，每张独立生成，不拼图、不宫格、不分屏。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。
