posts.text:
GPT2 x 甜品日签 x 奶油插画 x 提示词

天一冷就想吃点热乎的甜的，干脆做了一套秋冬甜品日签，从今天排到下周一。奶油底，左上是月份和星期，右上一个大日期，下面放一份甜品，底下一截磨砂玻璃把甜品糊成一团颜色，当手机壁纸挺舒服。

四张是栗子蒙布朗、南瓜派、热可可棉花糖、苹果肉桂挞。

提示词分两段。上面「画面风格」管版式、底色、字的位置、光和插画质感，这段别动。下面「主体」写你要放的东西和日期，换成自己想吃的、想放的，日期改成哪天，就是你自己的日签。做月签也一样，日期那里写月份就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

画面风格 Visual system（版式、底色、字体、光感、插画质感，原样保留）:
一张竖幅 3:4 的甜品日签海报，整张是平整的暖奶油白底色，干净无纹理。上方约三分之一大面积留白：左上角用纯黑色、圆润几何感的无衬线字体写一个大号全大写英文月份名，月份名正上方左对齐一行小号、细字重的同款字体全大写英文星期；右上角与月份名同一高度放一个超大号纯黑粗体日期数字，字形饱满醒目。三处文字都清晰锐利、字距舒展，左右边距一致。画面中下部是一份被放大的甜品，主体占据画面下方约三分之二，左右两侧和底边自然出框，顶部高点伸到画面中线附近，主物居中，小配件斜向穿插在两侧形成高低错落。甜品不是照片，而是简化造型的柔和 3D 插画：形体概括成圆润饱满的大体块，细节少而干净，明暗是平滑连续的渐变，表面有糖果和软陶般的蜡润光泽与柔和高光，奶油部分哑光丝滑，略带玩具感但不卡通化，没有描边，也不出现真实食物的细碎颗粒、粗糙纹理和摄影景深。大面积柔光从左上方照入，色温中性偏暖，亮部呈奶白，阴影轻薄柔软，只在物体交叠处加深，没有硬边投影。甜品一直延伸到画面底边，画面下方约五分之二横贯一整块半透明磨砂玻璃面板，上沿是一条水平直线，盖住甜品的下半段，面板后方的甜品被大幅柔化成朦胧的色团，上半部的甜品保持清晰，形成清晰与朦胧的上下对照；磨砂面板上不放任何文字或日历。色彩上暖奶油白占最大面积，甜品自身的颜色集中在中下部，黑色只用于文字。画面中的文字只有这三处：英文星期、英文月份名、日期数字，不要出现日历格、年份、其他数字或文字、品牌、logo、水印、黑色圆形标志或人物。整体干净、清甜、温柔，像一张可以直接当手机壁纸的日签。

主体 New subject（只改这一段）:
一份秋天的烤栗子蒙布朗：栗子奶油挤成一圈圈细长的面条状螺旋，堆成一座圆润的小山，山顶放一颗油亮的糖渍栗子，撒一层薄薄糖粉，底下是一层白色奶油和酥脆塔底；两侧斜插几颗裂开口的带壳烤栗子和一片焦糖色薄脆饼干。主色是栗子棕、焦糖色和奶白。文字：星期写 FRIDAY，月份名写 OCTOBER，日期数字写 30。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

天一冷就想吃点热乎的甜的，干脆做了一套秋冬甜品日签，从今天排到下周一。奶油底，左上是月份和星期，右上一个大日期，下面放一份甜品，底下一截磨砂玻璃把甜品糊成一团颜色，当手机壁纸挺舒服。

四张是栗子蒙布朗、南瓜派、热可可棉花糖、苹果肉桂挞。

提示词分两段。上面「画面风格」管版式、底色、字的位置、光和插画质感，这段别动。下面「主体」写你要放的东西和日期，换成自己想吃的、想放的，日期改成哪天，就是你自己的日签。做月签也一样，日期那里写月份就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

画面风格 Visual system（版式、底色、字体、光感、插画质感，原样保留）:
一张竖幅 3:4 的甜品日签海报，整张是平整的暖奶油白底色，干净无纹理。上方约三分之一大面积留白：左上角用纯黑色、圆润几何感的无衬线字体写一个大号全大写英文月份名，月份名正上方左对齐一行小号、细字重的同款字体全大写英文星期；右上角与月份名同一高度放一个超大号纯黑粗体日期数字，字形饱满醒目。三处文字都清晰锐利、字距舒展，左右边距一致。画面中下部是一份被放大的甜品，主体占据画面下方约三分之二，左右两侧和底边自然出框，顶部高点伸到画面中线附近，主物居中，小配件斜向穿插在两侧形成高低错落。甜品不是照片，而是简化造型的柔和 3D 插画：形体概括成圆润饱满的大体块，细节少而干净，明暗是平滑连续的渐变，表面有糖果和软陶般的蜡润光泽与柔和高光，奶油部分哑光丝滑，略带玩具感但不卡通化，没有描边，也不出现真实食物的细碎颗粒、粗糙纹理和摄影景深。大面积柔光从左上方照入，色温中性偏暖，亮部呈奶白，阴影轻薄柔软，只在物体交叠处加深，没有硬边投影。甜品一直延伸到画面底边，画面下方约五分之二横贯一整块半透明磨砂玻璃面板，上沿是一条水平直线，盖住甜品的下半段，面板后方的甜品被大幅柔化成朦胧的色团，上半部的甜品保持清晰，形成清晰与朦胧的上下对照；磨砂面板上不放任何文字或日历。色彩上暖奶油白占最大面积，甜品自身的颜色集中在中下部，黑色只用于文字。画面中的文字只有这三处：英文星期、英文月份名、日期数字，不要出现日历格、年份、其他数字或文字、品牌、logo、水印、黑色圆形标志或人物。整体干净、清甜、温柔，像一张可以直接当手机壁纸的日签。

主体 New subject（只改这一段）:
一份秋天的烤栗子蒙布朗：栗子奶油挤成一圈圈细长的面条状螺旋，堆成一座圆润的小山，山顶放一颗油亮的糖渍栗子，撒一层薄薄糖粉，底下是一层白色奶油和酥脆塔底；两侧斜插几颗裂开口的带壳烤栗子和一片焦糖色薄脆饼干。主色是栗子棕、焦糖色和奶白。文字：星期写 FRIDAY，月份名写 OCTOBER，日期数字写 30。

霓虹酒馆，JK 赴约

GPT Image 2.5提示词：
9:16竖画幅.真实光学手机室内摄影结合高清人像精修质感，整体呈浓郁的魅惑宝蓝背光与暖黄霓虹交织的冷暖撞色色调，带有柔和的灯光漫射光晕、细腻景深与清透柔焦效果。采用略低角度平视的全身中全景机位，一位身材高挑丰满、双腿修长、肌肤冷白的傲沉微醺御姐学姐居中偏右落座于餐吧高脚椅上，画面左下角边缘有一抹极浅的黄绿色虚化前景遮挡。她的躯干侧向画面左前方并慵懒斜倚在深色木质高脚桌边缘，背部微弓，展现出曼妙的S型坐姿曲线，头部微向右侧倾斜面向镜头。她的右臂屈肘支在桌面上，右手轻托住右侧脸颊与下颌；左臂弯曲收于桌前，左手纤长手指轻触一只装满金黄色果茶、插着白色吸管并点缀橙片的透明玻璃杯外壁；修长双腿在桌下呈优雅的二郎腿交叠姿态，右大腿紧密搭在左大腿上方，右脚穿着深棕色亮面乐福皮鞋悬空微翘于左下方，左腿向下延伸并以左脚尖轻点地面。她留着乌黑蓬松的齐刘海长发并披散于肩背；身穿修身白色长袖JK制服衬衫，领口系着红白斜纹领带；下身搭配高腰蓝灰黄格纹百褶超短裙，裙摆自然铺展于深蓝皮质高脚椅垫上；双腿包裹着极薄的高光泽油亮黑色连裤袜，大腿根部隐约透出防滑暗边，紧绷的尼龙纤维在交叠的大腿、膝盖与小腿前侧呈现出细腻的透肉质感与液态丝光。她的视线自齐刘海下方迷离直视镜头，双眸微睁且瞳孔闪烁着点状水光高光，上眼睑带着慵懒的微压感，卧蚕与双颊晕染着微醺的暖粉红晕，右手轻轻托在右侧脸颊旁，红润双唇处于微张静态位置，微启的红唇想要轻轻合拢却在微露洁白贝齿的边缘娇憨停驻。左上方的暖黄霓虹与餐吧射灯斜洒而下，在她的发顶勾勒出暖金色发丝轮廓光，并在超薄油亮黑丝包裹的右大腿前侧、左膝盖高点与小腿胫骨上激发出贯通的液态银白高光带与一抹明亮的暖黄聚光光斑，冷白如薄瓷的面部与手背肌肤透出温润的粉橘色次表面漫反射，玻璃杯中的冰饮也折射出通透的琥珀色光泽。背景是复古工业风餐吧，左上方悬挂着耀眼的黄色发光霓虹灯牌与液晶电视，左侧红砖墙旁摆放着黄花玻璃瓶，右后方是泛着深邃宝蓝色背光的木格酒架与酒瓶，将微醺幻觉、流萤与浮生的意境融入暧昧的餐吧夜色之中，把油亮黑丝的液态丝光与冷暖光影雕琢至像素级真实。

A photorealistic lifestyle photograph of a stylish young woman sitting elegantly at a beautiful modern outdoor café surrounded by lush green plants and natural sunlight. She has long, silky, naturally straight dark hair flowing gracefully over her shoulders and wears sophisticated black oversized sunglasses, a perfectly tailored black oversized blazer over a fitted black top, elegant cream-white wide-leg trousers, and delicate silver jewelry. A stylish silver wristwatch, small elegant earrings, and a minimal necklace add a touch of luxury to her overall appearance.

She sits comfortably on a modern woven café chair beside a beautiful wooden table, with one hand gently supporting her chin while looking slightly to the side with a calm, confident, and sophisticated expression. Her legs are crossed naturally, creating an effortless executive-fashion pose. On the table, there is an open slim silver laptop, a smartphone, and a takeaway coffee cup with elegant minimal lettering. A luxurious black quilted handbag with a gold chain strap rests beside the laptop, completing her premium fashion aesthetic.

The café features a contemporary outdoor terrace design with large glass windows, natural wooden furniture, woven chairs, decorative green plants, and beautiful white flowers. Behind her, a stylish minimalist wall displays the inspirational words "Dream, Plan, Achieve" in elegant handwritten typography. The background includes softly blurred café guests, lush greenery, and subtle architectural details that create a sophisticated urban atmosphere.

Warm natural afternoon sunlight filters through the surrounding trees, illuminating her face, hair, outfit, and the café environment with beautiful soft highlights and realistic shadows. The overall atmosphere feels luxurious, peaceful, modern, and effortlessly professional.

Natural skin texture, realistic facial details, individual hair strands, accurate body proportions, detailed blazer fabric, realistic clothing folds, natural hand positioning, authentic jewelry reflections, premium handbag texture, realistic laptop and smartphone surfaces, and beautifully balanced environmental lighting.

💎 GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

Art Deco 装饰艺术 × 多领域主题 × 几何造型与装饰秩序 × 复古现代美学

每张从艺术、建筑、人物、神话、自然、科技、日常物品及流行文化中随机选择一个不同的主体，结合主体特点，自主选择适合的 Art Deco 视觉方向。

以1920至1930年代装饰艺术的设计语言重新诠释主体。提炼其标志性轮廓，将主要形体概括为清晰的几何结构与流畅曲面，保留必要识别特征。

运用放射、阶梯、折线、扇形或其他装饰艺术母题，建立富有节奏的视觉关系。装饰与主体造型自然融合，疏密有致。

根据题材选择协调的色彩与材质，可以呈现高级漆器与金属、建筑石材、光滑丝缎、复古平面印刷或流线型工业材料，保持整体视觉语言统一。

自由安排主体姿态、景别、视角、位置及画面留白，突出鲜明轮廓、几何秩序与视觉张力。

同批作品的主体、主要构图、装饰母题及色彩关系具有明显差异。

竖版9:16。左下角保留克制的深蓝色实心圆点与白色手写体“DeepBlue”签名。

n=10，每张独立生成，不制作拼图。

🪭 GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

动漫或游戏角色古画转译 × 中国古代饰品与妆容 × 意境场景开放抽卡 × 大面积像素排序 × 东方极简编辑式构图 × 人物与题诗共同编排

每张随机选择一位不同的成年动漫或游戏角色，保留标志性发型、服饰外形、配饰与代表色，结合角色气质融入中国古代饰品与妆容。

以中国传统人物画的简练线描和大块淡彩描绘角色与古代场景。头发概括为清楚的大形，衣纹与饰品适度简化；面部以简练线条描绘，保留神态和角色识别特征。人物与环境笔法统一，纸绢肌理自然。

像素排序占画面约40%～50%，成为与人物共同主导构图的视觉元素。人物或景物的一部分转化为细密、平行、长短不一的笔直色带，沿同一方向排列，承接原画的色彩与明暗，与清晰画面形成鲜明对照。角色面部与关键识别特征保持清楚。

采用东方极简编辑式构图，协调人物、像素条带与留白。根据角色的性格、故事或能力，创作简短中文题词或短诗，以小幅书法融入画面。题词或题诗的部分笔画融入像素排序，与画面中的条带相互呼应，同时保留清晰字形，文字准确可读。

画面文字仅包含角色题词或短诗及左下角签名。

同批角色不重复，自由变化造型、场景、动作、构图、题诗与排序区域。

n=10，9:16竖版。每次生成一张，连续生成10张独立单图，不制作拼图或分屏。

左下角签名：深蓝色实心圆点，后接白色手写体「DeepBlue」，保持克制，不遮挡主体。

GPT2 x 月光山谷一点暖灯 x 夜景绘画 x 提示词

睡前来点安静的。山谷里一轮大月亮，松树和云都是蓝绿色的，只有山脚一小块地方亮着暖灯。

四张：湖边的帐篷、盘山路边的小卖部、下雪的小站台、海湾里停着的渔船。都不在城里，亮的就那一小片和一串小灯泡。

提示词里冷光暖光分开写：月光只负责勾树尖和云边，暖光只照中间那一小块。混在一起写，画面很容易发灰。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅约 9:16 的月夜山谷数字绘画，笔触细腻、边缘略带绘画感，介于电影概念图和绘本插画之间。机位在近处低处，平视略仰；近景是草地、石块、灌木或雪堆等深色前景，点缀少量洋红、紫蓝和白色的小色点；中景是画面里唯一的暖光处；远景是两侧高耸的深青绿松林夹出一道山谷，谷底尽头是层叠的雪线山峰，上方大片夜空。一轮满月悬在画面上部正中偏右，月光把周围翻卷的云团边缘照成亮青白色，天空从墨蓝过渡到深靛，散着零星星点。光线分两套：冷的月光从上方后侧打下来，只给松树尖、山脊和云边勾出蓝青色轮廓；暖的人造光集中在中景左下方一小块，橙黄灯光和一串串小灯泡把周围一小片地面和物件照成暖金色，衰减很快。蓝绿和墨蓝占大半画面，暖橙金只占约一成但最亮。不要城市楼群、亮窗成排、霓虹、白天感的天空或过曝的月亮。安静、远离人群、被山围着的温暖。

New subject:
中景是山谷里一片小湖的岸边，一顶尖顶帆布帐篷从里面透出暖黄的灯光，帐篷前拉着一串小灯泡挂到一根木杆上，旁边一张折叠小桌、两把露营椅和一只冒着热气的搪瓷水壶，平静的湖面倒映着月亮和那串灯。画面里没有人，也没有可辨认的文字、品牌或标志。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

GPT2 x 复古明信片 x 做旧纸质 x 提示词

傍晚放一套能直接拿去用的：旧明信片，上面一张风景照，下面是背面，贴着邮票、盖着邮戳、写了一句话，纸边磨得发白。

四张寄自四个地方：大理、苏州、哈尔滨、厦门。提示词拆成「画面」和「主体」两段，上面那段别动，下面换成你去过的地方、邮票图案和想写的那句话就行。

图上的字我只留了四处：POST CARD、地名、邮戳年份、一句手写中文。字一多模型就开始乱写，少一点好核对。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅约 4:5 的复古明信片展示图。背景是一张铺满画面的当地风景照片，略微失焦、偏暗、低饱和，只作环境底图。前景上下叠放同一张明信片的正面和背面，各占画面宽度约四分之三，横向放置，彼此轻微错位，边缘落下细软的投影。上方正面是一张带白色窄边框的彩色风景照片，色彩偏旧、轻微褪色并带胶片颗粒，四角磨损、发黄、有细小折痕。下方背面是做旧的米黄色卡纸，纸面有淡淡的水渍斑、细小纤维和磨白的边角；中间一条细竖线分隔，左侧是手写留言区，右侧上方是细小的衬线体印刷标题，右上角贴一枚带齿孔的原创小插画邮票，邮票上压着一个圆形邮戳和几道波浪消印线，右下是几条空着的细地址横线。手写字用深蓝墨水钢笔书写，笔画有轻微洇墨。光线是柔和均匀的漫射日光，略偏暖，纸面没有强反光。配色由底图的环境色、旧纸米黄、深蓝墨水和邮票上的一两个小色块组成。图上只出现 New subject 里写明的文字，每一处都要拼写准确、只出现一次，其余位置留白或只有空横线，不出现真实品牌、卡通形象或其他文字。安静、私人，像一张从旅途中寄回来的纪念。

正面照片：高原湖边一条长长的木栈道伸进湖里，尽头一棵歪着长的小树，远处是连绵的青山和大朵白云。背景底图：失焦的湖面和远山。邮票图案：一枝粉紫色的三角梅。图上文字只有四处：背面右上的印刷标题「POST CARD」；邮票底部小字「DALI」；邮戳圆圈里「2026」；左侧留言区一行手写中文「风很大，想你」。除此以外没有任何文字、品牌或标志。

做了四只：垂耳兔、小狐狸、柴犬、浣熊。最喜欢浣熊那张，面罩和爪子扒墙边的样子特别像真的在偷看。

上面 Visual system 那段固定，下面 New subject 换成别的小动物就行，刺猬、水獭、小熊猫都可以试。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅接近 9:16 的竖幅纸本透明水彩插画。画面被一道近乎竖直、略有起伏的破碎墙沿分成左右两块同色系蓝色域：左侧约占四成的浅天蓝到冰蓝前景墙面，右侧是深群青到钴蓝的湿中湿背景；边沿夹着细窄、不连续的白纸留白和少量灰蓝裂痕，避免机械直线。柔和偏冷的漫射光从左上方照入，背景以湿画法铺出蓝色浓淡流动，保留自然水痕、回流花、颜料沉积与粗纹水彩纸颗粒。构图采用与主体眼睛近乎齐平的正面机位，大面积环境包围小主体：可替换的小动物从墙沿后悄悄探出头与少量胸口，身体大部分被遮住，位于画面中下部、略偏右，约占画幅六分之一，上方保留充裕蓝色留白。主体亮部多用纸白，以极淡灰蓝和米白塑形，面部仅点少许浅粉暖色；眼鼻稍清晰，毛缘局部融入水色。不要文字、标志、边框、均匀数码渐变或过度写实毛发。整体松动通透、安静好奇。

GPT2 x 草野里一个人 x 黑白木刻 x 提示词

下午来一组黑白的。木刻版画，只有纸白和墨黑，草叶全是短刀刻出来的白痕，斜着切过画面，一个人小小的黑影站在里面。

四张换场地：麦田背影、海边礁石撑伞、雪坡牵狗、河边拎水桶。人一直是剪影，五官不用画。

灰阶一定要禁掉。模型一开灰就变成素描，木刻那股「刻出来」的劲就没了。斜切地平也别改直，直了画面会呆。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅约 3:4 的黑白木刻/线刻版画，只有纸白与墨黑，没有灰色中间调。高对比：大面积墨黑天空或暗部，密密麻麻的白色刻痕表现草叶、雪坡或浪纹，刻痕短促、斜向、疏密有节奏，看得出刀痕与印压颗粒；纸面白底带轻微纤维，墨面可有极淡印版木纹。构图斜切：地平或草海边缘从左下往右上倾斜，人物以实心黑色孤影剪影出现，多半是背影或侧影，五官细节弱化，人物比例偏小。机位略高或平视中景，前景刻痕更密、远景略疏；人物在草叶/雪/浪之间显得小而稳，周围纹理把人物托住。不要数码平滑渐变，不要照片写实，不要彩色。画面没有任何文字、签名或数字。安静、孤寂，像一张手印的黑白版画。

New subject:
麦田里的背影：斜切的高密麦浪用白色短刻痕表现，墨黑天空占上三分之一；一个穿短外套的人背影站在麦田中，双手插兜，剪影实心黑色。画面中没有文字。

2. Edit one: repaint the car

Each model got its own still back with the same instruction: paint the car cherry red and keep everything else. All three repainted it.

posts.text:
GPT2 x 留白器物海报 x 极简排版 x 提示词

傍晚发个能直接拿去用的，留白器物海报。背景几乎是空的，右下放一件小东西，左边写几个字，像手册里的单页。

四张换的是这件东西：一把木梳、一支钢笔、一只亚麻托特包、一只素烧小碗。标题和物件名都写在「主体」里，画面风格那段不用动。

字只留四处：标题、一行小说明、物件名、日期。品牌名我都没用真的。这种图最容易在空白处偷偷加Logo或者把字写错，所以提示词里要写「逐字照写，除此之外不要再加字」。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 3:4 的极简器物海报，像品牌手册里的单页：大部分是干净、均匀的浅色背景，几乎占掉画面的三分之二，只有一件实物放在画面偏下、偏右的位置，体积不大，周围留出大量空白。光线是柔和的棚拍平光，微微从左上方来，器物底下只有一小片很淡的接触阴影，没有戏剧性的硬影。背景色和器物是同一色系的浅色，饱和度低。文字很少，而且位置固定：左上或左侧有一行竖排或横排的中文标题（四个字），标题旁边或下方可以有一行更小的说明；器物附近或左下有物件名称；再允许一处很小的日期或短句。全部文字都要逐字照写、端正、间距均匀，用细的衬线或细黑体，颜色是深灰或近黑，不要花体、不要英文段落、不要Logo、不要假印章里的乱码。整张海报上的文字最多四处，除此之外不添加任何字母、数字或签名。质感是安静的产品摄影加极简中文排版，不要插画风，不要复杂场景。留白、克制，可以直接拿去做展览页或桌面壁纸。

New subject:

最容易翻车的是字。一写多，它就开始在角落里编英文段落。刊名我用的是 STREET LEVEL，不是某个真实杂志。

New subject:
【主体】刊名："STREET LEVEL"；主标题："KICK UP"；口号："WHEELS LEAVE FIRST."；底部："VOL. 01"。镜头贴在滑板场地面，前景是一块滑板的尾部和一只刚要离开板面的运动鞋，板轮几乎顶到镜头，滑板的人在上空，城市围网在远处。强调色用青绿。全图只有这四处文字。

GPT2 x 上路的对照页 x 复古波点 x 提示词

中午发一组对照页。上面是一张实景照片，下面用粗黑线和细波点画成一张旅行海报，字不多，像从画册里撕下来的一页。

四张换的是去哪儿：竹林里的绿皮火车、晚上的夜市巷、沙漠里一座驿站、雪后的温泉小镇。上面拍照、下面画海报的方法都不变。

下面那张海报最容易写满字。标题、一行小说明、中文地名，三处就够，再写就挤，也容易出现乱码署名。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 3:4 的对照页，上下两截，中间用一条很细的米白纸边隔开，像旅行画册里的单页。上半是一张横向铺满的实景旅行照片：天空和地形占满上半张，色彩饱满，光线是明确的自然光（晨昏或晴天），有真实的空气透视和照片颗粒，不要插画、不要角色。下半是同一地点改画成的日系复古旅行海报，底是米白或浅奶油色，主体用粗黑勾线和平涂颜色，天空或空白处铺着均匀的细密波点（半调网点），再点几朵扁平的白色云和一轮扁平的黄或橘黄太阳。下半左侧是排版区，右侧是插画场景，左右分得清楚，不要把字叠到建筑或主体上。下半文字只允许三处，且必须逐字照写、拼写正确、对齐干净：1）左侧超大的英文标题，细长无衬线或细线衬线，左对齐，可两行；2）标题下两行更小的英文短说明；3）再下方一行中文地名或短名。不要再写编号、署名、Prompt by、品牌、网址，不要条形码。插画配色克制：黑线，米白底，场景用有限的平涂（青绿、土黄、砖红、天蓝里只取和照片呼应的几块），波点是深灰或黑。质感上半是摄影，下半是粗线丝网/复古海报印刷，不要 3D、不要写实插画、不要水彩晕染。整张没有水印和真实品牌。干净、像能直接撕下来去旅行。

New subject:
【主体】上半是一条深绿竹林夹着的铁道，一列墨绿色的绿皮火车正从弯道里开出来，车窗透着暖黄灯，地面有薄雾，天气是阴天里突然漏下来的一层顶光。下半英文标题："BAMBOO LINE"；英文说明："A SLOW TRAIN THROUGH THE GROVE"；中文名：「竹林慢车」。插画里用粗黑线画火车、竹丛和一条弯曲铁轨，背景是细波点和一轮扁平浅黄太阳。全图只有这三处文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 远处一盏灯 x 月下夜景 x 提示词

睡前发一张安静的。深蓝的夜，一弯很细的月亮，几座软软的山影，最下面只有一点暖灯，整张只有这一处暖色。

四张换的是那盏灯在哪：山脚的小木屋、湖上的小船、海岬上的灯塔、草原上的帐篷。山影、月牙的位置不动，只换底下那一小点。不要人，不要字，也不要印章。

暖色一共只留月牙和灯两处，别让它大面积发光。越暗越好看，睡前看也不刺眼。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):

posts.text:
Video created with @Grok @Imagine
#GrokImaginePromptShare

Image Prompt (GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst):
An outdoor Art Deco train station platform, retro-futuristic. A sleek silver bullet train waits at the platform. A dozen or so passengers stand in small groups and walk along the platform, not blocking the train. Above the entrance archway, a brass sign reads "GRAND CENTRAL TERMINAL". On the side of the train, a small nameplate reads "AURORA EXPRESS". Both signs appear exactly once, fully legible, no duplicate text, no invented words. Bright afternoon light, open sky. Cinematic, elegant, luxurious.

Video Prompt (Grok Imagine):
0–4s: The silver bullet train sits at the platform, doors closed. A dozen passengers stand in small groups, some turning toward the train.
4–9s: The train's underglow brightens. It begins to glide forward toward the bottom right corner of the frame and keeps moving in that direction without reversing. The train is long, made up of many carriages, so the tail stays in the scene as the front advances. Passengers step back slightly as it passes.
9–15s: The train continues moving toward the bottom right, but because of its length, the rear carriages are still crossing the platform as the clip ends. The front of the train moves out of frame while the tail remains visible.
Camera holds steady throughout, a slight push-in at the start then static. Bright afternoon light, open sky. Ambient sound: rising electric hum, wheels on track, wind, a distant station chime.

Image Prompt (GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst):
A photograph of a surfer carving across the face of a large breaking wave. The surfer is mid-turn, body crouched low, spray flying from the board's edge. The wave is translucent green-blue, backlit by morning sun, with white foam churning below. Water droplets hang in the air around the surfer. The surfer carves hard across the wave, board spraying water as they turn. The wave curls and breaks behind them, foam churning forward. Camera tracks alongside, keeping the surfer in frame as they ride toward the shore.

經典動漫遊戲女性角色 × 巨型公共藝術裝置 × 現實世界玩具化 × 荒誕日常互動

每張獨立選擇一位具有鮮明辨識度的經典動漫或遊戲成年女性角色，保留原作標誌性髮型、發色、經典服裝、代表配色與關鍵配飾。

將角色轉譯為一座矗立於真實城市環境中的超大型實體人物雕塑，整體尺度接近周圍多層建築，保持角色原作的造型辨識度。

根據角色性格、身份、能力或經典劇情，自由設計一個有趣的日常互動事件。

巨型角色正在與一件正常尺寸的現實物品發生直接接觸，彷彿成年人擺弄微型玩具。互動動作自然、有故事性，形成強烈而清晰的尺度反差。

物件保持真實世界的正常尺寸、結構和材質，與附近行人及城市設施的比例一致。巨型人物的手指、身體或服飾與物件形成清楚、可信的接觸關係，重量分布、支撐位置和陰影合理。

周圍保留正常尺寸的行人、車輛、建築及城市生活細節，強化巨型雕塑與現實世界的尺度關係。

真實公共藝術現場攝影，攝影機記錄整座裝置與環境的自然關係，真實日光或合理現場照明，具有荒誕幽默感和強烈視覺衝擊力。

每張為獨立單圖，竪版9:16。

用 ChatGPT Images 2.6 给自己的 logo 做了一组“编辑部档案海报”，效果比我预想的好很多。

做法很简单：上传 logo，套下面这段提示词，比例选 4:5。它会把主体压成黑白剪影，再叠上期号、条形码、裁切线、竖排注释和一句手写宣言，像时装杂志封面、品牌广告和个人宣言揉成了一张图。

提示词（英文原版，直接复制）：

SUBJECT = "[person / brand / archetype / object]"
STYLE_DOMAIN = "[fashion / music / luxury / tech / art / sport]"
IDENTITY_TENSION / MANIFESTO_PHRASE / VISUAL_SIGNATURE = "[optional or AI infer]"
FORMAT = "[poster / magazine cover / campaign visual]"

IconLayer: severe profile or sculptural front-facing pose; reduce subject into black-white graphic force; one instantly memorable visual signature; rough ink or brush texture interrupts polish.
DossierLayer: issue number, micro captions, vertical annotations, barcode, crop marks, small philosophical slogans, brand code or collection label.
TypographyLayer: large hand-brushed phrase crosses the subject; type feels violent, elegant, urgent; phrase inferred from subject's myth and tension.
Generate an editorial dossier poster for SUBJECT — a fashion magazine cover, protest mark, luxury campaign, and personal manifesto fused into one graphic object.

小建议：SUBJECT 换成你的 logo、你喜欢的人物或品牌都行，后面几项不填就让 AI 自己推断。

欢迎大家试试，把你的结果贴在评论区，我想看看不同 logo 能长出什么样子。

#ChatGPT #AI绘画

Explore AI. Create Value.

Photorealistic cinematic contact sheet in a perfect 1:1 square format, arranged as a clean 2x2 grid of four separate photographs. Thin white gutters separate the panels. Each panel is a complete, independently readable outdoor scene with a natural pose, a different outfit in every panel, and consistent photographic lighting, colour grading and film grain.

Subject: use the supplied reference image as the identity reference. Preserve the subject’s facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions and recognizable identity across all four panels. The subject may be human, alien, creature, robot or any original character; adapt anatomy, clothing and interactions naturally to the chosen design.

Setting: a beautiful natural landscape in late afternoon, with rolling green hills, a calm lake, scattered wildflowers, distant mountains and a partly cloudy sky. The mood is relaxed, spontaneous and documentary-like: an ordinary day spent outdoors, not a staged fashion campaign.

Panel 1, top left — “Morning Hike”: the subject walks along a dirt trail through tall grass, looking slightly ahead with a calm, curious expression. One hand holds a lightweight backpack strap and the other brushes aside a low branch. Natural walking posture, relaxed shoulders and believable stride. Outfit: sage-green technical jacket, dark hiking trousers, trail shoes and a small canvas backpack. Soft morning light, dew on grass, distant hills in the background. Camera at chest height, 35mm lens, eye-level composition.

Panel 2, top right — “Lakeside Pause”: the subject stands at the edge of a calm lake, facing the water in profile. One hand holds a folded map while the other rests naturally at their side. Weight is balanced evenly, feet shoulder-width apart, expression thoughtful and quietly amused. Outfit: cream cable-knit sweater, light-wash jeans, waterproof boots and a rust-coloured scarf. Gentle reflections on the lake, reeds in the foreground, mountains softened by haze. Camera at chest height, 35mm lens, natural full-body framing.

Panel 3, bottom left — “Picnic Break”: the subject sits cross-legged on a checked picnic blanket in a grassy clearing, holding a sandwich with both hands and taking a relaxed bite. A thermos, fruit and a small basket sit nearby. Shoulders relaxed, eyes bright with enjoyment, small natural smile. Outfit: mustard-yellow oversized shirt, beige trousers, canvas sneakers and a light denim jacket tied around the waist. Dappled sunlight through nearby trees, soft shadows on the blanket. Camera at seated eye level, 35mm lens, candid composition.

Panel 4, bottom right — “Sunset Walk Home”: the subject walks back along a grassy path toward the camera, carrying a folded blanket over one shoulder and a small basket in the other hand. They glance toward the horizon with a relaxed, contented expression. Natural mid-stride movement, clothing moving gently in the breeze. Outfit: terracotta linen shirt, dark wide-leg trousers, leather sandals and a light cardigan draped over the shoulders. Warm golden-hour light, long soft shadows, wildflowers catching the breeze. Camera at chest height, 35mm lens, slightly off-centre composition.

All poses must be casual, believable and unstaged: natural weight distribution, relaxed hands, realistic interaction with objects and clothing that follows the body naturally. No dramatic gestures, contortions, runway stances or exaggerated expressions.

Consistent natural-light photography: warm golden-hour tones, soft directional sunlight, believable shadows, atmospheric depth and subtle lens character. Realistic skin or surface texture, detailed fabric, natural foliage, believable water reflections and coherent perspective.

A relaxed, naturalistic editorial series about an original character spending a simple day in nature. Warm, funny through small human details, captured like real documentary photographs rather than staged campaign images.

Exactly two arms and two legs in every panel unless the supplied character design naturally requires otherwise; anatomically coherent hands and joints; natural facial anatomy; no extra limbs, duplicated objects, broken joints, melted faces, gore, plastic skin, text overlays, logos or watermarks.

Craft-transformation exhibition poster — celadon crack, gold seam, restored bowl.

Prompt 👇

Theme: Kintsugi tea bowl repair Chinese title: 金缮成器 English title: GOLDEN SEAM Initial state / material: A cracked celadon tea bowl split into two pieces, cool gray-green glaze, visible raw clay fracture edges Transformation process: Fine gold lacquer seams being brushed along the cracks, tiny gold dust catching light Completed state: The same celadon bowl fully restored with luminous gold kintsugi lines, upright on a linen mat Central change axis: The gold lacquer repair seam itself — wet gold meeting clay fracture Correspondence: Crack / seam Main colors: celadon green, warm gold, ivory paper, soft charcoal Accent colors: muted rust Research node: PROCESS · SEAM · GLAZE Aspect ratio: 9:16

Generate a mature cultural exhibition poster with strong material expression and a craft-transformation central-axis composition.

The core is not two unrelated objects side by side — the material change itself becomes the composition.

Left side shows the INITIAL cracked celadon tea bowl pieces. Right side shows the COMPLETED gold-repaired bowl. Center is the critical craft moment where gold lacquer fills the fracture.

Viewers must understand without reading: original material → craft happening → finished state.

Left and right must truly belong together: the same bowl form, matching fracture edges that could rejoin, identical celadon glaze language.

The central axis is not a plain color band — it is where transformation occurs (gold lacquer meeting clay). Add 2–3 extremely restrained correspondence lines or process marks, never a process PPT.

Materials must read real: celadon glaze, raw clay, gold lacquer, linen, paper — clear stable surface logic. Do not replace material detail with noise or heavy aging.

Typography relates to the craft logic and may cross materials, sit near the central seam, or lightly intersect the subject. Avoid fixed four-character vertical stacks or one giant central character every time.

Include one small research node totaling about 6% of the frame (PROCESS / SEAM / GLAZE).

First glance: material contrast. Second: the central repair happening. Third: why left and right are one craft process.

Museum Exhibition Poster × Contemporary Editorial Graphic Design × East Asian Cultural Visual. High clarity, clean structure, concentrated information.

Avoid: unrelated left/right content, broken process logic, plastic materials, random cracks, excessive flame, complex tool diagrams, too many technical parameters, mechanical three-column layout, PPT info boxes, heavy aging, low-finish AI poster look.

Read that again. Muse Image is 83 ELO points behind #1 and costs 21x less. Nano Banana 2.1 is 38 points behind at one-sixth the cost.

Honest losses: ELO is human preference on generic prompts, not your product shots. GPT Image 2.5 still leads on hard edits and instruction following. And these are list API rates, batch and reseller prices differ.

My take: start with Nano Banana 2.1 for quality per dollar. Use Muse Image when you need cheap volume. Self-host FLUX.2 dev if you want zero vendor lock-in. Pay the OpenAI premium only when the edit has to be perfect.

Quality per dollar wins.

posts.text:
A quiet gaze inside a storm of silk and gold.

A Cantonese opera–inspired AI portrait, built around an over-the-shoulder pose, a cobalt-blue headdress, and flowing crimson silk.

The key visual direction: keep the face still and sharply focused while the surrounding fabric creates movement.

Made by GPT Image 2.5  ➡️ 

Prompt:

Create a single 2:3 vertical Chinese opera art portrait, combining the lifelike detail of refined fashion photography with the flowing environment of ornate Eastern digital painting.

The subject is an adult East Asian woman, approximately 25 years old, with an elongated oval face, a delicate chin, fair skin with natural warmth, slender almond-shaped dark eyes, gently arched eyebrows, and copper-red and crimson eyeshadow softly extending toward the temples. Fine black eyeliner, small deep-vermilion lips slightly parted. Her black hair is swept into a sleek updo, with three small curved opera-style locks along her forehead and one fine strand beside her cheek. Her expression is quiet, reserved, slightly melancholic, with direct eye contact. No exaggerated smile.

Frame her from the top of her elaborate crown to below the thighs. Her body faces away from the camera, angled slightly toward the left side of the image. Her shoulder and back form a diagonal rising from lower left to upper right. She turns her neck gracefully to the right, looking back at the viewer in a three-quarter view. Position her face approximately 53% across and 27% down the canvas. The large headdress spans roughly two-thirds of the image width and sits close to the upper edge.

Her nearer hand is raised on the right side, naturally holding a closed, slender folding fan with dark-red lacquered ribs. The fan angles toward the upper left, its tip suspended beside her jaw without touching her lips. Anatomically natural fingers and a relaxed wrist. Blue jade beads and a crimson tassel hang from the fan. Heavy robes fill the lower half, with sleeves and ribbons forming a long S-shaped flow toward the lower left. Use an intimate, eye-level composition with gentle telephoto-like perspective compression, avoiding wide-angle distortion.

Dress her in an elaborate Cantonese opera huadan–inspired stage costume: a standing-collar navy silk inner robe, vermilion outer sleeves, overlapping blue and red draped silk, and long, soft water sleeves. The neckline is modest and the body fully covered. Dense but clearly resolved gold-thread embroidery depicts dimensional phoenix feathers, kapok blossoms, small blue-green leaves, and curling cloud motifs. The embroidery follows the curved surfaces of the shoulders, back, and sleeves. Silk folds have believable weight and direction. Gold thread catches fine highlights while crimson and navy fabric remain dominant.

Give her a broad, intricate phoenix-style opera headdress layered with deep peacock blue, turquoise kingfisher-feather-like surfaces, gold filigree foliage, and vermilion gemstones. It fits closely around the forehead and expands into curved phoenix wings and delicate branches on both sides. Seven to nine cobalt-blue velvet pom-poms of varying sizes rise across the top. A small turquoise phoenix and red agate floral ornament sit near the center. Along the brow, turquoise ornaments edged in gold hold red teardrop stones. Fine gold chains, pearls, red and blue beads, and crimson silk tassels hang beside her face. Every component has a clear, plausible connection. Avoid melted metal and rigid mechanical symmetry.

The setting blends an abstract opera stage with a hand-painted mural, without realistic architecture. Deep navy, muted blue-gray, and warm gray-beige form the underlying palette. Behind her head, an irregular area of pale warm-gray paint and smoky washes separates the face and crown from the background.

Broad, translucent crimson ribbons enter from the middle left, curl behind her shoulders, and rise upward. Blue ribbons descend from the upper right, sweep along the right edge, and flow into the bottom of the image. Together they create a vortex around the figure. Combine translucent gauze, folded silk surfaces, and dry-brush marks. Add scattered kapok petals, tiny gold-leaf fragments, turquoise paint splashes, and sparse fine gold cloud lines. Build overlapping foreground, middle-ground, and background layers. Keep movement in the ribbons and painted shapes; the face, eyes, hand, and main headdress remain sharp.

A large, soft, warm light from the upper front left illuminates her forehead, cheek, nose, shoulder, and hand. Shadows carry cool-blue reflected light. Tiny warm-gold highlights catch the headdress edges and embroidery. Preserve subtle facial contours and soft neck shadows rather than flattening the face.

Use rich, layered color: approximately half navy, three-tenths vermilion, with turquoise, warm gold, and gray-beige completing the palette. The face is the calmest, brightest focal point. Slightly darken the edges. Soften the background while retaining painted texture. Resolve metal, velvet pom-poms, pearls, silk, and embroidery as distinct materials.

The atmosphere is dignified, dreamlike, sumptuous, and restrained, combining photographic dimensionality with the ornamental density of meticulous painting.

One complete image only. No borders, panels, text, signatures, logos, websites, or watermarks. No additional people. Do not simplify the crown into a small hairpin or turn the image into a generic costume portrait or anime face. Avoid plastic skin, excessive smoothing, malformed fingers, floating jewelry, and incoherent embroidery.

posts.prompt:
Create a premium vertical commercial poster for a fictional overseas fruit drink brand, "AURAZEST". Design it as a Cannes-level beverage ad where a hyper-real glass bottle is the absolute visual hero, fused with disciplined graphic poster design. Use a strict split composition: the left half is a refined warm-ivory information field, the right half a saturated solar-yellow brand field with a giant vertical typographic block. Position the hero bottle exactly across the central dividing line so it bridges both zones and controls the full hierarchy.

The bottle is a chilled elegant glass bottle filled with luminous golden pineapple-passionfruit juice, with thick transparent glass, realistic refraction, a precise blue-metal cap, dense micro-condensation, varied tiny droplets, visible meniscus, crisp label print, and premium manufacturing detail. The front label must read exactly "AURAZEST". It should feel tactile, cold, collectible, and physically believable, carrying the strongest focal weight in the poster.

Behind the bottle, build a large radiant fruit halo combining a pineapple cross-section with a more art-directed geometric fruit-core structure so it feels natural and iconic. The fruit disk sits slightly left of center behind the bottle, partially occluded, with juicy fiber detail, wet rind texture, bright translucency, and controlled splash arcs bursting outward. The splash must feel physically accurate yet graphically composed, with clear directional force, believable viscosity, suspended droplets, and no messy chaos. Add several fresh green leaves around the outer frame as rhythm accents, some softly blurred in the near foreground and some crisp in the midground, always supporting freshness and depth.

Typography must be newly invented and fully art directed. In the top-left, place a minimalist emblem and the brand name "AURAZEST". Beneath it, set the headline "SUNLIT IMPACT", with the smaller line "Tropical clarity with a bright lifted finish." In the lower-left, place a compact benefit lockup: "PURE FRUIT CHARGE". Across the entire right panel, place a massive vertical white typographic block reading "GOLDEN PULSE". Typography should feel integrated into the poster architecture, elegant and precise, with clean spacing, balanced weight, and no collision with the bottle label or fruit core.

Use a tightly controlled palette: 55% pineapple gold and radiant mango-yellow, 20% warm ivory and pale cream, 15% vivid botanical green, 10% deep amber shadow accents and cool blue cap contrast. Light the scene with a clean key from the upper left, luminous transmission through the juice, crisp specular edges on the bottle shoulders, soft reflected bounce from the pale background, and enough contrast to carve volume into the glass, fruit, and splash without muddy blacks or dirty haze. The finish should feel bright, premium, sharp, and globally campaign-ready.

Materials must read with extreme clarity: translucent juice glow, fibrous juicy flesh, glossy wet rind, fresh waxy leaves, sparkling droplets, clean heavy glass, and sharp printed label edges. The poster should combine commercial product realism, fruit freshness, and curatorial graphic discipline in one unified system. Maintain correct bottle proportions, label readability, coherent splash physics, clean perspective, elegant negative space, and powerful retail-ad impact.

Keep one single hero bottle only, product-first hierarchy, clean premium advertising realism, coherent fruit geometry, coherent droplet scale, plausible leaf perspective, and crisp typography. Avoid warped bottle shape, broken glass proportions, unreadable label text, accidental extra bottles, duplicated fruit slices, muddy shadows, dirty texture buildup, chaotic splashes, cheap font treatment, distorted vertical lettering, weak hierarchy, random clutter, off-theme decorative particles, accidental resemblance to existing real beverage brands, or style drift away from high-end commercial poster design.

posts.text:
硬直闪人像，脸常被写成柔光美颜。不是模型不会打硬闪，是闪光、阴影、皮肤纹理和背景亮度糊进同一句氛围词里，分不清谁该硬、谁该暗。

我把硬直闪拆成五格写：闪光指纹、人物面孔、场景与穿搭、姿势与构图、排除，排除也算一格。开头一行是题材和画幅的总述，是每张都不动的底子。骨架固定；四张只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行，闪光指纹与人物面孔不动。下一条是第一张的完整提示词。

附图四张，同一套五格：白墙走廊、便利店冷柜前、夜街转角、公寓门厅。gpt-image-2.5 出图，AI 生成，人物是虚构的成年人。
posts.prompt:
硬直闪人像，竖幅 9:16，写实摄影。
闪光指纹：机顶强直射闪光，像小型数码相机硬闪；硬阴影贴墙或贴地，边缘清晰；高光偏冷；皮肤纹理清晰可见；轻微胶片颗粒；背景比主体暗一档；主光是硬直闪。
人物面孔：虚构的成年女性，二十五岁上下，原创东亚或混血面孔；鹅蛋脸，微圆下颌，内双，鼻梁中等高，薄唇自然粉；浅暖白肤色带一点奶杏，脸颊有自然血色；齐肩黑棕直发，中分，两侧轻贴脸；偏纤瘦自然比例，肩窄；气质安静、略带街头感；表情平静，目光朝向镜头。
场景与穿搭：白天室内白墙走廊，浅灰白墙面干净平整；穿白色短袖 T 恤与蓝色牛仔裤。
姿势与构图：半身靠墙站姿，肩背轻贴白墙，一手自然垂放，头微侧；硬阴影落在墙面，人是画面最亮处。
排除：水印、logo、可读文字、乱码字、磨皮塑料感、柔光美颜灯、雾感打光、像真实名人的面孔、未成年人或幼态特征、第二个人物、性感化姿势、浓妆、节日装饰。

———

调试时我习惯一次只动一格。闪太软了，先查闪光指纹那行是不是写成了柔光或雾感；脸漂了，再查人物面孔有没有被改短；景不对，才动场景与穿搭和姿势与构图。附图换景是一次动两处，场景与穿搭加姿势与构图；自己调单张时，才一次只动一格。

想套自己的场景，复制帖 2：首行、闪光指纹、人物面孔、排除不动，只改场景与穿搭和姿势与构图。四张换地方换穿搭，别换身份。

———

换变体时，复制帖 2：首行总述、闪光指纹、人物面孔、排除一行一字不动；只换场景与穿搭、姿势与构图两行。人脸描述四张保持一致。第一张就是帖 2 原文。下面三套直接替换：

图2｜便利店冷柜前
场景与穿搭：便利店过道，冷柜玻璃门微蓝冷光很弱、只染边缘；穿深色短外套罩浅色内搭与深色裤；货架与冷柜色块模糊不可读。
姿势与构图：半身站在冷柜前，微侧身，一手轻扶冷柜边沿，目光平视镜头；硬阴影贴地，冷柜蓝光很弱、只染边缘。

图3｜夜街转角
场景与穿搭：夜间人行道转角，远处霓虹虚成小光斑；穿宽松白衬衫与深色裤；墙面干净，招牌虚成色块。
姿势与构图：半身站在转角墙边，肩线放松，一手插裤袋，头微转向镜头；硬阴影贴墙，远处霓虹只作虚焦光斑。

图4｜公寓门厅
场景与穿搭：窄门厅加电梯门，暖顶灯很弱、只染远处虚焦；穿针织开衫罩浅色内搭与深色裤；门厅墙面与电梯门干净平整。
姿势与构图：半身站在门厅中央偏右，身体微侧，双手自然垂放，目光朝向镜头；硬阴影贴地贴墙，暖顶灯仅作极弱环境光。

The food must feel rich, slow-cooked, deeply infused, and fully edible.

An adult hand enters from the right edge, gently setting or adjusting the plate. Only the hand and partial forearm are visible. The gesture should feel natural, careful, and service-oriented, adding warmth, scale, and immediacy.

Keep only essential props: a bundle of chopsticks and an aged metal ladle in the mid-right background, a small stack of ceramic bowls near the hand, and the rice pot in the lower-left foreground. No decorative clutter, no scattered garnish styling, no unnecessary ingredients.

The backdrop is a deep charcoal-black aged plaster wall with matte wear, mineral bloom, and subtle patina. The tabletop is dark stone or sealed concrete with soft low reflections and restrained texture. The setting should feel like a preserved heritage kitchen stripped to only meaningful elements.

Use soft directional warm light from upper left, like late tungsten mixed with faint daylight residue. Let it gently strike the clay lid, plate rim, egg yolk, sauce surface, hand, and brick edges, while the wall remains dark and atmospheric with visible texture. Palette: charcoal black, soot brown, fired clay orange, muted brick red, old brass, warm ochre lettering, beige ceramic, dark soy brown, and egg-gold. Preserve dark detail and tonal separation; avoid dead black collapse. The contrast should feel velvety, nostalgic, and high-end.

The clay pot should show porous earthenware grain, smoke-darkened rims, firing irregularities, and believable age. The brick stove should read as dry, chalky, chipped, and structural. Food must be highly convincing: pork with dense braised surfaces and slight fiber at torn edges, egg white smooth and firm, yolk matte-golden and softly set, chestnuts compact and satin-dry, sauce reduced and reflective without looking artificial. Ceramic glaze should show subtle pooling and aged refinement. Metal tools should appear softly worn, not shiny. The hand should have natural skin tone, realistic joints, clean nails, and credible contact shadows.

Typography must feel designed into the poster, not added later. “EMBER ROOT” is small, precise, and quiet. “Clayfire” is the main gesture in warm aged ochre, with hand-painted flow and archival sign-painter character. “braise” should continue the motion lightly. The supporting line must remain crisp, small, and clear. All text stays in the upper-left dark field and never overlaps the product silhouette.

Give the whole image a subtle old editorial print sensibility: gentle low-saturation warmth, faint archival depth, rich shadow transparency, restrained patina, and handcrafted permanence. The scene should feel timeless, expensive, and nostalgic without becoming dusty or dirty.

Avoid overcrowded props, weak hierarchy between pot and plated dish, empty black areas with no wall texture, broken contact shadows, plastic food surfaces, fake CGI gloss, muddy sauce, chrome-like reflections, dead black blocks, random dirt, flat lighting, gibberish text, extra labels, warped lettering, futuristic elements, neon color, excessive steam, hyper-sharpened HDR, greasy chaos, visual clutter, and malformed hand anatomy.

GPT- image 2.5 prompt👇
A Cannes Lions caliber luxury beauty poster for the fictional couture cosmetics house NOIRA, built as a product-first editorial beauty image. Preserve the exact visual architecture and light hierarchy: a full-bleed vertical close-up against a stark pale white background, the upper face buried in deep shadow, a hard shadow band cutting across the eyes, the head slightly lifted, and glossy red lips as the single most saturated and dominant focal point. The lipstick must feel like the source of the attitude, tension, and entire visual narrative.

Tight full-bleed vertical crop from just above the head to below the collarbones, centered and confrontational, with no border or margin. The model faces frontally with chin raised, neck elongated, shoulders bare, and collarbones sharply modeled by hard light. The mouth sits just above center as the emotional and commercial anchor. Preserve the severe contrast: the upper face remains nearly unreadable except for faint structural cues, while the lips, teeth, lower cheeks, throat, clavicles, and shoulder highlights are rendered with precision. No props, no product pack, no competing objects.

The hero product is a high-lacquer couture lipstick finish in deep blood-crimson to dark wine red, with dense pigment, mirror-like wet gloss, crisp lip edges, and dimensional mouth volume. The lips must feel alive and hyper-real, with micro texture visible beneath the gloss and highlights controlled like polished enamel. Teeth should appear bright, natural, and cleanly aligned through a fierce almost-biting expression. The lipstick must read as a luxury material event, not simple makeup.

The woman holds a severe frontal beauty posture, head subtly tilted back to expose the throat and intensify the jaw-to-neck shadow falloff. Bare shoulders remain asymmetrically alive enough to avoid mannequin stiffness, acting only as a sculptural pedestal for the lips and clavicle highlights. No hands, jewelry, or visible clothing detail.

The setting is fully abstract and studio-controlled. The background remains a clean pale white field with almost no texture. Depth comes only from the shadow mask over the upper face, the luminous lacquered lips, and the sharp specular highlights across the throat, collarbones, and shoulders. The image must feel like a fashion-beauty manifesto where product finish and light geometry replace scenery.

Preserve the tonal hierarchy exactly. Use a disciplined palette: 55% deep black and espresso shadow across the upper face and side contours, 25% warm bronze and coppered skin luminosity, 15% stark pale-white background, and 5% saturated lacquer-crimson lip color. Build the image with a hard narrow frontal-above key light that creates the exact shadow band over the eyes while allowing the lips, lower face, neck, clavicles, and shoulder caps to glow with sharp specular refinement. The lips must remain the richest color concentration and emotional apex. No muddy midtones, no pink lipstick drift, no flattened skin.

Render as hyper-real luxury beauty photography with natural skin pores, controlled glossy highlights on clavicles and shoulders, subtle peach-fuzz realism, and immaculate lip rendering. The lipstick finish must show wet gloss, dense color depth, dimensional volume, and clean reflection bands. Skin must feel alive and premium, never waxy or over-smoothed. Teeth must stay natural and believable. The final image should feel like a flagship global cosmetics print campaign: bold, dangerous, sensual, and technically flawless.

Place a minimal editorial wordmark “NOIRA” near the upper-left or upper-center in small refined black or deep charcoal lettering. If needed, add a restrained headline in the lower negative space: “Color That Bares Its Teeth.” Add the smaller subline: “Lacquer Lip Couture.” Typography must be sparse, elegant, and fully subordinate to the mouth and shoulder highlights.

Full-bleed luxury beauty poster, product-dominant, exact light hierarchy preserved, hyper-real, editorial, no border, no empty margin, no extra accessories, no props, no packaging in frame, no muddy shadows, no plastic lips, no distorted teeth, no waxy skin, no gibberish text, no style drift, no topology collapse.

De una foto de viaje a la portada de nuestro propio diario de aventuras. 🏝️🎨

Hecho con GPT Image 2.5. La misma historia, pero con una estética totalmente diferente.

La IA no solo genera imágenes. También convierte recuerdos en arte. ✨

¿Qué foto tuya transformarías?

PROMPT:

Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Process each photo separately. Never combine photos into a collage, grid, split-screen, or multi-photo composition.

FORMAT
Strict 3:4 vertical composition, horizontally divided into two exactly equal 50/50 sections. Top 50% = original photography; bottom 50% = flat editorial illustration. Keep the overall design premium, clean, art-directed, visually balanced, and rich in negative space.

TOP 50% — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Treat the uploaded photo as the single source of truth. Preserve the original subject, identity, facial features, body proportions, pose, expression, clothing, objects, environment, composition, colors, spatial relationships, lighting, shadows, depth, and photographic texture. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, distort, stretch, duplicate, or reinterpret the subject. Only subtle professional color grading is allowed, with the feel of an independent art magazine, premium travel editorial, or exhibition photograph. If more space is needed, naturally extend the existing background without altering the subject.

BOTTOM 50% — FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION
Reinterpret the same photograph as a playful, slightly awkward Korean-inspired flat editorial illustration. Identify and preserve the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, action, key relationships, and narrative of the original scene. Simplify them into rounded, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes with clean solid fills and rough, imperfect black hand-drawn outlines featuring subtle wobble, uneven thickness, broken edges, and imperfect contours. Remove photorealistic lighting, shadows, perspective, and material textures. Avoid conventional cartoon or photorealistic styles. Aim for a contemporary Korean children's book, independent magazine graphic, or playful editorial artwork.

COMPOSITION
Keep one dominant focal point with secondary objects used only as accents. Create relaxed visual rhythm through varied scale, slight misalignment, overlaps, partial cropping, irregular spacing, and subtle asymmetry. Allow some shapes to extend beyond or overlap the composition. Use bold color blocks and generous negative space. Preserve key visual relationships without reproducing every detail. The illustration should feel designed, relaxed, and intentionally imperfect, never mechanically traced or cluttered.

COLOR
Extract the photograph's most distinctive colors and reinterpret them as a limited palette of high-purity, high-saturation flat colors. Use bold, clean color blocks and bright youthful contrasts. No gradients, realistic shadows, muddy gray tones, glossy effects, complex blending, or excessive texture. The palette should feel cheerful, energetic, childlike, warm, and visually confident.

TYPOGRAPHY & EDITORIAL TEXT
Generate English text inspired by the photo's theme, action, emotion, atmosphere, or story. Integrate typography naturally into the illustration.

MAIN TITLE: 2–4 English words, placed near the upper illustration area. Use playful, slightly handwritten, imperfect lettering; irregular alignment or capitalization is allowed.

SUBTAGLINE: One short, restrained English phrase below the title.

LOCATION / YEAR: Small editorial line in the lower-middle area. Use a verified location/year when known; otherwise use the subject, activity, event, or travel theme. Never invent a location.

POETIC MICRO-CAPTION: A short 1–2 line poetic or playful phrase, placed naturally within negative space, beside a color block, along an edge, or on the visual axis.

SERIES NUMBER: Small, subtle editorial numbering such as “No.01” in a corner.

Typography may follow subject contours, align with color blocks, occupy negative space, overlap shapes slightly, rotate subtly, or use irregular spacing/cropping. Readability must remain strong. Title can be expressive; supporting text should stay clean and restrained.

ART DIRECTION
Combine real travel photography × playful flat illustration × premium editorial design × Korean graphic sensibility × travel diary aesthetics. The result should feel bright, youthful, cheerful, warm, playful, slightly quirky, sophisticated, and collectible—like a limited-edition travel art print or contemporary illustrated travel diary, not a generic tourist poster.

六张都是各模型的第一张样品，共用下方英文提示词（含统一的3:4输出要求），没有绑定人物参考图。比较的是同题首样；分辨率、采样设置和底层版本并不完全相同，不能据此推出模型总体排名。

完整实际提示词：

**Cinematic close-up portrait from the chest upward, shot on an 85mm lens with shallow depth of field.** A woman with the features of the reference image tilts her head back, eyes closed, her expression suspended between surrender and release. She wears a long-sleeve blouse constructed entirely of layered, deep matte black raven feathers—each barb and vane catching a thin rim of diffused light against the smoke. Large black hoop earrings hang motionless, a hard geometric counterpoint to the organic dissolution around her. Her loose hair is caught in an updraft, strands lifting and twisting forward as if pulled by an invisible current. Along the edges of her silhouette, feathers and hair begin to unravel into wet black ink splatters, drifting charcoal dust, and thin wisps of dark smoke; fine black ink flecks migrate across her cheekbone, jawline, and neck, settling into the pores and fine hairs rather than sitting on top of the skin. The background is a dense, layered field of smoky gray atmosphere, with thicker plumes rolling behind her and thinner veils drifting through the foreground, so that her face remains the only sharp anchor in the frame. Lighting is low-key and directional—a soft key from camera-left wraps her features while a cool rim light separates the feather blouse from the smoke, creating deep chiaroscuro without crushing the detail in the black feathers. Desaturated monochrome palette with the faintest warm undertone in the skin, cinematic film grain, high-resolution, atmospheric depth, surreal and ethereal mood.

Output: one portrait image, aspect ratio 3:4.

参数与图号：
① 即梦 Seedream 5.0 Pro：3:4、2K、单张；seed、步数、CFG未公开。服务显示8积分预扣快照，未核实最终净结算。
② Qwen Image 2.1 BF16：1536×2048，seed 20261023，40步，CFG 1，Euler/simple，denoise 1；无LoRA。
③ Krea2 Turbo FP8 scaled：1536×2048，seed 20261023，8步，CFG 1，Euler/simple，denoise 1；无LoRA。
④ gptimage2.5：1086×1448，单张；工具未披露底层版本、seed、步数及CFG。
⑤ MOSS-Image SFT INT8 convrot：1536×2048，seed 20261023，25步，CFG 2.5，er_sde/simple，denoise 1，SLG single layer 22（0–50%）。
⑥ FLUX3 Klein蒸馏 INT8 convrot：1536×2048，seed 20261023，16步，CFG 1，Euler/simple，denoise 1；无LoRA，负向提示词为空。

这六张是静态首样；没有人物参考图，无法验证同脸。Flux3关闭了原工作流的提示词扩写，直接编码上述共同文本；四路本地流程的负向提示词均为空。相同seed不代表跨模型等价随机条件。

隨機選取10種不同的海洋硬骨魚，每張一件完整標本。各張獨立變化體態、觀看角度、構圖與透光方向，展現不同體形與骨架結構。

軟組織近乎透明，隱約保留體表輪廓與柔軟體積。茜素紅顯示礦化骨骼，阿爾新藍顯示軟骨，染色分布依物種與骨化程度自然變化。骨架符合物種解剖，自然連接。透明甘油浸存質感，透射光顯露精密結構與前後層次，真實微距標本攝影。

沿用統一的圖鑑資訊網格：上方為中文名、斜體拉丁學名與科屬分類；中間完整展示標本；下方以30至50字介紹一個可從圖中觀察的有趣特徵，必要時用纖細引導線對應部位，另附簡短紅藍染色圖例。中文統一使用準確繁體字，名稱、學名、分類與特徵均經核對並對應物種。

中文名採思源宋體風格，說明採思源黑體風格，拉丁學名採西文襯線斜體。名稱含生僻字、易讀錯字或多音字時，在其下方以小字標示完整名稱的漢語拼音，聲調與讀音準確，採清晰無襯線字體，與拉丁學名適度分隔；常見易讀名稱省略拼音。

背景從標本紅藍染色中提取呼應色，降低飽和度、提高明度，形成淡灰藍、灰粉或灰紫等有彩灰色，保留骨架與背景的明暗及色彩差異。標本附近可有極輕微透光漸變，文字區域色調均勻，以深炭色文字保持清晰閱讀。整套背景明度與飽和度接近，色相隨主體變化。

字級層次清晰，文字左對齊，邊距充足，圖文互不遮擋。各張依魚形調整版面，保持整套視覺一致。

9:16豎版，n=10，10張獨立單圖，不拼圖。每張左下角小尺寸深藍色實心圓點，空格後接白色手寫體「DeepBlue」

GPT image 2.5 Prompt:

山海经奇珍异兽 × 低多边形造型 × 二向色玻璃艺术 × 彩色透射与反射 × 空间光影 × 名称文字投影

每张独立选择一种《山海经》中轮廓鲜明、适合玻璃表达的奇珍异兽，转化为简洁的空间艺术装置。依据原文保留体形与身份特征，确保关键结构及数量准确。10张异兽与主结构各异，每张重新变化姿态、玻璃构成、机位、构图、建筑空间与日光方向。

以少量宽阔、大小有层次的多边形玻璃面建立连贯体积，仅在轮廓与主要结构转折处增加分面。以四边形及不规则多边形为主，局部三角面辅助转折，大面积平缓部位保持完整，内部空间简洁。

躯干保持完整体块，肢体以简练折面表现关节与受力。角、翼、尾等依据自身形态采用宽阔薄面或简练多面体，与身体自然连接。优先保证辨识结构数量准确，再安排姿态与视角，使连接位置和末端便于辨认，轮廓间保留疏朗空隙。

动作具有生物逻辑，身体朝向、重心与附属结构相互呼应，保留古拙、神秘的生命感，表面细节高度概括。

相邻玻璃面沿共同边缘简洁衔接，以不同倾角建立体积。表面平整，薄板厚度与硬质边缘清楚，接缝克制，支撑或悬吊顺应重心，制作与安装可信。

玻璃清透，背景可透过主要玻璃面辨认，前后表面的叠合保持清楚。依据异兽气质组织色彩，显色随朝向及透射、反射关系变化。相邻折面色彩有别，面内相对完整，边缘与少量交叠处细腻变化，保留无色透明区域。

明确日光形成一组主要色光关系，彩色透射光与反射光落在地面或墙面，色块宽阔疏朗，位置与形状符合玻璃朝向和光路，辅助反光轻淡。

隐蔽的小型投影灯通过文字字模与二向色滤色片，将异兽准确中文名投在墙面或地面的留白处，仅出现一次。采用清楚端正的楷书，尺寸随字数与空间调整，完整画面中可读，视觉分量低于主体。优先选择侧后方较暗墙面；地面选择透视倾斜较小的位置。

名称沿用主要色光中的一种颜色，局部轻淡色差，亮度克制、字形清晰、边缘微柔。承接表面纹理自然可见，文字遵循平面透视，与主要彩色光块适当错开。

简洁的中性色建筑环境，空间尺度、背景明度与光线随造型变化。主体完整入镜，四周留出舒适边距，兼顾异兽辨识、立体结构、空间光影与名称阅读。真实艺术装置摄影，自然曝光，玻璃与色光层次清楚，主体保持视觉重心。

n=10，连续生成10张独立单图，每次1张，9:16竖幅。
左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体「DeepBlue」在后。

名称沿用主要色光中的一种颜色，局部轻淡色差，亮度克制、字形清晰、边缘微柔。承接表面纹理自然可见，文字遵循平面透视，与主要彩色光块适当错开。

简洁的中性色建筑环境，空间尺度、背景明度与光线随造型变化。主体完整入镜，四周留出舒适边距，兼顾异兽辨识、立体结构、空间光影与名称阅读。真实艺术装置摄影，自然曝光，玻璃与色光层次清楚，主体保持视觉重心。

n=10，连续生成10张独立单图，每次1张，9:16竖幅。

Balance the contrast to a natural photographic level: if image 1 looks too harsh or blotchy, soften it; if it looks flat or washed out, add depth. Aim for a well-balanced realistic photo — rich but not crushed shadows, clean highlights, smooth even tonal transitions, natural shading with real volume. posts.text:
GPT2 x 蓝色夜景 x 厚涂油画 x 提示词

晚上十点了，发几张安静点的。整张画几乎全是蓝的，只留一扇窗或者一道门亮着橙色的灯，颜料堆得很厚，能看到刮刀一道一道抹过去的痕迹。

四张是雪夜山里的小木屋、街角还没关门的小书店、湖边栈道尽头的小屋、乡下没人的小火车站。第一次出图蓝色太暗，墙也画成了米色，后来在提示词里把蓝调亮、把墙也写成蓝的，才是刚入夜那种感觉。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」管颜色比例、灯光只能有一两处、刀刮的笔触，别动它。下面「New subject」写你想画的地方和哪扇窗亮着，改这一段就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅 3:4 的蓝色夜景厚涂油画，用调色刀堆出来的完成态手绘油画。接近人眼高度的平视远景，主体建筑体量偏在画面一侧，占约一半宽度、可以局部出框，另一侧留出大片低细节的夜空和开阔地面或水面做负空间；地平线或水平线压在画面下三分之一附近，前景是粗粝的地面，中景是主体，远景高度概括。整体明度中等偏亮，是刚入夜的蓝调时刻那种饱和的青蓝、蔚蓝，天空像一整片明亮的钴青色颜料，不要暗沉的藏青、午夜深蓝或接近黑色的大面积暗部；冷青蓝的环境光柔和地罩住全画，天上不出现月亮、星星或强逆光；全画只有一到两处暖光：主体的一扇窗或一扇门透出橙黄灯光，在门口近处地面或水面投下一小片短而破碎的金橙反光，暖光不扩散、不照亮整片环境，不要路灯串、霓虹或多扇亮窗。颜色秩序：明亮饱和的青蓝到湖蓝铺满天空和开阔处，约五成五；钴蓝、群青和深海蓝塑造建筑、地面和阴影，约四成，建筑的墙面、屋顶、树和地面也都画成蓝色调，不要米色、棕色、灰色的墙或木头本色；琥珀橙到金黄只有约百分之四，集中在那一两处亮窗和它的反光里；最深处是深靛蓝不是中性黑，蓝色内部靠明度和冷暖差拉开远近，不要被处理成一层统一的蓝色滤镜。颜料很厚：刀脊、压痕、横向拖抹、刮痕和断续露底清楚可见，天空用宽而交叠的刮面，水面和地面用横向短刮痕，墙面有粗拙的块面，建筑轮廓略带手工的歪斜，形体高度概括成几个大色块，不画砖缝、木纹、瓦片、书脊和石板这类细节，远景只是一两道蓝色块面，暖光区域也保留厚涂痕迹，不要光滑的数字渐变、照片质感或均匀的浮雕滤镜。人物如果出现只是很小的深色背影，不画五官。整体安静、孤独，像深夜里只剩这一盏灯还醒着。画面里不要任何文字、招牌字、签名或水印。

New subject:
雪夜的山间小屋：画面右侧一座斜顶小木屋，屋顶压着厚厚的蓝白积雪，只有一扇小方窗亮着橙黄灯光，窗下雪地上映出一小块暖色；屋后是两三棵概括成深蓝块面的杉树，左侧是大片缓缓起伏的蓝色雪坡和远山，天空还在飘细小的雪片，雪地上一串浅浅的脚印通向门口。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

Main Scene: Preserve the main product, brand identity, people, clothing, colors, environment, and overall concept from the reference image. Enhance the scene with cinematic lighting, realistic textures, natural facial expressions, detailed product presentation, and professional commercial photography.  Instagram Interface Placement: Place a large, realistic Instagram-style post card horizontally across the middle of the entire composition, dividing the image into upper and lower visual sections. The card should feature a clean white background, circular brand profile picture, brand username, blue verification badge where appropriate, timestamp, three-dot menu, engagement icons, like count, caption text, and comment information.  Layering and Composition: The main subject should appear prominently in the upper section, while complementary characters, product details, or a continuation of the scene occupy the lower section. Allow selected elements, such as a hand, product, food item, or packaging, to extend naturally in front of or behind the central Instagram card, creating a realistic 3D depth effect. Keep the interface readable and ensure it does not unnecessarily obscure the main subject. Output Requirements: Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, high resolution, carefully balanced composition, Instagram interface centered horizontally and vertically around the middle of the image, realistic foreground-background separation, no unnecessary interface elements, no distorted hands, no duplicated objects, and no garbled text. GPT2 x 彩色玻璃窗 x 东方纹样 x 提示词

小时候在老教堂外面看过一扇彩色玻璃窗，太阳一照，地上落了一块一块的颜色，一直记得。这次让模型拼了几扇这样的窗，只是把里面的图案换成咱们自己熟的东西。

四张是锦鲤绕莲、喜鹊登梅、一朵大牡丹、月亮里的玉兔。每张中间都是一个大圆，金色集中在圆里，下面一层层青绿的浪和卷云往上托着。铅条特意写成深褐色，不用纯黑，整扇窗看着会透一点。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」管窗框、大圆、铅条、玻璃纹理和配色，别动它。下面「New subject」写圆里放什么、下面的卷纹换成什么，改这一段就行。换成家里的猫、你的生肖也都能拼。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

GPT2 x 极简排版海报 x 杂志感 x 提示词

周末在家做了一套能直接拿去用的活动海报。版式很简单：一块低饱和的色块里放一张照片，左边竖着一行大字标题，底下一行小字，剩下的地方都空着。

四张是咖啡新品、读书会、摄影展、周末市集，色块换了四个颜色：燕麦咖、灰绿、雾蓝、陶土粉。字我只留了两处，标题三四个字，小字一行，字少出图就基本不会错。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」是画面风格，管版式、留白、字体和纸感，别动。下面「New subject」是主体，改成你的主题、色块颜色、照片里放什么、标题和那行小字写什么，换成招聘、开业、课程通知也都能套。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张完整独立的竖幅 3:4 极简编辑设计海报，铺满整个画布，正面平视、无透视变形，像一张印好平放的杂志感海报原稿，不是模板拼贴，不是展示墙，不出现海报外的场景、相框或样机。底色是暖灰白哑光纸面，大面积留白。一块低饱和主色的大矩形占据画面中部偏右约四成面积，边缘被画面裁切，局部配一段裁切的圆弧；主色块里放一张同色调、低饱和、安静的主体照片，照片被色块完整裁成矩形，和色块融为一体。左侧是一个近黑色的超大中文主标题，纵向竖排，字少而大，粗壮的黑体，字形端正、笔画完整；画面底部左侧一行很小的横排说明文字，和竖排标题形成方向对照。版式用清晰的非对称网格，两三条极细的近黑分隔线和一两根短横线放在边缘和底部，所有元素精确对齐。画面中的文字只有主标题和底部那一行小字两处，逐字准确，不要任何其他文字、伪文字、乱码小字段落、页码、英文品牌名、商标或标识。颜色秩序：暖灰白纸底约一半，主色块约三成半到四成，浅雾灰辅助分区约一成，近黑只用于文字和细线约百分之六，不额外引入鲜艳强调色。光线是中性略暖的均匀漫射光，只在左上角有极轻的明度变化，没有投影、浮雕或立体效果。细微纸纤维、平整哑光油墨、锐利字缘，克制、安静、理性，有出版物的秩序感，不要做旧噪点。

New subject:
主题是咖啡新品海报。主色块是低饱和的燕麦奶咖色。色块里的照片是俯拍的一杯燕麦拿铁，白色陶瓷杯，奶泡上一个简单的拉花，旁边一小撮燕麦粒。竖排主标题为四个字「燕麦拿铁」，底部小字为「新品 11.01 上市」。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

GPT2 x 城市旅行海报 x 日系平涂 x 提示词

下午有点犯困，想出门又走不开，干脆把几个想去的地方做成了旅行海报。上面一大片蓝天，顶上一行白色大字写地名，街景就压在最底下一小条，光看着就挺舒服。

四张是厦门鼓浪屿、青岛老城、大理洱海、杭州西湖。每张只留了地名和省份那一行小字，店招、门牌、路牌都让它别画，画面干净很多，也不容易冒出错字。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」管天空占多少、大字放哪、光从哪边来、用什么颜色，别动它。下面「New subject」改成你老家或者想去的地方，地名拼写写清楚，再写两三样当地街边的东西就能出。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅 3:4 的日系复古旅行海报，日式平涂插画加干净的动画背景绘景。清澈的蓝天占画面上方约三分之二，是一大块连续留白，最多只有地平线附近几朵低矮的小积云，电线只在下部少量横穿。画面最顶部是一行超大的白色无衬线全大写英文地名，横贯画面宽度，字距舒展，四周留出安全边距；地名下方左侧紧贴一行很小的白色英文小字。画面中只有这两处文字，拼写必须完全准确，不要其他任何文字、汉字、日文、店招、招牌字、门牌、品牌、商标、徽章、路牌文字或坐标数字。下方约三分之一是当地的街景：街对面平视、略广角的远景机位，地平线压到画面下方四分之一附近，前景是带浅色标线的灰褐路面，中景偏右是当地有特色的低层建筑，左侧开阔，远景露出一窄条水面和低矮的山或岸线，建筑和远景形成不对称平衡；一两件生活细节（车、自行车、树、船）给画面一点人气，不让任何一个物件压倒画面。夏末下午暖白的阳光从左上方照进来，受光面明亮柔和，向右下投出清晰但不生硬的影子，暗部带灰青色环境光。颜色秩序：略灰的天蓝约六成半，铺满天空和水面；米白、浅暖灰约两成半，给标题、建筑亮面和道路；深橄榄绿、灰青绿约百分之八，给树和局部暗面；赭黄和低饱和砖红只占约百分之二点缀街道细节。平涂色块、克制的渐变、简洁透视，轮廓干净，细节适度概括，覆一层极细的纸纹和轻微褪色印刷感，不要厚重做旧，不要写实照片感，不要粗黑描边。整体安静、晴朗、慢，像一个没什么安排的夏天下午。

New subject:
顶部大字地名为 XIAMEN，下方小字为 Fujian, China。街景是鼓浪屿的一条安静坡道：右侧是两三栋红砖拱廊老洋楼，带白色廊柱和百叶窗，墙头垂下一大丛玫红色三角梅，坡道左侧开阔，远处是一窄条海面和一艘小小的白色渡轮，对岸是低矮的城市天际线，路边一棵大榕树。

I made this with GPT Image 2.5 on RunningHub: 

Prompt:
A high-angle, top-down overhead shot looking straight down at a young East Asian woman with delicate East Asian facial features and sleek, soft black hair. She crouches on a garden path, gently playing with a fluffy orange tabby cat. Dense foliage overhead filters the sunlight, creating a lively "komorebi" effect—dancing, circular bokeh light spots that ripple and drift across her skin and the cat's fur. As she tilts her head up toward the camera, a light haze softens the edges of the frame, adding a dreamy atmosphere. Her expression slowly shifts from a playful, slightly pouting look into a genuine smile that crinkles the corners of her eyes, while the dappled light delicately traces the fine texture of her skin and the glistening moisture in her eyes.

I Built a Talking AI Influencer for Just $10 🤖 — Here's the Full Workflow + Prompts

I tested a workflow for creating a realistic AI influencer using GPT Image 2.5 + Seedance 2.5 inside Higgsfield.

No expensive camera setup. No real presenter needed.

Here's the entire workflow, including the prompts I used. Feel free to copy and experiment with them.

STEP 1 — Create your AI character

Use GPT Image 2.5 to create an original fictional adult character.

The key is to build a consistent identity before generating videos.

STEP 2 — Generate a 6-view character sheet

You need front, side and back views of both the full body and face.

COPY THIS PROMPT:

"Create a photorealistic CHARACTER TURNAROUND CONTACT SHEET for an original fictional adult female AI presenter, age 26.

Create a clean 3-column by 2-row grid with SIX equally sized panels, separated by thin white gutters.

TOP ROW:
Full-body front view.
Full-body 90-degree side profile.
Full-body back view.

BOTTOM ROW:
4. Close-up frontal portrait.
5. Close-up side profile.
6. Close-up back-of-head and shoulders.
CHARACTER DESIGN:
An attractive but natural-looking adult woman with warm light-olive skin, subtle freckles across the nose, deep brown eyes, gently defined cheekbones and natural rose lips.
Shoulder-length dark chestnut brown hair with soft layered waves, a slightly off-centre part and natural flyaways.
Small silver hoop earrings. Fitted charcoal-navy long-sleeve crew-neck top, dark straight-leg trousers and minimal black shoes.

PRESENTATION:
Neutral matte medium-gray studio background across all six panels. Soft, even studio lighting, realistic skin texture, natural proportions and premium casting-reference photography.
Maintain exactly the same face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit and accessories in every panel.

No text, labels, numbers, watermarks or extra panels."

STEP 3 — Create a separate portrait

Don't use the entire character sheet as your only video input.
Create a separate vertical portrait to help maintain facial consistency during video generation.

COPY THIS PROMPT:

"Using the supplied six-view character turnaround sheet as the identity reference, create ONE single photorealistic vertical 9:16 medium close-up portrait of the SAME fictional adult woman, age 26.

Use the front-facing close-up as the primary face reference.

Preserve her exact facial structure, warm light-olive skin, subtle freckles, deep brown eyes, dark chestnut shoulder-length layered wavy hair and silver hoop earrings.

Keep the same fitted charcoal-navy crew-neck top.

She is seated facing the camera in a softly lit modern home creator studio, with a softly blurred bookshelf and warm practical lamp in the background.

Natural soft window light illuminates her face.

Frame from mid-chest upward, with her full head visible. She looks directly into the lens with a friendly, engaged expression and lips gently parted as if about to speak.

Realistic smartphone-camera photography, natural skin texture, authentic creator presence, no beauty filters.

Single full-frame portrait. NOT a collage, NOT a turnaround sheet. No text, captions, logos or watermark."

STEP 4 — Make your character speak

Now bring your portrait into Seedance 2.5 using Omni Reference mode.

Settings I used:

Model: Seedance 2.5

Aspect ratio: 9:16

Resolution: 1080p

Duration: 10 seconds

Native audio: ON
COPY THIS PROMPT:
"Create a photorealistic vertical 9:16 creator-style talking-head video using the provided portrait as the exact identity and appearance reference.
The same fictional adult woman must remain visually consistent: same face, warm light-olive skin, subtle nose freckles, deep brown eyes, shoulder-length dark chestnut layered waves, silver hoop earrings and charcoal-navy long-sleeve top.
Do not redesign her or change her age.
SCENE:
One continuous smartphone-style medium close-up in her softly lit home creator studio, with a softly blurred bookshelf and warm practical lamp in the background.

She looks directly into the lens and speaks naturally to the viewer with warm, confident, conversational energy.

MOVEMENT:

Subtle realistic facial expressions.

Natural blinking.

Small head movements.
One restrained hand gesture.

Natural mouth movements synchronized to speech.

VOICE:
Clear, warm adult female voice in a natural modern British English accent. Friendly creator delivery, not robotic or exaggerated.
EXACT DIALOGUE:
'You don't need a film crew to build an AI creator. Start with one face, keep it consistent, and let it speak.'
Keep the entire sentence audible. Do not paraphrase, omit or add words.
Light room tone only, no music.
No camera cuts, no change of location, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no watermark or logos."

STEP 5 — Build a recognizable AI influencer
This is where things get interesting.

Don't just generate random videos with different faces.

Keep the same character identity, hairstyle, outfit, background style and voice across your videos.

The goal is to create a recognizable virtual creator who can produce content consistently.

My takeaway

The real secret isn't just generating a beautiful AI face.

It's building a complete character identity and making that character reusable across different video productions.

I'm exploring how far we can push this with Higgsfield.

Would you follow an AI influencer if you couldn't tell it was AI? 👀

Share your thoughts below!

#AIInfluencer #Higgsfield #GPTImage #Seedance #AIVideo #GenerativeAI

【美学学习1】把贝聿铭的“借景”做成现代排版海报

很多人用 AI 做国风建筑容易陷入复杂插画堆砌，其实中式审美的顶峰恰恰是「极简与留白」。

今天做了一组现代东方建筑海报的排版实验：
• 题材：苏州北寺塔（借景苏博几何白墙与静水庭院）
• 排版约束：瑞士网格 + 极端字号反差，严格限制主标题字宽 < 65%
• 工具：GPT-Image 2.5 直出（100% Raw，无后期）

💡 排版驯服心得：
之前测试时模型总喜欢在底部画三视图挤死边距，这次在 Prompt 中显式下达「底部 15% 绝对真空留白」并禁止绘制机械图纸，画面底部的倒影呼吸感瞬间彻底出来了。

左上角的苏州市经纬度（31.3268° N 120.6202° E）也是一次成型。

GPT2 x 黑暗里一点微光 x 颗粒渐变插画 x 提示词

十点了，发点安静的。整张几乎全黑，只有一点小小的光，光是一层层带颗粒的半透明色团叠出来的，中间一颗白色小星星。

四张：刚划亮的火柴、一盏小油灯、停在草叶尖上的萤火虫、一支点着的线香和它的烟。

背景我写的是「暗梅紫」，不是黑也不是深蓝。写黑容易变成死黑一块，写深蓝又会变成夜景，梅紫压得住暖光，看着也更软。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅 3:4 的极简数字插画，用细密颗粒的喷绘渐变来画光。画面里只有一个小小的发光点，近距离平视，位于画面中下部，顶部和两侧是大片接近黑色的暗梅紫背景，暗部偏紫褐炭黑，不要海军蓝或深蓝夜景，背景里没有任何场景。发光处是一个炽白的小核心，收成一颗四角尖细、纵向略长的星芒，不要放射状光束；围着它叠几片边缘柔化、互相穿透的半透明色团：外层蜂蜜黄和琥珀金向上微微偏斜，内层珊瑚橙红，交叠处藏一点雾蓝和淡紫，冷色只占很小一块。光从核心往外柔柔散开，越往外越暗，最后融进黑里，只照亮物体自身的一圈边缘，不照亮环境。承托发光点的小物件只画简化的几何轮廓，被画面底边或侧边裁切，表面只接住一道薄薄的粉白反光。所有渐变和色团都带细密随机噪点，像磨砂粉尘，轮廓若隐若现，没有硬边、塑料高光或第二个亮点。暗梅紫约占四分之三，暖黄和珊瑚红是主角，白色只在核心。没有文字。安静、亲密，像夜里一个人时的一点微光。

New subject:
一根刚划亮的火柴：细木火柴棍从画面右下方斜着伸进来，被底边裁切，火柴头上一小簇刚燃起的火苗是唯一亮处，火苗边缘飘着两三粒细小的火星，火柴棍顶端被照出一道粉白的光边。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 夏天草地上的小摊 x 动画背景 x 提示词

晚上发点夏天的。一大片蓝天，一朵很高的积云，草地上停着一个没人看着的小摊，有点像吉卜力电影里路过的一个镜头。

四张：田埂边卖西瓜的小木车、山坡上卖花的小三轮、铁轨旁的便当小屋、湖边卖冰汽水的推车。每个都有一块褪了色的红，草里还藏着猫、狗、钓竿这些小东西。

关键是把摊子压在画面下面三分之一，上面全留给天和云。摊子一画大，天就挤没了，夏天那种空旷感也跟着没了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅 9:16 竖幅的手绘动画背景插画，细墨线勾结构和磨损，平涂色块，云朵用不透明颜料层叠和断续干刷做出颗粒，没有摄影渐变、镜头光晕和厚重立体渲染。晴朗的夏日午后：高饱和青蓝天空占画面约六成，顶部是大片纯净的蓝；一团巨大的积云从左侧低处向中部隆起，云顶不超过画面中线，受光面奶油白，背光面浅青灰，有体积。地平线很低，底部横着一条黄绿色草地，前景草叶用细碎短线画出。主体是一处小小的路边生活设施，接近人眼高度的正面远景，完整入画，压在画面下部三分之一，尺寸不大，上方留出辽阔天空；主体有屋顶或顶篷、台面和挂着的小物三层，旁边有两三件生活道具自然围着。阳光从左上方照来，温暖明亮、边缘清楚，檐下阴影是透气的深蓝绿。颜色面积：青蓝天空最大，奶油白与浅青灰的云其次，黄绿草地铺底，褪朱红只集中在主体的一个主要立面上，麦秆米黄、旧木褐和炭灰用在框架和细线上。旧木板有褪色涂层、细裂纹和露底，布料有折痕。画面里没有人物，没有任何可读文字，布旗和小牌子上只有抽象墨迹。安静、悠闲，像一个没人看着的夏天下午。

一家咖啡小店。第一款：一杯装在透明玻璃杯里的冰拿铁，奶和咖啡分层、浮着冰块；第二款：一杯顶上挤了奶油、撒了可可粉的热摩卡，装在白色厚瓷杯里。图上文字只有五个短词：大标题「Coffee Time」；第一款品名「Latte」，价格「18」；第二款品名「Mocha」，价格「22」。除此以外没有任何文字、品牌或标志。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 墙上画满的小房间 x 蜡笔童书插画 x 提示词

下午来一组软乎乎的。蜡笔加彩铅画在米黄的粗纹纸上，房间有点乱，墙上全是小孩自己画的东西，太阳、小鱼、小火车，有几笔还画到了柜子和地板上。

四张都是白天家里的小事：厨房里踩着凳子搅面糊的小男孩、趴在地毯上和橘猫一起看书的小女孩、窗边陪孙子拼拼图的奶奶、早上站在洗手台前刷牙的小孩。

墙上的涂鸦要写「疏密不均、随手画的」，再加一句别排成壁纸图案。不写的话，模型会把墙画成一整面整齐的花纹，小孩乱画的那股劲就没了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅约 3:4 的儿童绘本内页插画，用软蜡笔铺色、彩色铅笔叠线，画在暖奶油色的粗纹画纸上，纸纹透过所有色层，笔触干涩、断续，有轻微越界和反复涂抹，轮廓稚拙，透视带一点童趣，不要平滑上色和矢量轮廓。场景是一间有人在用、略微凌乱的室内角落。竖幅中远景，机位略高于人物视线，轻轻俯看，人物全身和脚边地面都入画；人物和家具集中在画面下半部，人物偏右，左侧一件大块的家具做视觉支点，上半部留出大片浅色墙面。墙上是孩子随手用蜡笔画的涂鸦：歪歪扭扭的小图形，疏密不均地散在留白里，有的涂鸦顺势画到了家具、门板和地板上，不要排成整齐的壁纸图案。前景地板上散落几支蜡笔、画纸和小物件。白天的柔和暖光从画外左上方进来，阴影浅而松散，没有强烈明暗。配色：暖奶油黄和浅麦色占一半，浅杏粉、灰玫瑰粉和赭木棕撑住家具和衣物，地板是深巧克力棕但看得出彩色笔迹，珊瑚红、柔钴蓝、草绿、明黄只以分散的小块出现在涂鸦和小物上。人物表情简单、放松。画面里没有任何文字、字母或数字，衣服上也没有字。温柔、自在，像一页讲平常日子的童书。

New subject:
早上的厨房一角：一个戴大围裙、头发翘起来的小男孩踩在小木凳上，站在矮橱柜前用木勺搅一大碗面糊，脸颊沾了一点面粉；左侧是一台圆角的旧冰箱，冰箱门和墙上有蜡笔画的鸡蛋、小鸡、勺子和一个笑脸太阳；地上散着蜡笔、一个空蛋壳和撒出来的一小撮面粉。画面中没有文字。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 雨夜街角一盏灯 x 像素画 x 提示词

中午发一组像素画。下雨的晚上从楼上往下看，整条街都是蓝黑的，只有一盏橙灯亮着，地上的水把灯光拉成长长一条倒影。

四张：雨里等公交的人、便利店门口蹲着撸猫的学生、巷子里冒热气的面摊、撑伞站在桥上的人。

像素感靠两句：写明硬边方块像素加棋盘格抖动，再把平滑渐变禁掉。少了这两句，模型很容易画成普通插画再糊一层马赛克。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):

中午来一组刺绣。一块米灰色麻布，大半留空，只绣一处风景，右下角站个小人，线一针一针的，小人还鼓起来一点，像真贴在布上。

GPT2 x 黑白网点漫画页 x 手绘分镜 x 提示词

下午来一页黑白漫画。奶油色的纸，黑墨线，阴影全是小网点，四五个格子错开叠着，讲一个人很普通的一天。

这次换了四个主角：夜班面包师、修自行车的人、搬家的狐狸一家、少年天文学家。格子怎么排、网点怎么用都不动，换人换事就行。

有两句我一定写进去：「没有对白气泡和拟声字」，还有「一格做成黑底白点的反白」。前一句防乱码字，后一句让整页有块重色，不然一片灰。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅约 4:5 的黑白手绘漫画页：奶油米色纸底上，四到五个大小不一的方形分镜框轻微错位、互相压角叠放，用粗细略不均的黑墨手绘框线，从上到下讲同一位主角一天里的几个安静片段；其中一格让主角走出画框，直接站在纸面空白处，脚边有一小片手绘地面。线条是钢笔墨线，圆润、略抖、有手感，角色是大眼小嘴的卡通比例，表情简单可爱。所有中间调和阴影都用圆形网点（screentone）表现，深色块用实墨填黑；必须有一格做成黑底白点的反白夜景或落雪窗景，让整页有一块重色。格子之间的空白处散落几片手绘落叶或小物件作装饰。没有对白气泡、没有拟声字、没有签名、日期或任何可读文字。明暗只靠网点疏密和实墨面积区分，不做渲染光影。配色只有奶油纸色和纯黑墨，网点为黑。印刷感带一点墨色不均，像独立漫画小志里的一页。慢、暖、日常、带一点小幽默。

New subject:
夜班面包师：一个戴白色厨师帽、系围裙的圆脸面包师。几格分别是：深夜在案板上揉面、蹲在烤箱前盯着面包膨起、捧着一托盘刚出炉的面包、天快亮时坐在店门口台阶上打哈欠；走出画框那格是他抱着一大袋面粉。反白格是窗外深夜的小雪。画面中没有文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

数量我写的是「十几枚」，后面跟一句「互不重叠」。不写的话模型要么只放三四个，要么全堆在一起，那种刚出窑倒一手的感觉就出不来。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅约 4:5 的手作陶瓷小挂件实拍：一只摊开的手掌从左下斜伸入画面，掌心朝上占画面中下大半，掌心和几根手指上松散摆着十几枚可整体替换的迷你釉彩陶瓷挂件，每枚约指甲盖大小，顶端带一枚细小金色挂环，彼此互不重叠、疏密自然，指缝间留一点空隙。机位约 45 度俯拍略斜，焦点落在掌心中央那几枚挂件上，边缘挂件和背景轻微虚化。背景是一张摊开的奶油米色素纸或浅木桌面，只作浅底，不出现任何可读文字；一角可放一片干枯落叶做前景点缀。光线是窗边柔和侧光，从右上进入，色温偏暖，每枚挂件釉面有小而柔的高光点，挂件在掌心投下浅暖灰的短阴影，不要硬闪光。材质：手捏陶瓷小坯体，表面厚涂玻璃釉，手绘小斑点、细线条和金边描边，轮廓略不规整，看得出手作痕迹，拒绝塑料、树脂或 3D 渲染感；手掌皮肤纹理真实自然。配色：暖肤色与奶油纸底占大面，挂件以珊瑚橘、奶白、焦糖棕、芥末黄为主，少量金色点缀。画面无品牌、无商标、无水印、无可读文字。温暖、手作、像工作室里刚把一把新烧好的小挂件倒在手上拍一张。

New subject:
迷你茶杯挂件：十几枚迷你茶杯、带盖小茶壶、小茶碟和一只小糖罐，釉色在奶白、薄荷绿、珊瑚粉之间轮换，杯沿和壶嘴描一圈细金线，几只杯子里有一小汪琥珀色茶釉，杯身手绘小圆点或小碎花。每枚顶端有小金环。画面中没有文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

Flat art. Thread texture. Then a cap.

Use the art as a reference; name the fill, lettering, edge and light. Reference the patch for placement.

Actual Made GPT Image 2.5 outputs. AI mockup, not a stitch file. Check letters and scale.
posts.prompt:
Slide 1 of 3: From flat to thread. A large navy shield patch has raised ivory NIGHT SHIFT lettering and a pale blue raccoon hugging an orange star. The patch sits on dark textured cloth. The original flat AI-generated artwork appears in a small inset at upper right. Both the reference and the embroidered-looking output were made with GPT Image 2.5 in Made. This is an AI concept mockup, not a physical patch.

———

Slide 2 of 3: Ask for the structure. Three detail crops of the actual patch output accompany exact phrases from its prompt: directional tatami fill across broad color areas; satin-stitch lettering and keyline; a thick navy overlocked outer edge. The crops show navy thread texture, raised cream letters and the rounded border against dark cloth. Use the flat art as a reference and inspect the letters and outline; the result is a material study, not exact preservation.

———

Slide 3 of 3: Then place the mockup. The reviewed patch was used as the reference for a second image edit. The resulting image shows the recognizable NIGHT SHIFT raccoon badge on the front of an orange canvas baseball cap, photographed at a three-quarter angle on a warm tabletop. Text says to reference the patch, then place it, and check letters, outline and scale. This is an AI mockup; a stitch file and sewn sample are still needed.

posts.text:
The chair vanished. Its reflection didn't.

Six edits from one image in Made's GPT Image 2.5. One kept the reflection; two needed a closer floor check.

Name the traces you want removed, then inspect the result. All six attempts inside.

AI test scene.
posts.prompt:
Slide 1 of 3. The chair's gone. Its reflection isn't. Actual GPT Image 2.5 test output A2 shows a warm stone room with no chair on the floor, but a red armchair remains visible in the large mirror on the right. An inset shows the original AI test image with the real red chair at left and its reflection at right. The retained reflection was generated by Made and was not added afterward.

———

Slide 2 of 3. Name the traces. Then check again. Two edits made with the same explicit prompt are shown: B1 has no chair, reflected chair or visible chair shadow; B3 removes the chair and its reflection but leaves a faint dark floor patch, circled in red for inspection. Exact added clause: including its reflection in the mirror and the shadow cast by the chair on the floor. Also name what should stay. Check the mirror and floor before exporting; explicit wording is no guarantee.

———

Slide 3 of 3. One scene, six edits. All three trials per prompt are shown. Prompt A asks to remove the chair and preserve the surroundings: A1 is visually clean, A2 retains the chair in the mirror, and A3 retains a floor shadow. Prompt B explicitly includes the reflection and shadow: B1 and B2 are visually clean; B3 has a faint dark floor patch. Red rings identify the floor areas in A3 and B3. All six edits use the same original source in Made's GPT Image 2.5. This small visual screen is not a reliability benchmark.

posts.author: static_stare
posts.text:
GPT2 x 超市托盘贴纸 x 水粉插画 x 提示词

周一晚上想画点有手感的，参考是俯拍的超市托盘，甜椒摆一列，旁边贴着圆贴纸和价签。我把食材换成了柿子、草莓、玉米、葡萄，贴纸文案也重写了，没用任何真实品牌。

水粉那种干刷露底和塑料托盘的白擦痕挺难稳住，出图的时候我把俯视和浅蓝灰托盘写得很死。

Visual system 固定，New subject 换成别的水果蔬菜就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖向 9:16 的平面不透明水粉插画。垂直俯视、中近景，无地平线；高饱和食材在浅蓝灰透明超市塑料托盘中纵向排列，彼此轻微遮挡，饱满色块占主体，边缘允许局部裁切。托盘圆角边框形成环绕主体的双层曲线，以半透明白色长擦痕、断续反光与浅灰叠色表现塑料；外围窄窄暖米色底。光从左上方柔和漫射，中性偏暖乳白；右下方仅留淡蓝灰接触阴影。食材表面保留不均匀水粉覆盖、干刷露底、细碎斑点及短划高光。沿四周错落安排圆形认证章、齿边产地票、竖向条码贴与倾斜价格签——文字与金额必须严格按 New subject 所写，使用简短装饰字形与图标，不用真实品牌。深蓝细线印刷感，温暖轻快的市集气息；不要商业摄影景深或镜面高光。

New subject:
三个橙红色的熟柿子，带深绿色的四瓣柿蒂，在透明塑料托盘里从上到下排成一列；托盘上贴着：左上角一枚圆形贴纸「FRESH」配一片小叶子图标，右侧中部一枚圆形贴纸「IN SEASON」，左下角一张奶油色小价签「$3.60」，左侧中部一条只有竖条纹没有数字的条形码贴纸。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 复古太空海报 x 装饰艺术平涂 x 提示词

周一下午想做点硬一点的，翻到一张奶油白配朱红的太空海报，斜线往上冲，人物仰着头，整张像六十年代的科幻封面。

做了四张：扛扳手的火箭机械师、天文台女天文学家、月面漫游车、舷窗前的圆头机器人。配色就锁奶油白、朱砂橙、炭蓝这三板斧。

Visual system 别动，New subject 换成别的岗位或载具就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖版复古太空探险海报插画，约 10:13。装饰艺术几何与中世纪太空宣传画融合，平整矢量色块、哑光纸张与细微丝网印刷油墨颗粒，不用柔滑渐变。低机位英雄式仰视，主体接近画幅全高；粗大斜向条带由左下贯穿右上，与服装结构线共同形成上升动势。后景以深炭海军蓝星空承托巨大朱砂红行星与奶油色轨道圆弧，远处配置小型火箭、发射塔和稀疏星点，保持明确尺度差。左上方暖白硬质主光照亮亮面，阴影压成冷石板灰与近黑平面。色板：奶油白与暖象牙、朱砂橙红、深炭海军蓝为主，低饱和石板灰与灰绿过渡，芥末黄仅作窄边点缀。不出现文字、标志或写实镜面反射。气氛坚定、浪漫、复古未来。

New subject:
一位戴圆形气泡头盔的男性火箭机械师，穿奶白和朱橙色拼块的连体工作服，一只手握着大扳手扛在肩上，仰头望向身后正在升空的复古尖头火箭，发射塔的斜撑和尾焰在背景里。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
由 GPT-image-2.5 模型生成。
--------------------------------
AI 生图提示词：
Vertical 3:4 low-angle shot in a Song wine cellar: rows of tall ceramic jars fade into damp dark, and a woman in translucent gauze bends to lift a wooden ladle from an open jar. Seen from waist up, tilted upward toward her face, the curve of her neck and the wet sheen of her collarbone catching the light. Fermenting rice steam curls upward; a small oil lantern at floor level warms the jar rims, while a shaft of cold daylight from a high vent grazes her shoulder. Droplets on glazed clay, condensation on her sleeve, gauze clinging where the vapour touches it. Muted amber and slate palette, deep shadow, tactile, film-like grain, shallow focus.

posts.text:
GPT2 x 秋天的小路 x 油画棒 x 提示词

最近很喜欢油画棒画的东西，一道一道糙糙的笔触，边上还留着纸白。趁银杏和枫叶还没掉光，画了四条秋天的小路。

四张是银杏道上推自行车的女孩、山里红枫石阶上背竹篓的老人、湖边长椅上坐着的人和两只大白鹅、傍晚田埂上拖着风筝回家的小男孩。第一次出来太细了，像彩铅插画，后来在提示词里写明笔触要粗要短、一笔一笔分开、叶子不画形状、人画大一点，才像油画棒画的。

提示词分两段。上面「Visual system」管笔触、纸白边、颜色比例和小路往里走的构图，别动它。下面「New subject」写什么地方、路上有谁，改这一段就行。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

GPT2 x 老街小店 x 钢笔淡彩 x 提示词

周日下午适合看点慢的东西。做了四家老街小店：理发店、修表配钥匙的、早点铺、小卖部，都是老街上常见的那种。

小卖部门口的竹椅上睡着一只三花猫，窗台上一排玻璃糖罐，看着就想进去买包辣条。理发店门口那根红白蓝的转灯，现在街上也不太能看到了。

第一版出来很像欧洲乡下的石头小屋，满墙花藤，钢笔线也几乎看不见。后来在提示词里写明是南方老街的灰白抹灰墙和青瓦，墙上钉个电表箱、挂台空调外机，再让笔线先把每样东西勾出来，才有了速写本的感觉。招牌我都让它留空，店是干嘛的，看门口摆的东西就知道。上面「Visual system」那段别动，下面「New subject」换成你记得的那家店就行，裁缝铺、五金店、修鞋摊都可以试试。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅 3:4 的钢笔淡彩速写，画在带明显纹理的冷压水彩纸上，像速写本里的一页，而不是精细写实的水彩画。画面中部偏上是一间中国南方老街上的小店门面：灰白色抹灰墙有点斑驳，一段青灰色小瓦坡屋檐，木门板或旧木框玻璃门，墙上随手钉着一两个空白的电表箱、一截电线或一台旧空调外机。正面平视的中景，门窗正对着看，墙面基本是平的，只带一点自然透视，不画纵深街道；门前一小片水泥地，摆着这家店自己的东西和一两盆植物，背景只露出一点相邻的屋顶。整张画的骨架是清楚可见的细深棕色针管笔线：门框、瓦片、凳腿、物件都先用笔线勾出来，线条轻松、略带抖动和断续，不把轮廓全部闭合；水彩只是在线上薄薄铺一层，颜色不完全贴着线走，看得见纸纹颗粒、水痕回流和干笔飞白。细节适量，大块墙面留白纸，不要每个角落都画满小物件。门面四周的笔触越往外越松，最后淡入大片白纸，上下各留出一截空白纸面。强烈的暖阳从右上方斜照，受光的墙面和地面直接留出纸白，投影统一朝左下方延伸，是一大块清楚的、透明的蓝紫和靛蓝色，屋檐下和门洞里也是蓝紫色暗部。色彩：暖纸白和浅灰白约五成，黄绿到橄榄绿的植物约两成，蓝紫、靛蓝的阴影约两成，低饱和赭黄和陶土棕的木头、陶盆约百分之八，零星一点灰粉或砖红。不要欧式乡村小屋、石头墙和满墙花藤，不要黑色粗轮廓和填色插画感，阴影不要用中性灰黑，材质不要画得过度写实。招牌、灯箱、门牌、电表箱都只画成空白的木板或色块，画面里不要任何可读的文字、字母、数字、签名或水印，这家店是做什么的全靠门口的东西看出来。整体安静、温暖，像晴天午后在老街上随手画下的一张。

New subject:
一家老理发店：一扇刷成浅蓝色的旧木门半开着，门边墙上装着一根红白蓝条纹的理发店转灯，窗户里能看见一把老式铁皮理发椅和一面圆镜子，门口一张木长凳上搭着一条白毛巾，一只橘猫趴在长凳底下，墙角一盆绿萝。

十点发一组冷的。冰湖上立着一座透光的球形小木屋，大月亮挂在后面，松树和雪岩围一圈，灯笼点在栈道边。屋里暖，外面冷。

四张换屋子用途：卧室舱、湖上茶屋、迷你天文台、木浴屋。冰湖、大月和冷暖对比别动，只换舱里在干什么。

冷暖对比我写死了：不写「屋内暖主光 + 月光冷辅光」，模型就爱把整张拍成同一色温，夜里那点对照就没了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一张竖幅约 2:3 到 3:4 的安静雪夜电影感场景：结冰湖面上矗立一座暖光球形/南瓜形半透明木构小屋，屋内透出橙金暖光，细木栈道连向近前景的雪岩，岩石与栈道边点着几盏小灯笼。机位略高的中远景，小屋大致居中偏上，前景雪岩与裂冰纹理可读，中景湖冰反射暖光，远景雪松林与雪山轮廓，天空悬一轮巨大冷月。主光是小屋内部暖光与灯笼，月光作冷蓝辅光与轮廓，冷暖对比明确；雪面有细颗粒，冰面有裂纹高光，烟气可从烟囱轻散。配色：靛蓝夜空与冷白雪、橙金窗光与灯笼。参考原图主体是卧室舱，二创保持同一视觉系统，换成茶屋/小天文台/木浴屋等功能变体，并避免任何水印文字。画面无品牌、无可读字母。安静、避世、像冷夜里唯一一处暖。

New subject:
卧室舱：球形半透明舱内可见铺好的床与一小张木桌，暖光从床头溢出，烟囱有淡烟。画面中没有文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

傍晚放一套能直接拿去改的：厨房撕页食谱卡。单张厚纸，一边撕毛边，字少而紧，纸色按奶油、桃色、鼠尾草绿、芥末轮一张。

四张虚构菜：蜜桃燕麦盅、柠檬黄油虾、松茸菇汤、焦糖布丁。提示词分「画面」和「主体」两段，上面那段别动，下面换成你的菜名、时间、份量和一个短步骤词就行。

晚上发一组图书馆。高书架夹出一条窄道，尽头落地玻璃，外面全是绿树，阳光把人影拉得很长，落在浅色地板上。平涂，带一点纸面颗粒。

四张换道里的小事：窗边读蓝皮书的人（橙裤）、梯子上取书、坐垫上睡着的猫和摊开的书、两人对坐低声讨论。小人可以换，夹道别拆。

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
一幅竖幅约 3:4 的平涂偏绘本插画：高书架夹出一条窄通道，尽头是落地玻璃墙，窗外是浓绿树冠；长长的阳光阴影落在浅色地板上。一点透视，机位约人眼高度看向通道尽头；左右书架高大、深褐木色，书脊只是色块条，没有任何可读文字。窗外树叶用块面与颗粒笔触表现，阳光从玻璃灌进来，室内相对更暗，人物与家具在地板上投下清晰偏长的暗影。全画面有细密纸面颗粒/噪点，颜色偏哑光，不要厚重油画笔触，也不要照片写实。配色：深褐书架、窗外翠绿、浅地板、书脊上的砖红/赭黄/灰蓝小色块；人物衣着可有一块亮色（如橙裤）做点缀。画面没有任何文字、字母或数字。安静、被阳光填满的图书馆午后。

GPT2 x 夜里只剩一种蓝 x 单色平涂 x 提示词

睡前发一组安静的。整张只剩蓝和一点象牙白，平涂、硬边，东西很少，像夜里房间里只开了一点冷光。

四张换的是那一点亮落在哪儿：窗台上的白瓷杯、一盏很弱的台灯、夹着书签的书、帘缝里的月亮。蓝色和留白的方法都不动。

提示词里要写死「不要黄光，不要再加别的颜色」。它很爱在夜里补一盏暖台灯，一补这种冷就没了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的单色平涂插画，近景或中近景，夜里的室内或窗边。全画面只有一个蓝色系加一点象牙白：主色是饱和度不高的深蓝到青蓝，受光面是浅象牙或很淡的蓝白，没有黄色、没有橙色、没有绿色，不要补一盏暖色灯。形体用干净的平涂色块和硬边阴影来分面，阴影边缘清楚，不要柔焦，不要厚涂笔触，不要照片颗粒。构图靠近主体，画面里东西很少，大面积是安静的墙、窗帘或桌面。光线来自窗外的月光或一处很弱的冷白光，亮度对比中等，暗部仍能看出形，不要死黑。画面无文字、无签名、无水印，器物上不要可读的字。安静、发冷，像夜里只剩一种颜色的房间。

New subject:
【主体】窗台上放着一只白瓷杯，杯子的受光面是象牙白，窗外是深蓝的夜，窗帘拉开一条缝，冷光照在杯沿和窗台上。没有人。画面中没有文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

GPT2 x 仰角特写 x 限色丝网 x 提示词

晚上发一组限色丝网。就三种颜色：深藏青吃掉暗部，米白做出体积，珊瑚粉只打一个很小的点。镜头压得很低，对着东西往上拍，排线又密，有点复古海报的感觉。

四张换的是拍什么：一只白猫、一只飞蛾、一台老相机、一台留声机的喇叭。三种颜色和仰角都不动。

提示词里要写死「只有三种颜色，珊瑚粉只能出现一处」。不写的话它会画回全彩，排线也会被抹成渐变。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 9:16 的限色丝网印刷海报特写：机位极低、几乎从下往上仰拍，主体被推到离镜头非常近，占满大部分画面，只有少量深色背景。全图只用三种颜色，不要第四色：深藏青或近黑的蓝吃掉所有暗部和背景；米白或象牙色负责受光面和体积；珊瑚粉只打一到两处很小的视觉焦点，比如一只眼睛、一个按钮或一点装饰。体积主要靠留白和深色的负形来塑造，暗部用高密度的细排线、交叉线和紧凑的短线去填，不要光滑渐变，不要写实照片的皮肤或金属反光。边缘是利落的印制边缘，像套色丝网，套印可以有极轻微的错位，但不要脏成墨团。画面无文字、无签名、无水印、无品牌、无游戏或影视角色特征。配色克制、对比强，有复古海报的狠劲。

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

GPT2 x 晒蓝纸上的白影子 x 蓝晒金箔 x 提示词

中午发一组蓝晒。就是那种把纸刷上药、压上东西拿到太阳下晒，晒完整张都是深蓝，被挡住的地方留下白影子。我在边缘又点了几小片金箔，像从标本匣里抽出来的一张。

四张换的是压在纸上的东西：芦苇边的白鹭、车篮里插了花的旧自行车、一把茶壶配干花、海边一座小灯塔。蓝底、毛边纸和金箔都不动。

提示词里要写清楚「这是手工蓝晒，蓝得不均匀，边缘有药液水痕」。不写的话它容易画成普通的蓝调插画，纸的毛边也没了。人名和签名都不要写，一写就像在临摹某张角色卡。
