posts.text:
Turn your workday into a flat-pack furniture manual.

Step 1: coffee. Step 4: the meeting that could have been an email. Spare parts: 47 unread messages.

One copy-paste prompt. Works in GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana, and Grok Imagine. Here it is.

The prompt:

"Create a single-page flat-pack furniture assembly manual titled MY WORKDAY, in the style of a Scandinavian instruction booklet. Clean black line art on off-white paper. No words except the title, step numbers, and a small parts list.

Show 6 numbered steps of a small faceless cartoon person assembling their day:
1. pouring coffee
2. opening a laptop covered in notification bubbles
3. sorting sticky notes into two piles
4. sitting in a meeting while a wall clock spins
5. one large block labeled DEEP WORK clicking into place, with a bold arrow
6. closing the laptop, a check mark above their head

Top right: a parts box listing 'Coffee x2, Meetings x3, Deep work x1, Unread x47'.
Bottom: the classic warning panel showing the person trying to do all 6 steps at once, crossed out with a big X.
Tiny hex key icon in the corner. Portrait 3:4, crisp print texture, lots of white space."

What you get: a clean, very shareable "manual" of a normal day that looks like it came out of a furniture box.

How to make it yours:

1. Swap the 6 steps for your real day. Paste your calendar into any chat and ask: "Turn tomorrow into 6 short, funny assembly steps."

2. Change the title. MY MONDAY, LAUNCH WEEK, MOVING DAY, NEW BABY.

3. Put yourself in it. Upload a selfie and replace "small faceless cartoon person" with "a line-art version of the person in the uploaded photo."

4. If the text comes out garbled, cut the parts list to 3 items. Short labels render cleaner.

Post your version below.
I want to see whose step 4 is the worst.

GPT2 x 只留一种主色 x 街头赛璐珞 x 提示词

晚上发一组街头插画。线很细，颜色是硬边平涂，背景几乎是白的。整张只给角色一个主色，别的全是黑白，手还得有动作。

四张换的是谁：短发花店店员、看黑胶的唱片行老板、夜班出租车司机、修车铺学徒。都不是现成角色，线稿和留白的方法不变。

主色跟着衣服和一件小东西走就行，不要再加第二种很跳的颜色，一加就散。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 3:4 的二维数字手绘街头插画：极细、锐利的黑线勾轮廓，颜色是硬边赛璐珞平涂，几乎没有柔和的晕染，只有面颊或关节处允许一点点喷枪似的腮红。背景是大面积纯白或极浅灰的留白，没有复杂场景，顶多在边缘留一点衣角、头发或饰品的出画。构图是近景半身或近胸特写，人物的手必须参与动作（整理头发、把玩小物件、插在口袋、扶着一根带子），手的结构要清楚。色彩系统非常克制：整张以黑、白、深灰为骨架，只给角色一个主色（以及这个主色的两三个深浅），不要再引入第二种高饱和颜色。主色用在头发的局部、衣服色块、饰品或指甲上，形成完整的视觉系统。不要画现成的游戏或动漫角色，不要可识别的商标和文字，不要签名和水印。气质干净、现代、有街头运动感，但不靠脏污和做旧。

四张换的是哪：苏州巷口、厦门渡口、山城台阶、海边石堤。标题、类别、一句短签，三处字就够，解签长文不要写，一写就挤还容易错字。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 5:8 的古意城市日签，像线装书里夹着的一页插画：底是温暖的米白或浅宣纸色，能看见很淡的纸纹。画面下半或一侧是细墨线加薄淡彩画出的城市小景，上半和一侧留出大片空白。线要细、要稳，颜色是矿物感的浅彩（石绿、花青、赭石、胭脂只点很少），不要厚涂、不要照片、不要现代扁平插画。光线是均匀的纸面环境光，没有强烈的投影，空气有一点薄雾。文字只允许三处，必须是端正的中文，逐字照写、不写错、间距均匀：1）顶部一行很小的类别「城市日签」，可配一条细线；2）画面上方或空白处一个较大的地名标题，两到四个字，细的宋体或细楷；3）标题附近或另一侧空白处一句短签，四到八个字，字号明显小于标题。不要写「早安」，不要写长解签、不要写日期、不要英文段落、不要印章里的乱码、不要地图针和logo。整张最多这三处文字。气质安静、留白多，像傍晚也可以看的一页。

New subject:
【主体】类别：「城市日签」；标题：「苏州巷」；短签：「门环还是温的」。画面左下是一条青石板小巷，白墙、窄门、一排漏窗，巷口有一棵很细的老槐，墙上一点爬藤。人只在远处留一个很小的背影。全图只有这三处文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

GPT2 x 走进漩涡里 x 笔触隧道 x 提示词

晚上八点发一组漩涡。整张都是弯弯的短笔触，一圈圈旋到尽头的一团光里，光里站着一个很小的背影，前面飞满小东西。

四张换的是颜色和飞的东西：金色麦浪里飞纸鹤，深绿林子里飞萤火虫，红霞里飞花瓣，紫色夜空里飞蒲公英种子。

人一定要小，指甲盖那么大，看不清脸最好。笔触要短要弯，一画成平滑渐变就没那个味道了。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的厚涂油画风超现实插画，整张都由密集、短而弯的笔触组成，像旋转的油画笔法。画面是一条向远处收缩的螺旋隧道：四周的笔触沿着同心漩涡一圈圈旋进画面中上部的尽头，尽头是一团最亮的光。光里站着一个很小的人物背影剪影，只有指甲盖大小，看不清脸和衣服。下半部分的地面也是旋转笔触，一路向前景铺开，前景到中景飞满许多小小的飞行物，越靠近镜头越大越清楚，颜色和主色形成撞色点缀。机位是略低的平视，透视向尽头强烈收束，纵深很深。光只来自隧道尽头，越往四周越暗，笔触边缘带一点光。色彩：主色占大面积，从尽头的浅亮色过渡到边缘的深色，飞行物是少量高饱和的撞色。颜料厚度和笔触方向都看得见，不要照片，不要 3D，不要平滑渐变，不要文字。安静，像走进一个晚上的梦。

New subject:
【主体】主色是金色麦浪：隧道四周是一圈圈金黄、琥珀、赭石的麦浪笔触，边缘压到深褐，尽头是暖白的光。飞的是许多小小的白色纸鹤，带一点淡蓝的影子。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 冬天的节气海报 x 照片拼版 x 提示词

傍晚发一套能直接拿去用的节气海报。上半是米白纸，下半一张照片，中间压一个蓝色大英文词，左边竖着一行红色手写，右下两个竖排的节气字。

四张是这一段的节气：小雪、立冬、大雪、冬至。每张三处字，大词 SNOW / WINTER / WHITE / NIGHT，一行手写，一个节气名，字都写进提示词里了，照抄不容易错。

换节气只改主体那段：照片拍什么、三处字写什么。照片里要有一根竖着的东西伸进纸面，电线杆、树、灯杆都行，版式就靠它撑着。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的日系杂志风海报，是实景照片加排版，不是插画。画面上半约 45% 是带细纸纹的米白色纸面，下半是一张实景摄影照片，照片和纸面之间是一条水平的直边分界。照片里有一个竖向的主体从下面一直伸进上半的纸面，伸出来的部分也保持照片质感，像海报的骨架。一个深青蓝色的粗体无衬线英文大词横排在画面中部偏右，正好压在纸面和照片的分界线上，字的下半截落在照片里。画面左侧有一行很大的砖红色英文手写花体，竖着沿左边从上往下写，笔画流畅，局部压在照片主体上。右下的照片区域里，两个米白色的大号汉字竖排，细黑体，干净醒目。照片是自然光，饱和度偏低，带一点胶片颗粒，天空通透。色彩只用米白、深青蓝、砖红三种加照片本身的颜色。文字只允许主体里指定的三处，必须逐字照写、拼写正确，不要多出别的字，不要日期、小字段落、网址、品牌和 logo。留白充足，安静，像一本冬天的杂志封面。

New subject:
【主体】小雪。照片是冬天田野边的一排芦苇和一根老木电线杆，芦苇顶上落着薄薄一层雪，天空是淡淡的蓝灰色，远处一条低低的山线。电线杆从照片底部伸进上方的纸面。文字三处：深青蓝粗体大词「SNOW」；砖红手写「a little snow today」；竖排汉字「小雪」。全图只有这三处文字。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
GPT2 x 眼睛里装着一个小世界 x 厚涂特写 x 提示词

下午三点半发一组特写。只画动物半边脸，一只大眼睛放在中间，眼珠里装着一个它自己的小世界，背景全黑，毛一缕一缕画出来。

四张换的是动物和它眼里的东西：狐狸眼里是下雪的松林，猫头鹰眼里是星空下的树林，小鹿眼里是枫林和小溪，野兔眼里是月光下的蒲公英。

脸一定要切掉一半，眼睛占三分之一左右才有冲击力。背景压黑，眼睛上那道白色高光别漏掉。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一张竖幅约 2:3 的数字厚涂特写插画。动物的半边脸从画面一侧压进来，出血裁切，只看得到一只眼睛、一部分鼻子和脸颊，眼睛放在画面中间偏上，又大又圆，约占画面三分之一。毛发用很多细长的笔触一缕一缕画出来，边缘松散，方向顺着脸的结构走，几根细白的胡须或长毛伸出画外。重点在眼睛：虹膜像一颗透亮的玻璃球，里面清楚地映出一个和这只动物有关的微缩小场景，场景有前后景和自己的光，眼睛上方有一道弧形的白色高光，下眼睑有一点湿润的反光。背景是接近纯黑的深色，和暖色毛发形成强烈的明暗对比，另一侧大面积留黑。光线是上方偏左的暖光，照亮额头和眼周，暗部沉进黑底。色彩：毛发以暖橙、焦糖、奶白为主，背景黑，眼里的小世界用它自己的颜色，是整张最精细、最亮的地方。笔触清楚，像平板上的厚涂，不要照片，不要 3D 毛发渲染，不要卡通大头，不要文字和签名。

New subject:
【主体】一只赤狐的半边脸，橙红色的毛，白色的脸颊和细长的白胡须。琥珀色的眼睛里映着一片正在下雪的松林，林间一条小路，路尽头一盏很小的暖灯。

模型：GPT Image 2.5

另外三张的提示词，评论区打 2 / 3 / 4 我发你。

posts.text:
Made with Token360 · GPT Image 2.5 Flare

Prompt 👇

Create a vertical 9:16 mixed-media editorial poster. A folded petrol-blue quilt is the dominant photographic object, its open fold forming a small sheltered reading nook on a pale cool-gray paper background. Preserve the quilt's recognizable shape, visible cotton fibers, stitched channels, soft thickness and believable weight. A single tiny illustrated adult in their forties sits inside the fold, knees comfortably bent, holding an open unlettered book. Their mustard cardigan, rust trousers and charcoal socks have delicate colored-pencil shading. Their face has mature proportions and a quietly absorbed expression.

The quilt remains photorealistic while the person remains visibly hand-drawn, with expressive graphite outlines, subtle warm skin shading and individual hair strokes. Do not turn the person into a rendered toy. The adult leans gently against the fabric wall; their feet rest on the lower quilt fold. Add coherent contact shadows and natural overlap where the drawing touches the real fibers. A loose thread at the fold gives scale without creating clutter.

Light the scene from the upper right with soft window light, cool shadows and restrained warm highlights. Retain clear separation between petrol blue, mustard, rust and the gray ground. Place the quilt in the lower two-thirds, with enough space above for the headline. Set "A SOFT CHAPTER" in slightly irregular handwritten lettering, then "A quiet place between the folds." in smaller handwriting. Include one subtle curved underline. These are the only words.

The image should read first as a real quilt, then reveal a small, comforting illustrated story. Keep the composition rich in tactile detail but organized around one object and one adult. No real brands, logos, watermarks, decorative icons, duplicate figures or invented publication marks. No childlike body proportions. Maintain believable perspective, shared lighting and clear hands holding the book.

—

Larus Canus

提示词：极简手绘纸质插图

将上传照片制作成3:4竖版上下双联艺术海报，上下严格各占50%。

上半部分完整保留原始照片，禁止重新绘制、修改人物、改变服装、改变动作或改变背景。

下半部分必须是上半部分同一场景的手绘插画版本。

【人物一致性】
严格保留原照片人物的面部轮廓、五官比例、发型、发色、表情、身体姿态和服装款式。允许将真实摄影转化为手绘线条和色块，但不得重新设计人物。

【插画风格】
日系复古极简手绘，粗细自然变化的炭黑色轮廓线，带有不完美的手绘笔触。局部使用淡彩水彩和复古平涂。

【色彩】
以原照片的主色调为基础，搭配芥末黄、复古蓝、炭黑色和奶油白。加入大型黄色英文字母，人物与字母自然穿插。

【背景】
奶油白粗纹纸质感，细腻印刷颗粒，大面积留白。

根据原照片内容自动生成简短英文标题和副标题。文字采用自然手写字体，搭配少量蓝色、黄色装饰线条。每张图片独立设计，不要机械复制固定版式。

上下两部分必须是同一人物、同一动作、同一场景。插画必须一眼能看出是原照片的艺术化重绘，而不是另一个相似的人。

禁止3D、动漫、光滑矢量、过度卡通化、人物变脸、服装改变、额外人物和无关装饰。

四张换的是画的东西：林子里的白鹿、开屏的孔雀、雪山日出、夜里的荷塘。海浪和太阳都不用了，光源每张自己定。不写字，也不要签名。

铅条要闭合，线别断，别让它变成一幅油画。玻璃要有透光感，亮部发白，暗部压深。

图1 提示词，直接复制：

Create an image with the following visual system. Replace the subject as specified.

Visual system (light, color, composition, medium, mood):
【画面风格】一幅竖幅约 9:16 的彩色玻璃镶嵌窗画。画面由几百块形状各异的玻璃片拼成，每块之间是细而有金属光泽的黄铜或金色铅条，铅条线流畅、闭合、不断线。玻璃是珠光和乳白的半透明质感：奶白、珍珠灰、青蓝、深海蓝为主，局部带琥珀金和一两颗彩色圆珠玻璃；光从画面后方透过来，亮部玻璃发暖白的光，暗部沉在深青蓝里，玻璃内部有云母一样的丝状纹理。画面中心偏上有一处最亮的发光点，光束像放射状的长玻璃条向外展开，几处有极小的星芒高光。局部用金色点状纹的细带做装饰边。不要照片、不要油画笔触、不要 3D 塑料感，不要文字和签名。浓郁、闪耀，晚上看像一扇亮着的高窗。

【主体】林间的一只白鹿，站在树干之间，树干是青蓝玻璃条，一束暖白的光从上方穿过树冠打在鹿身上，地面是铺着碎玻璃的苔地。鹿是乳白色，角带一点琥珀金。

一张九比十六竖版电影感生活摄影，平视三分之二身构图。一位完全虚构的四十岁东亚女性在雨天傍晚的小厨房准备晚饭。她留着深棕短发，穿深青色不透肤长袖棉衫、铁锈红帆布围裙和深灰长裤，没有首饰与妆面修饰。她专注地低头看锅，嘴角自然放松，身体微微侧向炉灶。

左手稳握黑色平底锅的长柄，右手用不锈钢长柄勺翻动锅中的南瓜块和蘑菇，锅保持水平，不抛锅、不让食物悬空。细微的蒸汽沿着锅沿升起，手指与工具接触合理。

厨房有旧木橱柜、灰蓝瓷砖与一扇挂着雨珠的小窗，台面只放洗净的蔬菜和一块叠好的擦布。窗外冷灰雨光与室内暖黄吊灯相互平衡，蒸汽边缘有柔和亮光，背景适度虚化。

五十毫米镜头，光圈二点零，轻微高光晕化与细腻胶片颗粒。保留皮肤自然纹理、围裙的粗棉织纹、锅的使用痕迹和可信的蒸汽。生活抓拍气质，不做时尚大片，不出现品牌、文字、水印、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮或三维渲染质感。

posts.text:
不拍照、不请模特，一个下午能不能做完一个服装品牌的 lookbook？👗

我们用 GPT Image 2.6 给一个虚构的小众品牌试了一下：同一个模特、同一套色调，换衣服换场景，最后连详情页也让它排。

定妆照、详情页和提示词都在下面 👇
posts.prompt:
怎么让 8 张图里是同一个人：

1. 先用文生图出 1 张定妆照（第一张），定下脸、发型和品牌色
2. 后面每张都拿它当参考图，只改衣服和场景
3. 最后把 8 张图一起交给 GPT Image 2.6，让它排成详情页（第二张），页面上的字也是它写的

———

① 定妆照（GPT Image 2.6 文生图，3:4，2K）

为一个虚构的极简中国女装品牌「SUYE 素野」拍一张 lookbook 时装照（天然亚麻、本色棉，燕麦色、鼠尾草绿和陶土色）。一位二十八九岁的中国女性，神情平静自然，黑色短发波波头，淡妆，站在阳光照进来的素色灰泥墙摄影棚里，旁边有一张木凳。她穿一件宽松的燕麦色亚麻衬衫裙，脚穿编织皮凉鞋。大窗户透进柔和日光，阴影柔和，胶片感调色，时尚杂志大片质感，全身，3:4 竖构图。不要文字，不要 logo，不要水印。

② 换装（GPT Image 2.6 图生图，参考图放定妆照，3:4，2K）

和参考图是同一位女性（脸、黑色短发波波头和平静自然的神情完全保持不变），为同一个虚构极简女装品牌拍一张新的 lookbook 照片（天然亚麻、本色棉，燕麦色、鼠尾草绿和陶土色）。傍晚时分，她走在金色麦田里，穿燕麦色亚麻短外套和同色 A 字长裙，肩上挎一只草编包，全身。柔和自然光，胶片感调色，时尚杂志大片质感，3:4 竖构图。不要文字，不要 logo，不要水印。

其他 6 张只换中间描写场景和衣服的那一句：
· 她站在灰砖墙的老石巷里，穿陶土色亚麻中长连衣裙，腰间系软带，手里抱一束牛皮纸包着的花。
· 她跪坐在安静茶室的矮木桌前倒茶，穿鼠尾草绿亚麻交领上衣和阔腿裤，四分之三侧面。
· 她站在海边礁石上，风吹起头发，穿白色宽松棉衬衫和本色亚麻阔腿裤，赤脚，全身，阴天柔光。
· 她走在竹林里，穿燕麦色亚麻马甲叠白 T 恤，配鼠尾草绿长裙，斑驳光影，全身。
· 她在清晨的集市上挑草编篮，穿陶土棕亚麻背带裙，里面是米白衬衫，抓拍瞬间。
· 黄昏时她倚在天台栏杆上，穿燕麦色粗针开衫，里面是米白亚麻吊带裙，背景是柔和的城市灯光，半身。

③ 详情页（GPT Image 2.6 图生图，参考图放上面 8 张，1:2，2K）

为一个虚构的极简中国女装品牌设计一张竖长的手机端电商详情页。把 8 张参考照片当作页面上的 lookbook 图：同一位模特、同样的衣服和场景，她的脸和衣服与参考图完全一致。暖奶油色背景（色值 F4EFE6），大量留白，优雅的细衬线字体配干净的无衬线字体，安静的日式/中式极简风格。
从上到下的布局：
1. 品牌头部：居中大字「SUYE 素野」，下面一行小字「2026 秋 · 亚麻与本色棉系列」。
2. 一张大幅主图（麦田那张）。
3. 栏目标题「新品 · 风吹过麦田的颜色」，配三个小圆色块，分别标「燕麦」「鼠尾草绿」「陶土棕」。
4. 其余 7 张照片排成网格，顺序为：摄影棚衬衫裙、石巷连衣裙、茶室套装、海边衬衫、竹林马甲、集市背带裙、天台开衫，每张下面用小字写商品名和价格：「亚麻衬衫裙 ¥459」「陶土棕系带连衣裙 ¥529」「鼠尾草绿交领套装 ¥689」「白棉衬衫 ¥329」「燕麦马甲 ¥299」「背带裙 ¥399」「粗针开衫 ¥569」。
5. 一条细分隔线，底部一行小字「虚构品牌 · 仅作演示」。
所有中文严格按给出的字渲染，清晰正确，不要其他文字，不要 logo，不要水印。

（图是用英文原版提示词跑的，这里译成了中文）

Photorealistic fashion editorial with the atmosphere of a winter morning in early 1990s northern China, inside an old state-run work-unit residential compound. She holds a small bouquet of dried wildflowers wrapped in vintage brown kraft paper, gently gripping it with both hands in front of her thighs.

She wears an oversized charcoal wool coat, a soft ivory knitted scarf, a dark burgundy ribbed sweater, straight dark trousers and black leather winter boots. Loose straight black hair falls naturally around her face, a few strands lifted by the freezing wind. Flushed cheeks from the cold, minimal makeup, a thoughtful expression, her gaze drifting slightly past the camera, shoulders gently raised against the chill.

In the distance, blurred red-brick socialist-style apartment blocks and a modest rusted bus shelter. Fine snowflakes drifting in the air, visible white breath. The delicate dried flowers add a subtle warm color accent against the muted cold winter surroundings.

Three-quarter portrait framed from the knees up, eye-level camera, woman placed off-center, the bus filling one side of the frame. Cold overcast northern daylight paired with direct on-camera flash, crisp well-lit face, deep darker background, subtle analog film grain, restrained desaturated colors, candid early-1990s Chinese street photography crossed with luxury fashion editorial. Real skin texture, tactile soft wool, believable hands and a believable kraft-paper bouquet, shot on a 50mm lens, vertical 3:4 composition. posts.text:
Same prompt. No reference image. Three models.

We gave one fixed character description — our photoreal cast member, defined only in words — to GPT (gpt-image-2), Seedream 5.0 Pro and P-H3-Image (open weights), n=3 each. Full prompt in the reply.

1. Seedream landed closest to the registered face. Also the most "Seedream": sharp, glossy, polished until she reads like a realistic 3D game character from a distance. Its definition of beauty is strong, and it pulls every face toward it.

2. GPT drew the softest face of the three — and the most real one. Polished, but she reads as an actual actress, not a render.

3. P-H3 kept the signature burgundy bob 3/3, but the face drifted: rounder eyes, freckles that are not in the spec, a different girl in draw 3. The hosted 1K output also looked grainy; the same model self-hosted at native resolution came out clean. The grain was the serving, not the model. The gloss stayed on both — that one is the model.

Lesson: a text-only identity is an interpretation, not a transfer. Each model reads the same words through its own definition of beauty. If you want your girl on a given model, carry her with a reference — or learn that model's dialect.

提示词：
一幅9:16竖向构图的写实东方古风女性环境人像。画面中只有一位年轻成年东亚女性，她穿着淡青白色花卉纹样交领汉服，坐在被深蓝青色水面与垂落树枝包围的自然环境中。身体微微向前倾斜，一只手朝镜头左下方伸出，另一只手自然抬至脸颊附近。黑色长发被侧风吹向画面左侧，人物的脸庞被穿过树叶的斑驳日光局部照亮，形成安静、朦胧而具有真实瞬间感的古风摄影画面。

女性拥有柔和的鹅蛋形面容，深棕黑色眼睛，自然细长的眉毛，平缓的鼻梁，小巧的鼻尖，轮廓柔和的嘴唇和自然白皙的皮肤。面部比例写实，没有夸张的动漫式五官。双眼微微眯起，视线略微向画面右侧偏移，没有正面直视镜头。嘴唇轻轻闭合，表情平静、内敛，带有若有所思的神态。脸部并非完全被均匀照亮，而是保留树叶阴影与明亮局部光斑交错的自然明暗变化。鼻梁、脸颊、眼周与下颌呈现细微的皮肤质感和柔和的立体转折。

她拥有浓密的自然黑色长发，头发没有整理成严密整齐的发髻，而是在后脑偏低处松散盘绕成低髻，发髻轮廓圆润且略微蓬松。额前留有不规则碎刘海，几缕细长发丝垂落在眉眼、鼻梁及脸颊前方。明显的侧向风将左侧的大量长发丝水平吹向画面左边缘，发丝彼此分离，形成细长、轻盈且略带动态模糊的线条。耳侧与后颈附近有松散的弧形发束，发型保留随风凌乱的自然状态，不添加醒目的发冠和华丽首饰。

她身穿一套以浅青色、灰蓝色和乳白色为主的传统交领汉服。领口左右交叠，内层领缘具有细密的浅色植物花纹，外层衣襟带有略深的青灰色滚边。衣身宽松，腰部通过交叠衣料和柔软系带形成自然收束。衣服表面分布精致而稀疏的浅蓝色植物纹样、细小枝叶和淡黄、浅橘、柔粉色花卉装饰，纹样不规则地散布在布料上，既不是大面积艳丽印花，也不是纯色无纹织物。

汉服袖子极为宽大，尤其是画面右侧的长袖，从抬起的手腕附近沿垂直方向自然下坠，形成宽阔、飘逸、带有连续褶皱的布料形状。袖口内侧露出柔软的衣料层次，袖子受到重力牵引，在手肘下方出现密集而自然的纵向褶皱。左侧衣袖顺着伸向镜头的手臂向前延伸，接近画面左下方时因景深而逐渐模糊。裙身和下摆大量堆叠在人物屈起的腿部周围，形成复杂的层层布料起伏，衣摆延伸至画幅下边缘并被自然裁切。

人物坐在靠近水面的位置，躯干略微朝镜头倾斜，肩膀自然放松。画面左侧的手臂从身体前侧伸向近镜头的左下方，产生明显的透视缩短，手掌松弛地向前伸展，手指自然分开，接近镜头的手部处于浅景深虚化区域。画面右侧的手臂弯曲抬起，手腕靠近下巴与脸颊，手指轻轻弯曲并悬停在脸旁，附近有几根纤细的树枝。两只手的动作不对称，呈现一个没有刻意摆正身体的自然瞬间。双腿大部分被宽大的裙摆遮盖，不刻意暴露完整腿部结构。

画面背景是一片幽深、安静的蓝青色自然水域，人物身后与身体右侧存在带有细小波纹的水面，水面反射暗青色、灰蓝色和局部浅蓝色环境光。背景上半部有被虚化的枝叶、深色树干轮廓以及不规则的蓝色光斑，无法清晰辨认远处的景物。画面右侧垂落着几束细长藤条、细枝和稀疏的绿色叶片，局部叶缘受到日光照射，出现细小的亮色高光。

摄影机通过深色树叶与枝条之间的间隙观察人物。画面最上方有大片虚焦的深墨绿枝叶，形成不规则的暗色遮挡；画面下方与左下角同样存在靠近镜头的模糊枝条、树叶和细藤。部分深色枝叶横向穿越画面下半部，遮挡少量裙摆，使人物仿佛被周围植被自然包围。前景遮挡保留真实的不规则边缘，不采用均匀对称的装饰性框架。

提示词👇：
一张极具电影质感的真人摄影风格特写肖像，画面主体是一位年轻的亚洲女性剑客。她位于画面正中央，占据绝大部分画幅，呈现胸部以上的近景特写。人物面朝镜头，头部微低，目光锐利而坚定地直视观看者，眼神中透出冷峻与杀气。她的面部轮廓清晰，鼻梁挺直，嘴唇微张，唇色自然偏红，皮肤保留真实的纹理与细腻的毛孔，脸颊和鼻尖带有微弱的汗光与灰尘痕迹。头发为深黑色，盘成略显凌乱的古风发髻，几缕碎发被风吹散，横跨在脸颊和额前，发丝间夹杂着细小的沙尘与光斑。头顶可见红绳与发簪的局部，发簪末端隐入画外。

她身穿深红色与暗黑色交织的粗粝战袍，衣料具有厚重的织物纹理，领口交叠，内衬为灰白色，边缘磨损。胸前斜挎着红色的编织绳结，绳结顺着衣襟垂落。画面左侧，一把带有暗色刀鞘和金色菱形装饰的长刀斜向入镜，刀柄部分被她的身体和衣物遮挡，刀身占据左侧边缘，形成强烈的对角线构图。她的双手未在画面中完全显露，仅可见手臂部分被衣袖包裹，处于持刀或戒备的姿态。

背景是混沌的灰蓝色与土黄色交织的战场环境，充满飞扬的尘土、碎屑和火星。画面右侧和下方有大量橙黄色的火星与光点在空中飘浮，部分火星靠近她的脸颊和发丝，形成暖色的点缀。主光源来自画面左上方，强烈的侧逆光勾勒出她面部的左侧轮廓、鼻梁高光以及发丝的边缘，右侧面部则处于柔和的阴影中，保留了眼窝和下颌的暗部结构。光线在红色的衣料上形成明暗交错的褶皱反光，金属刀鞘的凸起边缘反射出冷硬的高光。整体色调以暗红、灰蓝和暖橙为主，画面带有强烈的空气透视感，尘埃粒子在光束中清晰可见，呈现出一种紧张、肃杀且充满故事感的武侠氛围。

提示词👇：
blend of film photography and authentic photographic techniques, crafting a retro yet surreal artistic style, showcasing a breathtakingly gorgeous woman set against a dark-toned background. She wears long, voluminous dark-brown wavy hair and loose red garments, leaning against a wall in a languid pose with strands of hair drifting gently in the air. Soft side lighting and side backlight gild her hair strands with shimmering golden radiance; fill light on her face accentuates her three-dimensional facial features and oval duck-egg shaped face. Beneath her refined makeup, her stunning eyes with long eyelashes hold tender, amorous glances.

The shot adopts an unconventional asymmetrical perspective. Her face stays sharply in focus, while the foreground and background fall soft and blurred, layered with motion blur and focus blur. The palette carries pale tints wrapped in luminous haze and dim shadow haze, marked by prominent film grain with washed-out pale bloom, faded tones and light leakage. Dramatic contrast between light and shadow prevails, with dappled light spots spilling over her cheeks, building a quiet, literary and aloof atmosphere, as if she is immersed in peaceful solitude with fully amplified emotional resonance.

Rich cinematography brings marvelous visual effects of mapping, reflection and refraction, steeped in hazy aesthetics. Brilliantly composed, this is a cinematic masterpiece brimming with conceptual art and sophisticated elegance, rendered at 32K ultra-high resolution. It captures exquisitely lifelike human skin texture at 32K, delivering the immersive, on-site feel of an emotional portrait, with abundant, freehand visual layers.

A nineteen-year-old Eastern beauty with a pointed chin and youthful babyface following balanced three-section and five-eye facial proportions. Straight black long hair spills over both shoulders; several wispy strands brush across her face, with the hair retaining natural fluffiness and soft drape. She has a petite frame, cool pale porcelain skin that looks tender and dewy, a trending internet aesthetic face, random makeup and delicate accessories, captured in a spontaneous pose. Overall she is a stunning internet celebrity radiating pure allure, idol charisma and sweet charm, placed within a scene of muted Morandi color palette in sweet maiden style. Side lighting catches messy, floating strands of hair, shot from a random camera angle with lazy and playful vibes. Fine rendering strokes bring out beauty with one-of-a-kind charm.

iOS 系統Emoji × 顏文字× 全新表情設計

posts.prompt:
iOS 系统Emoji × 颜文字× 全新表情设计

每张独立选择两个或多个不同的 Emoji 或颜文字进行融合，开放探索人物、动物、食物、物件、自然元素与各种情绪。

整组变化来源类别与组合方式，探索 Emoji 与 Emoji、Emoji 与颜文字、多个颜文字等不同搭配，让颜文字多次参与融合。每张选择不同组合与心情，减少主体和表达重复。

先确定本张的融合配方，提取各来源最有辨识度的五官、神态、轮廓、动作或字符特征，将它们融合成一个完整的新表情，表达一种有趣的情绪或状态。

根据来源自身形态设计结果：脸部表情重点融合五官与神态；带手势或全身形态的表情保留有助于识别的身体结构；动物、物件和自然元素保留关键外形；颜文字的眼睛、嘴巴、符号或字符排列自然融入新表情。身体、四肢与动作由组合和表达需要决定。

融合结果保持简洁的表情图标感，以主体轮廓和关键特征传达心情，细节适度，缩小后仍清晰可辨。

画面从上到下展示融合公式：上方用「×」连接所选来源，中间将「＝」旋转90°，呈现为两条并排的细竖线，下方展示融合后的新表情。新表情明显大于来源，是画面的视觉重点。

公式中的 Emoji 参照 iOS 系统对应表情的外观，保留容易辨认的造型、颜色、神态与动作。公式中的颜文字以清晰字符原样呈现，保持所选字符及排列完整。

融合后的新表情采用与 iOS Emoji 协调的视觉风格：造型简洁圆润，表情鲜明，色彩饱满，具有柔和渐变、细腻高光与轻微立体感。人物、动物与物件保留各自适合的形态，整体如同同一套系统表情。

根据新表情的情绪与主体配色，自由选择协调的低饱和渐变背景，在新表情后方加入柔和的主题色光晕。光晕与主体保持适当的明度或色相差异，让表情轮廓清楚可辨。

在新表情附近写一句简短自然的中文心情短句，准确表达融合后的意思。字体形态与笔画气质呼应情绪，文字完整清晰，与表情和公式保持适当间距。

公式符号、颜文字与背景保持足够对比。画面疏密协调，留白自然。

竖版 9:16，n=10。每张为独立单图，逐张生成，不拼图。

左下签名：深蓝色实心圆点在前，白色手写体 DeepBlue 在后

在中央巨兽左侧，一只狼与怪物潮并行奔跑，体型明显小于巨兽，毛色偏灰黄，神态警觉，增强了尺度对比与叙事感。画面前景遍布大量密集的小型虫怪与蛛形怪，贴地快速爬行，外壳粗糙、肢体尖锐，部分前景生物被近距离放大并略微虚焦。画面左侧前景有一只超近距离的大型甲壳怪物被裁切进入画面，只露出局部身体和肢体，形成强烈压迫感与前景遮挡式构图。中景与远景中还分布着多只同类巨型角兽，正在成群推进。天空中密布无数飞虫，在高空与雾尘中盘旋飞舞，形成遮天蔽日的灾厄感。

环境是被黄沙、尘暴和体积光笼罩的荒原或废墟边缘，远处隐约可见朦胧的巨大建筑、残骸或城池轮廓，但被光雾和沙尘大幅吞没。主光来自画面右后上方，强烈暖白色日光穿过尘埃，形成大面积体积散射和逆光边缘辉光，整体色调为沙土米黄、暖灰、尘雾白、铁锈棕和深褐色，低饱和、电影化、压抑而宏大。画面具有清晰的前中后景层次：前景虫群，中景主角巨兽与狼，远景巨兽军团和飞虫群。镜头具有广角电影感，空间纵深明显，近大远小强烈，快门定格冲锋瞬间，但保留扬尘、飞沙和空气颗粒带来的动态气氛。

超写实怪物概念艺术，电影视觉特效质感，史诗级灾难场面，末日奇幻，体积光，沙尘暴氛围，细节丰富的甲壳与角质材质，强烈规模感，压迫感极强，像电影预告片中的关键一帧。

posts.text:
📰 #imNEWS: @OpenAI is rolling out Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, with generation about 50% faster plus native GIFs. People are already making 4 billion images a week on those surfaces. For marketers, the pitch is quicker product shots, tighter brand consistency on edits, and looping mascots without jumping to a video tool.

🔑 3 Key Takeaways

① Speed split: Flare vs Sunburst
In the API, GPT-Image-2.6 Flare is the fast lane. At low quality it can return an image in about six seconds and it is stronger on posters and product layouts. GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst is the quality lane, with tighter consistency across edits at medium or high quality.

② GIFs are now a first-class output
You can animate a brand mascot, turn a still product shot into a loop, or storyboard character motion before you shoot video. Town used the API to test animated characters in workplace product UX.

③ Markup, SVG, and a complexity knob
Image markup lands in the API so you can point at the exact region to change. SVG export is in for web, apps, and print. A new complexity setting controls how much planning the model does. OpenAI says keep complexity low for most edits and raise it only when the scene is packed with constraints.

✅ Action Item
If you sell with images, run one product SKU through Flare at low quality for speed, then the same prompt through Sunburst at medium. Save both. Next, ask for a 3-6 frame looping GIF of your mascot or hero product and check whether it stays on brand without a designer pass. That tells you if Images 2.6 belongs in your weekly creative workflow this month.

Source:

posts.author: AJMorales73
posts.text:
Crea esta hermosa ilustración en Google Nano Banana 2.1 

Prompt:

Convierte toda la fotografía subida en una ilustración de dibujos animados en 2D, colorida, limpia y hecha a mano. Conserva la composición original, el ángulo de la cámara, las poses, las expresiones faciales, las identidades reconocibles, los peinados, la ropa, los accesorios y todos los elementos importantes del fondo.

ESTILO DE LA ILUSTRACIÓN:
- Contornos negros limpios con un grosor de línea ligeramente variable, como si estuvieran dibujados a mano.
- Colores pastel planos con un sombreado tipo cel shading mínimo.
- Personajes simplificados con proporciones adorables, rostros expresivos y poses naturales.
- Líneas suaves, ligeramente imperfectas, para conseguir un aspecto ilustrado auténtico.
- Simplifica las texturas realistas convirtiéndolas en formas limpias, sin perder los detalles reconocibles.
- Recrea el entorno original, incluidos edificios, árboles, fuentes, caminos y otros objetos, utilizando el mismo estilo de dibujos animados.
- Utiliza una paleta de colores pastel suaves, con cielos azul claro, verdes apagados, tonos de piel cálidos y delicados matices rosados.
- Añade detalles artísticos sutiles, manteniendo la atmósfera de la escena original.

CONSERVAR LA IMAGEN ORIGINAL:

Mantén el mismo número de personas, sus posiciones, las proporciones corporales, los colores de la ropa, las interacciones y los tamaños relativos. Conserva la distribución del fondo original y su perspectiva. No añadas, elimines ni cambies de posición ningún objeto importante.

REQUISITOS DEL RESULTADO:

Una ilustración 2D pulida, que ocupe todo el encuadre, con contornos uniformes, colores planos y una estética alegre, propia de un libro de cuentos ilustrado. Toda la imagen debe estar ilustrada, sin ningún elemento fotorrealista.

EVITAR: Renderizados en 3D, fotorrealismo, sombreado excesivo, texturas de acuarela, líneas borrosas, rostros deformados, dedos o extremidades adicionales, cambios de vestuario, poses modificadas, detalles del fondo omitidos y texto o marcas de agua no deseados.

Relación de aspecto: Reproduce exactamente la de la fotografía subida.

Consejo profesional: Sube una fotografía cada vez y utiliza este mismo prompt para transformar distintas fotografías con el fin de mantener un estilo de dibujos animados uniforme y coherente.

Use the Pose and compose the image according to the Shot Type, keeping the entire costume visible with believable adult proportions. posts.text:
Made with  Nano Banana 2.1

This poster works because the phone stays identical. Only the environment changes.
🧊`identical hero smartphone across all four quadrants, crisp 2x2 grid, oversized vertical product, athlete secondary` This makes it read as one product system, not four separate ads.
🍊`salt droplets, drying mud, red mineral dust, cold spray beads on the same industrial form` This shows durability through precise traces, while keeping the phone premium and controlled.

Nano Banana 2.1 prompt👇
A Cannes-level commercial poster for the fictional rugged-tech brand TERRAVAULT, designed as a product-first four-environment performance campaign. Fuse cinematic environmental storytelling, collector-grade industrial precision, and graphic restraint. Preserve a perfectly divided 2x2 grid with four saturated monochrome fields, four miniature terrain stages, four extreme-sport athletes, a central TERRAVAULT wordmark crossing the seam, and a row of compact capability icons. The same TERRAVAULT ultra-rugged smartphone must remain the undisputed hero in all four panels, dominating water, mud, dust, and whitewater impact scenarios.

Use a square poster split into four exact quadrants with crisp boundaries. Top-left: vivid ocean cyan. Top-right: mineral amber-gold. Bottom-left: ember red-orange. Bottom-right: deep river blue. In every quadrant, the same oversized vertical TERRAVAULT phone rises from or is embedded in a micro-terrain pedestal, while one athlete stays clearly secondary in scale. Across the central seam, place a large custom white TERRAVAULT wordmark, perfectly centered. Above or below it, align four compact square icons for water, mud, dust, and impact resistance. The read must be immediate: product first, environment second, athlete third.

TERRAVAULT is a luxury expedition-grade rugged smartphone with a black titanium frame, matte ceramic back, reinforced corners, precision gasket seams, anti-slip side texture, a subtly raised lens housing, armored bevel transitions, and a refined industrial silhouette that feels premium, not utilitarian. The design must stay identical across all four quadrants, with each environment adding only specific traces: sea droplets and salt sheen in surf, drying clay and root-stained mud in trail, warm mineral dust and red grit in motocross, and cold spray beads with wet rock reflections in paddle.

Quadrant staging: top-left shows a female surfer on a shallow ocean-water stage with a curling wave behind her and the phone rising like a dark monolith from wet sand and surf. My Spotify Wrapped is a crime scene. 😅

Heavy metal. Hip hop. Dance club.

Most people think AI image generators can't keep your actual face consistent across a complex scene.

They are wrong. 🚫

Gemini's new Nano Banana 2.1 just dropped inside Magai. It takes a single selfie and turns you into a photorealistic IMAX concert poster. Three completely different versions of you. One frame. Zero weird AI faces. ✅

You have to try this. It takes 30 seconds:

1. Open Magai with the "Auto" model selected.
2. Upload 1 clear photo of your face.
3. Copy, paste, and fill in the brackets in this prompt: 👇

"Use Nano Banana 2.1 to create a hyper-stylized, ultra-photorealistic 4:5 vertical Rolling Stone and IMAX concert movie poster featuring 3 distinct versions of the person from the attached reference photo, shot as a high-budget commercial photography composite on a Hasselblad H6D-100c medium-format camera with an 80mm f/2.8 lens. Preserve their exact real-life facial identity, natural skin texture, eyes, and hair across all 3 figures, with a heavily muscular, jacked, athletic physique, broad shoulders, thick chest, and sculpted arms. At the top, integrate sleek 3D brushed-chrome movie-poster title typography reading "[YOUR NAME]", and at the bottom a clean festival billing block reading "[GENRE 1] | [GENRE 2] | [GENRE 3]". Pure photographic realism, tactile fabric weaves, zero illustration."

Drop your poster in the comments. I want to see your lineup. ⬇
 
P.S. Extra prompting MAY be required to get you looking as jacked as my heavy metal variant. 🤣

Cold, damp, bleak, suffocating and empty.

Lighting: natural flat overcast daylight only, very low contrast, no shadows, no rim light, no glow. Color palette: dull, washed-out, desaturated greys and muddy browns, like a real cloudy morning.

Photo quality: a degraded, low-quality amateur image, like a blurry frame from an old low-resolution video or a photo from a cheap old phone. - mercenary
- foot soldier

[ARMOR]
- dull scratched steel plate armor over chainmail
- rusty, worn brigandine and mismatched plates
- old dented plate armor with a dirty tattered surcoat

[ARMOR DETAIL]

- a faded dark red cloak, wet and dirty at the edges

[HELMET]

- He wears a rusty bascinet helmet with a chainmail aventail covering the neck and jaw, head bowed

[TERRAIN]
- a flat, treeless, muddy plowed field
- a bare, empty, frost-burnt stubble field
- a wide, flat, empty grass field with patches of dirt

[STORY CLUE]
- A broken wooden cart wheel lies half-buried in the fog behind him
- A few crows stand in the mud nearby, barely visible in the fog
- A torn old banner lies on the ground to the side, half-swallowed by fog
